title: DHL Freight söker: Terminalarbetare timanstäld, TBO Karlstad
description:
På DHL arbetar vi med att få våra kunders vardag att fungera. Som ett av de ledande företagen i världen inom logistik, ser vi till att våra kunder får leverans av varor och material. Utan transporter stannar samhället, vi har ett viktigt uppdrag - Förena människor, förbättra liv. Som medarbetare hos oss är du en viktig nyckelspelare.

Arbetsuppgifter och ansvar

Vad roligt att du är intresserad av arbete hos oss!

Dina arbetsuppgifter som terminalarbetare innebär att utföra terminalhantering av sändningar såsom lastning, lossning, truckning, scanning och kontroll av gods. Vi strävar alltid efter att förbättra service, produktivitet och processefterlevnad.

Profil & Bakgrund

För att lyckas i den här rollen ser vi att du har:

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
  • Har en truckutbildning enligt TLP10 och minst får köra truck typerna A2-4 & B1
  • Har god datorvana
  • Meriterande om du har erfarenhet inom transport/logistik

Nedan kännetecknar dig som person:

  • Älskar utmaningar och har ambitioner
  • Visar engagemang och uthållighet
  • Är strukturerad och resultatorienterad
  • Brinner för att kollegor och kunder är nöjda
  • Kommunicerar väl och är tydlig samt gillar att jobba i ett team

Återkoppling på ansökan

Vi söker löpande nya stjärnor till våra behovsanställningar. När vi har ett behov så kommer vi att titta på din ansökan och om din bakgrund matchar vad vi söker, så kontaktar vi dig. Vi ber om förståelse för att vi endast kan kontakta de sökande som går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen. Om du inte blir kontaktad för nästa steg i rekryteringsprocessen kommer din ansökan och tillhörande dokument, per automatik, att raderas efter 6 månader. Om du önskar att bli borttagen innan dess ber vi dig kontakta anna.lundberg@dhl.com.

Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta Supervisor Anna Lundberg vid frågor.

Tjänsten är placerad i Karlstad.

Vad erbjuder vi dig?

Vi på DHL trivs och många av oss har jobbat här länge. Vi är ett företag som ser våra medarbetares utveckling och potential – vi vågar satsa på våra medarbetare! I det stora globala, och internationella bolaget som vi är, har vi en härlig teamkänsla med familjär stämning där vi respekterar varandra. Här finns mycket medarbetarengagemang samt humor och vi tycker om att fira våra framgångar. Vi är certifierade i Top Employer och Great Place to Work vilket innebär att vi är en arbetsgivare som erbjuder den bästa arbetsmiljön för medarbetare att utvecklas både professionellt och personligt. Miljö och hållbarhet är viktigt för oss, vi arbetar ständigt med att utvecklas för att ligga i framkant, vilket uppmärksammas och ger resultat. Vi tar ansvar och blev bland annat utsedda till branschvinnare av Sustainable Brand Index B2B för tredje året i rad.

Vill du också vara med? Varmt välkommen med din spontanansökan!

Häng med oss bakom kulisserna, följ oss på Instagram

Eller kika närmare på DHL - vårt varumärke, DHL Freight - globalt eller DHL Freight Sverige

Enligt EU-direktiv (2009/52/EG) måste vi som arbetsgivare kunna påvisa våra medarbetares rättighet att arbeta inom EU. Vid en anställning på DHL måste du därför kunna uppvisa din rätt att arbeta inom EU genom medborgarskap (exempelvis pass) eller i annat fall uppvisa ditt arbetstillstånd. Vi genomför bakgrundskontroller på alla våra slutkandidater.

title: Vi opnormerer i klinik 1. Socialrådgiver med lyst til at arbejde i Psykiatrien søges til Klinik 1 – Afdeling for Psykoser, Psykiatrien, AUH
description:
Er du socialrådgiver med stærke faglige kompetencer indenfor det psykiatriske arbejdsfelt, med lyst til at arbejde i et stærkt tværfagligt miljø? Så kan du være den kollega vi søger til at være en del af vores Klinik.

Vi søger en selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst socialrådgiver, med stærke faglige kompetencer indenfor det psykiatriske arbejdsfelt, med overblik og lyst til at have det tværfaglige samarbejde i fokus.

Hvad laver vi i klinik 1?

Vi er en klinik under Afdeling for Psykoser som behandler ambulant behandling af patienter med skizofreni, psykoser, mental retardering, demens og organiske lidelser. Vi arbejder i fire teams, tre FACT-teams med psykosepatienter og et organisk-team. Vi har ca. 1200 patienter i behandling. De sociale problemer er mange, hvilket stiller forventning til dig, om en bred socialfaglig baggrund. Stillingen bliver forankret i et af vores FACT-teams. Teamet består af læger, sygeplejersker, psykologer, recoverymentorer, fysioterapeut og sekretærer, for tværfaglig tilgang er vigtig for denne udsatte patientgruppe.

Dine opgaver vil være

  • at være rådgivende, støttende og hjælpende for behandlerne i to af vores teams, f.eks. ved konferencer og morgenmøder
  • i samarbejde med behandlerne at lave ansøgninger f.eks. til bostøtte ol.
  • at deltage i og selvstændigt have samtaler med patienter om deres sociale problemer
  • at hjælpe og rådgive patienterne til udredning og bedring af deres sociale situation, herunder forhold der drejer sig om forsørgelse, beskæftigelse, bolig og familieforhold
  • at samarbejde tæt med patienternes myndighedsrådgivere og handlekommuner
  • primært at være tilknyttet Klinik 1, men i ferier og andre fraværsperioder, skal du sammen med afsnittets andre socialrådgivere, løse opgaver på tværs i hele afdelingen
  • at holde sig lov og praksismæssig orienteret
  • at deltage i supervision med dine fag-faglige kollegaer
  • samarbejde med behandlerne omkring udfærdigelse af statusattester ol.

Vi forventer du

  • er uddannet socialrådgiver, gerne med min. tre års erfaring fra en myndighedsafdeling i kommunen og/eller Kriminalforsorgen
  • har lyst og evne til at samarbejde på tværs af myndigheder og faggrupper
  • har bred viden om de lovgivningsmæssige rammer, både fra lov om socialservice og beskæftigelseslovgivningen
  • har erfaring med arbejde med patienter med dom til behandling
  • formulerer dig godt, både spå skrift og i tale
  • kan planlægge og styre møder
  • kan vejlede borgere uden at overtage deres opgaver og har en rehabiliterende tilgang
  • er vedholdende og målrettet i opgaveløsningen
  • er kreativ, nytænkende og fleksibel i opgaveløsningen
  • er robust og har et godt humør
  • kan strukturere og planlægge dine egne opgaver
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt i en afdeling med meget tværfaglighed
  • har kendskab til socialpsykiatrien
  • er handlekraftig.

Om Afdeling for Psykoser

Afdeling for Psykoser er en del af Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien. Afdelingen har lidt over 300 medarbejdere med forskellige faglige baggrunde. Den ledes af en cheflæge og chefsygeplejerske. Afdelingen består af tre alment psykiatriske sengeafsnit, et rehabiliteringsafsnit, tre ambulante kliniker samt en forskningsenhed.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børne- og straffeattest.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte oversygeplejerske Jette Nielsen på telefon 8174 6525 eller socialrådgiver Camilla Svensgaard på telefon 2480 1945.

Ansøgningsfrist for stillingen er d. 29. september 2026 og ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt d. 6. oktober 2026 mellem kl. 8.00-12.00.

Tiltrædelse d. 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale. Stillingen er en fast stilling, og som udgangspunkt 37 timer pr. uge.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Multi-Media Journalist (Ireland) - Racing Post
description:
Spotlight Sports Group is a global media and technology company with a clear purpose, to set the standard for trusted, customer-driven experiences across global racing and sports betting. Guided by our mission to create experiences that fans love, we combine more than 40 years of heritage with bold innovation to deliver award-winning content, data and digital products. With over 400 employees worldwide, our portfolio includes Racing Post, Pickswise, myracing and Free Super Tips, as well as the international marketing agency ICS-digital and ICS-translate. Together, we partner with leading operators, affiliates and media groups to power growth and engagement across the industry.

The Racing Post is looking for an ambitious, creative journalist with a passion for telling Irish racing's stories across video, social and digital formats, and who is as comfortable appearing on camera or editing short-form video clips as they are filing 500 words of news copy.

The role combines written racing journalism – news reporting, race previews and reports, feature writing – with a strong emphasis on video and social-first content for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and X. We want someone who understands how audiences consume content on digital and social platforms and is excited about building new formats alongside the core editorial work of a busy racing desk.

This is a junior position suited to someone at the start of their career or with limited professional experience who has a genuine feel for visual storytelling and an enthusiasm for horseracing.

What you'll do:

  • Create and star in video content for social platforms and YouTube, including shortform clips, social-native formats and contributions to Racing Post shows, both on camera and behind it
  • Attend race meetings and other events to produce video and written content on the ground
  • Write news, features, race previews and reports
  • Develop and pitch ideas for new video and social-first formats that grow our audience on digital platforms
  • Monitor racing and betting news daily and identify stories with visual or social potential
  • Work closely with the Ireland editor and the wider editorial team, in particular the Video and Audience teams, to ensure content reaches the right audiences in the right formats

Requirements

Essential

  • Good knowledge of horseracing and betting
  • Experience of creating video or social-first content – a personal portfolio, active social channels or professional work all count
  • Strong written communication and an instinct for storytelling across formats
  • Comfort appearing on camera and ability to communicate with confidence and flair
  • Understanding of social platforms – what performs, why, and how to create for them
  • Ability to work quickly and accurately under pressure
  • Willingness to work weekends and bank holidays across a seven-day rota

Desirable

  • Experience in a newsroom or digital publishing environment
  • Video editing skills
  • A personal track record of building an audience on social platforms
  • A full, clean driving licence

Benefits

We offer a range of well-being initiatives, including private medical insurance, excellent parental leave, a working globally policy, mental health support, assistance programs, and social gatherings. We also provide a pension scheme and various other benefit schemes. Plus, we all get our birthdays off work and enjoy 25 days of holiday per year.

We’ve also got you covered with life assurance and exclusive perks like the Star card and our Step Further Awards (our employee recognition program) to recognise your dedication. For those working via the hybrid model (in the office and at home) we’ve made commuting easier with our Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme.

You can also take advantage of complimentary access to our Racing Post Members Club, complete with an Ultimate Membership. We believe in making a positive impact beyond the workplace, and you'll have the chance to volunteer two days per year with our charity partner.

title: Specialist, Risk Management
description:
Summary

In this role, the Risk Management Specialist III will support and strengthen our risk management and information security programs. You’ll help ensure the organization maintains effective protections across regulatory, contractual, and data privacy requirements while partnering cross-functionally to identify, assess, and mitigate risk.

You’ll contribute to key initiatives including information security, vendor and project risk assessments, compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001), and policy development, helping to drive continuous improvement and operational maturity. This role offers the opportunity to build hands-on experience in a collaborative environment while acting as a trusted partner to stakeholders across Lega, ICT, and the broader business.

Requirements

Scope & Responsibilities

Information Security

  • Supports the deployment and continuous improvement of information security policies, standards, and technical controls
  • Coordinates Prosci’s ISO 27001:2022 certification and audit activities, including audit scheduling, evidence collection, and external auditor coordination
  • Administers compliance tooling (e.g., Vanta) to support the information security program and control monitoring
  • Facilitates ISMS Governance Council activities, including maintaining the enterprise risk register and reporting on risk posture
  • Conducts information security risk assessments for vendors, projects, and business changes
  • Tracks, reports, and supports remediation of identified control gaps and audit findings
  • Defines and monitors information security metrics to measure program effectiveness and progress
  • Serves as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, partnering cross-functionally to support secure business practices

Data Privacy

  • Supports the implementation and ongoing management of Prosci’s global data privacy program
  • Ensures alignment with applicable global privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, LGPD) and monitors compliance across business practices
  • Partners with Legal and internal stakeholders to interpret and apply privacy requirements to business operations
  • Coordinates data subject request (DSR) processes and response activities
  • Maintains internal privacy policies and external privacy notices
  • Supports employee privacy training and awareness initiatives

PCI Compliance

  • Supports the PCI DSS compliance program for outsourced, card-not-present payments under SAQ A scope.
  • Maintains documentation of PCI scope and ensures ongoing eligibility for SAQ A classification.
  • Oversees third-party service providers (TPSPs), including maintaining vendor inventories and monitoring compliance status
  • Supports completion of PCI assessments (SAQ A), including evidence collection, remediation tracking and reporting
  • Provides guidance and training to internal stakeholders on PCI requirements and secure payment practices
  • Serves as a point of contact for PCI compliance activities and coordination with internal and external

Client Assurance

  • Partners with internal stakeholders to understand client security and privacy requirements and expectations
  • Supports client assurance activities, including responding to security questionnaires and sharing relevant compliance documentation (e.g., ISO certifications)

Risk Evaluation

  • Supports the development and execution of a structured risk evaluation process for projects and business changes
  • Reviews initiatives for information security and data privacy risks and escalates findings as appropriate
  • Provides regular updates to governance forums on risk posture and emerging concerns

Competencies, Skills & Qualifications

Competencies

  • Communicates Effectively - Strong communication skills
  • Plans and Aligns
  • Respond timely to tasks/requests
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple risks and adapt to needed changes
  • Balances Stakeholders - Ability to work with all levels of management/team members
  • Decision Quality
  • A need to assume responsibility for work
  • Ability to pull together disparate pieces of information to analyze risk.
  • Knowledge of and proven ability for attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Analytical thinker
  • A drive to exceed goals

Qualifications

  • 4 – 7 years’ experience in Risk Management, including knowledge of US/international data privacy regulations, implementation for/maintenance of ISO certification 27001 certification, risk evaluation of new projects and vendors, creation of risk management solutions, review of client DPA and security agreements, and related matters.
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • CIPM Certification

title: Senior Executive Operations : PAO
description:
JOB TITLE

Sr. Executive – Operations

Function: Regional Business – Operations; Grade N

Reports To: Area Head

Location: City (Multiple Service Centres & Counters)

Travel Required: 50% ☑ 75% ☐

Position Overview

The Sr. Executive – Operations (Area Operations) is responsible for managing the end-to-end operations of a designated city comprising multiple Service Centres and Customer Service Counters, ensuring consistent delivery of Blue Dart's service commitments through operational excellence, customer focus and effective people leadership.

The role is accountable for driving operational performance across approximately 8–12 Service Centres and Counters by ensuring safe, timely and cost-effective pickup and delivery operations, superior customer experience, adherence to service quality standards, productivity improvement, operational governance and regulatory compliance. Working closely with the Area Head and cross-functional stakeholders, the incumbent is responsible for building a high-performing operations team, strengthening operational discipline, enhancing network capability and delivering sustainable business performance while supporting Blue Dart's growth objectives.

Job Purpose

To lead and manage the operational performance of multiple Service Centres and Counters within the assigned city by delivering industry-leading service quality, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction and cost optimization through effective leadership, operational governance, workforce management, continuous improvement and adherence to Blue Dart's operational standards and values.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

1. Operational Leadership & Service Centre Governance

  • Lead the overall operations of multiple Service Centres and Customer Service Counters within the assigned city, ensuring seamless day-to-day execution of pickup, delivery and customer service activities.
  • Drive operational excellence by ensuring consistent adherence to Blue Dart's operational standards, policies and Standard Operating Procedures across all assigned locations.
  • Establish strong operational governance through structured daily, weekly and monthly business reviews with Service Centre teams.
  • Monitor operational performance through dashboards, MIS reports and operational scorecards, taking timely corrective actions wherever required.
  • Ensure operational readiness across all locations to effectively manage daily volumes, seasonal peaks and business contingencies.
  • Conduct regular field visits to Service Centres and Counters to review infrastructure, operational processes, customer service standards and employee engagement.

2. Service Delivery & Customer Experience

  • Ensure timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments in accordance with committed transit times, service standards and contractual obligations.
  • Drive achievement of key service quality metrics including Net Service Levels (NSL), On-Time Delivery, First Attempt Delivery, Transit Time adherence and reduction in shipment exceptions.
  • Ensure effective management of undelivered shipments, Return to Origin (RTO), aging shipments and customer escalations through timely operational intervention.
  • Work closely with Customer Service and Commercial teams to resolve operational issues impacting customer satisfaction.
  • Strengthen customer confidence by ensuring consistent operational reliability, responsiveness and service recovery.
  • Promote a customer-centric culture across Service Centres by reinforcing service excellence and accountability at every level.

3. Operational Productivity & Cost Management

  • Drive productivity improvement across all Service Centres through optimum deployment of manpower, vehicles and operational resources.
  • Monitor operational cost indicators including Operating Cost per Movement (OCPM), Operating Cost per Kilogram (OCPK) and other productivity measures, implementing corrective actions to improve operational efficiency.
  • Support preparation and execution of operational budgets in collaboration with the Area Head while ensuring effective control over operating expenses.
  • Improve workforce productivity through effective planning, workload balancing and operational optimization.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction without compromising customer experience or service quality.
  • Ensure effective utilization of operational assets, equipment and infrastructure across all assigned locations.

4. Last Mile Operations & Network Execution

  • Ensure efficient execution of pickup and delivery operations across the assigned city through effective planning and operational coordination.
  • Monitor route performance, delivery productivity, pickup efficiency and vehicle utilization to maximize operational effectiveness.
  • Ensure timely connectivity of customer shipments into the Blue Dart network through effective coordination with upstream operational functions.
  • Drive continuous improvement in delivery performance, shipment visibility and operational turnaround times.
  • Ensure smooth execution during high-volume periods through proactive capacity planning and resource deployment.
  • Support implementation of new operational initiatives, customer solutions and service enhancements within the assigned geography.

5. Infrastructure, Capacity & Operational Readiness

  • Continuously assess operational capacity of Service Centres and Counters against current and projected business volumes.
  • Identify infrastructure enhancement opportunities to support business growth and improve customer experience.
  • Recommend facility upgrades, layout improvements, equipment requirements and operational enhancements to the Area Head.
  • Ensure Service Centres maintain high standards of housekeeping, asset maintenance, operational readiness and workplace organization.
  • Drive implementation of 5S and workplace improvement initiatives across all operational locations.
  • Ensure business continuity through contingency planning, backup arrangements and operational preparedness.

6. Vendor & Channel Partner Operations

  • Monitor operational performance of outsourced delivery partners, PDAs, RSPs and other channel partners supporting the assigned city.
  • Ensure vendor operations comply with Blue Dart's operational standards, customer commitments and safety requirements.
  • Monitor productivity, service quality, attendance, compliance and performance of outsourced resources.
  • Conduct regular operational reviews with vendors to drive continuous improvement and operational accountability.
  • Ensure contractual obligations, service level commitments and operational deliverables are consistently achieved.
  • Work closely with Procurement, HR and other support functions to address vendor-related operational challenges.

7. Safety, Security & Compliance

  • Foster a strong culture of safety, operational discipline and compliance across all assigned Service Centres and Counters.
  • Ensure strict adherence to operational SOPs, security protocols, statutory requirements and company policies.
  • Ensure safe handling, storage and movement of customer shipments while minimizing operational risk.
  • Drive awareness and compliance relating to workplace safety, security procedures and emergency response protocols.
  • Conduct regular operational audits and inspections to identify compliance gaps and implement corrective actions.
  • Promote ethical conduct, integrity and zero tolerance towards fraud, theft, shipment pilferage, operational malpractice and policy violations.
  • Ensure all operational assets, customer shipments and company property are adequately safeguarded.

8. People Leadership & Capability Development

  • Lead, motivate and develop Service Centre In-charges, Shift In-charges and frontline operations teams to achieve operational excellence.
  • Build a high-performance culture driven by accountability, collaboration, customer focus and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions and developmental discussions with direct reports.
  • Identify high-potential employees and support succession planning across operational locations.
  • Ensure adequate manpower planning and resource availability across all assigned Service Centres.
  • Drive employee engagement initiatives that strengthen morale, teamwork and organizational commitment.
  • Promote regularity, punctuality, professional grooming, discipline and adherence to Blue Dart's Code of Conduct across all operational teams.
  • Facilitate implementation of technical, behavioural, safety and compliance training programmes to continuously enhance workforce capability.

9. Operational Governance, Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Review operational dashboards and performance metrics to identify trends, operational risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Drive data-based decision-making through effective use of operational MIS and performance analytics.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, quality, customer experience and operational efficiency.
  • Simplify operational processes through standardization, automation and adoption of best practices wherever feasible.
  • Ensure timely submission and accuracy of operational reports, statutory records and management information.
  • Share operational best practices across locations to improve consistency and drive execution excellence.

10. Cross Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Commercial, Customer Service, HR, Security, Finance, Engineering, Fleet, Procurement and other support functions to ensure smooth business operations.
  • Support business expansion initiatives, customer onboarding, network optimization and strategic operational projects.
  • Collaborate with Area Head in executing operational priorities and achieving business objectives.
  • Represent Operations in cross-functional reviews, audits, customer meetings and operational governance forums whenever required.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to strengthen operational performance and organizational effectiveness.

Qualifications & Experience:

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Commerce, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • MBA or Post Graduate qualification in Operations, Supply Chain Management or Business Management will be an added advantage.

Experience

  • 6–8 years of experience in courier, express logistics, transportation, warehousing or supply chain operations.
  • Experience managing multiple Service Centres, Counters or city operations with responsibility for operational performance and people leadership.
  • Proven experience in Pickup & Delivery Operations, Service Centre Operations, workforce planning and service quality management.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive productivity, operational excellence, cost optimization and customer satisfaction.
  • Experience in managing outsourced workforce, operational vendors and channel partners will be an advantage.

Skills & Capabilities:

Technical Skills

  • Multi-Site Operations Management
  • Service Centre & Counter Operations
  • Pickup & Delivery Operations
  • Workforce Planning & Productivity Management
  • Customer Service & Service Quality Management
  • Cost Optimization & Budget Monitoring
  • Vendor & Channel Partner Management
  • Operational MIS & Performance Analytics
  • Safety, Security & Regulatory Compliance
  • Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

Behavioural Competencies

  • Operational Leadership
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Making
  • Planning & Organising
  • Team Leadership & Coaching
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Problem Solving
  • Results Orientation
  • Integrity & Ethical Conduct
  • Operational Discipline
  • Collaboration & Teamwork
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

Key Performance Indicators:

Sr. No.

Key Result Areas

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1

Cost Efficiency

Achievement of OCPM & OCPK targets; Budget adherence

2

Service Excellence

Net Service Levels (NSL); On-Time Delivery; Transit Time adherence

3

Customer Experience

NPS achievement; Customer complaint resolution; Reduction in service escalations

4

Operational Productivity

Shipment productivity; Workforce utilization; Service Centre performance

5

Vendor & Channel Partner Performance

Operational performance of PDAs, RSPs and Delivery Associates against agreed service levels

6

Safety & Compliance

SOP adherence; Audit compliance; Statutory and security compliance

7

People Leadership

Employee productivity; Training & capability development; Attrition management

8

Continuous Improvement

Process improvement initiatives; Operational efficiency and productivity enhancement

title: Ansvarlig kollega til pakkeri og indkøb hos fiskeengros virksomhed
description:
Vi søger en ny kollega til vores produktion.

Vi er en veletableret engrosvirksomhed beliggende på Aarhus havn. Vi producere fiskefars og fiskefrikadeller.

Derudover har vi alt indenfor fisk og skaldyr som vi sælger til diverse restauranter, skoler, plejehjem og dagligvarebutikker.

Du bliver en del af vores fersk fisk afdeling som består af 3 personer og det daglige indkøb.

Den ugentlige arbejdstid varierer mellem 34 - 37 timer.

Du skal kunne tale, skrive og forstå dansk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

title: Senior Salesforce Business Analyst (Based in UAE)
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst based in Dubai, with strong expertise in Salesforce and business process optimization. The role will serve as a key link between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into effective Salesforce solutions. The position will focus on requirements analysis, process optimization, solution definition, testing, documentation, and user adoption, ensuring that Salesforce initiatives deliver practical and measurable business value.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with a minimum of 3 years of Salesforce experience.
  • Strong experience in requirements gathering, business process analysis, documentation, and solution definition.
  • Advanced business analysis skills with the ability to understand complex business requirements and translate them into practical solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce capabilities and business processes.
  • Knowledge of software design concepts and/or programming or coding languages.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly in English.
  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel when required.
  • Experience in Freezone, Real Estate, Property Management, or related industries is preferred.
  • Experience working on Salesforce implementation, enhancement, or transformation projects.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies is an advantage.
  • Experience developing and delivering end-user training for business applications.
  • Functional or industry-specific knowledge relevant to the organization's business.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce configuration, automation, and standard functionality is an advantage.
  • Must be present in United Arab Emirates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Requirement Gathering & Analysis: Conduct workshops and interviews with key business stakeholders to uncover requirements, document pain points, and define functional specifications.
  • Process Mapping: Map current-state business processes ("as-is") and design optimized future-state workflows ("to-be") within Salesforce.
  • User Stories & Documentation: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, technical requirements, and process flow diagrams.
  • Solution Collaboration: Partner with Salesforce Developers, Admins, and Solution Architects to design user-friendly, out-of-the-box Salesforce configurations.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Create test cases, lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and ensure solutions meet specified business requirements before deployment.
  • Change Management & Training: Develop user training materials, conduct live end-user training sessions, and foster user adoption across business teams.

title: Bliv livredder i Albertslund – skab tryghed, fællesskab og gode oplevelser i vandet
description:
Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for børn, unge og voksne hver eneste dag?

Er du ansvarsbevidst, serviceminded og klar til at lære nyt?

Og har du lyst til at være en del af et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok og skaber trygge rammer for tusindvis af gæster året rundt?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye livredder til Albertslund Svøm & Fitness samt Friluftsbadet Badesøen.

Om Albertlund Kommune

Albertslund er en grøn kommune med store ambitioner. Vi er stolte af vores kommune, og gør os umage i vores opgaver og indsatser for borgerne, foreningerne og virksomhederne. Vi er én kommune og én organisation. Vi har engagerede og dygtige medarbejdere samt en samarbejdskultur, der går på tværs af områder og niveauer. Det gør Albertslund Kommune til et godt sted at arbejde. Lige nu søger vi en livredder til Albertslund Svøm & Fitness samt Friluftsbadet Badesøen.

Om jobbet

Som livredder bliver du en del af et engageret team, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe trygge, aktive og inkluderende rammer for kommunens borgere og gæster.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Varetage livredderfunktionen i Friluftsbadet Badesøen og kommunens svømmehaller
  • Sikre høj sikkerhed og professionel service over for vores gæster
  • Medvirke til den daglige drift og praktiske opgaver i anlæggene
  • Bidrage til et positivt og imødekommende miljø for brugerne
  • Undervise og facilitere forskellige aktiviteter og holdtræninger som eksempelvis:
    • Vandaerobic
    • Bevægelsestræning
    • Mobilitytræning
    • Cirkeltræning
    • Personlig træning
    • Spinning
    • Saunagus
    • Baby- og småbørnssvømning

Vi sørger for grundig oplæring og kompetenceudvikling, så du bliver klædt godt på til både livredderopgaver og undervisning.

Arbejdet følger sæsonerne. Om sommeren vil en stor del af arbejdstiden foregå i Friluftsbadet Badesøen, mens arbejdet resten af året primært foregår i Albertslund Svøm & Fitness og Svømmehallen Syd. Der må forventes skiftende arbejdstider med dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde. Arbejde p.t. hver 4. weekend.

Dine kompetencer

Vi er åbne over for forskellige faglige baggrunde. Du kan være ufaglært eller komme med erfaring fra service, handel, håndværk, undervisning, idræt eller noget helt andet.

Det vigtigste er, at du

  • er moden, ansvarsbevidst og kan bevare roen i pressede situationer
  • har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker i alle aldre
  • er imødekommende, hjælpsom og serviceminded
  • har lyst til at lære nyt og udvikle dine kompetencer
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en aktiv del af et team
  • kan bestå erhvervslivredderprøven kort efter ansættelse, hvis du ikke allerede har den

I Albertslund Kommune arbejder vi med borgere, og vi gør os umage for at skabe værdi i vores opgaveløsning. Vi reflekterer over vores praksis, skaber læring sammen og samarbejder på tværs af fagområder for at sikre de bedst mulige oplevelser for vores gæster. Derfor søger vi en kollega, der tager ansvar, bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og har lyst til løbende at udvikle sig.

Det er en fordel, hvis du allerede har en livredderuddannelse, men det er ikke et krav. Vi sørger for den nødvendige uddannelse og certificering.

Det kan du forvente af os

Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt fagligt og socialt fællesskab, hvor vi

  • prioriterer sikkerhed, kvalitet og ordentlighed
  • giver grundig oplæring og støtte til nye kollegaer
  • har fokus på faglig og personlig udvikling
  • hjælper hinanden i hverdagen
  • har en uformel og respektfuld omgangstone
  • arbejder målrettet for at skabe gode oplevelser for alle vores gæster

Du får mulighed for at udvikle nye kompetencer og blive en vigtig del af kommunens tilbud inden for sundhed, bevægelse og fritidsliv.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Arbejdsstederne er Albertslund Svøm & Fitness, Friluftsbadet Badesøen samt Svømmehallen Syd.

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt.

Lønindplacering sker efter forhandling mellem kommunen og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Det er en del af Albertslund Kommunes ansættelsespolitik at fremme mangfoldighed og ligestilling.

Det er en forudsætning for din ansættelse i Albertslund Kommune, at du har en gyldig arbejds- og opholdstilladelse.

Albertslund Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

Albertslund Kommune støtter positivt op omkring fuldtidsindsatsen i henhold til Trepartsaftalen om løn- og arbejdsvilkår og ansætter derfor som altovervejende udgangspunkt på 37 timer.

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Tiltrædelse: 1. november 2026.

Ansøgningsfrist: 20. september 2026

Jobsamtaler afholdes 28. september 2026 i tidsrummet kl. 07.30-15.00.

Har du spørgsmål?

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Mikkel Sønderby van de Louw, leder af Friluftsbadet Badesøen og Albertslund Svøm & Fitness, på telefon 23 24 38 69 eller mail inj@albertslund.dk

Velkommen til Albertslund - den bæredygtige by for børnene, det grønne og fællesskaber. Albertslund Kommune har mange kvaliteter, som skaber fantastiske rammer for hverdagslivet – både for borgere og medarbejdere. Midt i naturen og med et rigt forenings- og kulturliv, som børn og voksne cykler til og fra på byens mange kilometer cykelstier, der er adskilt fra bilerne på vejene. Der er S-tog lige til døren og flere supercykelstier, bl.a. mellem Albertslund og Vesterport i hjertet af København. Desuden skaber letbanen gode forbindelser til hele hovedstadsområdet.

I Albertslund Kommune har vi samme tilgang til vores opgaver, som vi selv ville ønske at opleve som borgere. Vi er vidt forskellige, men er fælles om vores opgave for borgere, foreninger og virksomheder. Du kan møde nogle af vores dygtige medarbejdere på og få et indtryk af bredden af arbejdsområder, opgaver og fagligheder i Albertslund Kommune.

I Albertslund Kommune er der højt til loftet og gode udviklingsmuligheder - vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Nattevagt (SSA/SSH) til døgnbehandlingstilbuddet Heimdal
description:
– Bliv en del af et fagligt stærkt og omsorgsfuldt team på døgnbehandlingstilbuddet Heimdal

Heimdal er et døgnbehandlingstilbud til børn og unge med omfattende psykiske og fysiske funktionsnedsættelser. Børnene og de unge har kroniske lidelser eller funktionsnedsættelser, som ofte er kombineret med sansemæssige, motoriske og kommunikative vanskeligheder. Fælles for målgruppen på Heimdal er, at alle børnene og de unge har behov for massiv omsorg og pleje samt en tværfaglig indsats. Børnene og de unge har behov for hjælp til alle daglige gøremål.

Heimdal har 12 pladser.

Om os
På Heimdal vægter vi højt at skabe et godt, trygt og udviklende børneliv i samarbejde med forældrene. Vi har en nuanceret pædagogisk tilgang til arbejdet med børnene og de unge mennesker, og vi tager hele den pædagogiske værktøjskasse i brug. Vi tager udgangspunkt i det enkelte barn / unge menneske og dets behov. Vores pædagogiske tilgang er relationsskabende, og vi er bevidste om, at det er børnenes hjem, vi træder ind i.

På Heimdal arbejder vi med alternativ og supplerende kommunikation og tilpasser de pædagogiske metoder til det enkelte barn. Arbejdslivet på Heimdal er foranderligt, da målgruppen ændres over tid.

God opstart med mentorordning
Når du starter hos os, bliver du tilknyttet en fast mentor i oplæringsperioden. Mentorordningen sikrer, at du får en tryg og grundig introduktion til både børnene, arbejdsopgaverne og den pædagogiske tilgang, vi arbejder ud fra.

Din mentor er en erfaren kollega, som støtter dig i hverdagen, hjælper dig med at finde fodfæste i dine nye rammer og er med til at sikre en fagligt funderet opstart.

Vi ved, at det tager tid at lære børnene og vores praksis at kende – og det giver vi dig plads og støtte til.
Personalegruppen på Heimdal omfatter pædagoger, pædagogiske assistenter, omsorgsmedhjælpere og sygeplejersker.

Om dig
Vi håber, at du
  • evner at se barnet bag funktionsnedsættelsen
  • kan få øje på fagligheden og se udvikling i omsorg og pleje
  • kan skabe gode stemninger med dine kollegaer i en sårbar målgruppe
  • kan bidrage til det faglige fællesskab og til arbejdsmiljøet i medarbejdergruppen
  • besidder it-kundskaber på brugerniveau og er fortrolig med digitale løsninger hertil. Vi arbejder med KMD Nexus som fagsystem.

Om stillingen
Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt.
Du skal arbejde 7 dage og har efterfølgende 7 dage fri.
Arbejdstiden er 23.00-07.30.

Tilbuddet er en del af Enhed for Handicap i Slagelse Kommune og er beliggende på Pilagervej 31 i Slagelse.
Ansættelse sker på overenskomst for social- og sundhedspersonale, indgået mellem KL og FOA.
Startlønnen forventes at tage udgangspunkt i indplacering som SSH eller SSA på hhv. grundlønstrin 19-29 eller 24-34.
Indplacering afhænger bl.a. af uddannelsesbaggrund, anciennitet og kvalifikationer.
Intervallet for startlønnen udgør således 28.130-35.155 kr./md. ekskl. pension.

Yderligere oplysninger
Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte
  • daglig leder Thomas Jensen på telefon 20 75 69 57 eller på mail thjen@slagelse.dk

Du kan læse om Heimdal på Enhed for Handicaps hjemmeside (nyt vindue).

Det praktiske
Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Opstartsdato: 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.

Ansøgningsfrist
  • 20. september 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt i uge 39.

title: Industry Insights
description:
The Customer Success Analyst – Emerging Brands is an experienced insights and customer success professional with a passion for FMCG, emerging brands, and creating compelling, data-driven analysis in a fast-paced commercial environment.

This role partners closely with the Emerging Brands Leadership Team and cross-functional stakeholders to develop strategic content, identify growth opportunities, and improve the overall customer experience. The analyst combines advanced analytical capabilities with strong storytelling skills to translate complex market data into actionable recommendations that support prospecting, customer engagement, product evolution, and business growth.

The Customer Success Analyst also serves as a key contributor to internal initiatives, helping socialize product enhancements, improve data quality awareness, and represent the Voice of the Customer in product and hierarchy development discussions.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Strategic Partnership

  • Partner closely with the Emerging Brands Leadership Team to prioritize, scope, and deliver high-impact analytical content that supports trade collateral, prospecting activities, proposals, customer presentations, and joint business planning sessions.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to understand evolving business priorities and deliver timely, value-added insights.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by translating business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
  • Support the NIQ mission of becoming the preferred measurement partner for Emerging Brands through high-quality insight generation and customer-focused deliverables.

Advanced Data Analysis & Insight Development

  • Analyze NIQ datasets and syndicated solutions to identify emerging consumption trends, shopper behaviors, market opportunities, and category dynamics.
  • Connect market trends to customer pain points and business opportunities within the Emerging Brands portfolio.
  • Develop strategic analyses that quantify market opportunities and support customer acquisition, retention, and growth initiatives.
  • Leverage multiple NIQ solutions, including The Full View, OmniShopper, Strategic Planner Global, Nielsen Product Insider, and Advanced Analytics, to provide comprehensive business recommendations.

Insight Delivery & Data Storytelling

  • Develop compelling PowerPoint presentations and analytical materials that communicate complex findings in a clear, concise, and business-relevant manner.
  • Create impactful visualizations and data-driven stories tailored to diverse audiences, including internal leadership, commercial teams, and prospective customers.
  • Ensure deliverables maintain a high standard of quality, consistency, and commercial relevance.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Product Support

  • Lead internal workstreams in partnership with Product, Operations, Customer Success, and Account Leadership to assess, communicate, and socialize Product Enhancements, Market Enhancements, and Data Quality Alerts.
  • Build business cases that support changes to syndicated product coding and category hierarchy based on Emerging Brands Voice of Customer feedback, governance board requests, and hierarchy backlog priorities.
  • Collaborate across functional teams to improve internal processes, product adoption, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing initiatives by documenting best practices and developing training materials when new processes or enhancements are introduced.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Support onboarding and enablement activities related to Emerging Brands products, services, and analytical capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal workflows, reporting processes, and analytical methodologies.
  • Maintain a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Contribute to thought leadership initiatives that strengthen NIQ's position as the trusted insights partner for Emerging Brands.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Data Analytics, Mathematics, or related field.
  • Advanced studies or certifications in Market Research, Business Analytics, or Customer Success are considered a plus.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Market Research, FMCG, Retail, Commercial Analytics, Consulting, or related analytical roles.
  • Experience working with syndicated market measurement data and customer-facing analytical projects is highly preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical thinking with the ability to synthesize large datasets into meaningful business insights.
  • Excellent data storytelling and presentation skills with advanced PowerPoint visualization capabilities.
  • Deep understanding of FMCG performance metrics, including ACV, TDP, Household Penetration, Buying Rate, Base vs. Incremental Volume, Share, Distribution, and Velocity metrics.
  • Extensive knowledge of NIQ solutions and datasets, including The Full View, OmniShopper, Strategic Planner Global, Nielsen Product Insider, and Advanced Analytics.
  • Ability to independently manage projects with evolving priorities and ambiguous business questions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Experience leading internal initiatives and collaborating across Product, Operations, Commercial, and Customer Success organizations.
  • High level of accountability, ownership, and execution focus.
  • Passion for supporting Emerging Brands and contributing to customer success.
  • Highly proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining a strategic business perspective.
  • Ability to work independently while fostering collaboration within multicultural and cross-functional teams.
  • Professional English proficiency (C1 or above) required.

Our Benefits

  • Flexible working environment
  • Volunteer time off
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

NIQ may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools at various stages of the recruitment process, including résumé screening, candidate assessments, interview scheduling, job matching, communication support, and certain administrative tasks that help streamline workflows. These tools are intended to improve efficiency and support fair and consistent evaluation based on job-related criteria. All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. NIQ regularly reviews its AI tools to help mitigate bias and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. For more information, please visit NIQ’s AI Safety Policies and Guiding Principles: https://nielseniq.com/global/en/info/niqs-ai-safety-policies/

About NIQ

NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.

For more information, visit NIQ.com

Want to keep up with our latest updates?

Follow us on: LinkedIn | Instagram | Twitter | Facebook

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve. We believe that embracing a wide range of perspectives drives innovation and excellence. All employment decisions at NIQ are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We invite individuals who share our dedication to inclusivity and equity to join us in making a meaningful impact. To learn more about our ongoing efforts in diversity and inclusion, please visit the https://nielseniq.com/global/en/news-center/diversity-inclusion

title: Lead Consultant, Data Centers
description:
Hybrid-based position in our New England office locations: Boston, Hartford, Portland, Westford

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? Are you excited about joining a company that strives to make a difference – for its employees, clients, and society? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Compliance Strategy and Transactions (CST) team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Ramboll is seeking a full-time Lead Consultant to join our CST team and support data center clients with site selection, environmental and technical due diligence, civil/site development review, feasibility assessment, and early-stage project planning. The successful candidate will combine assistant project management capabilities with a civil engineering background to help coordinate multidisciplinary due diligence assignments and evaluate site development considerations. This position can be based in any of our New England offices: Boston, Hartford, Portland, or Westford. Our New England offices put you at a crossroads of vibrant cities, coastal and forested landscapes, and active communities tackling real-world environmental challenges.

At Ramboll, we will support and encourage your professional development, invite you to unfold your ingenuity and contribute to exciting and innovative projects, and work for sustainable change so people and nature can flourish. If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

As our new Lead Consultant, you will serve in an assistant project manager role for data center projects from early site screening through due diligence and conceptual planning. Working closely with project managers, technical specialists, and client teams, you will coordinate multidisciplinary inputs; track scope, schedule, budget, actions, and deliverables; and help maintain clear communication across the project team. You will also apply your civil engineering background to review conceptual master plans and evaluate site access, grading, stormwater, utilities, earthwork, and other site development considerations. To succeed in this role, you should be highly organized, technically grounded, detail-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.

Your key responsibilities will be:

  • Support project managers in delivering complex data center due diligence assignments by assisting with scope, schedule, budget, staffing, deliverables, and client expectations.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary technical teams, maintain project schedules, track action items and information requests, and provide status updates to ensure timely project execution.
  • Support client meetings and communications by preparing materials, documenting decisions, tracking follow-up actions, and contributing to progress updates.
  • Review site development concepts, including master plans, test fits, civil/site constraints, utilities, grading, stormwater management, permitting considerations, and other technical factors to support due diligence recommendations.
  • Prepare and quality-review client-ready reports, risk summaries, proposals, work plans, cost estimates, and technical deliverables while supporting multiple concurrent data center projects and site visits.

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, environmental science, geology, chemistry, physics, biology, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred. Environmental engineering candidates should have demonstrated civil/site development or land development experience.
  • Minimum of five years of relevant consulting experience, including civil/site development, due diligence, land development, or multidisciplinary project delivery.
  • Experience supporting project management activities, including scope, schedule, budget, meeting coordination, action tracking, and deliverable management.
  • Working knowledge of site development principles, including grading, drainage, stormwater management, utilities, earthwork, development constraints, permitting, and interpretation of conceptual site plans, Civil 3D drawings, surveys, and technical studies.
  • Strong technical writing, organization, communication, problem-solving, and client-service skills; experience with CAD, Civil 3D, Bluebeam, GIS, data centers, mission-critical, industrial projects, and/or EIT or PE credentials preferred.

What we can offer you

  • Interesting and diverse projects
  • The opportunity to work with some of the best and brightest professionals in your field
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent health and retirement benefits
  • Investment in your development
  • Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
  • Appreciation for the unique person you are
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
  • Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $82,500 - $107,000 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

title: Achubwr Bywyd / Lifeguard - Welshpool
description:
Ymunwch â’r Egni yn Freedom Leisure – Gwneud yn Dda, Teimlo’n Dda!

Yn Freedom Leisure, mae popeth yn ymwneud ag awyrgylch cadarnhaol, pobl wych, a chael effaith go iawn. Ydyn, rydyn ni’n rhedeg cyfleusterau hamdden a diwylliannol, campfeydd, a phyllau nofio—ond wrth wraidd y cyfan, ein pobl ni sy'n gwneud y gwahaniaeth.

Fel un o ymddiriedolaethau hamdden elusennol blaenllaw'r DU, rydyn ni’n falch o'n cenhadaeth o Wella Bywydau Trwy Hamdden. Rydyn ni yma i helpu cymunedau i fyw bywydau iachach a hapusach trwy wneud ein canolfannau'n groesawgar, yn gynhwysol, ac yn hygyrch i bawb - oherwydd mae pawb yn haeddu teimlo'n dda. Rydyn ni i gyd am ddarparu gwasanaeth cwsmeriaid anhygoel gyda gwên—bob dydd. Rydyn ni’n creu mannau lle mae pobl yn teimlo'n gartrefol, wedi'u cefnogi, ac wedi'u hysbrydoli.

Os ydych chi'n angerddol am helpu eraill ac yn caru creu profiadau gwych, byddwch chi'n teimlo'n gartrefol gyda ni. Nid oes angen i chi fod yn arbenigwr i ddechrau - byddwn yn rhoi'r holl hyfforddiant a chefnogaeth sydd eu hangen arnoch chi. Gyda dros 130 o ganolfannau ledled Cymru a Lloegr, mae yna lawer o le i dyfu. Mae llawer o'n tîm wedi adeiladu gyrfaoedd anhygoel gan wneud yr hyn maen nhw'n ei garu, gan helpu cwsmeriaid o ddydd i ddydd a gwneud i bobl deimlo'n dda.

Rydyn ni’n falch o fod yn weithle lle mae croeso i bawb, eu bod yn cael eu gwerthfawrogi, a'u cefnogi i ffynnu—oherwydd pan fydd ein tîm yn adlewyrchu'r cymunedau rydyn ni’n eu gwasanaethu, rydyn ni i gyd yn tyfu'n gryfach gyda'n gilydd.

Os ydych chi’n hoffi siarad â phobl yna dyma’r rôl i chi yn bendant. Rydyn ni’n deall nad yw meithrin perthynas â chwsmeriaid a chydweithwyr mor hawdd ag y mae’n swnio a weithiau fe ddaw gyda phrofiad. Byddwn yn darparu’r holl hyfforddiant angenrheidiol i fod yn Achubwr Bywyd llwyddiannus ond rydyn ni hefyd yn credu fod cyflogi pobl o gymysgedd o gefndiroedd cyflogaeth yn gallu bod yn fwy buddiol i’n tîm, efallai bydd rhai yn eu swydd gyntaf erioed ag angen rhagor o gefnogaeth oddi wrth eu cydweithwyr.

title: Principal AI Engineer (Forward Deployed)
description:
Principal AI Engineer (Forward Deployed)

At-a-Glance
- Principal-level individual contributor role embedded directly with customers
- Building AI capability against live operational problems, at pace
- Python, large language models, agentic workflows, data integration
- Set the technical standard for how AI gets deployed across every customer
- Share options and an unusually short distance between idea and impact

About the Company
My client is a UK technology company building an AI operating and orchestration layer that puts intelligent systems to work inside large, complex organisations where accuracy and accountability really matter. The platform is already live and in daily operational use with major customers. The engineering group is small, senior and unusually fast moving, with AI tooling built into how the team genuinely works rather than bolted on afterwards.

The Role
This is a forward deployed role in the truest sense. You go to where the problem is, work alongside the people who have it, and build against it in days rather than quarters. At principal level you are also the technical authority for how that work gets done, setting the patterns, calling the hard architectural questions, and lifting the engineers around you. It suits a very experienced engineer who wants real influence without moving into people management, and who is motivated by problems that matter rather than problems that scale neatly.

Key Responsibilities
- Embed with customer teams to understand operational problems first hand
- Build working AI solutions rapidly against real data and real constraints
- Set the technical approach and architectural patterns used across deployments
- Own the hardest problems, the ones nobody else has managed to crack
- Design and tune retrieval, prompting and agent behaviour for demanding use cases
- Establish the standard for how output quality is validated before it is relied upon
- Convert successful deployments into repeatable product capability
- Mentor senior engineers and act as the technical voice with senior customer stakeholders

What You'll Need

Essential:
- 8+ years building software or AI systems in production
- Deep Python expertise and substantial hands-on large language model experience
- Track record of shipping quickly in ambiguous, under-specified situations
- Experience setting technical direction that other engineers then follow
- Confident working directly with customers, including in operational settings
- Eligible for UK security clearance

Desirable / Nice to Have:
- Previous forward deployed, field engineering or embedded consulting experience
- Background delivering into a heavily regulated or operationally critical domain
- Open source contribution, patents or published technical work

Why Apply?
- The shortest possible distance between a real problem and a working solution
- Genuine principal-level scope, not a senior role with a better title
- Share options as part of the package
- Almost no bureaucracy between you and shipping
- Flexible working pattern
- Direct line to founders and senior leadership
- Shape how an entire engineering function operates while it is still being built

Benefits:
Work From Home

title: Project Manager (6m FTC)
description:
We have an exciting new opportunity to join our Strategic Projects team as their new Project Manager. This role is offered on a 6-month fixed term contract basis, with hybrid working from our office in Embassy Gardens, London (approx. 2 days per week).

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Projects, you’ll be responsible for leading teams to deliver projects than span one or more business departments. The Project Manager will manage resources, schedules and financials whilst adhering to stage gate quality guidelines throughout the full project lifecycle. This also includes management of issues, risks and project change requests to ensure successful and on-time project delivery.

The team

The Strategic Projects team is a key part of Penguin Random House Operations (which also includes Technology, Facilities and Distribution). We help Penguin Random House achieve transformational change, delivering initiatives based on our strategic priorities, and supporting essential replacements to core processes and systems as they become end-of-life. We support changes from initial Conversations and Prioritisations through to implementation, engaging with departments across PRH and DK to help changes take place and embed.

The role

Key responsibilities:

  • Provide leadership to a project team by building and motivating team members to meet project goals, adhering to their responsibilities and project milestones.
  • Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to implementation/hypercare for one or more project initiatives simultaneously.
  • Report on project success criteria results, metrics, test and deployment management activities.
  • Prepare estimates and detailed project plans for all phases.
  • Procure adequate resources to achieve project objectives.
  • Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources and chair the project management team meetings.
  • Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks and issues, communicating across leadership.
  • Understand interdependencies between technology, operations and business needs.
  • Participate in feasibility studies, vendor selection and proposals for evaluation by appropriate key stakeholders.
  • Review various vendor statement of works (SOWs) and Specifications for requested goods and services.
  • Set and continually manage project expectations while delegating and managing deliverable with team members and stakeholders.
  • Develop and deliver progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation and presentations to various audiences, including project team, sponsors, and key stakeholders.
  • Manage project issues and risks to mitigate impact.
  • Continue professional development in order to keep abreast of emerging technologies, methods and best practices.
  • Maintain and develop a good understanding of project management principles, methods and techniques.

What you’ll bring

Essential criteria:

  • Previous project management experience with a track record of managing plans from creation to execution. Specifically:

- Experience of managing file management or document management projects involving user data migration. Technical expertise is not required, but you should be confident leading delivery across business and technical teams, managing dependencies and supporting the adoption of new ways of working.

- Experience of managing technology projects involving system integrations and SAP development. Technical expertise is not required, but you should be confident leading delivery across technical teams, managing dependencies and working with specialist SMEs and suppliers.

  • Experience with the Microsoft Office digital suite, including but not limited to Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, One Note etc.
  • Strong organisational skills, proactive and comfortable working in a dynamic project delivery environment.
  • Good Knowledge of Waterfall/Agile project management, frameworks, methodologies and associated governance structures - including, but not limited to Prince2 and Scrum.
  • Ability to present and explain technical information to non-technical audiences, establishing rapport.
  • Awareness of IT frameworks such as ITILv3 and the software development process, including requirement gathering, analysis/design, development tools/technologies, release/version control testing and deployment management.

Desirable criteria:

  • Proficient in MS Project or experienced in using a PPM Tool with planning capabilities.
  • Experience of working with SAP, enterprise system integrations and file management platforms (e.g. Box, Microsoft 365/SharePoint, Nasuni) would be advantageous but is not essential.
  • Experience of using JIRA, Confluence and ChatGPT.
  • Experience within creative, publishing, media industries is beneficial but not essential.

Application instructions

Please apply with your CV and Cover Letter by 23:59 on Wednesday 9th September 2026.

AI

Here at Penguin, we believe in the power of authenticity and human creativity. When you apply for a position, we want to encourage you to showcase your unique voice. Throughout our recruitment process, please share your own thoughts, experiences, and skills. This helps us get a true sense of who you are and what you might bring to our team.

We celebrate creativity and diverse perspectives, so please be yourself! While we recognise AI tools can be helpful, we recommend using them thoughtfully to ensure your responses reflect you.

Disability Confident

As a Disability Confident Committed organisation, we offer interviews to candidates with a disability who meet the essential criteria for the role, and opt-in on their application form. The essential criteria for this role are listed as part of the ‘What you’ll bring’ section.

There may be times when the volume of applications means we cannot take all eligible candidates to interview. We encourage you to tell us about any reasonable adjustments you may need by emailing PRHCareersUK@penguinrandomhouse.co.uk. Remember, you only need to share what you are comfortable with, for us to support your request.

Salary

The salary for this opportunity is £65,000-£70,000, depending on how your skills and experience align to the role, plus a generous bonus scheme and benefits.

Hybrid working

While our offices across the UK are places to connect, collaborate and celebrate with colleagues, we recognise that flexibility around where you work is just as important. For this role we expect that you will work from our office in Embassy Gardens, London 2 days per week (typically Tuesday & Thursday). You will be required to be flexible on other days as required by the business.

title: Erfaren teamleder søges!

Stillingen kræver, at du kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag, sikre struktur i opgaverne og motivere teamet til at nå fælles mål.

Der tilbydes en spændende arbejdsplads med en sund og inkluderende kultur, hvor samarbejde og respekt er nøgleord. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, som prioriterer medarbejdernes faglige vækst og giver gode muligheder for både personlig og karrieremæssig udvikling.

Interesseret? Send dit CV til Randers-u@jobteam.dk


Arbejdsopgaver

Som teamleder vil arbejdsopgaverne være mange og det er vigtigt du trives i en travl hverdag. Du vil bl.a. komme til at skulle stå for:

  • Overvågning og styring af lageret.
  • Motivation og trivsel i teamet.
  • Kørsel med truck.

Virksomheden forventer du kommer med enten en uddannelse indenfor området eller en god portion erfaring. Derudover forventer de mere konkret at du har:

Som person er det vigtigt du mestrer opgaverne på gulvet, såvel som de administrative og mere tekniske arbejdsopgaver.

Derudover er det også vigtigt du er:

Da der er flere indgangsvinkler til stillingen, vil løn blive aftalt efter kvalifikationer og i overensstemmelse med virksomhedens overenskomst.

title: Hørekonsulent til Center for Kommunikation
description:
Vil du arbejde med hørelse, rådgivning og gode løsninger for borgere med høretab? Så kan du blive vores nye kollega i Høreafdelingen.

Vi søger en fagligt engageret hørekonsulent til vores team omkring voksne med høretab. Du bliver en del af en dygtig og fleksibel gruppe, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og bruger sparring aktivt i hverdagen.

En hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver
Du får tjenestested i Herning og varetager blandt andet telefontid, justeringer og service af høreapparater samt udredning, afprøvning og sagsfremstilling af høretekniske hjælpemidler. Opgaverne løses både i Herning og i vores samarbejdskommuner.

Hvem er du?
Vi ønsker os en kollega, der samarbejder godt, tager fagligt ansvar og bidrager til gode løsninger for borgerne. Du må gerne være nysgerrig, initiativrig og have lyst til at udvikle praksis sammen med resten af teamet.

For at kunne varetage opgaverne skal du være uddannet audiologopæd, audiolog eller audiologiassistent. Du kan også have en anden uddannelse med tilsvarende kvalifikationer. Der indgår kørsel i jobbet, og derfor er kørekort kategori B en nødvendighed.

Om Center for Kommunikation
Center for Kommunikation er en undervisningsinstitution under Herning Kommune. Vi varetager specialundervisning og specialpædagogisk bistand til børn og voksne med kommunikationsvanskeligheder.

Høreafdelingen består af syv medarbejdere og en afdelingsleder. Vi arbejder med rådgivning, høreapparatservice, høretekniske hjælpemidler, tinnitus/lydfølsomhed, CI, SPS og vejledning af erhvervsaktive borgere med høretab.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!
Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Henriette Gadegaard på telefon 96 28 49 00.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuldtid. Ønsker du et lavere timetal, skal det fremgå af ansøgningen.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 22. september kl. 12.00, og samtaler afholdes den 24. september kl. 12.00-14.00. Vi ønsker stillingen besat pr. 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst. Der indhentes straffeattest og børneattest i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

I Herning Kommune lægger vi vægt på ligestilling og diversitet og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge. title: Embedded Software Engineer | C, Device Driver, Linux ,Multithreading - 10+ years - Bangalore
description:
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) at Cisco is seeking skilled software engineers to join our Diagnostic/BSP team, responsible for ensuring the reliability and performance of our world-class hardware. Our team develops software for Cisco’s network switches and routers, which feature advanced application awareness to build a flexible and agile network infrastructure. These capabilities support multi-layered responses to the diverse workload demands of AI and ML. This is a unique opportunity to grow your technical skill set and gain visibility and recognition across cross-functional teams within Cisco. We value motivated individuals who enjoy solving complex challenges and thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment.

Your Impact

  • Design, and develop, BSP, and Diagnostics for Cisco Core and Edge routing products.
  • Design, develop, and test kernel and user space device drivers for FPGA and networking peripherals.
  • Develop and execute software test plans.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to debug prototypes and validate software.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field with 12+ years experience, or Master’s degree with 10+ years experience.
  • Proficient in C, C++, and Python programming.
  • Strong hardware and device driver development background, including experience with Linux hardware bring-up.
  • Demonstrated experience in hardware and device driver development, including Linux hardware bring-up, multi-threading, event handling, and state machine implementation.
  • Skilled in developing, debugging, and validating embedded systems and device drivers for protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, and/or GPIO.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficient in kernel debugging tools such as GDB and KGDB.
  • Experience developing software from concept through delivery for large-scale, high-speed interface and bandwidth.
  • Ability to troubleshoot software defects from kernel modules to applications.
  • Experience with collaborative system design, specification writing, and requirements review.
  • Commitment to quality, mentoring, and continuous learning in networking, optics, and embedded systems.
  • Experience with AI/ML and Agentic AI framework.
  • Knowledge of Layer 2/3 network protocols.
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills.
  • Experience with network processors and optical networking.
  • Familiarity with secure-boot, open-source tools, CMIS, and SFF standards (SFP, QSFP).
  • Strong communication skills and knowledge of software quality processes.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
