Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye juniormægler hos home Søborg og Dyssegård!

Fuld fart på din mæglerkarriere

Som vores nye juniormægler vil du få base i vores forretning i Søborg. Her står et stærkt og erfarent hold klar til at sparre med dig, så du hurtigt kan tage det næste store skridt i din mæglerkarriere. Vi leder efter dig, der elsker salgsprocessen fra start til slut – lige fra det første opsøgende opkald til den endelige underskrift.

Vi tilpasser forløbet efter din baggrund og sikrer, at du hurtigt får masser af ansvar og selvstændige opgaver i hverdagen.

Dine primære opgaver bliver blandt andet:

  • Kommissionering: Opsøgende salg, vurderinger og indtag af nye ejendomme til salg
  • Salg og fremvisning: Gennemførelse af fremvisninger og åbent hus-arrangementer
  • Kunderelationer: Løbende opfølgning og tæt dialog med både købere og sælgere
  • Pipeline-building: Ringe på emner og opbygge din egen kundeportefølje
  • Generel support: Sikre at sagerne kører professionelt og smidigt i mål i samarbejde med teamet

Hos home får du:

  • Store udviklingsmuligheder: Fokus på din mæglerkarriere, hvor du hurtigt får lov til at køre egne vurderinger og kommissioneringer.
  • De bedste kolleger: Et arbejdsmiljø med højt humør, uformel omgangstone og stort fokus på trivsel.
  • Branchens bedste sparring: Daglig sparring fra mæglere med mange års erfaring og et højt fagligt niveau.
  • Attraktive vilkår: En lønpakke, der matcher dine kvalifikationer, med en stærk og motiverende provisionstruktur, der belønner dine resultater.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter en resultatorienteret holdspiller, som:

  • Er uddannet ejendomsmægler, godt på vej (f.eks. finansøkonom/finansbachelor), eller har solid erfaring med opsøgende salg.
  • Har et naturligt salgsdrive og brænder for kommissioneringsdelen – du ser muligheder, hvor andre ser lukkede døre.
  • Er udadvendt, tillidsskabende og formår at skabe langvarige relationer til vores kunder.
  • Er målrettet, flittig og tager fuldt ansvar for at nå dine mål.
  • Bevarer overblikket og det gode humør – også når der er maksimalt tryk på telefonerne.
  • Har kørekort og egen bil til rådighed.

Har du mod på at blive vores nye juniormægler?

Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt via nedenstående link. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og lukker processen, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Som led i processen kan din ansøgning og tilhørende oplysninger blive videregivet til den kommende indehaver/franchisetager. title: Registered Kinesiologist
description:

Department: Allied Health
Reports to: Manager, Allied Health
Salary: $37.47 - $46.84 per hour
Hours: 37.5 hours per week
Shifts: Days
Status: Temporary Full-Time ( October 2027 )
Closing Date: September 9, 2026

Position Summary

The Rehabilitation Pain service, is part of the Comprehensive Interprofessional Pain Program at UHN and is a clinical interdisciplinary program that investigates, assesses, and treats chronic pain and musculoskeletal disorders. Collaboration within the clinical and research interdisciplinary team, which includes physicians, kinesiologists, nurses, biomedical engineers, and scientists, is a key component of this role.

The kinesiologist will be an integral member of the clinical team who provides comprehensive assessment, consultation, care and patient education to individuals with musculoskeletal disorders and chronic pain.

Duties

  • Performing patient assessments that evaluate function;
  • Developing and delivering coordinated patient-centred care through collaboration with the interdisciplinary team;
  • Reviewing and triaging patient referrals;
  • Participating in goal setting with patients; providing patient education as needed;
  • Maintaining relationships with various stakeholders and influencing positive improvement in service delivery, patient outcomes and population health;
  • Facilitating referrals to appropriate community resources as needed; communicating effectively with patients and internal/external care providers, including completing reports and documenting patient assessments and care plans;
  • Measuring the impact of patient-care programs and educational programs;
  • Participating in professional and hospital initiatives related to quality improvement and research;
  • Mentoring learners and other staff; covering for colleagues;
  • Demonstrating an understanding of, complying with, and committing to patient safety responsibilities; and following hospital plans, policies and procedures in order to ensure a safe environment for patients.
  • The kinesiologist will also support and collaborate on research activities within the program. The kinesiologist will perform cross-functional responsibilities and other duties as assigned.
  • Bachelor’s University degree in Kinesiology with minimum 5 years’ experience
  • Current registration and member in good standing with the College of Kinesiologists of Ontario (CKO)
  • Membership with Professional Association (e.g. Ontario Kinesiology Association) preferred
  • Basic Cardiac Life Support (C Level) Heart Saver Plus Canada (on employment)
  • Experience in managing patients with complex disability (e.g., chronic pain) with overlapping mental health issues is an asset
  • Experience coordinating with an interdisciplinary health care team in a multi-site academic health care setting is an asset
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution and creative problem-solving skills
  • Interest in producing written patient educational materials is an asset
  • Openness to integrating cognitive-behavioural-therapy-like strategies, mindfulness, and/or relaxation techniques into the therapeutic approach an asset
  • Experience with chronic pain an asset

Why join UHN?

In addition to working alongside some of the most talented and inspiring healthcare professionals in the world, UHN offers a wide range of benefits, programs and perks. It is the comprehensiveness of these offerings that makes it a differentiating factor, allowing you to find value where it matters most to you, now and throughout your career at UHN.

  • Competitive offer packages
  • Government organization and a member of the Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan (HOOPP https://hoopp.com/)
  • Close access to Transit and UHN shuttle service
  • A flexible work environment
  • Opportunities for development and promotions within a large organization
  • Additional perks (multiple corporate discounts including: travel, restaurants, parking, phone plans, auto insurance discounts, on-site gyms, etc.)

Current UHN employees must have successfully completed their probationary period, have a good employee record along with satisfactory attendance in accordance with UHN's attendance management program, to be eligible for consideration.

All applications must be submitted before the posting close date.

UHN uses email to communicate with selected candidates. Please ensure you check your email regularly. At University Health Network (UHN), artificial intelligence technologies may be used to assist in the screening, assessment, and selection of candidates for this position.

Please be advised that a Criminal Record Check may be required of the successful candidate. Should it be determined that any information provided by a candidate be misleading, inaccurate or incorrect, UHN reserves the right to discontinue with the consideration of their application.

UHN is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive recruitment process and workplace. Requests for accommodation can be made at any stage of the recruitment process. Applicants need to make their requirements known.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

title: Leder til LeveBo Rosengården
description:
Er du optaget af høj faglighed, sikker drift, beboertilfredshed og personaletrivsel?

Er du samtidig en leder der ser muligheder, udvikling og forandring og som leder med mod, ansvarlighed og ordentlighed i tråd med Frederikshavns Kommunes ledelsesgrundlag? Trives du i en organisation, hvor vi gennem politikken ”sammen om” skaber løsninger i fællesskab med medarbejdere, beboere og pårørende og andre samarbejdspartnere?
Er du uddannet sygeplejerske og har du lyst til at stå i spidsen for en engageret medarbejdergruppe og blive en del af en motiverende og energifuld ledergruppe?

Kan du se dig selv som leder for et plejecenter, hvor beboeren er i centrum og hvor samarbejdet med pårørende vægtes højt, så er du måske den leder vi søger til Rosengården.

Lidt om Rosengården:
Rosengården har 64 lejligheder og ca. 65 medarbejdere. Primært social og -sundhedshjælpere, social og -Sundhedsassistenter og sygeplejersker.
På plejecenterområdet i Frederikshavn Kommune har vi stor fokus på beboerens selvbestemmelse og på en dagligdag med indhold og glæde. Vi vægter faglighed og personaletrivsel højt. Vi er optaget af at, beboernes hverdag indeholder omsorg, fællesskaber og livsoplevelser. Rosengården er et godt sted at bo, gæste og arbejde.

Dit job som leder vil særligt være:

  • Personaleledelse og personaleudvikling med særlig fokus på faglighed og arbejdsmiljø
  • Fokus på kompetenceudvikling gennem faglig faciliterende ledelse
  • Ressourcestyring og optimering, budgetansvar, ledelsestilsyn
  • Rekruttering af nyt personale, god introduktion og fokus på tilknytning
  • Understøtte og sikre implementering af politisk bestemte tiltag og målsætninger
  • Tæt, åbent og udviklende samarbejde med personalegruppen, lederkolleger og områdelederen

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Sygeplejefaglig baggrund
  • Ledererfaring
  • Din ledelsesstil er anerkendende, involverende og dialogbaseret
  • Du prioriterer at løse konflikter konstruktivt og værdigt
  • Du kommunikerer tydeligt og forstår at sætte retning med følgeskab
  • Du er handlekraftig og indgår i samarbejde præget af psykologisk tryghed
  • Økonomisk ansvarlig og kan gennemføre relevante handleplaner mod sikker drift
  • Positiv tilgang i en travl hverdag
  • Du ser forbedringsmuligheder og kan motivere personalet
  • Diplom i ledelse eller indstillet på at påbegynde lederuddannelse

title: Rituals Advisor / Consilier în vânzări (m/f/d)  -  Bucureşti,  Park-Lake
company: ÆON Thana Sinsap (Thailand) Public Company Limited (AEONTS)
description:
Alătură-te misiunii noastre în calitate de consultant de vânzări (Rituals Advisor) și ajută-i pe clienții noștri să descopere farmecul mărcii noastre, creând pentru ei o atmosferă în care se pot simți speciali în agitația de zi cu zi. Pentru noi, fiecare client este unic, iar abilitățile tale ne ajută să îi inspirăm și să le arătăm că ne pasă cu adevărat de ei.

Ce sarcini te așteaptă?

  • Crearea unei experiențe de neuitat pentru clienți prin utilizarea „insulei de apă”, oferirea de consultanță personalizată și sprijin în alegerea produselor perfecte.
  • Serviciu activ pentru clienți și sprijinirea echipei în atingerea obiectivelor de vânzări.
  • Menținerea esteticii și ordinii magazinului în conformitate cu standardele Rituals.
  • Respectarea normelor de securitate și sănătate în muncă.
  • Colaborare strânsă cu managerul magazinului și managerul adjunct pentru atingerea obiectivelor stabilite.

Ce oferim la Rituals?

La Rituals, avem grijă de angajații noștri la fel de mult ca de clienții noștri. Oferim mai mult decât un loc de muncă – oferim oportunități de dezvoltare, de construire a relațiilor și experiența de a contribui la formarea culturii mărcii Rituals:

  • Loc de muncă stabil, cu contract de muncă.
  • Plan de formare clar și sprijinul unui mentor dedicat, pentru a deveni un expert în domeniul frumuseții și al bunăstării încă de la început!
  • Beneficii speciale, cum ar fi pachetul de bun venit cu produsele noastre, reduceri pentru angajați, instrumente și sisteme moderne care facilitează munca de zi cu zi, programe de bunăstare, pauze de odihnă plătite și sprijin pentru transportul public.
  • O atmosferă inspiratoare, sprijinul unei echipe pasionate și entuziaste, oportunități reale de dezvoltare a carierei și sprijin pentru dobândirea de noi competențe.
  • Activități frecvente de team building și întâlniri în care construim relații și sărbătorim împreună succesele noastre!
  • Inspiră-i pe ceilalți cu cunoștințele și abilitățile tale!

Pe lângă angajament, căutăm oameni care lucrează cu inima deschisă și pasiune alături de ceilalți:

  • Ai experiență în comerțul cu amănuntul sau în ospitalitate? Super! Credem că abilitățile tale de relaționare cu clienții sunt foarte valoroase.
  • Ești excelent în lucrul în echipă și cu clienții, le înțelegi nevoile și, la fel ca noi, îți dorești să oferi servicii de calitate.
  • Ești o persoană atentă la detalii, bine organizată și sistematică.
  • Cauți un loc de muncă cu normă parțială și ești dispus să lucrezi în majoritatea weekendurilor, ținând cont de programul de funcționare al centrului comercial.

Alătură-te nouă și creează împreună cu noi zile magice!

title: Pædagog søges til vuggestue med stærk profil
description:
Alsidig pædagog til vuggestue med stærk profil

Fasangården har sjældent ledige pædagogstillinger – nu søger vi en dygtig pædagog til vores vuggestue.

Fasangården er en integreret institution på Frederiksberg med gode fysiske rammer, en tydelig og transparent ledelse og et trygt og stærkt arbejdsfællesskab. På alle stuer er der 2 pædagoger og 2 pædagogmedhjælpere. Vi har eget korps af kendte vikarer og vi hjælper altid hinanden så ingen er alene.

Vi søger en uddannet pædagog, som vil være med til at give Fasangårdens børn en god dag, hver dag. Stillingen er på Larvestuen med 13-14 børn i alderen 10 mdr.- 2 år, hvor din nærmeste pædagogkollega er Snerle, som har arbejdet i Fasangården i 4 år. Snerle er sporskifteuddannet i Fasangården og har en baggrund i pædagogik og uddannelsesstudier fra RUC. Snerle har en solid erfaring og et indgående kendskab til Fasangårdens kultur og pædagogiske processer. Snerle er et menneske fuld af energi og godt humør. Snerle er altid optaget af børnenes behov og elsker alt med natur og udeliv, Læse Leg, børnefællesskaber mv. Snerle bruger ethvert påskud for at holde fest og ser lyst på de fleste udfordringer.

Stuens faste pædagogmedhjælper er Emilie og Malte. Emilie er mild og imødekommende, og så holder hun virkelig meget af vuggestuebørn. Hun er nysgerrig på pædagogik og vil rigtig gerne blive ved at dygtiggøre sig. Emilie har været i huset siden august sidste år. Malte er den sidst tilkomne på stuen og har været hos os siden foråret. Malte har en baggrund som bla. tømrer, elsker at lege og han har en rolig tilgang til børnene.

Snerle, Emilie og Malte ønsker sig en pædagogkollega, som kan sætte kreativitet med vuggestuebørn i spil og vil hjælpe børnene med at få øje på egne alsidige kompetencer. Du må meget gerne hvile i dig selv og prioritere samarbejdet i et team. Det vil være et stort plus hvis du har erfaring med vuggestuebørn.

Vi tilbyder dig meget gerne 37 timer, men vi er villige til at forhandle timetallet. Stillingen er ledig nu, men vi venter gerne på den rette.

Hvorfor skal jeg vælge Fasangården, når der er masser andre jobs?

Det skal du, hvis du vil arbejde et sted, med et stabilt fundament og med gode muligheder for at sætte dig selv i spil med dine pædagogiske kompetencer og interesser, om det er tryghedsskabende rutiner, dialogisk læsning, købmandslege, hulebyggeri eller noget helt femte. Vi har flere dygtige medarbejdere, der har prøvet noget andet og som er vendt tilbage til Fasangården.

Du skal også vælge Fasangården, hvis du vil arbejde et sted med kollegaer, som værner om trygge arbejdsfællesskaber, faglig udvikling, at skabe spændende pædagogiske forløb sammen, samt kollegaer som godt kan grine ret højt i pauserummet.

I Fasangården er der også gode muligheder for kurser og uddannelse, fx diplom-fag eller kurser fra KP. Vi har pt. en uddannet søvnvejleder, to pædagoger, som er uddannede Marte Meo terapeuter, og vi forventer at uddanne flere. Hvert år tager vi på studietur til Italien, hvor vi dygtiggør os indenfor Reggio Emilia filosofien.

Vi har egne ressourcekonsulenter ansat i huset og ud over det arbejder vi tæt sammen med PPR og forvaltning om stærke børnefællesskaber.

Hvad skal jeg mere vide om Fasangården?

Fasangården er en veldrevet og ambitiøs profil-institution. Vi arbejder med inspiration fra den italienske pædagogiske filosofi Reggio Emilia, som har læring gennem kreativt virke som en meget tydelig fane. Samtidig arbejder vi for at give børnene varierede muligheder for aktivitet og udfoldelse i alsidige børnefællesskaber – herunder bl.a. rytmik, bevægelse, dialogisk læsning, papkasse-byggeri, legemanuskripter, medlegende voksne, ture og meget andet, hvor børnene kan høre til og danne venskaber.

I Fasangården er vi meget stærke inden for bl.a. kunst og kreativitet, anerkendelse og relationsarbejde, og vi har høj pædagogisk faglighed. I øjeblikket har vi udviklingsfokus på leg med deltagende voksne (herunder implementering af legemanuskripter og guidet leg), samt legezoner på vores store grønne vild med vilje legeplads.

Hvad siger pædagogerne selv?

Mia, som har været i Fasangården i 7 år, fortæller: ”Socialt har personalegruppen det rigtig godt sammen. Fagligt bliver man udfordret og der er mulighed for at videreuddanne sig. Jeg synes virkelig det betyder meget med det sociale – vi kan komme til hinanden og søge sparring. Vi er et stort hus, men det føles ikke sådan når man er her, for vi kender alle sammen hinanden”

Melissa har været 2 år i Fasangården, og hun siger: ”Jeg har været studerende her i huset og da jeg blev færdiguddannet blev jeg tilbudt flere jobs, men jeg ville gerne tilbage til Fasangården. Jeg blev fanget af den kreative profil, kunstprojekterne og at kunne tænke kreativt hele vejen rundt om børnene. Der er mulighed for at afprøve nye ting og der er kollegaer, som støtter op. Det er et meget rummeligt hus, kollegialt er der et stærkt fællesskab og vi har et godt samarbejde med vores engagerede forældre. Jeg synes der er meget frihed her. Ledelsen er gode til at tilgodese medarbejdernes behov og ønsker. Det er jeg sindssyg glad for”.

Hvad tænker Fasangården, at jeg som ny pædagogkollega skal kunne?

Du skal være med til, hver dag at skabe en tryg og forudsigelig hverdag, hvor børnene bliver opfordret til at opleve og udforske verden omkring sig.

Du skal vide, hvad der driver din pædagogiske gejst og måske have områder du brænder særlig meget for.

Du skal ville og kunne samarbejde, være bevidst om brugen af narrativer, og altid have et positivt og ressourceorienteret sprogbrug. Du skal også være åben for at lære nyt og villig til at lære fra dig.

Du behøver ikke at have erfaring med Reggio Emilia, men vi forventer, at du har orienteret dig i filosofien og at du er villig til at lære og udføre, samt er med til at opretholde og give liv til vores fælles retning.

Hvad skal jeg ellers vide?

I Fasangården tilbyder vi også:

  • Høj pædagog-andel, vi er minimum 2 pædagoger på hver stue.
  • Indflydelse på egen arbejdstid (timetal og skema kan drøftes).
  • Forberedelsestid som du selv tilrettelægger.
  • Tidlig fri hver 3. fredag.
  • Mulighed for gratis parkering hvis du bor langt væk.
  • Personalemøder i dagtimerne og to stormøder om året kl. 17.30.
  • Studietur til Italien.
  • Godt arbejdsmiljø og høj medarbejder- og forældretilfredshed.

Hvad med det praktiske?

Vi er normeret til i alt 158 børn, som er fordelt på 5 vuggestuegrupper, 3 børnehavegrupper og vores klub for de ældste børnehavebørn. Vi prioriterer uddannet personale og hver stue har minimum 2 pædagoger og 2 pædagogmedhjælpere. Der er eget ledelsesteam bestående af leder, souschef og en afdelingsleder med ressource-funktion. Fasangården ligger i hjertet af Frederiksberg med både offentlig transport og gratis parkering meget tæt på. Vi har store lyse grupperum, flere fælleslokaler og en stor grøn legeplads med bl.a. æbletræer, fleksible udendørs atelierer, plads til det vilde og det stille og udsigt til en bondegård.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Er i henhold til gældende overenskomst samt indgået aftale om ny løn.

Det er i Frederiksberg kommune et krav at vi indhenter straffeattest og børneattest.

Ansøgningsfrist er:

Fredag d. 25. september kl. 12.00

Samtaler afholdes løbende – send gerne din ansøgning i dag.

Yderligere information:
Du kan læse mere på vores hjemmeside:

Eller ved kontakt til Karina på tlf. 28981330 eller Signe på tlf. 28981333

På vore hjemmeside kan du bl.a. læse vores virkelig flotte tilsynsrapporter.

Ansøgning modtages kun via linket her på siden.

Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning!


Frederiksberg er en levende by med et dynamisk bysamfund. Byens sjæl bygger på vores historie og klassiske arv og er med til at præge den spændende udvikling af Frederiksberg som en grøn, sund og pulserende del af Hovedstaden.
Vi er en moderne kommune, der betjener 104.305 borgere. Frederiksberg Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestillingen og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, handicap, race, hudfarve, religion eller tro, politisk anskuelse, seksuel orientering, kønsidentitet, kønsudtryk eller kønskarakteristika eller national, social eller etnisk oprindelse.

title: Lead Horticulturist
description:
The Arnold Arboretum of Harvard University seeks a highly motivated and skilled horticulture professional, passionate about the care of diverse plant collections, gardens, and landscapes, to fill the role of Lead Horticulturist. The successful candidate will join the Arboretum’s Horticulture Department in stewarding one of the finest and most significant woody plant collections in North America.

Job-Specific Responsibilities:

Under the direction of the Manager of Horticulture, the Lead Horticulturist:

  • Oversees the work of assigned horticulturists and gardeners.
  • Coordinates daily activities to ensure work is completed properly, safely, and in a timely manner.
  • Is responsible for ordering, inventory control, and maintenance of equipment and supplies associated with the team’s work.
  • Serves as a lead in the Arboretum’s Plant Health Care and safety programs.
  • Assists with training and onboarding of new staff.
  • Performs maintenance and structural pruning of young trees, shrubs, and vines.
  • Carries out nursery practices, including ball-and-burlap techniques and proper planting protocols.
  • Monitors and manage pests and diseases as part of a holistic Integrated Pest Management (IPM) program.
  • Performs weed management and lawn maintenance.
  • Monitors and improves soil health.
  • Evaluates and enhances landscape aesthetics in assigned areas.
  • Safely operates, maintains, and performs minor repairs on various horticultural and landscape equipment.
  • Performs leaf, litter, and snow management.
  • Identifies and assists with repair of irrigation, drainage, paths, and other hardscape and infrastructure systems.
  • Oversees the work of interns, apprentices, and seasonal or term staff as assigned.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

The Lead Horticulturist is a key member of the Horticulture & Landscape crew and is expected to lead by example by following Arboretum policies and safety practices and promoting a collaborative, team-oriented environment. This role works closely with other members of the leadership team to support continuous improvement of operations and team dynamics.

Working Conditions:

  • This position is primarily performed outdoors in a variety of field conditions. Work is regularly conducted in all seasons and in all types of weather, including heat, cold, rain, and snow.
  • Work may involve exposure to noise, dust, pollen, chemicals (including fertilizers and pesticides), and other environmental conditions associated with horticultural operations. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) will be provided and is required when indicated.
  • Work schedules may occasionally include early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed, particularly during weather-related events or other operational emergencies.
  • This position is designated as essential personnel for certain weather-related or emergency situations and is expected to report to work or remain on duty as required.

Physical Requirements:

  • This role requires the ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, reach, kneel, and crouch for extended periods of time.
  • The position requires the ability to frequently lift, carry, push, and pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • The role involves regular use of hand tools and power equipment and may include operating vehicles and equipment such as trucks, tractors, mowers, and loaders.

Basic Qualifications are the minimum requirements a candidate must meet to be considered for this role.
Bachelor’s or associate degree required; preference for degrees in arboriculture, horticulture, or a closely related field.

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in horticulture or a closely related field.
  • In lieu of a degree, a minimum of five (5) additional years of experience in ornamental horticulture required
  • Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate as part of the pre-hiring process and on an ongoing basis.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • Demonstrated experience in the safe and proper operation of horticultural and landscape equipment.
  • Ability to serve as essential staff for weather-related emergencies impacting the grounds (e.g., snow events, storms).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead, train, and coordinate the work of others.
  • Demonstrated commitment to working safely and fostering a respectful, inclusive work environment.

Certificates and Licenses:

  • Will be required to obtain and maintain a Massachusetts Pesticide Applicator License within six (6) months of employment and either a Massachusetts Commercial Pesticide License or a Massachusetts Private Pesticide License within three (3) years of employment.
  • Will be required to obtain and maintain, within six (6) months of employment, a hoisting license of the proper classification as required by the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.
  • Will be required to obtain and maintain certification as an Arborist with the Massachusetts Arborist Association or with the International Society of Arboriculture within six (6) months of employment.
  • May be required to obtain and maintain a valid Commercial Driver’s License (CDL), if job duties require the operation of commercial motor vehicles.
  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 40 hours per week
  • Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $48.43, as negotiated in the Service Employees International Union (SEIU), Local 32BJ Arboretum Employees’ agreement.
  • Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Harvard University requires pre-employment reference and background screenings: Identity, Education, DOT Physical, RMV and Drug screenings.
  • Other Information:
    • Pre-Employment Requirements
      • As part of the hiring process, the finalist will be required to:
        • Undergo a Department of Transportation (DOT) physical examination or provide proof of such examination
        • Complete a drug screening, as permitted by applicable law.
        • Successfully complete a Registry of Motor Vehicles (RMV) license verification.
        • Undergo an education background check.

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that all duties and responsibilities must be performed at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location. Certain visa types may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 000. Corresponding salary information can be found in the job description above.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions
  • Wellbeing and mental health resources
  • Support for families and caregivers
  • Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

description:

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

PET Configuration Test Department is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated individual to join our team in assembling, testing, and troubleshooting electrical/mechanical systems and computer-based diagnostic imaging equipment. This role requires hands-on work with tools, test equipment, and technical documentation in a team-oriented environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assemble, test, and troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, or computer-based systems. Follow written procedures and technical drawings to perform tasks. Accurately record data and findings in internal systems. Use provided tools and test equipment (e.g., cordless screwdrivers, torque wrenches, digital multimeters). Some roles may involve occasional handling of low-level radioactive components (safety measures provided).

Required Qualifications

Willingness and ability to learn new technical skills. Ability to read and follow step-by-step procedures. Ability to interpret engineering drawings (e.g., mechanical schematics, wiring diagrams). Strong attention to detail when logging data electronically or on paper. Comfortable working collaboratively as part of a team. Able to lift up to 50 lbs occasionally.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with hand and power tools (e.g., torque wrenches, Atlas Copco smart tools, Faro Lasers). Experience using electrical test instruments (e.g., digital multimeters, ground bond testers). Experience installing software on computer systems. Availability to work 1st shift and occasional overtime (including some weekends). Post-secondary education in a technical field (e.g., Mechatronics certification, Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a technical field). Prior work experience in a technical or manufacturing environment.

title: Cobalt KS Process Engineer
description:
Job Title: Process Engineer

Department: Engineering

Reports To: Department Supervisor

FLSA Status: Salary

Summary: The Process Engineer is responsible for developing, optimizing, and maintaining manufacturing processes used in the production of boats and marine components. This role focuses on improving safety, quality, cost, and delivery by analyzing production methods, implementing process improvements, and supporting cross-functional teams throughout the manufacturing lifecycle.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Process Development & Optimization

  • Design, document, and improve manufacturing processes
  • Optimize processes related to fiberglass layup, resin infusion, composite bonding, welding, machining, assembly, and finishing
  • Develop standard work instructions, process flow diagrams, and manufacturing routings
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen)

Production Support

  • Provide day-to-day engineering support to production teams
  • Troubleshoot process issues impacting quality, throughput, or safety
  • Support new product introductions (NPI) and production ramp-ups
  • Collaborate with production supervisors to improve line balance and labor efficiency

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure processes meet quality standards, marine regulations, and customer specifications
  • Assist with root cause analysis and corrective actions for defects and non-conformances
  • Support audits and compliance with ISO, ABYC, and applicable marine standards

Cost & Efficiency Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to reduce material waste, cycle time, and rework
  • Support cost-reduction initiatives through process improvements and material optimization
  • Analyze production data and KPIs to drive informed decisions

Equipment & Tooling

  • Specify, evaluate, and support manufacturing equipment, tools, jigs, and fixtures
  • Collaborate with maintenance and vendors on equipment installation and upgrades
  • Ensure safe and efficient operation of manufacturing equipment

Documentation & Training

  • Create and maintain process documentation and manufacturing specifications
  • Train production personnel on new or revised processes
  • Support knowledge transfer and continuous skill development

title: Projektstilling:  Demenskonsulent med Marte Meo-erfaring til ældreområdet i Svendborg Kommune
description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle fremtidens demensindsats?

Svendborg Kommune ønsker at styrke den faglige indsats på plejecenterområdet og søger derfor en demenskonsulent – gerne med erfaring inden for Marte Meo – til et 1-årigt pilotprojekt.

Svendborg Kommune ønsker løbende at udvikle og styrke den demensfaglige indsats på plejecenterområdet. Som led i denne udvikling afprøver vi en ny organisering, hvor Marte Meo-kompetencerne samles i en ny funktion i Demensteamet.

Formålet er at understøtte en ensartet og høj faglig kvalitet på tværs af kommunens plejecentre og samtidig styrke den faglige sparring, supervision og kompetenceudvikling tæt på praksis. Funktionen skal bidrage til at understøtte medarbejdere og ledelse i arbejdet med personcentreret omsorg og skabe de bedst mulige rammer for borgere med demens og deres pårørende.

Stillingen er organisatorisk placeret i Demensteamet, som består af fire demenskonsulenter og en demensfaglig konsulent. Teamet er en del af Visitation og Rehabilitering, der desuden omfatter visitatorer, rehabiliteringsterapeuter, arbejdsmiljøkonsulent og uddannelsesområdet. Her bliver du en del af et stærkt tværfagligt miljø med gode muligheder for faglig sparring, udvikling og samarbejde.

Om os

I Svendborg Kommune arbejder vi sammen om kerneopgaven og sætter fællesskabet højt. Vi vægter ordentlighed, ansvarlighed og høj faglighed i opgaveløsningen og har stor respekt for samarbejdet med både borgere, pårørende og interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Vi har fokus på arbejdsglæde, trivsel og på at bringe hinandens forskellige kompetencer og styrker i spil.

Svendborg Kommune er blandt landets foregangskommuner på demensområdet. Vi arbejder ud fra en helhedsorienteret og personcentreret tilgang og er hjemsted for Danmarks første demensby. Vores demensindsats bygger på en stærk demenspolitik, tværfagligt samarbejde og et mål om at skabe trygge, meningsfulde og værdige liv for mennesker med demens.

Samtidig står vi – ligesom resten af landet – over for implementeringen af den nye ældrelov, som giver nye muligheder for at udvikle vores indsatser med fokus på livskvalitet, selvbestemmelse og helhedsorienterede løsninger.

Dine primære opgaver

Du bliver en central sparringspartner for plejecentrene og får blandt andet ansvar for:

  • Besøg hos borgere med demens på kommunens plejecentre.
  • Være kontaktperson og tovholder i svære forløb på plejecentrene.
  • Rådgivning, vejledning og støtte til borgere og pårørende gennem hele forløbet.
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.
  • Supervision og faglig sparring i komplekse borgerforløb.
  • Kompetenceudvikling og undervisning af medarbejdere inden for demensområdet.
  • Undervisning og sagsbehandling i forbindelse med magtanvendelse og værgemål.
  • Undervisning i personcentreret omsorg – gerne med afsæt i Marte Meo.
  • Vejledning om kommunens tilbud og relevante indsatser.
  • Medvirken til udvikling af nye tiltag samt deltagelse i udviklingsprojekter på demensområdet.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du:

  • En nyoprettet projektstilling med mulighed for at præge udviklingen af området.
  • Et engageret og tværfagligt team med høj faglighed og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab.
  • En arbejdsplads med stor grad af selvstændighed og indflydelse på tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdet.
  • En værdibaseret organisation, hvor personcentreret omsorg, rehabilitering og borgerens selvbestemmelse er fundamentet for vores arbejde.
  • Grundig introduktion og mentorordning.
  • Fokus på faglig udvikling, læring, arbejdsglæde og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Vi søger en kollega, som

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en mellemlang sundhedsfaglig uddannelse.
  • Gerne har efteruddannelse inden for demens, eksempelvis en diplomuddannelse.
  • Har erfaring med Marte Meo eller interesse for at anvende metoden i praksis.
  • Kan arbejde struktureret, selvstændigt og fleksibelt.
  • Trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og kan rådgive i komplekse borgerforløb.
  • Har stærke formidlingskompetencer og motiveres af undervisning og supervision.
  • Har kørekort.
  • Har gode IT-kompetencer – gerne erfaring med Nexus.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte:

  • Myndighedsleder Anne Bak Sørensen på telefon 30 17 60 01.
  • Demensfaglig konsulent Annette Søby på telefon 24 88 68 55.

Praktiske oplysninger

Ved ansættelse i stillingerne skal der fremvises en privat straffeattest. Denne kan med fordel indhentes ved indkaldelse til samtale. Der vil ligeledes skulle indhentes referencer ved to tidligere arbejdspladser. Disse kan med fordel indskrives i ansøgningen. Løn- og ansættelse efter gældende overenskomst.

Frist for ansøgningen er 13.09.26

For rekvirering af stillings – og funktionsbeskrivelse kontakt myndighedsafdelingens kontor på mail socmyn@svendborg.dk eller telefon på 62 23 40 00 tryk 3

Der indkaldes til samtale d. 14.09.26 pr. mail og samtalen afholdes d. 15.09.26.

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem 40.000 og 44.000 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

title: Telecaller - Gujarati (Dostt)
description:
About Lokal:

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

    • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
    • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
    • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
    • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
    • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
    • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

Role Overview:

We are hiring for our sister app - Dostt , an audio and video platform. Currently, we operate in Hindi. As we expand rapidly, we are seeing significant growth.

We are looking for a motivated and results-driven Telecaller to join our team. The Telecaller will be responsible for making outbound calls to potential leads, understanding their needs, and offering suitable services & onboarding them to the platform. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a customer-centric approach, and the ability to handle rejections professionally.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Make outbound calls to potential and existing hosts to inform them about products and services.
  • Follow up on leads generated through various marketing campaigns.
  • Maintain detailed records of host interactions and transactions.
  • Achieve daily/weekly/monthly call and conversion targets.
  • Provide accurate and timely information to hosts.
  • Stay updated with the latest products, services, and promotional offers.
  • Train & Onboarding new hosts as per Guidelines of App.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Proven experience as a Telecaller or in a similar role.
  • Excellent communication skills in Gujaratiand English (read, write and speak).
  • Ability to handle Host rejection and remain patient.
  • Basic knowledge of computer operations, CRM & Excel.
  • Strong listening and negotiation skills with a positive attitude and ability to work in a team

Why Join Us?

We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

title: Account Champion
description:
The Role

At Portless, we don’t just ship packages; we bridge the gap between global brands and their customers. As an Account Champion, you are the "Operational Architect" and heartbeat of our highest-priority accounts. You aren't just a translator; you are the strategic link that ensures North American growth strategy is converted into flawless, scalable execution on the China & Chicago fulfillment floors. You are a Logistics Diplomat—equally at home presenting performance data to executives as you are commanding authority on the warehouse floor.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Liaison & Risk Mitigation

  • Bridge the Strategic Gap: Act as the primary conduit between North American leadership and the China & US FC. You don't just communicate strategy; you influence it by providing the "boots on the ground" reality.
  • The Feedback Loop: Serve as the internal advocate for the merchant. Identify recurring friction points on the floor and partner with CS, Product/Services, & Engineering to build systemic, software-based solutions that prevent future bottlenecks.
  • Cultural & Operational Translation: Ensure "unboxing" quality and delivery speed expectations are not just understood, but codified into the local FC’s DNA.

2. Operational Prioritization & Leadership

  • Workload Orchestration: Lead the FC floor in prioritizing daily tasks for Tier 1 & 2 Merchants. You hold the "Michelin Star" standard for our most valuable clients.
  • Dynamic Resource Allocation: Maintain a seat at the table with FC Management to shift labor and resources in real-time based on order volume surges and strategic urgency.
  • SOP & SLA Excellence: Act as the guardian of operational standards. You don’t just follow SOPs; you rewrite them to ensure we are always moving toward a more scalable, "0-to-1" environment.

3. Data Storytelling & Queue Discipline

  • Systems Mastery (Jira & WMS): Own the Jira service queues with 100% "in-system" discipline. Use these tools to ensure every merchant request is tracked and resolved.
  • Data-Driven Diplomacy: Move beyond anecdotal updates. Use throughput data and KPI tracking to prove value to merchants and justify operational changes to leadership.
  • Accountability & Mentorship: Lead and upskill junior FC team members in documentation excellence and time management.

4. Global Communication & Synergy

  • Human-Centric Communication: Drive a culture of "Proactive Transparency." Move beyond automated notifications to provide thoughtful, human updates that build deep trust with North American Account Managers.
  • Cross-Departmental Leadership: Lead initiatives that break down silos between the FC, CS, and Engineering teams to ensure a unified global response to challenges.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ Years of Experience: Proven track record in fulfillment, cross-border logistics, or account management (3PL experience is a must).
  • Bilingual Capability: Native-level fluency in English and Mandarin is essential. You must be able to negotiate in the boardroom and the warehouse breakroom.
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced experience with Jira, Slack, ERP, and WMS platforms. Ability to interpret data to find "the story" behind the numbers.
  • Warehouse Expertise: Hands-on experience with non-bonded and bonded warehouse requirements.
  • Leadership Presence: Proven ability to lead diverse teams through high-pressure "Peak Season" environments.

Values & Ways of Working

  • Extreme Ownership: You don't say "that's not my job." You own the package until it’s in the customer's hands.
  • Strategic Boldness: You have the confidence to challenge a process if you know there is a faster, better way to serve the merchant.
  • Precision as Kindness: You understand that in global logistics, a 1% error rate is a failure. You obsess over the details so the merchant doesn't have to.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are frustrated by "good enough" and move with a sense of purposeful impatience. You understand the grit of a warehouse floor but can speak the language of a North American executive. You are looking for a "tour of duty" that allows you to prove your leadership on a global stage and paves the way for a future in Executive Operations or Global CS Leadership.

title: Starszy Specjalista ds. Administracji Operacyjnej (K/M) 15745
description:
DHL eCommerce (Poland) to lider polskiego rynku przesyłek krajowych i prekursor wdrażania innowacyjnych rozwiązań e-commerce, dedykowanych klientom w Polsce i Europie. W DHL eCommerce wykorzystujemy wiedzę w dziedzinie krajowych oraz międzynarodowych przesyłek drogowych, docierając do 28 krajów Unii Europejskiej.

Praca w DHL eCommerce (Poland) to szansa na karierę w jednej z czołowych firm branży logistycznej, w zespole najlepszych specjalistów z całego świata.


Twoje zadania:

  • obsługa interwencji, reklamacji i dyspozycji klientów,
  • zapewnienie prawidłowego rozliczania przesyłek nadanych i doręczonych,
  • stała współpraca z kurierami w zakresie rozliczania z dokumentacji, otrzymywanych płatności i jakości pracy,
  • cykliczne przygotowywanie i weryfikacja raportów związanych z realizowanymi zadaniami,
  • zadania administracyjne związane z obrotem faktur, zamówień, umów, materiałów eksploatacyjnych.
  • wsparcie procesów magazynowych.
Nasze oczekiwania:
  • dobra znajomość programów z pakietu MS Office (MS Excel, MS Word),
  • komunikatywność i łatwość nawiązywania relacji,
  • umiejętność pracy zespołowej,
  • umiejętność organizacji pracy i ustalania priorytetów.

OFERUJEMY

  • zatrudnienie na umowę o pracę,
  • wynagrodzenie: 5300- 6360 zł brutto (na wskazany przedział wynagrodzenia składa się wynagrodzenie zasadnicze oraz miesięczna premia uzależniona od wyników operacyjnych jednostki, do 20% wynagrodzenia zasadniczego)
  • coroczną podwyżkę (uzależnioną od wyników finansowych firmy i indywidualnej oceny rocznej).

Dodatkowo do wynagrodzenia:

  • dodatek świąteczny do 1400 zł brutto,
  • dofinansowanie do wypoczynku do 900 zł brutto,
  • zniżki na przesyłki DHL na terenie Europy
  • dostęp do platformy kafeteryjnej.

W super cenie:

  • pakiet opieki medycznej lub ubezpieczenie na życie (zapłacisz tylko 1 zł),
  • karta sportowa.

Masz szansę na:

  • nagrody w ramach konkursu na Człowieka Roku,
  • nagrody jubileuszowe,
  • prezenty z okazji narodzin dziecka, stypendia dla dzieci,
  • uzyskanie pożyczki na preferencyjnych warunkach,
  • przystąpienie do Pracowniczego Programu Emerytalnego.
Rozwijaj się razem z nami:
  • w 2025 roku ok. 12% osób awansowało dzięki rekrutacjom wewnętrznym oraz w ramach ścieżek karier,
  • posiadamy autorskie szkolenia wewnętrzne oraz narzędzia wspierające Cię w planowaniu rozwoju,
  • możesz bezpłatnie uczyć się języków obcych na platformie online.

DHL eCommerce (Poland) sp. z o.o. (dalej „DHL") żąda podania jedynie takich danych osobowych, które wskazane są w obowiązujących przepisach prawa (imię/imiona i nazwisko, data urodzenia, dane kontaktowe wskazane przez kandydata, a w przypadku gdy jest to niezbędne do wykonywania pracy określonego rodzaju lub na określonym stanowisku - także dane dotyczące wykształcenia, kwalifikacji zawodowych i przebiegu dotychczasowego zatrudnienia). W szczególności DHL nie żąda przesyłania zdjęcia.

Podanie przez Ciebie danych osobowych przekraczających zakres danych osobowych wymaganych przez DHL oznacza wyrażenie przez Ciebie zgody na przetwarzanie tych danych. Przesłanie przez Ciebie zdjęcia, oznacza wyrażenie wyraźnej zgody na przetwarzanie danych nim objętych.

Jeśli przekazane przez Ciebie dokumenty aplikacyjne zawierają dane, o których mowa w art. 9 ust. 1 RODO (dane szczególnej kategorii, w tym dane dotyczące zdrowia w szczególności orzeczenie lekarskie o niepełnosprawności ) DHL będzie przetwarzał w/w dane na podstawie artykułu 22[1] § 4 Kodeksu pracy.

Możesz z łatwością cofnąć zgodę w dowolnym momencie. Aby to zrobić, napisz do IOD na adres: dpo.parcel@dhl.com Wycofanie zgody nie wpływa na zgodność z prawem przetwarzania dokonanego przed jej wycofaniem.

Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych zawartych w zgłoszeniu jest DHL eCommerce (Poland) sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie, przy ul. Osmańskiej 2, 02-823 Warszawa. Możesz skontaktować się z nami drogą pisemną lub poprzez następujący e-mail: dpo.parcel@dhl.com Będziemy przetwarzać Twoje dane osobowe w celu przeprowadzenia procesu rekrutacji na stanowisko, na które aplikujesz, w tym w celu komunikacji z tym związanej, w celu prowadzenia przyszłych rekrutacji (o ile wyrazisz na to zgodę) i w celu przesłania zaproszenia do wypełnienia ankiety związanej z badaniem satysfakcji kandydata dotyczącym jakości procesu rekrutacyjnego oraz - w uzasadnionych przypadkach - w celu ewentualnego ustalenia, dochodzenia lub obrony przed roszczeniami. Masz prawo żądać do nich dostępu, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania i żądania ich przeniesienia. Masz także prawo do wniesienia w dowolnym momencie sprzeciwu wobec przetwarzania - z przyczyn związanych ze swoją szczególną sytuacją. W zakresie w jakim przetwarzanie Twoich danych osobowych odbywa się na podstawie zgody, masz prawo do jej cofnięcia, bez wpływu na legalność przetwarzania dokonanego przed jej wycofaniem. Masz prawo wniesienia skargi do Prezesa Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych, jeżeli sądzisz że przetwarzanie danych osobowych narusza przepisy prawa w tym zakresie. Więcej informacji znajdziesz pod poniższym linkiem: https://www.dhl.com/pl-pl/ecommerce/o-dhl-ecommerce/przetwarzanie-danych-osobowych.html (zakładka: Kandydat do pracy (aplikacja składana w odpowiedzi na prowadzony proces rekrutacyjny)).

Uprzejmie informujemy, że w DHL eCommerce (Poland) sp. z o.o. obowiązuje procedura zgłoszeń wewnętrznych pozwalająca na zgłoszenie informacji o naruszeniu prawa. Z pełną treścią procedury można się zapoznać pod adresem https://www.dhl.com/pl-pl/ecommerce/footer/masthead.html

Zgłoszeń objętych procedurą dokonywać można na adres pldec.compliance@dhl.com

title: Director, Global SME Partner Management & Go-to-Market
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Director, Global SME Partner Management & Go-to-Market

Role Overview
The Director, Global SME Partner Management & Go-to-Market supports the Vice President in driving adoption, utilisation and commercial impact across Mastercard's SME partnership ecosystem.

The role translates global partner management and go-to-market strategy into practical operating models, issuer activation frameworks, enablement materials and performance routines that regional teams can deploy consistently.

Working with regional Product, SME Business Development, Account Management, Services and partner teams, the Director helps scale strategic partner solutions across issuer portfolios and supports measurable growth in SME customer activation, engagement and solution utilisation.

The role does not own regional execution directly. It acts as a global execution partner and centre-of-excellence contributor, ensuring regional teams have the tools, governance, data and best-practice support needed to launch, promote and grow partner solutions effectively.

Scope & Operating Model
• Operationalise the global GTM strategy and partner growth priorities set by the VP.
• Build issuer activation playbooks, launch models and enablement assets that regional teams can adapt and deploy.
• Support joint growth planning, partner performance management and governance routines.
• Develop adoption dashboards, insight packs and best-practice reporting for use across the global SME partnerships organisation.
• Work through regional teams rather than owning local execution directly.
• Escalate strategic issues, material risks and prioritisation choices to the VP with clear options and recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Go-to-Market Planning & Ecosystem Enablement
• Support the VP in translating global go-to-market strategy into practical plans, playbooks and deployment frameworks for strategic SME partner solutions.
• Develop repeatable GTM models that support issuer launch, activation, engagement and scale across priority regions.
• Maintain global GTM assets, sales narratives, launch guidance and implementation toolkits for regional teams.
• Track progress against ecosystem growth priorities and highlight dependencies, risks and areas requiring VP-level intervention.

2. Issuer Adoption & Portfolio Activation
• Partner with regional SME Business Development and Account Management teams to embed partner solutions into issuer growth conversations and portfolio plans.
• Develop issuer activation frameworks, launch checklists and adoption playbooks that can be adapted locally while preserving global consistency.
• Support regional teams in identifying activation barriers and codifying approaches that accelerate issuer adoption.
• Capture and share best practices for scaling ecosystem adoption across issuer portfolios.

3. SME Customer Penetration & Solution Utilisation
• Develop practical frameworks to improve awareness, activation, usage and retention of partner solutions within issuers' SME customer bases.
• Work with Product, Services and regional teams to define engagement journeys, customer propositions and utilisation levers for partner solutions.
• Monitor utilisation patterns, regional feedback and performance insights to identify opportunities to improve SME customer engagement.
• Support measurable increases in activation and usage by turning insights into repeatable improvement actions.

4. Partner Performance Management & Growth
• Support executive partner governance by preparing business review materials, performance packs, growth plans and issue logs.
• Contribute to joint partner growth plans by coordinating inputs from regions, Product, Services and commercial teams.
• Track partner performance against agreed adoption, utilisation and commercial objectives.
• Identify opportunities to deepen partner value, improve deployment effectiveness and scale successful use cases across markets.

5. Regional Enablement & Best-Practice Management
• Act as a hands-on enablement lead for regional Product, SME Business Development and Account Management teams.
• Create and maintain GTM playbooks, partner briefs, issuer-facing materials, internal guidance and adoption toolkits.
• Coordinate communities of practice, regional feedback loops and best-practice sharing around partner-led SME growth.
• Ensure learnings from regional execution are codified into scalable global frameworks.

6. Performance Reporting, Governance & Insights
• Build and maintain adoption reporting mechanisms, dashboards and governance routines that provide visibility across partner solutions and regions.
• Consolidate regional performance inputs and translate them into clear insights, risks, actions and recommendations for the VP.
• Support quarterly business reviews, partner governance forums and internal stakeholder updates.
• Ensure performance measures are consistently defined and used across partner management and GTM activity.

7. Stakeholder Coordination & Matrix Leadership
• Coordinate across Product, Sales, Services, SME Business Development, Account Management and regional teams to support aligned execution.
• Drive follow-through on agreed actions, dependencies and priorities across cross-functional teams.
• Represent the global partner management and GTM function in working-level forums and regional planning discussions.
• Escalate strategic trade-offs, resource constraints and material execution risks to the VP with clear options and recommendations.

Experience & Capabilities

• Strong experience in partnership management, go-to-market execution, business development, product commercialisation or ecosystem growth.
• Demonstrated ability to turn strategy into scalable operating models, enablement materials and practical execution plans.
• Experience working across product, sales, account management, services and regional organisations in a matrixed environment.
• Strong commercial judgement, performance orientation and ability to use data to identify adoption opportunities and execution barriers.
• Credibility with internal stakeholders and external partners, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
• Understanding of issuer, SME and fintech ecosystems, including the commercial drivers behind SME customer engagement and solution utilisation.
• Strong written communication, structured problem-solving and senior stakeholder briefing capabilities.

Success Measures

• Quality and adoption of GTM playbooks, launch models, issuer activation frameworks and enablement materials.
• Number and percentage of priority issuers progressing through defined partner-solution activation stages.
• Growth in issuer portfolio penetration, SME customer activation, utilisation and engagement for partner solutions.
• Partner performance against agreed adoption, utilisation and commercial growth objectives.
• Timeliness and quality of partner governance materials, dashboards, business reviews and performance insights.
• Evidence that regional learnings are captured, codified and reused across markets.
• Feedback from the VP, strategic partners, regional teams and cross-functional stakeholders on enablement quality and execution support.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: (Senior) Director Pharmacovigilance Operations
description:
(Senior) Director Pharmacovigilance Operations/Central PV Services is responsible for the leadership, strategic development, and operational oversight of the global Central Pharmacovigilance (PV) Services organization. The role ensures compliant, efficient, and scalable delivery of centralized pharmacovigilance services, including Individual Case Safety Report (ICSR) processing, literature surveillance, signal detection and management, benefit-risk management, aggregate safety reporting, and related PV operational services. The role is accountable for building and expanding strategic global delivery hubs, developing scalable outsourcing models, driving operational excellence, and supporting the operational, financial, and client objectives of the PV & MI Business Unit.

Key areas of responsibility and main tasks:

Strategic & Functional Leadership

  • Execute the Central PV Services strategy in alignment with the PV & MI Business Unit objectives.
  • Develop scalable centralized PV operating models supporting global clinical development and post-marketing programs.
  • Lead establishment, expansion and optimization of global PV delivery hubs.
  • Develop strategic outsourcing models to improve scalability, quality, operational efficiency, and financial performance.
  • Drive innovation, automation, AI-enabled technologies and digital transformation across Central PV Services.
  • Advise the VP, Global Safety & MI on operational strategy, service delivery, capacity planning and operational risks.
  • Act as escalation point for significant Central PV operational and service delivery issues.
  • Provide operational performance reporting, delivery metrics and strategic updates to senior management.

Central PV Operations & Delivery Excellence

  • Provide strategic and operational oversight of centralized pharmacovigilance services across:
  1. Case Management (ICSR processing, case intake and triage, medical coding, quality review, and medical review support).
  2. Literature Management (literature surveillance, screening, and literature case processing).
  3. Signal & Benefit-Risk Management (signal detection, validation, evaluation, benefit-risk assessment, and related risk management activities).
  4. Aggregate Safety Reporting (PSURs/PBRERs, DSURs, PADERs, and other regulatory aggregate safety reports).
  5. Operational Excellence (Safety Data Exchange activities, operational metrics and reporting, process standardization, automation, continuous improvement, and service delivery governance).
  • Ensure all Central PV Services are delivered in accordance with applicable regulations, contractual obligations, internal procedures, quality standards, and client expectations.
  • Monitor operational, quality, and productivity KPIs, ensuring timely escalation, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Drive operational excellence through standardized processes, technology enablement, automation, and scalable delivery models that support sustainable business growth.

Global Delivery Hub & Outsourcing Strategy

  • Develop and implement the global strategy for centralized PV delivery, ensuring scalable, efficient, and consistent service delivery across regions.
  • Build, expand, and optimize strategic centralized PV delivery hubs to support business growth and evolving client needs.
  • Lead the transition and integration of PV activities into centralized delivery models, ensuring effective governance, business continuity, and operational consistency.
  • Establish standardized operating models, resource planning, and workforce strategies to optimize capacity, utilization, and delivery performance across global operations.
  • Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, innovation, digital solutions, and enabling technologies to enhance quality, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Develop and maintain resilient global delivery capabilities that support sustainable growth, client satisfaction, and high-quality service delivery.

Compliance & Operational Quality

  • Maintain inspection-ready Central PV operational processes.
  • Ensure delivery complies with EU GVP Modules, FDA, ICH and other applicable global regulations.
  • Support regulatory inspections and client audits involving Central PV Services.
  • Oversee implementation and follow-up of CAPAs related to operational activities.
  • Ensure governance of operational KPIs, quality metrics and compliance monitoring.
  • Collaborate with QPPV Office, Medical/Clinical Safety, PV/MI Technologies, and Medical Information functions to ensure harmonized PV/MI governance.

Financial & Business Support

  • Contribute to Business Unit financial targets through effective operational planning, workforce optimization and resource forecasting.
  • Support pricing, proposals, RFIs, RFPs and bid defenses by providing operational expertise, delivery models and resource assumptions.
  • Identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, automation and cost optimization while maintaining quality and compliance.
  • Support expansion of Central PV Services across existing and new clients.

Team Management

  • Lead and develop the Central PV Services leadership team.
  • Build organizational capability supporting global service expansion.
  • Drive succession planning and talent development.
  • Promote a culture of operational excellence, accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure appropriate organizational structures supporting sustainable growth.

Client & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Support client retention through high-quality operational delivery and continuous service improvement.
  • Partner closely with the QPPV Office, Program Management, Operations Strategy, PV/MI Technologies, Medical & Clinical Safety and Medical Information to ensure integrated service delivery.
  • Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory, Commercial, Legal and Business Development functions.
  • Represent Central PV Services during governance meetings, operational reviews and client engagements.
  • Support strategic client initiatives involving centralized PV outsourcing and transformation

Other responsibilities

  • Identify areas for improvement and proactively propose solutions within the area of responsibility.
  • Deputize for another employee or staff member of the same department as instructed by the Head of Department.

Perform additional tasks related to the department's activities as assigned by the Head of Department

Requirements

  • MD, PharmD, PhD, MSc or equivalent scientific degree preferred.
  • At least 12 years of pharmacovigilance experience.
  • At least 5 years of progressive leadership experience managing global PV operations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading centralized PV services and global delivery organizations.
  • Extensive knowledge of case processing, literature surveillance, signal detection, benefit-risk management and aggregate reporting.
  • Experience building global shared service centers and scalable outsourcing models.
  • Strong knowledge of EU GVP Modules, ICH guidelines, FDA and global PV regulations.
  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections and client audits.
  • Strong understanding of safety databases and PV technologies.
  • Demonstrate strong leadership and collaboration by effectively leading and aligning global operational teams.
  • Drive executive communication through operational excellence and strategic execution.
  • Influence stakeholders across complex global organizations.
  • Demonstrate strategic thinking with a strong operational excellence mindset.
  • Apply advanced decision-making and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrate negotiation skills and commercial acumen with a client-focused approach.
  • Stay informed of emerging PV technologies, automation, AI, and regulatory developments.
  • Effectively adapt to and lead organizational change.
  • Apply coaching and mentoring techniques to develop future leaders.
  • Demonstrate behaviors aligned with Company values, cultural awareness, and the ability to work effectively in diverse environments.
  • Professional level in English, both oral and written.

Benefits

  • International team and environment
  • Remote Work, workation & Flexibility
  • Health & Wellbeing – wellness initiatives
  • Professional growth and development in the Life science industry
  • Team Culture – Team buildings, global meetings, and B Active events.
  • Performance based annual bonus
  • Comprehensive Insurance - Personal accident, business trip coverage, and additional health insurance.

title: 2 Konsulenter søges til Marjattas kontraktteam
description:
Socialfaglig konsulent og pædagogisk konsulent til Marjattas Kontraktteam

Vil du være med til at styrke kvalitet, myndighedssamarbejde og faglig udvikling på det specialiserede socialområde?

Vi søger to nye kollegaer til Marjattas Kontraktteam, en socialfaglig konsulent og en pædagogisk konsulent. Marjattas Kontraktteamet understøtter ledere og tilbud på tværs af Marjattas socialområde og fungerer som bindeled mellem tilbuddene, kommunerne, Region Sjælland og øvrige samarbejdspartnere. Du får mulighed for at bringe din faglighed i spil, lære nyt og bidrage til udviklingen af både kvalitet, samarbejde og arbejdsgange

Om Marjatta

På Marjatta møder vi mennesket med udviklingshæmning, som et ligeværdigt og unikt menneske med en sund indre kerne. Vi tror på, at ethvert menneske kan udvikles og udfolde sit potentiale bl.a. igennem undervisning, meningsfulde aktiviteter, omsorgsfulde møder med dygtigt personale, deltagelse i kunstneriske projekter og ikke mindst fællesskabet med andre.

Du vil indgå i et tværfagligt team af konsulenter og bliver en del af vores fælles administration, hvor en snes kolleger arbejder med bl.a. sekretariat, HR, personale, løn, økonomi, ejendomme, sundhed og kontrakter. Vi er en organisation i udvikling, hvor faglig kvalitet, samarbejde og læring er centrale omdrejningspunkter. Som led i vores fortsatte udvikling af socialområdet udvider vi nu Kontraktteamet med to nye konsulentstillinger.

Om Kontraktteamet

Marjattas Kontraktteamet består i dag af en socialfaglig leder, en økonomimedarbejder og en dokumentationsmedarbejder. Teamet arbejder tæt sammen med ledere på tværs af Marjattas tilbud og har en central rolle i at understøtte kvalitet, dokumentation, myndighedssamarbejde og udvikling. En væsentlig opgave for teamet er at understøtte Marjattas ledere gennem faglig sparring, kvalitetssikring og rådgivning i komplekse sager.

Om stillingerne

Som konsulent i Marjattas kontraktteamet bidrager du til at sikre høj faglig kvalitet på tværs af Marjattas. Du omsætter faglige vurderinger til kvalificeret dokumentation, understøtter ledere i komplekse faglige processer og bidrager til et konstruktivt samarbejde med kommuner og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

Stillingen rummer både drifts- og udviklingsopgaver. Afhængigt af din faglige baggrund vil du blandt andet arbejde med myndighedssamarbejde, dokumentation, kvalitetsudvikling og understøttelse af faglig praksis.

Marjatta har driftsoverenskomst med Region Sjælland, og kvalitetsarbejdet er derfor tæt forankret i samarbejdet med regionen. Arbejdet tager afsæt i Den Danske Kvalitetsmodel på det sociale område, og vi arbejder aktivt med audits, forbedringsarbejde samt udvikling af fælles standarder, retningslinjer og arbejdsgange.

Som konsulent bliver du en del af dette samarbejde og vil indgå i tværgående projekter, netværk og forbedringsfællesskaber sammen med kolleger fra Region Sjællands øvrige sociale tilbud.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har et solidt fagligt fundament, er nysgerrig på at lære nyt og har lyst til at bidrage til udviklingen af et tværfagligt team, hvor vi sammen skaber gode løsninger

Eksempler på arbejdsopgaver som Socialfaglig konsulent

  • Understøtte visitations- og indskrivningsprocesser
  • Koordinere og kvalitetssikre socialfaglige processer
  • Kvalitetssikre anmodninger om takstændringer og kontraktgenforhandlinger
  • Sparre med ledere om myndighedsmæssige og socialfaglige problemstillinger
  • Kvalitetssikre magtanvendelsesindberetninger i samarbejde med ledere og medarbejdere
  • Bidrage til udvikling af arbejdsgange, procedurer og kvalitetsarbejde
  • Bidrage til samarbejdet med kommunale myndigheder og øvrige samarbejdspartnere

Som Socialfaglig konsulent søger vi dig, der

  • er uddannet socialrådgiver eller socialformidler
  • har erfaring fra myndighedsområdet eller det specialiserede socialområde
  • har kendskab til relevant lovgivning
  • kan arbejde struktureret og bevare overblikket i komplekse processer
  • har gode kommunikative kompetencer og stærke samarbejdsevner
  • trives i en hverdag, hvor opgaver og prioriteringer kan ændre sig
  • ser dig selv som en del af et tværfagligt arbejdsfællesskab med fokus på kerneopgaven

Eksempler på arbejdsopgaver som Pædagogisk konsulent

  • Sparring og vejledning til ledere og medarbejdere
  • Kvalitetssikring af faglig dokumentation
  • Understøttelse af arbejdet med magtanvendelser
  • Deltagelse i audits og forbedringsarbejde
  • Udvikling og implementering af fælles retningslinjer og arbejdsgange
  • Understøttelse af socialpædagogisk praksis og faglig udvikling
  • Bidrage til lærings- og udviklingsprocesser på tværs af organisationen

Som Pædagogisk konsulent søger vi dig, der

  • er uddannet inden for det pædagogiske område
  • har erfaring fra det specialiserede socialområde
  • har kendskab til Marjattas målgrupper
  • er stærk i dokumentation og faglig formidling
  • kan omsætte pædagogisk praksis til faglige beskrivelser, der lever op til myndighedskrav
  • har erfaring med kvalitetsudvikling og udviklingsprocesser
  • arbejder struktureret og kan skabe overblik
  • trives i tværfagligt samarbejde

Fælles for begge stillinger tilbyder vi

  • En central rolle i et tværgående team med stor betydning for organisationen
  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og stærke værdier
  • Mulighed for at præge kvalitets- og udviklingsarbejdet på tværs af organisationen

Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Yderligere oplysninger: Har ovenstående skabt interesser og har du lyst til at høre mere er du velkommen til at kontakte leder af Marjatta Bernhard Schmitz på 2462 7431 eller Socialfaglig leder Heidi Haislund på 2051 5340.

Ved ansættelse indhentes relevant straffe- og børneattest, samt efter aftale referencer fra tidligere arbejdsplads.

Bemærk at Marjatta er en røg-/tobaksfri arbejdsplads.

Læs mere om Marjatta på vores hjemmeside

Tæt på skov, fjord og strand på Sydsjælland og Stevns ligger Marjatta. I Marjatta bygger vi vores arbejde på Rudolf Steiners menneskesyn og den antroposofiske filosofi. Marjatta rummer ca. 250 børn, unge og voksne borgere, rundt omkring på mangfoldige bosteder og værksteder. Vi har omkring 600 medarbejdere. Vi lægger vægt på, at beboerne skal møde omsorgsfulde og fagligt kompetente medarbejdere, som med varme og professionalisme understøtter hver enkelt borgers trivsel, udvikling og livskvalitet.
