title: Healthcare Assistant - North Wales – Betsi Cadwalader
description:
Job Description

As a Healthcare Assistant working permanent night shifts, you’ll play a vital role in delivering high-quality, person-centred end of life care to patients in their own homes across North Wales. Working overnight, you will provide compassionate support during a time when patients and their families often need reassurance, comfort, and responsive care the most.

Working under the guidance of registered professionals, you will support patients with personal care, symptom management, mobility, comfort measures, and emotional support, helping them remain safe, comfortable, and dignified throughout the night.

You’ll be responsible for recognising and responding to changes in a patient’s condition, escalating concerns appropriately, and maintaining accurate documentation. You will work both independently and as part of a wider multidisciplinary team, ensuring continuity of care and contributing to individualised care plans.

This is a rewarding and hands-on role where you’ll make a meaningful difference to patients and families during some of the most important moments of their lives, while supporting Marie Curie’s commitment to delivering exceptional end of life care around the clock.

Salary: Marie Curie Clinical Pay Scale Band 2 (aligned with AFC) £26,300 - pro rata per annum + enhancements

Contract: Permanent - Night shifts Only

Based: Community Based – North Wales

Locations:

Flintshire & Wrexham - Full Time/ Part Time (36 hours per week & 18 hours per week)

Job includes working across two services:

  • Hospice Care at Home Night Service 22:00-07:00 - Travelling up to 25 miles from Home Address
  • Rapid Response Night Service - 22:00-07:00 - Based in Deeside Community Hospital

Gwynedd - Full Time (36 hours per week)

  • Hospice Care at Home Night Service 22:00-07:00 - Travelling up to 25 miles from Home Address

What's in it for you:

  • Annual leave allowance 27 days plus 8 public holidays (pro rata)
  • Competitive Policy for parental/sick Leave
  • Continuous Professional development
  • Industry leading training programmes
  • Season ticket loan for travelling to and from work
  • Defined contribution schemes for Pension
  • Marie Curie Group Personal Pension Scheme
  • Loan schemes for bikes; computers and satellite navigation systems
  • Introduce a friend scheme
  • Help with eyecare cost
  • Entitled to Marie Curie Blue Light Card
  • Entitled to Benefit-Hub Discount Scheme
  • Life assurance – for all employees

What we’re looking for:

  • NVQ Level 2 in Health and Social Care or equivalent Level 2 qualification (e.g. NCFE, BTEC), plus functional skills in numeracy and literacy at Level 2
  • At least 6 months of recent care delivery experience in a health or social care setting
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to hold person-centred, empathetic conversations and work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
  • Knowledge of palliative and end of life care, including holistic care planning and symptom management
  • Ability to plan and prioritise care, respond to changes in patient condition, and escalate appropriately
  • A valid driving licence and access to a vehicle

Please see the full job description here:

Application Process

For further information or to arrange an informal chat please contact our Hiring Manager Zoe Evans at Zoe.Evans@mariecurie.org.uk

At Marie Curie, our values are central to everything we do. They guide how we care for people, how we work together, and how we make decisions every day. We are committed to creating a workplace that is safe for everyone — staff and volunteers alike — supportive, inclusive and rewarding. We take stringent steps to ensure that anyone who joins our organisation are suitable for their roles and are committed to safeguarding all our people from harm. We actively consider our impact on the planet, embedding sustainability into everyday decisions to create a lasting, positive difference for the individuals we care for and the world we share.

We believe everyone should have the opportunity to thrive and fulfil their potential. Marie Curie is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion, recognising both the social justice imperative and the strength a diverse workforce brings. We actively encourage applications from people of all cultures, perspectives and lived experiences.

We are happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process. If you require any support, please contact us at recruitment@mariecurie.org.uk.

Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team, and in return, we ask that your application authentically reflects you — your experience, perspective and voice.

title: Lager- & Logistikmedarbejder søges til virksomhed i vækst - (Ølgod området)
description:
Er du uddannet inden for lager og logistik, og har du allerede opbygget nogle års erfaring fra en moderne produktionsvirksomhed?

Har du samtidig flair for IT og lyst til at udvikle dig i takt med en virksomhed, der vokser og stiller stadig større krav til digital lagerstyring?

Så kan det være dig, vi søger.

En spændende lagerrolle i en virksomhed i udvikling

Vi søger en Lager- & Logistikmedarbejder til en virksomhed i Ølgod-området, som er inde i en markant udvikling.

Vi ser gerne, at du er relativt tidligt i din karriere – eksempelvis med 5-6 års erfaring inden for lager og logistik – og at du har en relevant uddannelse med dig.

Det er ikke tilfældigt.

Virksomheden er i vækst, og fremtidens lagerfunktion bliver i stigende grad digital. Derfor søger vi en medarbejder, som ikke blot er stærk på det praktiske lagerarbejde, men også har lysten og evnerne til at arbejde med IT, lagerstyring og digitale arbejdsgange.

Du får dermed mulighed for at blive en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor lager og logistik spiller en stadig vigtigere rolle i den samlede værdikæde.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en vigtig del af lagerfunktionen og får en varieret hverdag, hvor både struktur, præcision og samarbejde er afgørende.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Varemodtagelse og kontrol af indgående varer
  • Registrering og håndtering af varer i virksomhedens lagersystem
  • Aflæsning af lastbiler med truck
  • Pluk og intern levering af materialer til produktionen
  • Lagerstyring og løbende optimering af lagerbeholdninger
  • Sikring af korrekt placering og mærkning af varer
  • Intern logistik og koordinering med produktionen
  • Bidrage til at udvikle og effektivisere de digitale lagerprocesser
  • Oprydning og vedligeholdelse af orden på lagerområdet

Stillingen er på daghold.

Vi leder efter en medarbejder med blik for fremtiden

Den klassiske lagerrolle har ændret sig meget. Hvor lagerarbejde tidligere primært handlede om truck, paller og fysisk håndtering, fylder IT, registrering, lagerstyring og digitale systemer i dag stadig mere.

Derfor er det vigtigt for os, at du:

  • Har en relevant uddannelse inden for lager og logistik
  • Har ca. 5-6 års relevant erhvervserfaring
  • Har gyldigt truckcertifikat
  • Har kørekort B
  • Har gode IT-kompetencer og er fortrolig med at arbejde i digitale systemer
  • Er nysgerrig på nye systemer og arbejdsgange
  • Arbejder struktureret og præcist
  • Kan tage ansvar og arbejde selvstændigt
  • Trives med samarbejde på tværs af lager og produktion

Du behøver ikke være IT-specialist. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at bruge IT som en naturlig del af dit arbejde og har mod på at lære nyt.

Om virksomheden

Du bliver en del af en moderne produktionsvirksomhed med solide rødder i dansk industri og klare ambitioner for fremtiden.

Virksomheden er i kraftig udvikling og investerer løbende i både produktionsfaciliteter, teknologi og automatisering. Flere kunder og øget aktivitet betyder samtidig, at kravene til logistikken omkring produktionen bliver større.

Det giver dig en mulighed for at komme ind på et tidspunkt, hvor der sker meget, og hvor dine kompetencer kan være med til at præge udviklingen.

Her er der ikke tale om et lager, der står stille.

Der er fart på – og der bliver investeret i fremtiden.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling i en virksomhed med gode fremtidsudsigter
  • En vigtig rolle i en virksomhed i fortsat vækst
  • En varieret hverdag med både praktiske og IT-baserede opgaver
  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold
  • Dygtige og engagerede kolleger
  • Mulighed for at få indflydelse på udviklingen af lager- og logistikfunktionen

Ansøgning

Power People står for rekrutteringsprocessen.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Power People på pmi@powerpeople.dk.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og indkalder relevante kandidater til samtale. Stillingen besættes, når vi har fundet det rette match.

title: LIBRARY CLERK-FT
description:
GENERAL PURPOSE

Performs a variety of routine work in the public library youth services environment and provides services to library patrons and staff. As a Library Clerk, you must demonstrate outstanding interpersonal skills and customer service skills, as a great part of this job will involve interacting with the local community.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED

Works under the close supervision of the Youth Services Librarian.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Assists in checking in and out library materials and placing holds on requested materials. Assists patrons with title selection and reader’s advisory services via telephone, email and in person.

Answers telephone calls and email correspondence to provide information pertaining to the Youth Services department, or refers patrons as appropriate.

Responsible for daily shelving of returned library materials in the Youth Services collection.

Responsible for maintaining order in the children’s book shelves by performing daily scheduled shelf reading as assigned by Youth Services Librarian or other supervisory staff.

Performs routine maintenance on books and other materials, such as mending covers, preparing new books and materials for shelving.

Assists in setting up tables and chairs for classes.

Assists in maintaining library collection and facilities by vacuuming and dusting; straightening books, chairs, shelves, papers and magazines; and emptying waste containers and book drops.

Ability to relate in a friendly and open manner with children and parents.

Enforces all library policies established by the Lake Wales Library Board and the City of Lake Wales including patron behavior and rules.

Works with teenage patrons in the Library’s Teen Room. Must be able to enforce library behavior policies to these customers.

Assist in the children’s section in conducting special programs or projects for children, as assigned.

Must have a working knowledge of all Lake Wales Public Library electronic resources available on the library’s website. Should be able to demonstrate these resources and teach patrons how to use them.

The Opportunity: As a Seasonal Team Associate, you’ll partner with a Mattel Retail Services Representative to grow Mattel’s presence at major retailers, working a minimum of 15 hours per week during our busiest holiday season. We are looking for enthusiastic temporary team members who are passionate about merchandising, enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, and want to drive results and make magic happen this holiday season! This job can open the door to future merchandising career opportunities with Mattel.

What Your Impact Will Be:

  • Brand ambassador of Mattel/Fisher-Price brands and products
  • Collaborate with your lead Mattel Representative to secure prime product placements for Mattel’s iconic brands
  • Partner with lead Mattel Representative on monthly scheduling
  • Unpack cases of various Mattel toys
  • Merchandise and organize product on the sales floor
  • Construct & deconstruct store fixtures including shelving and racking
  • Implement point of purchase materials
  • Execute special projects as assigned including, but not limited to store events
  • Administrative tasks including but not limited to managing time entry, attending meetings, trainings, checking email etc.

What We’re Looking For:

Basic Job Qualifications:

  • Must be at least 18 years old
  • High school diploma or GED
  • Preferred work hours are during the weekday during daytime hours; occasional weekends
  • Must be available to work a minimum of 15 hours per week
  • Preferred device requirement – Up to date smartphone and/or computer with Chrome Browser to access for time worked entries, email and Workday. Other browsers (e.g. DuckDuckGo) are not supported. A mobile phone is required for multi-factor authentication to receive SMS(text) or voice call.
  • Must have access to reliable internet
  • Must have reliable transportation to travel to and between assigned store locations (gas mileage reimbursement per company policy)
  • Reside within approximately 20 miles of the assigned territory/store cluster or otherwise able to reliably service the assigned territory

Physical Requirements:

  • Stand, bend, twist, squat, kneel, reach
  • Walk for long periods of time
  • Climb ladders up to 12’ tall
  • Lift up to 25 pounds frequently, 50 pounds occasionally
  • Push/pull carts containing product - occasionally up to 100 lbs
  • Operate power tools (screwdriver & drill)

About You:

  • Merchandising, retail or customer service experience (preferred, but not required)
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ensure tasks are completed efficiently with a strong sense of urgency
  • Represent the brand with professionalism and a positive attitude
  • Bring a flexible, adaptable mindset and enjoy collaborating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Eagerness to learn new skills with a safety-first mentality
  • Tech-savvy (smartphone, apps)

Ready to make an impact this holiday season? Apply today!

The hourly rate for this position is $16.00.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

How We Work:
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

  • We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
  • We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
  • We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

Who We Are:
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

title: ISS søger en faglært kok til vores kunde beliggende i Skjern
description:
Er du kreativ og nytænkende i din tilgang til mad? Brænder du for at skabe gastronomiske oplevelser af høj kvalitet til dine gæster? Så har vi muligvis en stilling for dig.

Bliv Faglært Kok i et team med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og kundekontakt

Til denne kunde leverer ISS en food-court kantineløsning til husets ca. 300 dagligt spisende gæster. Konceptet består af tre foodstations med hvert deres koncept. Maden serveres tallerkenanrettet på et højt kvalitets- og serviceniveau. Som kok skal du i samarbejde med køkkenchefen og det øvrige team sikre leverance af disse tre forskellige foodstations, hvor kvalitet står øverst på agendaen. Køkkenet består af 7 engagerede, dygtige og motiverede medarbejdere, der hver dag i et tæt samarbejde leverer et fremragende produkt til vores kunde. Det forventes, at vores kommende souschef er en holdspiller, der går forrest og viser vejen for det øvrige team.

Vi søger en Faglært Kok, som brænder for madlavningskunsten, har mod på at fremvise sine ideer, og er interesseret i at bidrage til at skabe et team i verdensklasse. Hvis du kan nikke genkendende til dette, så tror vi på, at dette er det rette sted for dig.

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt i tidsrummet 06:00 – 14:00. Opstart hurtigst muligt.

Kreativ, serviceminded og fleksibel

Du har erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen, og formår at sætte standarden højt for det produkt, der skal leveres hver dag. Du er en dygtig håndværker – og et knivskarpt forbillede – der er villig til at gå en ekstra mil for et godt resultat og for dine kolleger. Endvidere er du ivrig efter at bruge din faglighed, kreativitet og foodpassion og brænder for at lave mad fra bunden af høj kvalitet hver dag.

Som person er du udadvendt, og kan tale med vores kunder, når de henvender sig. Det skal være vigtigt for dig at levere et højt serviceniveau hver eneste dag. Selv i de travleste perioder formår du at holde hovedet koldt og forblive fokuseret. Du er samarbejdsvillig og motiveres af udfordringer. Du er endvidere ambitiøs i din tilgang til jobbet, og du går aldrig på kompromis med kvaliteten. Derudover skal du kunne kommunikere på dansk og engelsk i både tale og på skrift.

Et stort gastronomisk netværk

Som en del af ISS – kan vi i kraft af vores størrelse – og vores erfaring, tilbyde dig et netværk af dygtige og kvalitetsbevidste kolleger. Vi vil med glæde hjælpe dig med at sikre faglig udvikling og spændende karriemuligheder.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning vedlagt CV via nedenstående link senest den 31. august 2026.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen kan du kontakte Uffe Mikkelsen på mail: uffe.mikkelsen@dk.issworld.com

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, og indkalder løbende kandidater til samtale.

#LI-DNI

About ISS

We are one of the world’s leading providers of integrated facility services. With 300,000 colleagues globally, and 6,000 in Denmark, we focus on delivering the best facility services and creating the workplace that our customers dream of. The key word that binds us together is service. United by a commitment to exceptional service, we aim to create inclusive workplaces, foster innovation, and enhance company culture.

Our employee promise is simple yet powerful: ISS is a place to be you. Since 1901, ISS has been a people-first company. We seek to be a company of belonging and create places where people are respected, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Diversity and inclusion have always been in our DNA, and our diverse workforce has played a critical role of connecting people and places to make the world work better..

Follow ISS Denmark on LinkedIn, Instagram og Facebook hvis du vil lære mere om vores arbejdskultur og modtage notifikationer om fremtidige jobmuligheder.

title: Tekniker til vedligehold
description:
Har du erfaring med erfaring med teknisk kompliceret udstyr og motiveres du af fejlfinde og blive udfordret på højt fagligt niveau? Kan du finde løsninger, så der undgås nedbrud på udstyret? Så er det dig, vi mangler til at styrke vores vedligeholdelsesteam

ReSource Denmark driver Danmarks største plastsorteringsanlæg, som er placeret i Esbjerg. Vi bidrager til den grønne omstilling, ved at sikre at så meget plast som muligt bliver sorteret til genanvendelse i Danmark. Vi har idriftsat sorteringsanlægget i juni 2024 og vi sorterer plastaffald fra hele Danmark. Vi arbejder på tre skift og har ca. 70 medarbejdere ansat. Vores anlæg er højt automatiseret og anvender den nyeste teknologi inden for området.

Til vores vedligeholdelsesteam, søger vi en tekniker til daghold til at hjælpe med at vedligeholde vores maskiner og udstyr. Som tekniker hos ReSource Denmark bliver du en vigtig del af vores daglige drift og du bliver en del af et team på 7 teknikere, der også håndterer vores ABA-anlæg.

Du kommer tæt på anlægget og vil samarbejde på tværs af organisationen, hvor du vil have berøring med kollegaer og kunder. Dine opgaver vil primært være

  • Udføre forebyggende vedligeholdelse på anlæggets faciliteter og udstyr
  • Identificere og løse tekniske problemer ved hjælp af passende værktøjer og metoder
  • Udføre reparationer og udskiftninger af defekte komponenter for at sikre, at anlægget fungerer optimalt
  • Overvåge og teste udstyr for at identificere potentielle fejl
  • Udarbejde dokumentation vedr. fejlfindinger

Vi forestiller os, at du er

Uddannet smed, mekaniker, industrielektriker eller lign. og gerne har 3 – 5 års erfaring fra en lignende stilling, hvor du bl.a., har arbejdet som tekniker på maskiner og transportbånd. Du har et godt humør og møder dine kollegaer med et smil, som du gerne hjælper, når du kan.

Du løser dine opgaver struktureret og selvstændigt, hvor dine deadlines overholdes. I dit arbejde er det naturligt for dig at kommunikere med alle i organisationen på en imødekommende og venlig måde, som er præget af nysgerrighed og entusiasme. Du nyder et godt samarbejde både internt og med samarbejdspartnere og trives i en virksomhed, hvor både det sociale og fagligheden sættes højt.

Vi tilbyder

  • Løn efter lokalaftale og industriens overenskomst
  • Sundhedsforsikring og tandforsikring
  • Pensionsordning

Vores virksomhed er kendetegnet ved en uformel og humoristisk omgangstone, hvor vi udviser respekt for hinanden samtidigt med at vi har et højt kvalitetsniveau. Vi arbejder ud fra nøgleordene Tillid, Ordentlighed og Løsningsorienteret.

Er du vores nye vedligeholdelsestekniker? Så ansøg via mail på job@resourcedk.com, hvor du vedlægger din ansøgning og cv.. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet vores nye medarbejdere.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Maintenance & Facility Manager, Torben Ryborg Madsen, på 9244 0142 eller via mail på trm@resourcedk.com**.**

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Kom og bliv vores SSA eller SSH-kollega i dagvagt i hjemmeplejen
description:
Er du vores nye kollega, der sammen med os vil skabe gode rammer og vilkår for borgerne i Helhedsplejen i Vordingborg kommune?

Vi har brug for nye kollegaer på fuld tid (37 timer), men det endelige timetal aftales efter ansøgers ønske. Det er dagvagter og der arbejdes oftest hver anden weekend.

Vi har lige nu indmødested i Nyråd på Vintersbølle, men indmødestedet vil ændres til Skovbo i Langebæk eller Vordingborg i forbindelse med den omorganisering der sker i Vordingborg kommune.

Stillingerne er ledige pr. 01.11.26 eller efter aftale.

Vi er en arbejdsplads med mangeartede opgaver, som gør at du vil få rig mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt.

Du bliver en del af et team bestående af både Sygeplejersker, Social- og sundhedshjælpere, Social-sundhedsassistenter samt uuddannede medarbejdere.

Vi arbejder ud fra kerneopgaven, og tænker i helhedspleje med en rehabiliterende tilgang til borgerne.

Teamet er praktiksted for både social- og sundhedshjælpere og social- og sundhedsassistent, elever samt sygeplejestuderende, Hvis man har en interesse i at få vejleder uddannelsen er der stor mulighed for det.

Vi tilbyder:
  • Høj faglighed
  • Triage dagligt
  • Et kollegialt miljø præget af hjælpsomhed og faglig sparring
  • God introduktion, hvor du bliver tilknyttet en kollega
  • Introduktion vil blive tilrettelagt ud fra dine kompetencer
  • Fokus på implementering af den ny ældrelov og arbejdet i teams og rehabilitering
  • Fokus på arbejdsmiljø og trivsel

Vi forventer:
  • At du har lysten og viljen at til at levere en god og kompetent hjælp hos vores borgere
  • At du ser dokumentation som en naturlig del af dit daglige arbejde
  • At du bidrager positivt til arbejdsfællesskabet
  • At du formår at samarbejde, samt løfte i flok
  • At du er mødestabil
  • At du tør sige højt hvis du har brug for hjælp
  • At du har kørekort
  • At du har vejlederuddannelse, eller er interesseret i at tage den vil være en fordel

Vi arbejder ud fra Vordingborg Kommunes værdier som er: Dialog, udvikling og synlighed.

Ansøgningsfrist: 10. september 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt uge 38 2026

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

For yderligere informationer
Kontakt Områdeleder Sanne Dahl Toxværd på tlf. 23 35 62 24 for supplerende oplysninger.
Først fra uge 37, i uge 36 kan Områdeleder Mette Suikkanen kontaktes på tlf. 2169 9386.

Hvis du indstilles til ansættelse i stillingen, vil der inden endelig ansættelsesaftale indgås, blive indhentet reference hos seneste arbejdsgiver og gerne hos flere.

Når vi ansætter personale inden for sundheds- og omsorgsområdet, er det en betingelse, at den person vi ønsker at ansætte, kan fremvise en tilfredsstillende privat straffeattest.

Vordingborg Kommune

Vordingborg Kommune er en attraktiv og moderne arbejdsplads beliggende i Danmarks vildeste natur. Her langs Danmarks længste kystlinje mellem historiske købstæder og stærke fællesskaber er vi omtrent 4000 ansatte, der arbejder for at gøre vores kommune til et endnu mere grønt og attraktivt sted at bo og leve.

Vi har fokus på, at hverdagen skal hænge sammen og tilbyder rammerne om et liv i balance. Her får du mange kvadratmeter for færre penge, du kommer tæt på kysten, i spektakulær natur – med et meningsfuldt job. Så kom og vær med!

title: Sundhedsfaglig medarbejder til Aftengruppen Lavsenvænget
description:

title: PhD scholarship in open-source EDA tools development - DTU Compute
description:
Open-source development has changed the software world by providing free compilers and operating systems. A similar shift is currently happening with the electronic design automation (EDA) tools. Open-source tools, such as OpenROAD and LibreLane allow the tapeout of chips using open-source tools only. The overarching goal of ODE4EC-PIV is to enhance Europe's competitiveness in global chip design by boosting productivity through open-source EDA tools and their interoperability, addressing key areas such as efficient verification and bespoke design processes, and promoting innovation through open, standardised, and sovereign EDA solutions.

Your project will involve developing open-source tools for generating hardware and developing a functional verification framework.

Responsibilities and qualifications

* Conduct research on EDA tooling
* Designing hardware generators
* Development of a verification method, such as functional verification in Scala/Java.
* Integrating the development into the Chips JU project ODE4EV-PIV
* Co-supervise students.
* Optionally contribute to teaching.

Required qualifications:

* Hardware design in a hardware description language such as Chisel, VDHL, or Verilog. Knowing Chisel is a bonus.
* Knowledge of the chip design and verification process
* Basic programming skills in Java/Scala

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) in computer science, computer engineering, or electrical engineering or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

At DTU Compute, we have a large focus on creating a good working environment. Our work with diversity and inclusion is an essential part of that. We believe that having a good working environment is a necessary foundation to provide excellent research, teaching, supervision and innovation.

At DTU Compute, we have about 140 PhD students. We offer several events and activities for all our PhD students such as annual PhD Bazaar, onboarding course where you will meet other PhD students, and you can join our PhD Club that organizes BBQs, board games events, lunches etc.

You can read more about DTU Compute at

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. The allowance will be agreed upon with the relevant union. The period of employment is 3 years.

Starting date is 1. December 2026 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Martin Schoeberl, masca@dtu.dk,

You can read more about DTU Compute at

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU.

Application procedure
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 18 September 2026 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
  • If available, include a link to an open-source project you contributed to in your CV.
  • List of publications, if applicable

You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Compute – Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science – is an internationally recognised academic environment with over 400 employees and 10 research sections. We broadly cover digital technologies within mathematics, data science, computer science, and computer engineering, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, internet of things (IoT), chip design, cybersecurity, human-computer interaction, social networks, fairness, and data ethics. Our research is rooted in basic research and centres on mathematical models of the physical and virtual world, as a basis for the analysis, design, and implementation of complex systems. We focus on ensuring that our research results contribute to creating a better society by supporting areas such as health, green transition, energy supply, and life science. We collaborate with universities, public and private organisations, and companies in Denmark and abroad, and through DTU’s startup ecosystem, we encourage innovation and entrepreneurship. We have a strong ethical, human, and sustainable approach that ensures integrity in our work. Therefore, we strive for and take responsibility for driving the democratisation of digital technologies, so that everyone has the opportunity to actively participate in the development, and we ensure a continued open, democratic, and inclusive society for the benefit of all. At DTU Compute, we value diversity, inclusion, and a flexible work-life balance.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: Neurofysiologitekniker søges til Neurofysiologisk Klinik, AUH
description:
På Neurofysiologisk Klinik, Aarhus Universitetshospital søger vi en ny kollega til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt pr. 1. marts 2027. Som en del af stillingen er der tjenestested på Neurofysiologisk Klinik, Regionshospitalet Gødstrup svarende til 18,5 timer pr. uge det første år.

Er du uddannet neurofysiologitekniker, og brænder du for at arbejde med hjerne, nerver og muskler og derigennem dygtiggøre dig på det elektrofysiologiske område? Så er det måske dig, vi står og mangler som vores nye kollega.

Vi tilbyder en dynamisk klinik i stadig udvikling, hvor patientundersøgelser, forskning og udvikling prioriteres højt. Du vil få gode kollegaer og mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling.

Om Neurofysiologisk Klinik

Neurofysiologisk Klinik er en del af Neurologi, og er beliggende ved krydspunkt J209 på AUH. Klinikkens åbningstid er mandag til torsdag kl. 8-15.30 og fredag kl. 8-15 – dog udføres udvalgte undersøgelser i tidsrummet 7.30-18.00. Desuden varetager et mindre team aftenvagter på EEG-overvågningsstuen på Neurologisk sengeafsnit mandag til torsdag. Vi udfører akutte EEG-undersøgelser i dagstimerne alle ugens dage, hvorfor du må forvente at deltage i weekendvagt-rullet.

I klinikken foretager vi undersøgelser af patienter med funktionsforstyrrelser i centralnervesystemet, det perifere nervesystem og musklerne. Vi udfører en bred vifte af elektrofysiologiske undersøgelser; herunder EEG, EP og ENG samt de mere specielle undersøgelser såsom søvn, langtidsmonitorerings EEG, ultralyd af nerver, MEG, IOM m.m.

Dine nærmeste kolleger er 11 neurofysiologiteknikere, 3 bioanalytikere, 3 neurofysiologiteknikerelever og overbioanalytikeren, og der er et tæt samarbejde med afdelingens læger, sekretærer, ingeniører m.m. Du vil få tilknyttet en mentor i opstartsperioden.

Du kan læse mere om klinikken på vores hjemmeside .

Vi ønsker en ny kollega, der

  • er uddannet neurofysiologitekniker (et ufravigeligt krav)
  • har flair og interesse for IT og teknik
  • er glad for langvarig patientkontakt og sætter patientens behov i centrum
  • er udadvendt og åben med empati for patienter og kollegaer
  • har et godt humør og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • er forandringsparat og kan navigere i en til tider travl hverdag
  • er fremmødestabil.


Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til overbioanalytiker Anne Dorthe Møller på telefon 2169 5513 eller på mail annemole@rm.dk.

Kopi af eksamensbevis bedes vedlagt i ansøgningen.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst. Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børneattest.

Ansøgningsfristen er søndag d. 13. september 2026. Ansættelsessamtaler finder sted løbende efter aftale.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Anæstesisygeplejerske søges til Capio Privathospital Odense
description:
Til dig, der tror, at høj faglighed og en stærk kultur hænger uløseligt sammen og ønsker mere end at passe et job.

Vi søger en anæstesisygeplejerske, som brænder for sit fag og ved, at høj kvalitet ikke kun handler om den behandling, vi giver patienterne – men også om den kultur, vi skaber sammen.

Hos Capio arbejder vi ud fra én fælles kerneopgave: at skabe høj patientsikkerhed, stærk faglighed, den bedste patientoplevelse og en bæredygtig drift. Derfor søger vi ikke blot en dygtig kollega, men en kollega, der har lyst til at tage ansvar for fællesskabet.

Hos os skal kultur ikke hænge på væggen – den skal kunne mærkes i hverdagen. Det betyder, at vi:

  • taler med hinanden, ikke om hinanden.
  • hjælper dér, hvor opgaven er.
  • tager ansvar og kommer med løsninger.
  • samarbejder på tværs, når det gavner patienten.

Vi forventer ikke, at du er perfekt. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er nysgerrig, engageret og har lyst til at bidrage til, at vi hele tiden bliver lidt bedre.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fast stilling på 28-32 timer ugentligt.
  • Ca. 75 % anæstesi og 25 % opvågning.
  • Arbejde mandag-fredag med enkelte vagter til kl. 20.00.
  • Et fagligt stærkt team med høj specialiseret viden.
  • Synlig ledelse, korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for indflydelse.
  • Løn efter DSR-overenskomst samt sundhedsforsikring.

Vi søger dig, som

  • er uddannet anæstesisygeplejerske med mindst to års erfaring.
  • tager ansvar og arbejder selvstændigt.
  • bidrager til et stærkt samarbejde og en god kultur.
  • har fokus på kvalitet, udvikling og gode patientforløb.
  • trives med at hjælpe dine kolleger, også på tværs af funktioner.

Om Capio

Capio Privathospital Odense er et elektivt hospital med høj faglighed, stærke tværfaglige samarbejder og en ambition om hele tiden at udvikle os. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når dygtige mennesker arbejder sammen i en kultur præget af ansvar, respekt, hjælpsomhed og fleksibilitet.

Hvis det lyder som et sted, hvor du kan se dig selv, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Ansøgning
Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt og senest 13 september 2026. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Yderligere information

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte ledende sygeplejerske Pernille Bonde pbon@capio.dk Tlf. 29750745 eller hospitalschef Helle Hillingsø hhil@capio.dk tlf 29750717

Ved ansættelse indhentes børneattest og straffeattest.

title: Senior Building Services Engineer – Modular Data Centre Solutions
company: YDU JC Air Cond & Ref Inc.- Dubai
description:
Senior Building Services Engineer – Modular Data Centre Solutions Silent-Aire | Dublin

What you will do

As a Senior Building Services Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the next generation of Modular Data Centre (MDC) solutions. Working within our Modular Design Engineering team, you will provide technical leadership across the full project lifecycle, from early-stage concept development through detailed design, factory manufacture, testing, commissioning, and site integration. You will be responsible for developing innovative, high-performance building services solutions that meet the demanding requirements of mission-critical environments. A key aspect of the role will be the ownership and development of Descriptions of Operation (DoO), ensuring engineering designs are translated into safe, reliable, and fully operable systems that perform as intended. This is an opportunity to work on complex, cutting-edge infrastructure projects within a collaborative, fast-paced environment where your expertise will have a direct impact on project success.

How you will do it

Building Services & Modular Design Lead the design and delivery of mechanical and electrical building services systems for modular data centre solutions. Develop engineering designs from concept through to detailed design, supporting efficient off-site manufacturing and seamless site integration. Ensure solutions meet performance, resilience, sustainability, and energy-efficiency requirements. Produce, review, and approve calculations, schematics, layouts, technical specifications, and design documentation. Drive engineering best practice and provide technical guidance to internal stakeholders throughout the design process.

Descriptions of Operation (DoO) & Control Strategies

Develop, maintain, and take ownership of Descriptions of Operation (DoO) for modular data centre systems. Define system functionality, control strategies, sequences of operation, interlocks, alarms, and failure responses. Ensure operational documentation aligns with P&IDs, controls architecture, BMS point schedules, I/O lists, and commissioning procedures. Act as the technical authority for operational narratives, supporting controls integration, factory acceptance testing, and commissioning activities.

Project Delivery & Stakeholder Collaboration

Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams including BIM, controls, manufacturing, commissioning, and project delivery functions. Engage with clients, consultants, and equipment vendors to review designs, resolve technical challenges, and ensure project objectives are achieved. Support factory testing, commissioning activities, and site integration to verify performance and operational readiness. Provide technical leadership, contributing to continuous improvement and the ongoing development of modular engineering standards.

What we look for

Degree qualified in Building Services Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Significant experience delivering MEP systems within mission-critical, data centre, pharmaceutical, or similarly complex environments. Strong understanding of mechanical and electrical building services design, system integration, and operational performance. Experience working on modular, prefabricated, or off-site manufactured solutions would be a distinct advantage. Proven track record of developing Descriptions of Operation, control philosophies, and operational narratives for complex engineered systems. Ability to translate technical design intent into clear, structured, and effective operational documentation. Strong problem-solving skills with the confidence to make informed engineering decisions and provide technical leadership. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, solutions-focused approach and a passion for delivering innovative engineering solutions in a fast-growing, technology-driven sector.

Join Silent-Aire and help deliver world-class modular data centre solutions at the forefront of mission-critical infrastructure innovation.

title: Practical Internship: Simulation Software Engineer
description:
Are you looking for a student job where your code is used on real offshore and dredging projects?

At Boskalis, engineers use Event Symphony, our in-house logistics simulation platform, to support decision-making during tenders and projects. Event Symphony enables engineers to evaluate work methods, fleet configurations, weather impacts, production risks, and operational bottlenecks before equipment is mobilized offshore.

By simulating complex logistics operations, engineers can compare alternatives, quantify risks, and make better-informed decisions for projects worth millions of euros. Event Symphony is actively used across Boskalis to support tenders, project planning, and innovation initiatives.

As a Simulation Software Engineer, you will become part of the team developing and maintaining Event Symphony. You will work on real feature requests, usability improvements, and bug fixes that help engineers and simulation specialists use the platform more effectively. You will collaborate directly with simulation engineers, software developers, and AI specialists while gaining hands-on experience with software engineering, simulation technology, and maritime operations.

Your responsibilities as AI Solutions Engineer:

  • Implement new features in Event Symphony.
  • Resolve backlog items and bug fixes from our GitHub development board.
  • Improve usability and user experience of simulation workflows.
  • Help develop and maintain Python-based simulation components.
  • Improve automated testing, documentation, and software quality.
  • Support the development of new simulation capabilities and tooling.
  • Work closely with simulation engineers to translate user needs into software features.
  • Learn how simulation and optimization are used to support major offshore and dredging projects.

Your qualities

  • Experience with Python and SimPy.
  • Affinity with software development and/or problem solving.
  • Experience using Git and GitHub.
  • Interest in simulation, optimization, or engineering applications.
  • A proactive and curious mindset.
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate with users and developers.

Do not worry if you are not proficient in all areas yet, we encourage continuous learning and development; your colleagues will help you out and we will provide on-the-job training for the right candidate!

The following competences are also important:

  • A good command of written and spoken English.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills as well as the ability to work independently.
  • A mindset geared towards continuous learning and curiosity for tackling new challenges.
  • Ability to handle feedback and reset your course if needed.

If you are excited about the opportunity to work on innovative projects and have the drive to make a significant impact, we would like to hear from you. Explain to us why your background and expertise make you the ideal candidate for our AI program and join us in shaping the future of Boskalis. Apply now and help us shape the future of our industry.

What Boskalis offers

  • A flexible student position alongside your studies.
  • The opportunity to contribute to software that is used on real tenders and projects.
  • Supervision from experienced software developers, simulation engineers, and AI specialists.
  • Hands-on experience with Python software development in a professional environment.
  • Exposure to offshore construction, dredging, logistics optimization, and simulation technology.
  • A collaborative and innovative working environment.
  • Potential opportunities for internships, graduation projects, or future employment within Boskalis.

What you can expect

  • A dynamic environment: A job where you can make an impact, as part of a diverse, international team of experts.
  • Rewarding conditions: A competitive salary and much more, including holiday allowance, holiday entitlement of 26 days (based on a full-time contract), a non-contributory pension scheme, collective schemes such as company health insurance, travel allowance
  • Career development: We have a professional career development track for AI roles. Develop yourself with (online) courses at our Boskalis academy, both on personal and professional AI development.
  • The Boskalis Campus: Experience the unique Boskalis vibe at our Papendrecht site, complete with restaurants, sports fields, and a wharf where our vessels dock. We offer a state-of-the-art auditorium, brainstorming rooms, experience center for client meetings, and a barista corner where you can connect with colleagues.
  • Young Boskalis: Are you under 36? Come and join Young Boskalis! Have fun and join in social and sports activities ranging from pub quizzes to yoga, bootcamps and an annual sailing boat race. Networking and knowledge sharing are a vital part of Young Boskalis as well.

Extra information

  • Your team: You will be part of the central AI department, mostly young and diverse teams of data engineers, software developers and AI engineers.
  • Where you will work: For office-based roles, depending on your preference and project stage, you work partly at home and partly in the Papendrecht office in an attractive working environment.
  • Full/part-time job: Depending on what you prefer the position is part-time
  • Next steps: Apply easily by completing the online application form. Interviews are held online or in the office. Once it’s clear we are a good match, we will make you an offer – and look forward to welcoming you to the company.

We are more than happy to answer your questions about the position of Student Vacancy. Please contact Jenna de Waard, Campus recruiter via campus@boskalis.com.

Interested? Please apply by filling in your details and by uploading your cover letter and CV on our careers site.

Your track record will have seen you holding senior roles on complex projects, in transmission, operator senior leadership roles, or in a Professional Services organisation. Roles include Programme Director, Asset Director, Portfolio Director or Head of Sector within a Professional Services firm.

Du kan både være nyuddannet, studerende eller pensionist. Arbejdstiden og mængden vil kunne afpasses efter dine behov.

Da arbejdet som studiestøttegiver følger de studerendes studieforløb og strukturen på uddannelserne, skal man være indstillet på at være på arbejde i de perioder, hvor studerende studerer og har brug for studiestøtte.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at

· afklare studerendes støttebehov og tilrettelægge relevant studiestøtte.

· gennemføre samtalebaserede støtteforløb (fysisk såvel som online) med fokus på studieteknik, motivation, struktur og trivsel.

· skabe et trygt og professionelt rum for studerende med forskellige forudsætninger og behov.

· bidrage til udviklingen af studiestøtteteamets praksis og metoder.

· samarbejde med relevante aktører på tværs af VUCV og bidrage til videndeling om studiestøtte.

· arbejde med administrative processer, dokumentation af studiestøtteforløb.

Om dig

Du sætter samarbejde højt og er nysgerrig og kan give og modtage feedback til både studerende og kollegaer. Du kan samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder.

Har god diagnoseforståelse og erfaring med at arbejde med målgruppen – kendskab til SPS-området er en fordel

Har en relevant baggrund eller er studerende inden for fx det pædagogiske, socialfaglige, psykologiske, didaktiske, sociologiske eller specialpædagogiske område.

Forståelse for eller erfaring med VUC og gerne faglig indsigt i HF- eller AVU-området vil være en fordel.

Arbejder struktureret og er god til at planlægge egen tid.

Vi tilbyder


Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med fokus på fællesskabet, en uformel og humoristisk omgangstone samt gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling samt desuden:

· PC og telefon samt tilskud til internet

· Frokostordning

· Gratis kaffe og frugt

· Motionsrum

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold

· Start 1. oktober 2026 – eller gerne før

· Timelønnet ansættelse

· Tjenestested Albertslund og Rødovre

· Løn i henhold til erfaring og kvalifikationer

· VUCV er en mangfoldig organisation og vi opfordrer alle uanset etnisk og social baggrund, køn og alder til at søge

· Kontakt vicedirektør May Brandt, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen på mb@vucv.dk

· Motiveret ansøgning inkl. eksamensbeviser og CV sendes til job@vucv.dk

title: Mattel Retail Team Associate - Albany, NY 12065
description:
The Opportunity: As a Seasonal Team Associate, you’ll partner with a Mattel Retail Services Representative to grow Mattel’s presence at major retailers, working a minimum of 15 hours per week during our busiest holiday season. We are looking for enthusiastic temporary team members who are passionate about merchandising, enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, and want to drive results and make magic happen this holiday season! This job can open the door to future merchandising career opportunities with Mattel.

What Your Impact Will Be:

  • Brand ambassador of Mattel/Fisher-Price brands and products
  • Collaborate with your lead Mattel Representative to secure prime product placements for Mattel’s iconic brands
  • Partner with lead Mattel Representative on monthly scheduling
  • Unpack cases of various Mattel toys
  • Merchandise and organize product on the sales floor
  • Construct & deconstruct store fixtures including shelving and racking
  • Implement point of purchase materials
  • Execute special projects as assigned including, but not limited to store events
  • Administrative tasks including but not limited to managing time entry, attending meetings, trainings, checking email etc.

What We’re Looking For:

Basic Job Qualifications:

  • Must be at least 18 years old
  • High school diploma or GED
  • Preferred work hours are during the weekday during daytime hours; occasional weekends
  • Must be available to work a minimum of 15 hours per week
  • Preferred device requirement – Up to date smartphone and/or computer with Chrome Browser to access for time worked entries, email and Workday. Other browsers (e.g. DuckDuckGo) are not supported. A mobile phone is required for multi-factor authentication to receive SMS(text) or voice call.
  • Must have access to reliable internet
  • Must have reliable transportation to travel to and between assigned store locations (gas mileage reimbursement per company policy)
  • Reside within approximately 20 miles of the assigned territory/store cluster or otherwise able to reliably service the assigned territory

Physical Requirements:

  • Stand, bend, twist, squat, kneel, reach
  • Walk for long periods of time
  • Climb ladders up to 12’ tall
  • Lift up to 25 pounds frequently, 50 pounds occasionally
  • Push/pull carts containing product - occasionally up to 100 lbs
  • Operate power tools (screwdriver & drill)

About You:

  • Merchandising, retail or customer service experience (preferred, but not required)
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ensure tasks are completed efficiently with a strong sense of urgency
  • Represent the brand with professionalism and a positive attitude
  • Bring a flexible, adaptable mindset and enjoy collaborating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Eagerness to learn new skills with a safety-first mentality
  • Tech-savvy (smartphone, apps)

Ready to make an impact this holiday season? Apply today!

The hourly rate for this position is $18.50.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

How We Work:
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

  • We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
  • We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
  • We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

Who We Are:
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

title: Agentic AI Process Expert - Senior Consultant
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our 39,000 employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

As Lilly strives to achieve these objectives, we have embarked on building and in-housing a state-of-the-art “next-best action recommendation engine” platform to enable more agile sales and marketing operations. This platform will

- ingest a wide variety of data sources,

- run advanced personalized marketing models

- and integrate seamlessly with all other Lilly SF and marketing operations platforms

to provide recommendations on “what should we do next” to the sales and marketing teams at the individual doctor level, enabling better decision making and improving customer experience.

As part of this team, we are excited to welcome professionals interested in driving cutting-edge technology-driven business operations, with a focus on quality assurance and continuous improvement. This team will be responsible for operating the omnichannel recommendation engine platform (VERSO) which will drive SF and marketing campaigns for Eli Lilly USA.

Mandatory Requirements:

Technical and behavioral skills/qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 6+ years of experience in AI/ML, advanced analytics, digital transformation, or intelligent automation roles.
  • Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying Agentic AI solutions using LLMs, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and multi-agent architectures.
  • Experience establishing end-to-end AI processes, including agent design, tool integration, governance, monitoring, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
  • Strong understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and AI workflow optimization.
  • Experience defining AI operating models, standards, best practices, and scalable delivery frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into AI-enabled solutions and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive adoption of emerging technologies in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving abilities, and a continuous learning orientation.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience implementing Agentic AI at enterprise scale with measurable business impact.
  • Knowledge of MLOps, LLMOps, AI governance, responsible AI, and model lifecycle management practices.
  • Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or similar cloud-native AI ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with process mining, intelligent automation, and workflow transformation initiatives.
  • Exposure to healthcare, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or commercial operations domains.
  • Experience mentoring teams and establishing AI capability-building programs.
  • Industry certifications in Azure AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Cloud Architecture, or related domains.
  • Experience working in Agile product teams and partnering with business stakeholders to deliver digital transformation programs.
  • Published thought leadership, conference presentations, open-source contributions, or participation in AI innovation communities.

Ce poste vous correspond ? Alors, rejoignez-nous !

A propos du site d’Evreux :

Situé en région Haute Normandie, le site GSK d’Evreux est un acteur majeur dans la fabrication de médicaments respiratoires destinés à soigner l’asthme ou la Broncho-Pneumopathie Chronique Obstructive (BPCO). De par sa taille et les volumes fabriqués, ce site fait partie des 3 plus importants sites industriels de GSK et contribue à plus de 10% du chiffre d’affaires global de l’entreprise. Il se positionne parmi les 3 plus importants employeurs dans le département de l’Eure et est un des plus gros sites de production de médicaments en France (environ 1 000 collaborateurs).

Nous sommes dans une dynamique d’amélioration continue soutenue par une forte politique d’investissements, le site d’Evreux disposant d’un outil industriel optimisé, à la pointe de la technologie.

La Sécurité et la Qualité sont des fondamentaux. Notre volonté est d’être exemplaire en matière de sécurité, démontrant le zéro accident, tout en livrant des produits de qualité, à forte valeur ajoutée.

A propos de GSK :

GSK est une entreprise biopharmaceutique de premier plan en France, en termes de présence et d’emploi, avec plus de 3.400 collaborateurs répartis sur 3 sites de production (Evreux, Mayenne et Saint-Amand-les-Eaux) et au siège social (Rueil-Malmaison).

Notre mission est d’unir la Science, la Technologie et les Talents pour devancer ensemble la maladie. Nous prévenons et traitons les maladies grâce aux vaccins et médicaments de médecine générale et de spécialité. Nous concentrons nos efforts sur la science du système immunitaire, la génétique humaine et les technologies de pointe. Nous investissons dans quatre domaines thérapeutiques essentiels (maladies infectieuses, VIH, oncologie et immunologie/respiratoire) et saisissons toutes les opportunités futures qui peuvent avoir un impact sur la santé à grande échelle. Notre objectif est d’avoir un impact sur la vie de plus de 2.5 milliards de personnes.

Nous recrutons des personnes qui croient en notre mission, incarnent notre culture et veulent nous aider à atteindre nos ambitions. Dans notre environnement de travail, chacun est valorisé, intégré, apprécié pour sa personnalité et ses différences. Nous favorisons également l’épanouissement de nos collaborateurs, avec des projets stimulants qui répondent aussi bien à leurs aspirations qu’aux besoins futurs de nos activités.

title: Trainee Supervisor
description:
Ben jij klaar voor jouw volgende stap binnen DHL?

Heb jij al ervaring opgedaan binnen onze operatie en wil je doorgroeien naar een leidinggevende rol? Dan is dit jouw kans. Binnen onze RegioHub in Zwolle bieden wij ambitieuze DHL-collega's de mogelijkheid om zich in ongeveer 12 maanden te ontwikkelen tot volwaardig Supervisor Logistiek. Je werkt fulltime in een 3-ploegendienst. Ben jij klaar om door te groeien naar een managementtrol binnen onze logistieke operatie?

Functieomschrijving
Als Trainee Supervisor Logistiek start je in de operatie van onze RegioHub Zwolle. Vanuit jouw ervaring als teamleider leer je het logistieke proces op een hoger niveau kennen en ontwikkel je jezelf stap voor stap naar de rol van Supervisor. Daarbij word je begeleid door ervaren collega's en een persoonlijke mentor die jou ondersteunen in jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Tijdens het traineeship krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen een dynamische logistieke omgeving. Je leert hoe je operationele processen aanstuurt, leiding geeft via teamleiders, resultaten verbetert en sturing geeft aan een grotere organisatie-eenheid. Zodra je er klaar voor bent, groei je door naar de functie van Supervisor en maak je onderdeel uit van het Management Team.

Jouw belangrijkste taken:
  • Meewerken in en inzicht krijgen in alle logistieke processen binnen de RegioHub;
  • Aansturen, begeleiden, coachen en motiveren van medewerkers op de werkvloer;
  • Signaleren, initiëren en implementeren van procesverbeteringen;
  • Analyseren van operationele prestaties en sturen op KPI's;
  • Bijdragen aan een veilige, efficiënte en kwalitatieve werkomgeving;
  • Actief deelnemen aan managementoverleggen als onderdeel van het Management Team;
  • Volgen van trainingen, workshops en ontwikkelprogramma's gericht op leiderschap en logistiek management;
  • Samenwerken met verschillende afdelingen, van chauffeurs en planners tot managers.

Diensttijden:
Bij DHL is het logistieke proces 24 uur per dag in beweging. Om het proces soepel te laten verlopen werken de logistieke teams in de 3 ploegendienst van maandag tot en met zaterdagochtend. De tijden van de diensten zijn;
  • Ochtenddienst van 08.00 uur tot 16.30 uur;
  • Middag-/avonddienst van 15.30 uur tot 00.00 uur;
  • Nachtdiensten van 23.00 uur tot 07.30 uur.
Stap in bij DHL en maak elke dag impact in het grootste logistieke netwerk van Nederland. Solliciteer nu!

 
Wij zoeken een Trainee Supervisor die het volgende meeneemt:
Als Trainee Supervisor wil jij je volgende stap zetten binnen de logistiek. Jij bent iemand die graag het overzicht houdt en bewaart in complexe situaties. Jij krijgt energie wanneer jij mensen kan begeleiden en aansturen naar betere prestaties.
  • Je hebt HBO werk- en denkniveau;
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in de logistiek is een pré, bij voorkeur als teamleider of een vergelijkbare functie.
  • Sterke leiderschapsvaardigheden en ervaring met het aansturen van meerdere teams;

title: Sr System Engineer
description:
100% onsite - San Jose, CA or Morrisville, NC

We are looking for a talented and versatile Sr. Systems Engineer to join our embedded engineering team. In this role, you will own the full development lifecycle of embedded electronic systems — from concept and architecture through hardware design, PCB layout, and firmware implementation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and develop electronic systems from requirements to production, including power supply design, signal conditioning, communication interfaces, and mixed-signal circuits.
  • Perform schematic capture using industry-standard EDA tools (Altium).
  • Execute PCB layout, routing, and design rule review for multi-layer boards, ensuring signal integrity, EMC compliance, and thermal performance.
  • Write and maintain hardware design documentation, including schematics, BOM, and design verification reports.
  • Lead PCB design reviews.
  • Implement and optimize peripheral drivers (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB, Ethernet) and communication stacks.
  • Write clean, maintainable C/C++ code following embedded best practices, including memory management, interrupt handling, and low-power design.
  • Perform bring-up, debugging, and root cause analysis of complex hardware/firmware issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD debug tools.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure system-level requirements are met and properly validated.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in embedded systems engineering in a professional setting.
  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ firmware development for 32-bit ARM MCUs or MPUs.
  • Solid understanding of digital and analog circuit design, including power electronics fundamentals.
  • Experience with embedded communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, Ethernet).
  • Proficiency with debug tools: JTAG/SWD probes, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters.
  • Ability to read and interpret datasheets, application notes, and reference manuals independently.
  • Strong documentation habits and experience with version control systems (Git).

NICE TO HAVE (PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS)

Candidates with any of the following will be given strong preference:

  • Embedded Linux experience — Embedded Linux:
  • Board bring-up, device tree configuration, and kernel/driver development.
  • Yocto Project or Ubuntu for custom Linux distribution builds.
  • Familiarity with Linux IPC mechanisms, system services, and application development.
  • Motor control and power electronics — Motor Control & Power Systems:
  • Field-Oriented Control (FOC) / BLDC / PMSM motor drive design and implementation.
  • Power electronics design: DC-DC converters, motor driver stages, gate drive circuits.
  • Experience with motor control libraries or DSPs.

The expected annual pay range for this position is $109,500 - $171,150. This position is also eligible for bonus opportunities and commission pay. Please note that the final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.
