title: Content Creation Subchapter Lead (Content Creation, including Medical)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Global Digital Hub is a growing business line within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our primary goal is to enhance Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives in areas such as Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

The Opportunity

The Content Creation Subchapter Lead is a pivotal people leader who inspires and engages subchapter members to collaborate across the network, significantly contributing to Roche’s Ten Year Ambitions. This role is accountable for driving the integration of the new operating model, exemplifying agile collaboration. The content creation chapter team consists of medical writers, content editors, project delivery coordinators, and medical copy quality assurance specialists.

As the Content Creation Subchapter Lead, you will be responsible for supporting the strategic vision and direction of the chapter, continuously seeking opportunities for innovation and value creation. This critical position has a global scope, leading a diverse team across various regions. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

  • People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop team members, providing coaching and support to enable them to execute content creation projects successfully and continuously improve their skills. Create and implement personal development plans tailored to individual needs and aspirations.

  • Operational Leadership: Coordinate the operation of the Content Creation Subchapter, ensuring high effectiveness of assigned content creation activities. Manage content creation resources, monitor their utilization, and ensure customer satisfaction within the subchapter.

  • Recruitment: Find, attract, develop, and retain top talent, aligned with the evolving needs of the function and the business. Conduct interviews and facilitate the onboarding process.

  • Capability Building: Foster the development of the content creation team members, promoting a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and content excellence.

  • Agile Collaboration: Drive the embedding of the new operating model, serving as a role model for agile collaboration within the content creation subchapter.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate effectively with different chapters, subchapters, and other relevant teams to drive impactful content creation solutions and align with business and Global Digital Hub strategies.

  • Service Quality: Provide recommendations to enhance service quality, responsiveness, and content output to meet or exceed business partners' expectations.

  • Process Governance: Establish and maintain process governance principles, ensuring proper documentation and adherence to content creation best practices within the scope of the Content Creation Subchapter's responsibility.

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Professionally represent the Content Creation Subchapter with key stakeholders, promoting the value and impact of content creation within the organization.

  • Content Tech & AI Integration: Drives team adoption, training, and best-practice sharing around modern content tech, GenAI writing tools, DAM systems, and regulatory review platforms (e.g., Veeva Vault).

  • OneRoche Mindset: Support the embedding of the OneRoche mindset within the content creation subchapter and across the Global Digital Hub, fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration.

Who You Are

We are looking for a dynamic individual who is highly involved and passionate about strategic marketing, commercial execution and developing people. As a Content Creation Subchapter Lead, you thrive in a team environment and excel in a fast-paced global setting. You are a proactive and innovative problem-solver, always seeking sustainable and scalable solutions. Keeping up with the latest digital updates and content trends is a natural part of your commitment to providing cutting-edge content capabilities to our partners.

You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes:

  • Higher education. A degree in Marketing or in Life Sciences will be considered an advantage, but candidates with other relevant experience will also be considered.

  • Overall 5+ years of experience with 2+ years of experience delivering commercial marketing assets or campaign execution, preferably within large organizations (healthcare/pharma), agencies, or startups.

  • 2+ years of people leadership experience, including direct line management or indirect team leadership within complex projects.

  • Strong medical or science background will be considered as advantage

  • High level proficiency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Customer-service mentality & can-do attitude.

  • Continuous improvement and growth mindset, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, ability to prioritize tasks.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, including analytical abilities, active listening, critical thinking, and a focus on sustainable and scalable content solutions.

  • Ability to thrive under pressure, manage complex challenges, and work independently while maintaining high content standards.

  • Experience with the standard IT applications. Quick learner with a passion for exploring new technologies, tools, and techniques. Dynamic and flexible in adapting to different software and workflows.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills to foster collaboration within the team and effectively engage with senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to work in different time zones.


In Exchange we provide you with

Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office)

A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Salary starts from 3000 EUR gross/monthly. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Product Designer (AI Prototyping) - 202609
description:
WHO WE ARE

Digify is a cloud-based document security and virtual data room platform that helps organizations control, protect, and track sensitive documents after they're shared. Companies use Digify for fundraising, M&A, due diligence, and secure collaboration — and everything runs natively in the browser, with no software to install.

Today Digify is trusted by more than 800,000 professionals across 138 countries, including teams at BCG, ByteDance, Mastercard, and LinkedIn.

THE ROLE

LOCATION: SINGAPORE

We're looking for a Product Designer who designs by building. Not someone who hands off static mockups and waits — someone who takes a product decision and turns it into a working, testable prototype using AI tools, fast.

Our product solves a genuinely hard design problem: making powerful security controls — data rooms, granular permissions, digital rights management, audit logs, dynamic watermarking — feel simple and intuitive. Your job is to reduce that complexity into experiences people understand instantly.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. You'll partner closely with our Platform Pod Lead, who owns feature decisions, and turn those decisions into UX flows and working prototypes so the team can see and test ideas before we commit engineering time. Rather than writing lengthy specs, you reduce uncertainty through prototypes, user feedback, and iteration.

A note on how we work: You'll have a clear partner in the Platform Pod Lead, but a lot of independence in how you get from a feature decision to a tested prototype — that path is yours to own. We're also in a phase where roles here stay fluid: designers will influence product direction, and product will shape design. If you want a strict lane, this isn't it. If you want to help define both the product and how it's built, you'll thrive.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Partner with the Platform Pod Lead to take feature decisions and own their translation into UX flows and working prototypes.
  • Build realistic, interactive prototypes with AI tools (such as Claude Design) that users can actually experience and test.
  • Simplify complex security and permission workflows into intuitive, browser-native experiences.
  • Run lightweight user interviews and usability tests, and turn feedback into better designs quickly.
  • Design user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity interfaces, and production-ready components.
  • Work closely with engineers through development so the shipped product matches the intended experience.
  • Continuously improve our design system and reusable UI components.
  • Stay current with modern interaction patterns and evolving AI design tooling.

Requirements

  • 3–6+ years designing SaaS or web applications.
  • Proven ability to build working prototypes with AI tools — such as Claude Design. We need someone who ships functional prototypes with AI tools today, not someone curious to learn. Your portfolio should show AI-built prototypes, not just polished screens. (Comfort with Figma is helpful but not the focus.)
  • Strong end-to-end product thinking: discovery, interaction design, and information architecture — not just UI.
  • Ability to simplify complex, multi-step workflows into intuitive experiences.
  • Comfort working close to code. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should understand HTML, CSS, and JavaScript well enough to prototype in the browser and collaborate credibly with engineers.
  • Comfortable running lightweight user testing and translating insights into design decisions.
  • Strong communication — able to explain design choices with user insight, data, and product goals.
  • High autonomy and comfort with ambiguity. You can take a rough decision and run with it without waiting to be told how.

Bonus Points

  • Experience designing enterprise or B2B products, ideally in complex or security-sensitive domains.
  • Familiarity with design systems and component libraries.
  • Understanding of accessibility and responsive design.
  • Experience working closely with engineering in an agile SaaS environment.

Why This Role is Different

At Digify, designers don't just create screens — they help shape the product. You'll turn decisions into prototypes, put them in front of real customers, influence product direction early, and work directly with engineers to ship. We believe the fastest way to build the right product is to validate ideas before writing production code — and right now, you'll have the autonomy to do exactly that.

Vi er i rivende udvikling og har derfor brug for en kok, der er fleksibel, løsningsorienteret og fagligt stærk, uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.

Som person er du:

Sammen med os kan du glæde dig til:

title: Bliv bedemand hos Pallisby Begravelser
description:
Vi søger dig, der vil lære et meningsfuldt fag fra bunden

Kan du være roen i rummet, når andre står i en af livets sværeste situationer?

Hos Pallisby Begravelser hjælper vi familier med at skabe en tryg, personlig og værdig afsked. Vi møder mennesker dér, hvor de er, og vi tager ansvar for både de store beslutninger, de små detaljer og alt det praktiske omkring begravelse og bisættelse.

Nu søger vi en ny kollega, som har lyst til at blive oplært i bedemandsfaget.

Du behøver ikke have erfaring fra branchen. Det vigtigste er, at du har hjertet med, er nysgerrig på faget og har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker i situationer, hvor nærvær, respekt og ordentlighed betyder alt.

Om jobbet

Som bedemand hos Pallisby Begravelser bliver du med tiden en vigtig støtte for de pårørende. Du er med til at skabe overblik, tryghed og ro i et forløb, hvor mange familier både har brug for menneskelig omsorg og praktisk hjælp.

Du bliver grundigt oplært og kommer stille og roligt ind i de opgaver, der hører til faget.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • samtaler og kontakt med pårørende
  • hjælp til planlægning af begravelser og bisættelser
  • koordinering med kirker, kapeller, præster, kirkegårde, krematorier, blomsterhandlere og andre samarbejdspartnere
  • praktiske opgaver før, under og efter ceremonier
  • Ilægning og klargøring af afdøde (Herunder løft)
  • deltagelse ved højtideligheder
  • administrative opgaver og dokumenthåndtering

Arbejdet som bedemand er alsidigt, og ingen dage er helt ens. Nogle dage kræver overblik og tempo, andre dage kræver stilhed, tålmodighed og evnen til bare at være til stede.

Du skal derfor være indstillet på, at arbejdet kan ligge uden for almindelig kontortid, og at der indgår vagter og weekendarbejde.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter et menneske, der har lyst til at lære — og som kan møde andre mennesker med varme, respekt og situationsfornemmelse.

Måske kommer du fra service, omsorg, sundhed, detail, hotel, restauration, pædagogik, administration eller noget helt andet. Din baggrund er ikke afgørende. Det er din personlighed, din modenhed og din lyst til at gøre en forskel.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • er empatisk, rolig og nærværende
  • har god situationsfornemmelse
  • trives med både mennesker, praktik og ansvar
  • kan bevare overblikket, også når der er mange følelser i rummet
  • er ordentlig, pålidelig og detaljeorienteret
  • kommunikerer venligt og tydeligt
  • har lyst til at blive dygtig til et fag, hvor man aldrig bliver helt færdig med at lære
  • har kørekort til personbil

Det er en fordel, hvis du bor i eller omkring Horsens/omegn, men det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at blive en del af Pallisby Begravelser og den måde, vi møder familier på.

Vi tilbyder

Hos Pallisby Begravelser får du en hverdag med mening. Du bliver en del af et fag, hvor nærvær, omtanke og ansvar går hånd i hånd, og hvor din indsats kan mærkes hos de mennesker, du hjælper.

Vi tilbyder:

  • grundig oplæring i bedemandsfaget
  • tæt sparring med erfarne kolleger
  • en hverdag med både menneskelige, praktiske og administrative opgaver
  • ansvar i takt med, at du bliver tryg i rollen
  • et arbejde, hvor du gør en reel forskel for familier i en svær tid
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på ordentlighed, omsorg og nærvær

Lyder det som dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV til maja@shlb.dk Skriv gerne lidt om, hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker, afsked og omsorg — og hvorfor du kan se dig selv i bedemandsfaget.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Gitte Pallisby på tlf. 70 86 87 55

Ansøgningsfrist: Vi ansætter når den rigtige kommer

Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Souschef - Nordsjælland
description:
Souschef med ambitioner – er det dig?

I Netto vil vi være kendt for at levere gode kundeoplevelser – og vil du også være med til det, så er denne stilling måske noget for dig?

Som souschef kan du se frem til en masse selvudvikling, karrieremuligheder og ikke mindst fællesskab. Som souschef har du flere ansvarsområder. Til daglig fungerer du både som butikschefens højre hånd og sparringspartner. Og er butikschefen ude af huset, syg eller på ferie, så er det altså dig, der har det overordnede ansvar.

Helt kort så skal du

  • udvikle og træne medarbejdere, og sikre at de er glade og motiverede
  • gå forrest ude i butikken og vise det gode eksempel for dine kolleger
  • løse forskellige administrative opgaver
  • supportere butikschefen i alle typer af opgaver
  • være med til at sikre, at butikken opnår de ønskede driftsresultater
  • være rollemodel for Nettos værdisæt og medarbejderoplevelse, vi kalder det NEX: Netto Employee Experience

Alle de gode grunde
Stillingen er en rigtig god mulighed for at være med i et dagligvareeventyr. Du bliver del af en stærk kultur præget af god energi, engagement og Netto-ånd. Vi har fokus på din personlige udvikling som leder. Du kan også glæde dig til

  • konkurrencedygtig løn, pension og bonusordning
  • sundhedsforsikring
  • masser af gode personaleordninger fx rabatter i Bilka, føtex, Netto, Carl’s Jr. og Starbucks og leje af vores feriehuse og lejligheder i ind- og udland

**Leder- og livserfaring
**I stillingen som souschef er det vigtigt, at du først og fremmest er et ordentligt menneske og har erfaring med at lede mennesker. Og du elsker at sprede trivsel og glæde omkring dig. Mere præcist så forestiller vi os, at du

  • har ledererfaring
  • er åben over for Nettos holdning til ledelse ved at skabe resultater igennem høj medarbejdertrivsel
  • er nysgerrig og villig til at lære nye ting

**Souschef – blot en begyndelse?
**Du får selvfølgelig en masse god erfaring fra din dagligdag som souschef, men der er også mulighed for at komme på uddannelse og kurser. Måske kan du blive butikscheftrainee, hvor du får helt styr på teorien bag god ledelse. Netto er en del af Danmarks førende retail-koncern, så det kan også være, du på sigt ønsker en stilling hos føtex, Bilka eller på hovedkontoret. Du kan også sigte mod en international karriere.

Er du vores nye kollega?

Vi søger souschefer i flere af vores butikker langs kysten I Nordsjælland som dækker fra Helsingør til Gilleleje og alt derimellem. Send din ansøgning til os via linket nedenfor. Vi inviterer løbende til samtale, så søg allerede i dag.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Netto – vi bærer vores logo med stolthed

Du kender måske allerede Netto som Danmarks største dagligvarekæde – men vidste du også, at vores medarbejdere er rigtig glade for at arbejde her?

Du bliver nemlig del af et helt specielt sammenhold med masser af opbakning, og hvor vi alle løfter i flok. For det vi laver er vigtigt, men dem, vi laver det med, er endnu vigtigere.

Vi håber, du er lige så begejstret for dyrevelfærd, reduktion af madspild og en bæredygtig fremtid, som vi er. Vi har bl.a. vores eget økologiske brand: ØGO. Og det er naturligvis til gode Netto-priser.

title: Production worker
description:
Are you interested in manufacturing, quality, and technology? Join UXV Technologies and help build advanced robotic systems used in demanding environments.

As a Production Worker, you will assemble, inspect, and prepare products for delivery. Working closely with the Production, Quality, and Engineering teams, you will ensure products are built according to specifications, quality standards, and documented procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Assemble products according to work instructions and production plans.

  • Perform mechanical and electronic assembly with precision and attention to quality.

  • Inspect finished products to ensure they meet quality requirements before control inspection.

  • Perform modifications, rework, component replacement, and precision soldering under a microscope when required.

  • Complete production records and traceability documentation accurately.

  • Follow approved procedures, work instructions, and quality standards.

  • Report defects, quality issues, and process deviations promptly.

  • Contribute to process improvements by providing feedback.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

  • Support other production-related tasks as needed.

Note: This role does not include technical troubleshooting, root cause analysis, or engineering decisions. Employees are expected to follow procedures and escalate issues through the appropriate channels.

Requirements

Education & experience:

  • Secondary school education or equivalent.

  • Technical, vocational, or manufacturing-related education is an advantage.

  • Experience in production, assembly, manufacturing, electronics, or a similar environment is an advantage but not required. Full training will be provided.

  • Experience in a regulated, quality-focused, or security-sensitive environment is beneficial.

Professional competencies:

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

  • Ability to read, understand, and follow work instructions and procedures.

  • Good written and verbal English skills.

  • Ability to work accurately, systematically, and consistently.

  • Basic computer skills for production reporting.

  • Willingness to learn and follow company procedures and quality standards.

Technical skills (advantageous):

  • Experience with mechanical and/or electronic assembly.

  • Experience using hand tools, measuring equipment, and basic production equipment.

  • Experience with rework and precision soldering.

  • Experience with inspection, testing, and quality verification.

  • Familiarity with production documentation and traceability requirements.

Personal qualities

  • Reliable, responsible, and punctual.

  • Quality-focused and detail-oriented.

  • Positive team player with good collaboration skills.

  • Takes ownership of assigned tasks and follows through.

  • Open to training, feedback, and continuous improvement.

  • Professional, trustworthy, and respectful of security requirements, confidentiality, and workplace rules.

Why UXV Technologies?

Work in a skilled, collaborative, and international team inspired by innovation and creativity.

Contribute to a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone feels safe, valued, and supported.

Build your career in an organization committed to excellence, security, and continuous improvement.

title: To socialfaglige medarbejdere til Botilbud Rosenvænget i Skærbæk
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for, at mennesker med handicap kan leve et selvstændigt, meningsfuldt og værdigt liv? Så er du måske en af vores nye kolleger.

På Rosenvænget søger vi to socialfaglige medarbejdere, som brænder for at understøtte borgernes livskvalitet, udvikling og medbestemmelse gennem en fagligt funderet, rehabiliterende og relationsorienteret indsats. Vi søger medarbejdere, der kan omsætte socialfaglig viden til praksis og bidrage til et lærende miljø, hvor borgerens ønsker, mål, ressourcer og drømme er omdrejningspunktet for den pædagogiske indsats.

Stillingerne er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer pr. uge og omfatter dag- og aftenvagter i tidsrummet kl. 7 -23. Vi arbejder som udgangspunkt hver anden weekend, og et lavere timetal kan aftales.

Om Rosenvænget

Rosenvænget er et botilbud under § 107/108 inden for Voksen Socialområdet. Borgerne har forskellige fysiske, psykiske og kognitive funktionsnedsættelser og kan have behov for støtte inden for en bred vifte af livsområder.

I fremtiden forventer vi at komme flere borger, som skal vurderes og udredes, med henblik på fremtidig støttebehov.

Vores indsats tager afsæt i den enkelte borgers ressourcer, ønsker og drømme. Vi arbejder målrettet med at understøtte borgernes muligheder for at tage aktiv del i eget liv og opleve størst mulig selvbestemmelse, deltagelse og trivsel. Derfor møder vi borgerne med respekt, nysgerrighed og en høj faglig bevidsthed om betydningen af relationer, kommunikation og individuelt tilpassede indsatser.

Du bliver en del af et engageret og tværfagligt team bestående af socialpædagoger, social- og sundhedsassistenter, omsorgsmedarbejdere, ergoterapeut og sygeplejerske. Sammen arbejder vi for at skabe et trygt, udviklende og meningsfuldt hjem for borgerne.

Dine opgaver.

  • Som socialfaglig medarbejder får du en central rolle i at understøtte borgernes trivsel, udvikling og muligheder for at mestre eget liv.
  • Kontaktpersonsfunktion med fokus på trivsel, udvikling og individuelle mål.
  • Planlægning, gennemførelse og evaluering af pædagogiske indsatser med afsæt i den enkelte borgers ønsker, mål og delmål.
  • Støtte og vejledning i dagligdagens opgaver, herunder håndtering af lommepenge, indkøb af personlige ejendele samt forberedelse til statusmøder og andre relevante aftaler.
  • Understøttelse af deltagelse i hverdagsliv, sociale fællesskaber og meningsfulde aktiviteter med afsæt i borgerens interesser og ressourcer.
  • Personlig pleje og omsorg med respekt for den enkelte borgers integritet, selvbestemmelse og individuelle behov.
  • Medicinhåndtering i overensstemmelse med gældende retningslinjer.
  • Systematisk dokumentation, opfølgning og evaluering i Nexus med fokus på udvikling og progression.
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med kollegaer, pårørende og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere for at sikre sammenhængende indsatser.

Vi lægger vægt på, at den faglige indsats bygger på refleksion, viden og et aktivt samarbejde med borgeren om de mål og ønsker, der giver mening i den enkeltes liv.

Vi søger dig, der

  • er uddannet socialpædagog, ergoterapeut, social- og sundhedsassistent eller har anden relevant socialfaglig baggrund.
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for handicapområdet.
  • kan arbejde rehabiliterende og ressourceorienteret.
  • er fagligt nysgerrig og reflekterende i din praksis.
  • ser dokumentation som et vigtigt fagligt redskab til udvikling og kvalitetssikring.
  • kan skabe tillidsfulde relationer og møde mennesker med respekt, anerkendelse og empati.
  • bidrager aktivt til tværfagligt samarbejde og fælles faglig udvikling.
  • har blik for både borgerens perspektiv og den samlede faglige indsats.

Har du erfaring som praktikvejleder, oplæringsvejleder eller ressourceperson inden for et særligt fagområde, vil vi gerne bringe dine kompetencer i spil.

Vi tilbyder

  • mulighed for at blive en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, udvikling og borgerperspektiv går hånd i hånd
  • et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde med høj faglig ambition
  • en kultur præget af faglig refleksion, sparring og videndeling
  • løbende kompetenceudvikling og mulighed for at specialisere dig inden for relevante fagområder
  • indflydelse på udviklingen af den pædagogiske praksis
  • en arbejdsplads, hvor borgernes livskvalitet og selvbestemmelse er det fælles udgangspunkt
  • en grundig og struktureret introduktion, der sikrer en tryg opstart

På Rosenvænget tror vi på, at stærke faglige fællesskaber skaber de bedste forudsætninger for, at borgerne kan leve et liv med størst mulig selvstændighed, deltagelse og livskvalitet. Derfor investerer vi i både borgernes og medarbejdernes udvikling.

Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel gennem faglighed, relationer og meningsfulde indsatser? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Er du interesseret i at vide mere om stillingerne, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte tilbudsleder Lena Kvistgaard-Persson på tlf. 20 21 58 45 eller teamleder Anne-Mette Kjær Petersen på tlf. 24 92 28 34.

Kan du se dig selv som en del af vores faglige fællesskab? Så glæder vi os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Der afholdes løbende samtaler og stillingsopslaget fjernes når rette kandidat er fundet.

Lønramme

  • Social- og sundhedsassistent 29.426 kr. - 34.717 kr.
  • Ergoterapeut (generel) 29.825 kr. - 35.746 kr.
  • Socialpædagog 32.863 kr. - 37.424 kr

Indplacering i lønramme afhænger af erfaring, kompetence og relevant uddannelse. Vi gør opmærksom på, at vi indhenter straffeattest, inden du bliver ansat.

Du søger stillingen ved at sende ansøgning, CV og anden dokumentation elektronisk via ansøgningslinket. Du modtager en kvittering for ansøgningen, men vær opmærksom på, at kvitteringen og en eventuel invitation til samtale kan ende i dit spamfilter.

title: Publicity Assistant
description:
The Publicity Assistant supports the publicity efforts of the Press by participating in the planning and execution of seasonal and title-specific publicity plans. They are responsible for the nomination and submission process for the awards program, in collaboration with the Acquisitions department. They also coordinate the purchase of services and payment of invoices for the department.

Job-Specific Responsibilities:

Publicity (75%)

  • Creates and implements publicity plans for seasonal lists of facing page libraries and distributed books. Independently creates review lists using as reference standard lists; handles review copy requests and media inquiries; creates press materials to pitch assigned titles to a wide variety of media outlets—print, radio, broadcast/podcast—for time-sensitive stories.
  • Assembles and orders print galleys—includes working with outside vendors and coordinating orders among various departments in-house. Handles mailing of galleys and finished books to media as needed.
  • Maintains and improves department database of review contacts and review lists. Produces seasonal list letter for media e-mail blast; manages list and deployment via Cision.
  • Creates and circulates weekly publicity newsletter.
  • Manages publicity department email inbox: responds to inquiries, fulfills review copy requests via warehouse, refers inquiries to individual publicists when necessary. Maintains departmental inventory of galleys and finished books.
  • Reads, excerpts, and posts review quotes from all media into publishing management system for use on paperback covers, HUP website, partner sites, advertising, and promotion. Shares review quotes with Director of Marketing for approval prior to weekly circulation via hup-mktnews email list.
  • Responsible for payment of invoices, including processing (with accounting) and cost assignment and record keeping in publishing management system.
  • Manages departmental subscriptions, assists with other tasks as assigned.

Awards (25%)

  • Collate awards requests from author questionnaires to include on monthly nomination lists. Consult with Editorial Director if any prize should not be included.
  • Using previously established SharePoint files, share all possible awards for each month with Editorial Director who eliminates irrelevant awards before the list is circulated to the entire department.
  • Send SharePoint link to all AEs and EAs, who then go to SharePoint and add their suggested nominations by established monthly deadlines.
  • Keep Biblio updated: enter awards information and guidelines in the awards database in Biblio. Keep Biblio updated with nominated titles and title status for each award entered.
  • Read all award eligibility guidelines and deadlines and keep track of them.
  • Order required number of books to be sent to awards committee members. Where applicable, provide protected digital book files through SharePoint.
  • Submit check requests for awards entry fees using P Card and report on Concur. All Concur expense reports to be approved by Director of Marketing. Ask for approval in advance for unusually high nomination fees.
  • Write nomination letters based on descriptive copy and seek approval from relevant AE or Editorial Director before sending the letters out. AEs may also write their own nomination letters.
  • Seek approval from Editorial Director for high-profile awards, awards with nomination limits, and awards with high fees. (NB: These high-profile awards are tracked in advance by Editorial Director.)
  • When an HUP book wins an award, update Biblio, and send a HUPall (email used for office-wide communication). Keep record of, and communicate with relevant colleagues, all embargoed information.
  • Answer awards-related correspondence from author, keeping AEs and Editorial Director looped in, as necessary.

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, hybrid.

Basic Qualifications are the minimum requirements a candidate must meet to be considered for this role.

  • Three or more years of related experience; education beyond high school may count toward experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Office Suite

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

College degree strongly preferred. Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills required. Ability to work quickly and accurately on detailed projects in a fast-paced setting with a concern for meeting deadlines.

  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 35 hours per week, Monday through Friday
  • Visa Sponsorship: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Harvard University requires pre-employment reference and background screenings: Identity
  • Other Information:
    • This position will have a 3-month orientation and review period.

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 053. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions
  • Wellbeing and mental health resources
  • Support for families and caregivers
  • Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

title: Power BI Lead
description:
This role is for one of Weekday’s clients


Min Experience: 7+ years
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, Pune, Gurgaon, Haryana, India
JobType: full-time

Experience Range: 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience in Power BI, SQL, and PowerApps, including practical exposure to BI engineering projects

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:
1. Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and KPI scorecards to deliver actionable insights for business stakeholders
2. Build and optimize Analysis Services reporting models, ensuring compatibility with data warehouse standards and supporting both tabular and multidimensional models
3. Connect to diverse data sources, import and transform data for business intelligence, and implement advanced calculations using DAX to enhance reporting accuracy
4. Architect reporting solutions based on client requirements, translating wireframes and requirement documents into scalable analytics solutions
5. Implement and manage row-level security, integrating analytics with data governance, quality, and security platforms to ensure compliance and data protection
6. Optimize dashboard and query performance to efficiently handle large and multiple datasets, ensuring timely delivery of analytics outputs
7. Collaborate with UX/UI teams to design impactful visualizations, leveraging Power BI product capabilities for enhanced user experience
8. Engage with internal and external stakeholders to understand business challenges, deliver tailored analytics solutions, and ensure high-quality client outputs

Required Skills:

title: Specialist -Finance -OTC-Voice.
description:
Join our “Finance Team” at DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF) GSC – Global Service Centre!

Job Title: Specialist – Finance (Order to Cash - OTC – Collections)

Job Grade – M

Job Location: Chennai

Are you dynamic and results-oriented with a passion for logistics? Join our high-performing Global Shared Services Team (GSC) at DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF); a Great Place to Work certified organization and one of the “Top 20 most admired Shared Services Organizations in 2022” by the independent global Shared Services & Outsourcing Network (SSON).

We are the captive Shared Service Provider for DHL Global Forwarding and DHL Freight (DGFF). We are an organization of more than 4,600 colleagues complemented by approximately 500 virtual FTE (i.e., bots applied in process automation). Our colleagues are based across six service delivery centers in Mumbai, Chennai, Chengdu, Manila, Bogota & Budapest. You will interact with people from all over the world and get the chance to a truly international organization.

An Order to Cash Voice Collections Specialist focuses on directly communicating with customers to address and resolve overdue payments, employing phone calls and other communication tools for reminders and negotiations. They are tasked with reconciling accounts, maintaining accurate interaction logs, and delivering high-quality customer service with a professional demeanour. The role also involves monitoring credit limits to prevent overtrading and escalating unresolved accounts to key stakeholders, ensuring timely interventions such as credit holds.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Initiating contact with customers to address overdue accounts using phone calls, emails, letters, and other communication methods.
  • Sending payment reminders and follow-up messages to encourage timely payments.
  • Negotiating payment plans that are mutually beneficial to both the customer and the company.
  • Responding to customer inquiries regarding outstanding debts and resolving billing disputes or discrepancies.
  • Reconciling accounts to ensure payments received match the outstanding amounts and updating account information accurately.
  • Maintaining detailed records of all customer communications, including payment promises and agreements.
  • Providing high-quality customer service, assisting with payment-related inquiries, and maintaining professionalism in all interactions.
  • Conducting credit limit reviews to prevent overtrading and informing customers when they are nearing their credit limits.
  • Escalating unresolved accounts to supervisors, collection managers, or key account managers as needed and recommending credit holds for delinquent accounts.
  • Deliver a high level of service quality through timely and accurate completion of services.
  • Collaborate with colleagues within the business to identify solutions, best practices, and opportunities to improve the service to our business partners.
  • Flag any challenges in the operations to the immediate supervisor and business partner in a timely manner.
  • Co-ordinate with the relevant stakeholders for regular communication and flow of information as defined for the respective service.
  • Contribute as a subject matter expert in problem-solving and process improvement.
  • Assist staff in resolving complex issues, maintain thorough process documentation, and ensure quality control.

Skills and Abilities:

  • Proficient in using MA!N for comprehensive customer account management, or familiarity with other industry-standard collections tools suitable for B2C contexts.
  • Competent in utilizing telecommunication platforms like BT, and knowledgeable about JBA, EDM, and specific Freight payment/ERP systems.
  • Advanced Excel skills and familiarity with operational systems such as S21, CW1, and DDH for data management and analysis.
  • Excellent business communication and presentation capabilities, with a strong ability to convey complex information effectively.

Educational and Experience Requirements:

  • Holds a Bachelor's or Postgraduate degree in fields such as Commerce, Computer Science, or Business Administration with a focus on finance (B.Com/M.Com/B.C.S./B.B.A./B.B.M. (Fin)/M.B.A. (Fin)/M.F.M.),
  • Achieved a minimum of 50% aggregate scores in academic pursuits, underlining a robust foundational knowledge in relevant disciplines.
  • 1 – 3 years of relevant work experience, with a preference for candidates with a background Order to Cash process.
  • Proficient understanding of accounting and financial principles, specifically for Order to Cash.
  • Experience with financial software and ERP systems, such as SAP or Oracle, is crucial for managing transactions and financial records.
  • Familiarity with the logistics industry and shared services operations is highly preferred, enhancing the ability to navigate industry-specific financial practices.
  • Work experience in logistics or shared services operations is preferred.

Apply now and embark on an exciting journey with us! We offer:

title: Bliv en del af Elverhøj i Ishøj Landsby – et dagtilbud fyldt med natur, nærvær og stærke fællesskaber
description:
Vil du gøre en forskel for børn hver eneste dag i naturskønne omgivelser? Er du en pædagog, der brænder for leg, udeliv, nærvær, faglig udvikling og fællesskab? Så kan det være dig, vi søger som vores nye kollega i Elverhøj.

Vi søger:

🌿 3 pædagoger til vuggestuen – hvoraf 1 stilling er et barselsvikariat

med start 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Stillingerne er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer, men vi er fleksible mellem 34 og 37 timer, hvis du ønsker et lavere timetal.

Her får du hverdagen tæt på naturen

Elverhøj ligger naturskønt i Ishøj Landsby omgivet af natur, grønne områder og gode muligheder for udforskning og udeliv. Hos os er naturen ikke blot en kulisse, men en aktiv del af børnenes hverdag.

Vi er en integreret daginstitution med 4 vuggestuegrupper og 4 børnehavegrupper fordelt på to huse omkring en fælles legeplads. Her deler børnene hverdagen med vores fritgående høns, små haver og masser af muligheder for nysgerrighed, undersøgelser og leg.

Natur, science og madmod i børnehøjde

Vi har en stærk profil inden for natur og science, hvor børn og voksne sammen udforsker verden gennem eksperimenter, undersøgelser og oplevelser.

I tæt samarbejde med Ishøj Naturcenter arbejder vi med både børnenes læring og medarbejdernes kompetenceudvikling. Samtidig er arbejdet med mad og madmod en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores køkkenpersonale er aktive medspillere i det pædagogiske arbejde, og hver fredag samles børn og voksne omkring bålet til fælles madoplevelser.

En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og stærkt kollegaskab

I Elverhøj bliver du en del af en engageret personalegruppe bestående af pædagoger, pædagogiske assistenter og medhjælpere.

Vi tror på, at den bedste udvikling skabes sammen. Derfor investerer vi løbende i faglig udvikling gennem blandt andet:

  • ICDP
  • Kompetenceudvikling i samarbejde med Ishøj Naturcenter
  • Kursusforløbet "Ansvar og følgeskab til pædagogikken" i samarbejde med Københavns Professionshøjskole

Vi har fokus på tillid og trivsel i arbejdsfællesskabet med hinanden samt i arbejdet med børnene og deres forældre.

Ledelse tæt på praksis

Vi prioriterer nærværende og faglig ledelse. Det betyder, at vi som ledelse er tæt på hverdagen og understøtter medarbejdernes pædagogiske arbejde i praksis.

Vi arbejder ud fra den styrkede pædagogiske læreplan og Ishøj Kommunes kvalitetsparametre med ét fælles mål: At skabe de bedste udviklingsmuligheder for alle børn gennem trygge relationer, legende læringsmiljøer og høj pædagogisk kvalitet.

Er du uddannet pæadgog og kan du genkende dig selv i dette:

✨ Brænder for arbejdet med børn og deltager aktivt i lege, aktiviteter og relationer

✨ Er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og god til at skabe trygge fællesskaber

✨ Er nysgerrig på egen og kollegers praksis og har lyst til at udvikle dig fagligt

✨ Møder børn, forældre og kolleger med anerkendelse, respekt og et positivt ressourcesyn

✨ Kommunikerer tydeligt og professionelt både mundtligt og skriftligt

✨ Trives i et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor samarbejde og fælles ansvar er vigtige værdier

Vi tager godt imod dig

Som ny medarbejder bliver du en del af et grundigt onboardingforløb. Du får både støtte fra dine nærmeste kolleger og tilknyttes en mentor, som hjælper dig godt ind i huset og kulturen.

Derudover får alle pædagoger i Ishøj Kommune 1 times skemalagt forberedelsestid om ugen, ligesom pædagoger modtager et særligt løntillæg for arbejdet med kommunens kvalitetsparametre.

Har du lyst til at være med?

Hvis du drømmer om en arbejdsplads, hvor natur, leg, faglighed og fællesskab går hånd i hånd, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Ansøgningsfrist: Den 23. september 2026 kl. 12.00

Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst. Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest samt referencer i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen i Elverhøj.

title: Senior Executive Coordinator to Professor Danielle Allen
description:
The Senior Executive Coordinator will provide high-level support to the James Bryant Conant University Professor, Director of the Allen Lab for Democracy Renovation at the Ash Center for Democratic Governance and Innovation, and Director of the Democratic Knowledge Project at the Harvard Graduate School of Education. They will sit at the nexus of a complex ecosystem of organizations and activities led by the Director and must bring exceptional judgment, discretion, and diplomacy to coordinating a high volume of requests and communications across a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders, each with different priorities, expectations, and working styles.

The Senior Executive Coordinator will perform a range of support activities including complex calendar coordination; managing incoming requests, including routinely and politely communicating declines and non-availability of the Director; interfacing with faculty, students, staff, external partners, media, and others on behalf of the Director; travel arrangements; and other duties as required by a demanding and high volume work environment. Candidates must demonstrate exceptional time management and organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, consistently high standards of quality, the ability to multitask and prioritize successfully, and the ability to manage and track a high volume of requests, relationships, and follow-up actions simultaneously.

The Senior Executive Coordinator works speedily yet accurately in a high-demand environment and will possess a high level of maturity and good judgment. They will work closely with the Director, maintaining steady communication and seeking feedback in a timely and consistent manner.

The Ash Center is a global and values-driven community that believes diverse perspectives are paramount to better understanding and addressing real-world problems. In fostering an environment of rigor, curiosity, and integrity, we value and respect different opinions, lived experiences, and diverse research and policy areas and approaches. We actively seek candidates who share our commitment and values.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Manage a complex calendar for the Director:
  • Monitor and resolve incoming requests each day through email, tracking sheets, and other management systems
  • Maintain a calendar that provides margin for meals, biobreaks, and other requirements of sustainability
  • Identify potential conflicts well in advance and seek timely solutions
  • Serve as liaison between the Director, their speaking agent, and parties requesting interviews or speaking engagements
  • Align daily and long-range commitments with flexibility recognizing the Director’s evolving priorities and objectives
  • Monitor steady stream of commitments and deadlines
  • Create and maintain regular communications with team members on Director's activities
  • Track student advisees and their basic scheduling needs for the Director’s time
  • Perform the following administrative duties:
  • Track, oversee, and reconcile Director’s financial expenses and reimbursements
  • Provide support for the faculty member’s travel, to include making flight and hotel reservations and/or coordinate with the speaker’s agency making said arrangements;

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and 5 years of professional experience in increasingly responsible administrative positions.

  • Experience with complex logistics or as an administrative professional to a high ranking or senior principal in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent attention to detail and high standards for quality of work.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to track multiple work streams, prioritize tasks to changing needs, and see tasks to completion in a timely manner.
  • Enthusiasm for new and emerging technologies and excellent computer skills, including word processing, spreadsheet and database management experience, and familiarity with automated systems (AI)¿
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion
  • Must enjoy and thrive working in a fast-paced environment
  • Work well under pressure and be able to prioritize work¿

  • An interest and awareness of those making democracy deeper and more robust in the United States or around the world.
  • High EQ and the ability to relate on many levels with leadership, colleagues, and external partners. Tact, poise, mature judgment, diplomatic skills, and discretion.
  • Appointment End Date: Fully benefits-eligible one year term appointment, with possibility of renewal.
