title: Senior Software Engineer - Security
description:
We are the software supply chain security team, part of Apple Services Engineering (ASE) Security org. We work on the software behind iCloud, App Store, Apple Music, TV+, and Commerce. Our job is to make software Apple can trust: know what goes into it, catch the security problems in it before they ship, and keep unsafe code out of production. Engineering teams across Apple Services build against the tooling we provide.

The near-term work is assurance signal. Scanners, design reviews, and code analysis produce findings faster than anyone can judge them, so engineers hand-triage noise and stop trusting the output. That triage step sets the ceiling on how much assurance we can run and on how much of it our partner teams act on. We are building automated security assurance that produces findings engineers trust: agentic and LLM-driven analysis, wrapped in the evaluation harnesses and guardrails that keep non-deterministic components honest as inputs, targets, and models change.

The longer-term agenda is the supply chain itself. Today nobody can answer questions about a running service without a person spending a day chasing registries, build systems, and scanners: what went into this build, where each dependency came from, who owns fixing it when it goes bad. We are building the paved path that answers those questions by construction, through dependency risk management, build and release integrity, artifact signing and verification, and policy-based admission of software into runtime.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, write, and ship production software. Success here takes strong distributed systems engineering, real judgment about where agentic components belong and where they don’t, and the ability to make security controls show up in other teams’ existing workflows without becoming a tax.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role where you will partner with infrastructure, platform, and product security teams to build the tooling and services that other engineers across Apple depend on to develop, ship, and operate services securely at scale. You will be accountable for producing quality software that meets service-level objectives.

Your everyday activities will include designing, implementing, testing, and operating security services and features, including scanning and assurance tooling, agentic and LLM-integrated components, backends and APIs, and the integrations that make security work show up in developers’ existing workflows. You will participate in code and security reviews to help your peers meet a high bar for the software they ship.

You will do research, prototyping, and present ideas, designs, and results to your team, management, and internal customers. You are expected to own significant components end to end and to remain close to the code as those components evolve.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including production ownership of non-trivial systems
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with proficiency in at least two: Python, Go, Java and comfort working across additional languages as the work requires
  • Solid working knowledge of software supply chain security concepts, including package and dependency risk, build and release integrity, artifact signing and verification, attestation infrastructure and policy-based admission of software into runtime environments
  • Experience designing, building, and operating agentic systems and LLM-integrated applications in production including prompt engineering, orchestration, and evaluation of model outputs
  • Familiarity with application security assurance methodologies, including static and dynamic analysis approaches and their operational trade-offs
  • Experience designing and operating distributed backends: APIs, data pipelines, and services with meaningful uptime and performance requirements
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and integrating security controls into them
  • Comfortable operating in Linux and macOS environments, with proficiency in a shell scripting language such as Bash
  • Working understanding of the full software development lifecycle building, testing, deploying, and monitoring production software

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building policy admission systems that enforce security controls at deployment or runtime
  • Experience with threat modeling, taint analysis, or other program-analysis techniques
  • Working knowledge of common web and service-level vulnerabilities (injection, IDOR, input validation, authentication and authorization flaws)
  • Experience evaluating and integrating new models and services to extend product capabilities
  • Full-stack engineering experience, including building user-facing surfaces that expose complex data to internal customers
  • Experience with containerization, container orchestration, and cloud infrastructure at scale
  • Experience with gRPC and other high-performance service interfaces
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience in a related field

title: Vi søger dygtige generalister til Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærds departement
description:
Vil du være med til at gennemføre den grønne omstilling af landbruget? Kan du se dig selv arbejde med artsforvaltning eller med implementeringen af den mest ambitiøse grønne aftale i nyere tid i Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd?

Vi søger generalister, og herunder en jurist, som ønsker at arbejde med beskyttede arter på naturområdet eller at være med til at udføre det store implementeringsarbejde for et Grønt Danmark.

Om os
Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd har et bredt og politisk prioriteret opgavefelt. En central opgave er at realisere den grønne trepartsaftale, herunder omlægningen af danske arealer fra landbrug til natur og skov, beskyttelsen af vandmiljøet og indførelsen af verdens første klimaafgift på landbruget. På dyrevelfærdsområdet står ministeriet bl.a. over for arbejdet med en grisefirepart og den fortsatte omstilling mod en mere bæredygtig produktion.

Ministeriet består af et departement og to faglige styrelser: Naturstyrelsen og Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø.

Hvad kommer du især til at arbejde med?
Du vil enten komme til at arbejde med artsområdet eller med implementering af klimaafgifter for landbruget, og du skal indgå i tværfaglige samarbejder, hvor både teknisk faglighed, jura og flair for politisk kontekst er afgørende for at opnå gode resultater. Du skal bl.a. udarbejde forelæggelser til minister og folketing, faglige notater, forberede og deltage i møder og samarbejde med interne og eksterne interessenter. Kontoret har et tæt samarbejde med Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø, som spiller en væsentlig rolle med faglige og juridiske bidrag til opgaveløsningen. Da der er mange interne og eksterne samarbejdsflader for stillingerne, stilles der store krav til dine relationelle kompetencer.

Du bliver en del af et arbejdsmiljø med fagligt dygtige kollegaer, hvor vi vægter godt samarbejde, engagement, det sociale og holdånd højt.

Stillingerne er placeret i kontoret Klima, grønne virkemidler og naturforvaltning. Kontoret arbejder bl.a. med klimaområdet, fx den kommende CO2-afgift på landbruget, samt med forskning og analyse, forvaltning af arter, miljøvurdering og husdyrområdet. Vi søger nye kollegaer til artsområdet og til afgiftsområdet.

Artsområdet: Dine opgaver vil i udgangspunktet knytte sig til samarbejdet med dine kollegaer om bl.a. arbejdet med beskyttede arter, invasive arter, jagt- og vildtforvaltning, men der vil også være mulighed for at bidrage til andre områder i kontoret, fx juridisk assistance til miljøvurderingsområdet.

Afgiftsområdet: Dine opgaver vil knytte sig til afgiftsområdet, hvor du kommer til at samarbejde og koordinere processer med dine kollegaer, styrelsen og andre ministerier om at udvikle den kommende CO2-afgift på udledninger fra husdyr i landbruget. Der vil primært være opgaver af generalistmæssig karakter, men også opgaver, hvor analytiske/kvantitative kompetencer og viden/interesse for landbruget vil være en fordel.

Om dig
Du har en relevant samfundsfaglig kandidatuddannelse, fx cand.scient.pol. eller lignende. Du kan være nyuddannet eller have nogle års erfaring med generalistopgaver. Hvis du søger stillingen i klimaområdet, kan du også have en naturvidenskabelig kandidatuddannelse, fx agronomi, husdyrvidenskab, klimaforandringer mv. Hvis du er jurist, er det en fordel, hvis du har beskæftiget dig indgående med miljø- og naturret (naturbeskyttelsesdirektiverne og miljøvurderingsloven) og i øvrigt kan se dig selv arbejde som generalist.

Vi forventer, at du kan se dig selv i følgende udsagn:

  • Har faglig interesse og stærke kompetencer: Du har interesse for og evne til at sætte dig ind i komplekse problemstillinger og har politisk forståelse for at kunne omsætte relevante problemstillinger til politiske løsninger. Du har gerne relevant erfaring, f.eks. fra centraladministrationen eller interesseorganisationer.
  • Er god til at styre processer: Du er velstruktureret, kan tænke i helheder, processer og fastholde overblikket, også når tingene går stærkt.
  • Har stærke samarbejdsevner: Du er opsøgende og god til at inddrage og samarbejde med kollegaer, styrelser, ministerier og organisationer. Du synes, det er spændende at samarbejde med andre fagligheder og finde løsninger på politiske problemstillinger.
  • God formidler: Du er god til at formidle komplekse problemstillinger klart og præcist, og du har gode sprogkundskaber, såvel skriftligt som mundtligt.
  • God kollega: Du bidrager som holdspiller og er en god kollega, men er også klar til at påtage dig et selvstændigt ansvar. Du motiveres af at bidrage til kontorets opgaveløsning samt giver og modtager gerne feedback i samarbejdet.
Vi tilbyder dig

  • Et spændende job i et ministerium på et politisk prioriteret område.
  • Gode muligheder for at udvikle dit faglige potentiale og dine personlige kompetencer.
  • Dygtige kollegaer med mange forskellige fagligheder og tæt samarbejde om opgaveløsningen.
  • Gensidig fleksibilitet i planlægningen af arbejdsudførslen.
Ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelsen er på fuld tid, og aflønning sker som fuldmægtig eller konsulent i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række Akademiker-organisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademiker-overenskomsten).

Der vil afhængig af kvalifikationer være mulighed for at forhandle kvalifikationstillæg.

Ansættelsesområdet er Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd med tilhørende institutioner. Tjenestestedet er departementet, Holmens Kanal 22, 1060 København K.

Stillingerne er til besættelse snarest muligt.

Vil du vide mere
Hvis du har uddybende spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef i Klima, grønne virkemidler og naturforvaltning Rasmus Lunden Bertelsen på tlf. 23 24 91 01.

Sådan søger du
Ansøgningsfristen er den 8. september 2026. Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 38-39.

Du søger stillingerne ved at sende dit CV, motiveret ansøgning, uddannelsesbevis og andre relevante dokumenter.

Du må meget gerne angive i din ansøgning, hvis du har særlig interesse for en stilling i enten klima- eller artsområdet eller begge områder.

Der vil være en opgave som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen. Dette vil blive præciseret ved indkaldelsen.

Stillingerne kan være forbundet med et krav om, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele din ansættelse.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: Timelærer til FVU Digital
description:
Vil du være med til at styrke voksnes digitale færdigheder og gøre en konkret forskel i deres hverdag, uddannelse og arbejdsliv?

Vestegnen HF & VUC søger en engageret timelærer til FVU Digital. Stillingen er aktuelt på ca. 12 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Har du desuden kompetencer inden for naturfag på AVU eller andre fag på AVU og FVU, kan der være mulighed for flere undervisningstimer.

Om stillingen

Som underviser på FVU Digital skal du gøre digitale færdigheder konkrete, anvendelige og overskuelige for voksne med forskellige forudsætninger. Undervisningen tager udgangspunkt i deltagernes behov og i digitale opgaver, de møder i hverdagen, på en uddannelse og på arbejdsmarkedet.

Dine centrale opgaver bliver at:

• planlægge og gennemføre praksisnær og deltagerinddragende undervisning i FVU Digital

• skabe trygge læringsrammer med tydelig differentiering og progression

• koble undervisningen til deltagernes konkrete digitale behov og erfaringer

• bidrage til faglig sparring, videndeling og udvikling af vores digitale didaktik

Undervisningen kan være fordelt på flere lokationer i vores dækningsområde på den københavnske Vestegn og kan også foregå i samarbejde med virksomheder og andre partnere. Du skal derfor være indstillet på, at arbejdssted og undervisningstidspunkter kan variere.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• har en relevant faglig og pædagogisk baggrund – du kan være nyuddannet eller erfaren

• har stærke digitale kompetencer og kan omsætte dem til enkel og anvendelig undervisning

• brænder for at arbejde med voksne og møder kursisterne anerkendende og respektfuldt

• kan differentiere undervisningen og skabe motivation, tryghed og synlig progression

• arbejder selvstændigt, fleksibelt og struktureret og samtidig trives i et fagligt fællesskab

• gerne har kompetencer eller undervisningserfaring inden for naturfag på AVU eller andre AVU- og FVU-fag

Vi tilbyder

• en timelærerstilling på aktuelt ca. 12 timer om ugen med mulighed for flere timer afhængigt af dine faglige kompetencer

• en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed, kollegial sparring og plads til initiativ

• en strategisk forankret digital dagsorden og fokus på moderne læringsteknologier

• muligheder for kompetenceudvikling og for at bidrage til udviklingen af vores undervisning

• gode personaleforhold med bl.a. kaffe, frugt, frokostordning og motionsrum

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold

Der er tale om ansættelse som timelærer på aktuelt ca. 12 timer ugentligt. Tiltrædelse er snarest muligt. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst med mulighed for forhandling af tillæg.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelses- og erhvervschef Ingolff Serup Lindbo på cli@vucv.dk eller telefon 20 70 99 68.

Ansøgning inkl. eksamensbeviser og CV sendes til Ingolff Serup Lindbo på cli@vucv.dk og avujob@vucv.dk.

Send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende, og vi ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
description:
We are looking for a talented (Senior Salesforce Administrator) to join our growing global team at Sectigo.


The Senior Salesforce Administrator manages all assigned aspects of the Salesforce environment at Sectigo. This position is responsible for guiding the ongoing development, improving processes, promoting adoption of the platform, and performing the execution on the day-to-day configuration, support, maintenance, and improvement of our Salesforce platform. This individual primarily focuses on a list of assigned regions, as well as interacting with and supports users globally besides collaborating with other Salesforce administrators on the team. This individual works closely with functional leaders, organizational units, and subject matter experts to identify, develop, and deploy new business processes for the sales, marketing, and support departments. This role is a part administrator and heavily supports users on CPQ from assisting with quote creation and working with product management to set up price books/product bundles/approval flows.

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

  • Serve as system administrator for the Salesforce.com environment and provide day-to-day end-user support for 300+ Salesforce users.
  • Maintain and support CPQ, collaborating with sales leaders, product, legal, and finance teams.
  • Assist with rolling out CPQ to other sales divisions of the company.
  • Handle all basic administrative functions including user account maintenance, reports and dashboards, workflows and other routine tasks.
  • Improve process around cases for support department to ensure appropriate inputs available for correct routing to agents and essential metadata captured for metrics reporting.
  • Complete regular internal system audits and prepare for upgrades.
  • Manage Salesforce.com data feeds and other integrations (HubSpot, ZoomInfo, Jira, Jitterbit, etc.).
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve technical problems and track problems appropriately.
  • Monitor application storage usage and archive data as needed, maintain data security and integrity.
  • Create and customize standard and custom objects, fields (including formula fields), page layouts, security rules, sharing rules, and validation rules.
  • Build framework for user profiles, roles, permission sets, assignment rules, and license types.
  • Monitor and improve data quality, integrity, and user adoption.
  • Work with our institutional management team to establish suitable processes to support administrative, development, and change management activities.
  • Leverage expertise to collaborate on best practices/standards supporting platform adoption and the full application lifecycle (design, development, change control, UAT, deployment and support).
  • Document current and future state processes and develop functional specifications.
  • Promote data integrity, data governance, and compliance. Performs special assignments as requested by departments.
  • Assist with building test plans and scenarios to support QA/ UAT efforts.
  • Perform data loads and data quality reviews. Hands-on experience with tools like Data Loader.
  • Ability to develop and maintain SFDC Visual Force pages, Apex classes, triggers & lightning components a plus.
  • Develop end-user training documentation and provide user training for new releases.
  • Assist in training new users and grow the Salesforce.com skill set across the organization.
  • Other duties as assigned and related to the nature of this role and company initiatives.

More information about this role:

  • This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week.
  • This is an individual contributor role, reporting to our Manager, Salesforce.
  • The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 12,50,000 and INR 13,50,000

Education:

  • Bachelors from an accredited college or university is strongly preferred

Experience:

  • Salesforce Admin and CPQ specialist certificates are strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Salesforce administrator/developer.

Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:

  • Proven Salesforce subject matter expert with experience creating reports, optimizing processes, training, and managing dashboards.
  • Strong experience with CPQ covering implementation, maintenance of price books, products, and quote/order form templates, and providing training and support for sales teams in building quotes.
  • Maintain high standards of data quality for Salesforce records, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
  • Ability to customize and configure Salesforce Communities to meet business requirements, including branding, page layouts, and user permissions, is a plus.
  • Experience with Cases and understanding of their workflows and accessibility rules.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests, and manage laterally and upwards.
  • Creative and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Must demonstrate exceptional verbal and written communication skills at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on Salesforce.com and all upstream and downstream applications, systems, and processes.
  • Excellent planning, organization, attention to detail and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, experienced building strong cross-functional working relationships.
  • Strong business acumen and understanding of marketing and sales processes on experience.
  • Strong computer aptitude and proficiency in MS Office applications is a must.
  • Ability to work in a global, fast-paced environment.

Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate.

Our “One Sectigo” culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo:

To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage.

Global team. Global reach. Global impact.

At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work – and our team members – reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

title: Souschef - Ikast - jem & fix
description:
Vi leder efter en målrettet, ansvarsfuld, og dygtig souschef som kan assistere butikschefen i den daglige drift. Hvis du elsker udvikling, ansvar, og kan trives i et til tider travlt miljø, er det måske dig, vi søger.

Vores overbevisning er, at kunder kan klare sig selv, og vores vigtigste opgave er at sikre, at de kan få deres byggematerialer til en lav pris. I øjeblikket søger vi en dygtig souschef til at assistere butikschefen i den daglige drift.

Dine opgaver vil inkludere tæt samarbejde med butikschefen, stedfortræderrolle i butikschefens fravær, planlægning af ambitiøse mål for butik og medarbejdere, medansvar for resultater og salgstiltag, samt bidrag til optimal varedisponering og butikspræsentation.

Vi søger en person med evnen til at skabe resultater gennem samarbejde, der motiveres af at hjælpe kollegaer til at blive dygtigere. En struktureret tilgang til dit arbejde, med evnen til at holde overblik, er afgørende. Er du energisk og trives i et hurtigt tempo, er det helt perfekt.

Hos jem & fix, Danmarks største byggemarked, har vi en flad struktur og højt til loftet. Du vil få en struktureret introduktion til jobbet, en erfaren mentor, og adgang til vores eget akademi med målrettet undervisning. Vi tilbyder en attraktiv lønpakke inklusive bonusordning, Fritvalgslønkonto, pensionsordning, og sundhedssikring fra dag ét.

Kørekort er et krav.

Vi håber at høre fra dig snarest muligt.

title: Mattel Retail Team Associate - Providence, RI 02865
description:
The Opportunity: As a Seasonal Team Associate, you’ll partner with a Mattel Retail Services Representative to grow Mattel’s presence at major retailers, working a minimum of 15 hours per week during our busiest holiday season. We are looking for enthusiastic temporary team members who are passionate about merchandising, enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, and want to drive results and make magic happen this holiday season! This job can open the door to future merchandising career opportunities with Mattel.

What Your Impact Will Be:

  • Brand ambassador of Mattel/Fisher-Price brands and products
  • Collaborate with your lead Mattel Representative to secure prime product placements for Mattel’s iconic brands
  • Partner with lead Mattel Representative on monthly scheduling
  • Unpack cases of various Mattel toys
  • Merchandise and organize product on the sales floor
  • Construct & deconstruct store fixtures including shelving and racking
  • Implement point of purchase materials
  • Execute special projects as assigned including, but not limited to store events
  • Administrative tasks including but not limited to managing time entry, attending meetings, trainings, checking email etc.

What We’re Looking For:

Basic Job Qualifications:

  • Must be at least 18 years old
  • High school diploma or GED
  • Preferred work hours are during the weekday during daytime hours; occasional weekends
  • Must be available to work a minimum of 15 hours per week
  • Preferred device requirement – Up to date smartphone and/or computer with Chrome Browser to access for time worked entries, email and Workday. Other browsers (e.g. DuckDuckGo) are not supported. A mobile phone is required for multi-factor authentication to receive SMS(text) or voice call.
  • Must have access to reliable internet
  • Must have reliable transportation to travel to and between assigned store locations (gas mileage reimbursement per company policy)
  • Reside within approximately 20 miles of the assigned territory/store cluster or otherwise able to reliably service the assigned territory

Physical Requirements:

  • Stand, bend, twist, squat, kneel, reach
  • Walk for long periods of time
  • Climb ladders up to 12’ tall
  • Lift up to 25 pounds frequently, 50 pounds occasionally
  • Push/pull carts containing product - occasionally up to 100 lbs
  • Operate power tools (screwdriver & drill)

About You:

  • Merchandising, retail or customer service experience (preferred, but not required)
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ensure tasks are completed efficiently with a strong sense of urgency
  • Represent the brand with professionalism and a positive attitude
  • Bring a flexible, adaptable mindset and enjoy collaborating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Eagerness to learn new skills with a safety-first mentality
  • Tech-savvy (smartphone, apps)

Ready to make an impact this holiday season? Apply today!

The hourly rate for this position is $20.00.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

How We Work:
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

  • We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
  • We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
  • We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

Who We Are:
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

Visit us at and .

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran and protected veteran status, disability status, and or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

title: Linjefører søges i Frederikshavn og omegn
description:
Vi søger en engageret og handlekraftig medarbejder, som skal være den nuværende linjeførers højre hånd hos en af vores samarbejdspartnere.

Du bliver en vigtig del af teamet og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med linjeføreren om at få produktionen til at køre så effektivt og smidigt som muligt. Du skal være med, når der skal holdes øje med produktionen, løses udfordringer og skabes flow på linjen.

Der er tale om en længerevarende opgave med mulighed for fastansættelse. Arbejdstiden vil primært være i dagstimerne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • At assistere den nuværende linjefører og være med til at holde produktionen kørende
  • At overvåge produktionslinjen og reagere, hvis noget ikke fungerer, som det skal
  • At hjælpe med opstart, omstilling og justering af produktionen
  • At udføre kvalitetskontrol og være med til at sikre et godt resultat
  • At hjælpe med at løse udfordringer, når tempoet er højt
  • At koordinere og samarbejde med kolleger på linjen
Vi leder efter dig, der

  • Har erfaring fra produktion, industri eller lignende
  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for maskiner og produktion
  • Er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære mere
  • Kan bevare overblikket, når der er travlt
  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og klar til at tage initiativ
  • Trives med at arbejde tæt sammen med andre
  • Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Ansættelse igennem JKS på overenskomstmæssige vilkår, der kan være mulighed for at blive fastansat hos virksomheden.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

Er du interesseret i at søge stillingen, bedes du sende en ansøgning, CV samt relevante bilag via "Søg stillingen" nedenfor. Grundet persondataforordningen modtager vi ikke CV og ansøgning på mail.

title: Order Distributor

We are open to applicants from all backgrounds. Experience isn't everything — what matters most is your attitude, communication, and how you deal with people.

  • Comfortable working inside a prison, alongside offenders
  • Able to communicate clearly and deal with people, including in challenging situations
  • Have 3 years UK address history (required for security clearance)
  • Happy in a physical role — expect regular lifting and moving heavy stock

  • Visit to learn more

✅WHO WE ARE

​We're the global leaders in supply chain management with 188,000 people in over 50 countries. Our expert teams work together to deliver for our customers across a range of industries including retail, automotive, healthcare and more.

At DHL, we're all about creating a workplace where everyone's skills and experiences matter, and where you can be your true self every day.

As proud supporters of the Armed Forces Covenant, we value the skills and experience of ex-service personnel and are dedicated to helping our veterans find jobs.

title: Cost Analyst | Infrastructure | Gold Coast
description:
We are looking for a Cost Analyst who will be taking responsibility for end to end service delivery and to ensure that client objectives are met through the delivery of an effective cost management service.

This role will also entail working from the client office on the Gold Coast three days per week.

Some of the duties include:

  • Undertaking detailed cost analysis and reporting, breaking down cost summaries and reviewing actual costs against forecast costs to identify variances and assess contractual compliance.
  • Deliver Cost Intelligence which can be embedded into ways of working through implementation of cost analytics tools and processes.
  • Provide cost estimating and assurance for projects at various stages of the project lifecycle utilizing benchmarking and parametric scaling to drive efficiencies.
  • Provide support as an integrated team member within a centralized Program Management Office structure developing and maintaining positive relationships across the client stakeholder group.
  • Knowledge management – Ensure that key information and learning generated is transferred internally in Turner & Townsend.
  • Seek out opportunities to develop new business with existing clients and report such opportunities to the appropriate line manager.
  • SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.
  • Comply with the requirements of Turner & Townsend’s Business Management Systems including Health & Safety, Environmental and Quality Management associated with the role and position within the company.
  • Degree in Construction Management or Engineering.
  • Achievement of Chartered status with AIQS or RICS or equivalent recognized body.
  • 3+ years cost analyst and/or cost management experience, preferably in a private practice or construction organization.
  • Strong ability and attention to detail to interpret financial data, identify trend and provide actionable insights.
  • An understanding of the characteristics of projects over a project life cycle and strong technical grounding providing cost estimating and/or cost management for infrastructure assets.

title: Hearing Wellness Advisor- Chelmsford
description:
If you enjoy working directly with customers, supporting clinical care, and being part of a service that genuinely changes lives- this Hearing Wellness Advisor role offers a rewarding entry point into a long-term audiology career.

You’ll play a key role in supporting customers throughout their hearing journey, while building the experience, skills, and qualifications needed to progress into clinical audiology- backed by the scale, stability, and investment of Boots Hearingcare.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role with real responsibility, structured development, and a clear future pathway.

The clinic environment

You’ll work within a modern clinic, supporting both customers and Audiologists in delivering outstanding hearing care.

The environment includes:

  • Access to the latest hearing technology and hearing aid solutions
  • Structured diaries and appointment-based services
  • Strong clinical and operational support
  • Clear processes and high standards of care

The role

As a Hearing Wellness Advisor, you’ll:

  • Be the first point of contact for customers, providing a warm and professional welcome
  • Carry out hearing screenings and pre-clinic checks
  • Support hearing aid maintenance, aftercare, and troubleshooting
  • Assist Audiologists with clinic flow and customer preparation
  • Confidently discuss hearing health, ear care products, and next steps with customers
  • Manage administration, appointments, and customer records accurately
  • Play an active role in delivering a high-quality, customer-centric service

You’ll be trusted with responsibility and supported to grow your capability over time.

Training & career progression

From day one, you’ll receive structured training to build confidence and clinical understanding, including sessions at our Boots Hearingcare Academy in Llandudno. Training is delivered over several months, with all accommodation and expenses covered, and is supported by hands-on experience in store.

Career pathway

This role offers a clear progression route: Hearing Wellness Advisor → QHAD → Audiologist

With strong performance, you can progress onto our fully funded Qualification in Hearing Aid Dispensing (QHAD) programme, leading to a qualified Hearing Aid Audiologist role.

Entry requirements:

  • GCSEs (or equivalent) Grade C / 5 or above in Maths, English, and Science
  • Strong performance and customer focus
  • Ability to balance academic study with clinical practice

What’s in it for you

  • Salary: £26,500per annum
  • Monthly bonus scheme
  • Boots Discount Card
  • Free hearing aids (if required as an employee)
  • Free flu vaccination (discounted for family members)
  • Pension scheme (including salary sacrifice)
  • Life assurance
  • Flexible Benefits Box – tailor your package
  • Telus wellbeing support – confidential support inside and outside work
  • 25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 with service, plus bank holidays
  • Long service awards recognising your contribution

What we’re looking for

  • A strong customer-service background (healthcare or retail ideal)
  • Confidence working with customers in a consultative environment
  • Excellent communication and organisational skills
  • Strong attention to detail and administration skills
  • A genuine interest in hearing health and progression into audiology
  • GCSEs (or equivalent) in Maths, English, and Science to support future QHAD entry

We care. We drive innovation. We strive for excellence. We build the best team.

title: Clinical Assessor
description:
What we offer

  • Excellent training and ongoing support – be part of our valued team where wellbeing is prioritised.
  • Full or part time hours (minimum 3 days per week).
  • Monday to Friday between 8am to 5pm with no weekend or night shifts (occasional 8pm finishes may be required).
  • £39,500 starting salary, rising to £40,500 after DWP approval.
  • 10% of Salary Bonus scheme (based on quality and performance).
  • Hybrid working – home and clinic based (up to 3 days per week).
  • Watch this short video to find out more

Please note, due to business needs, part-time staff will be required to work on a Friday each week as part of their usual pattern. Also there will be an initial full time (paid) training period of 8 weeks so candidates must be able to commit to that.

Other benefits

  • HCPC/NMC fees paid and full revalidation support.
  • 15 weeks’ full maternity, adoption and shared parental pay.
  • Company pension, life assurance and Cycle2Work scheme.
  • Discounts across retail, travel, technology and wellbeing.
  • Free access to Headspace (for you and up to 5 others).
  • A paid volunteering day each year.
  • Ongoing training, development and clear career pathways.
  • 25 days’ holiday (rising to 27 with service) with the option to buy more up to 5 days.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Conduct functional assessments which include initial reviews, face-to-face, video or telephone assessments to evaluate how a claimant’s health condition or disability affects them for various types of benefit.
  • Analyse and interpret clinical information and supporting evidence.
  • Write detailed evidence-based reports to support the DWP/DfC in making informed and objective decisions - no treatment or diagnosis required.
  • Use IT systems to support clinical decision-making and report writing.
  • Develop your clinical knowledge and constantly learn about health conditions which are less familiar to you.

What are PIP and WCA?

  • Personal Independence Payment (PIP) is a benefit for people with a long-term health condition or impairment. It is paid to make a contribution to the extra costs that disabled people may face, to help them lead full, active and independent lives.
  • Work Capability Assessment (WCA) is a functional assessment that looks at a range of different activities relating to physical, mental, intellectual and cognitive functions, to help DWP determine a customer's capability for work or work-related activity.

About you

  • NMC registered Nurse (RGN, RMN or RNLD) or HCPC registered paramedic, occupational therapist or physiotherapist with a valid PIN and no current restrictions
  • Minimum of one year’s post-registration experience.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to produce clear, accurate and detailed reports.
  • Comfortable working quickly to meet structured targets.
  • Good IT skills including Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn new systems while working remotely.
  • excellent observational and communication skills, giving you the ability to listen, empathise and dig deeper.
  • A driving licence or access to transport for assessment centre working.

Please note: all candidates must hold the right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role

About Capita HAAS

We were awarded two contracts to deliver the Health Assessment Advisory Service (HAAS) assessments in the Midlands and Wales for the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP), and in Northern Ireland for the Department for Communities (DfC).

We deliver assessments for a variety of different benefits, including delivering PIP, WCA and Specialist benefit assessments across the Midlands and Wales, and in Northern Ireland.

title: Har du blik for natur, græsning og god arealdrift?
description:
Vil du være med til at forvalte nogle af Danmarks vigtigste naturområder? Har du interesse for naturpleje, græsning, arealdrift og samarbejde med mennesker? Og motiveres du af en hverdag med stor variation og mange kontaktflader? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig.

Naturstyrelsen søger en medarbejder til Team Lysåben Natur i enheden Arealer på hovedkontoret i Randbøl.

Naturstyrelsen forvalter statens skov- og naturområder og står i disse år over for store og spændende opgaver. Biodiversitet, naturgenopretning og udviklingen af den lysåbne natur fylder stadig mere i vores arbejde. Samtidig er der stor offentlig interesse for forvaltningen af statens arealer, hvilket stiller krav til både faglighed, samarbejde og god dialog.

Om stillingen
Team Lysåben Natur arbejder med rammer og retningslinjer for forvaltning, pleje og udvikling af Naturstyrelsens lysåbne arealer.

En væsentlig del af teamets arbejde handler om naturpleje med græssende dyr, forpagtnings- og græsningsaftaler samt de mange driftsmæssige og administrative opgaver, der følger med forvaltningen af statens naturarealer. Teamet arbejder også med dyrevelfærd, jagt- og vildtforvaltning, biodiversitet, naturgenopretning og den løbende dialog med borgere, forpagtere og Naturstyrelsens mange øvrige interessenter. Derudover arbejder teamet med blandt andet §3-beskyttelse, Natura 2000 og kulturminder på Naturstyrelsens arealer.

Du bliver en del af et team med stor faglig bredde og mange samarbejdsflader. Vi understøtter Naturstyrelsens 16 lokale enheder og bidrager til en fagligt funderet og ensartet forvaltning af statens lysåbne naturarealer.

Du vil opleve en stor opgavevariation og få mulighed for at arbejde tæt på nogle af de mest aktuelle dagsordener inden for naturforvaltning, biodiversitet og naturgenopretning.

Dine kerneopgaver bliver at:

  • Bidrage til administration og udvikling af forpagtnings- og græsningsskabeloner.
  • Understøtte Naturstyrelsens arbejde med drift og pleje af lysåbne naturarealer.
  • Bidrage til opgaver knyttet til tilskudsordninger, fællesskemaer, gødningsregnskaber, sprøjtejournaler og andre driftsrelaterede forhold.
  • Bidrage til håndtering af borgerhenvendelser, herunder spørgsmål om græssende dyr og naturforvaltning.
  • Understøtte de lokale enheder med faglig sparring og koordinering.
  • Bidrage til udvikling af nye løsninger inden for biodiversitet, naturgenopretning og naturpleje.
  • Bidrage til teamets øvrige opgaver inden for lysåben natur.
Du kan forvente et spændende og varieret job i en enhed, der arbejder tæt sammen med kolleger i hele landet samt andre fagkontorer i Naturstyrelsen og Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd.

Din profil
Du trives i spændingsfeltet mellem naturforvaltning, arealdrift, administration og samarbejde – og vi forestiller os derfor, at du har en jordbrugs-, natur- eller miljøfaglig uddannelse (fx som agronom, jordbrugsteknolog, skov- og landskabsingeniør eller biolog).

Dine erfaringer, kompetencer og personlige egenskaber er dog vigtigere for os end en bestemt uddannelsesmæssig baggrund.

Du har nogle års relevant erhvervserfaring indenfor administration, det kan eksempelvis være med fællesskemaer, gødningsregnskaber og sprøjtejournaler eller andet, der giver dig et godt afsæt. Det kan være du tilmed har erfaring med eller interesse for GIS og digitale værktøjer, så er det et plus.

Du lykkedes i jobbet, hvis du:

  • Trives med dialog og samarbejde med borgere, forpagtere og kolleger.
  • Kan skabe gode relationer og bidrage til konstruktive løsninger.
  • Arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for egne opgaver.
  • Kan formulere dig klart og præcist på skrift.
  • Trives i en hverdag med både planlagte opgaver og uforudsete henvendelser.
  • Har lyst til at indgå i et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter opgaverne i fællesskab.
Vi tilbyder
Et spændende og varieret job med stor faglig bredde og mulighed for at arbejde med nogle af de mest aktuelle natur- og biodiversitetsdagsordener i Danmark, og for at gøre en konkret forskel for udviklingen af naturindholdet på Naturstyrelsens arealer.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt team med høj grad af frihed, hjælpsomhed og sparring i hverdagen. Vi lægger vægt på ordentlighed, samarbejde og et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, når der er travlt.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår kan være i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række Akademiker-organisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten), i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Lærernes Centralorganisation og CO10 Centralorganisationen af 2010 (LC/CO10-fællesoverenskomsten) samt tilhørende organisationsaftale for Skov- og landskabsingeniører eller i henhold til den overenskomst på statens område, som din uddannelse/faggruppe er dækket af.

Ansættelsesområdet er Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd med tilhørende institutioner.

Tjenestestedet er Naturstyrelsen, Førstballevej 2, 7183 Randbøl.

Arbejdstiden er gennemsnitligt 37 timer pr. uge.

Det er et krav, at du har kørekort til personbil, da stillingen indebærer samarbejde med Naturstyrelsens lokale enheder og lejlighedsvis deltagelse i møder rundt om i landet.

Yderligere oplysninger
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Kristian Gernow, tlf. nr. 2143 1452 eller teamleder Lars Linneberg, tlf. nr. 2018 5799.

Du kan læse mere om Naturstyrelsen på nst.dk.

Sådan søger du stillingen
Du søger stillingen online ved at sende din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag senest den
10. september 2026 kl. 12.00.

Samtaler forventes afholdt den 14 og 15. september 2026.

title: Business Analyst
description:
This role is for one of Weekday’s clients
Salary range: Rs 1500000 - Rs 1800000 (ie INR 15 - 18 LPA)


Min Experience: 3+ years
Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India
JobType: full-time

We are looking for a highly analytical and business-focused Business Analyst with 3–6 years of experience to support strategic decision-making, business planning, performance analysis, and data-driven initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Business Intelligence and business planning, along with a solid understanding of business analysis methodologies.

In this role, you will work closely with business leaders, cross-functional teams, and operational stakeholders to understand business requirements, analyze performance, identify opportunities, and translate data into actionable insights. You will play an important role in helping teams make informed decisions and improve business performance.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business performance, operational metrics, and market trends to identify opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.
  • Develop and maintain Business Intelligence reports, dashboards, and analytical models to support business and management decisions.
  • Gather, validate, and interpret data from multiple sources to generate meaningful business insights.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business objectives, challenges, and requirements.
  • Support business planning activities, including forecasting, budgeting, performance planning, and strategic initiatives.
  • Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, analytical requirements, and actionable recommendations.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and gaps in business data and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis to understand operational and business performance issues.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to evaluate processes and identify opportunities for optimization and automation.
  • Support the development of business cases, feasibility assessments, and strategic recommendations.
  • Track project and business outcomes against defined objectives and KPIs.
  • Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across business reports and dashboards.

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong expertise in Business Intelligence and data-driven decision-making.
  • Strong understanding of business planning, forecasting, and performance management.
  • 3–6 years of relevant experience in business analysis, business intelligence, strategy, operations, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work with large datasets and derive actionable insights.
  • Strong understanding of KPIs, business metrics, and performance reporting.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear and structured outputs.
  • Strong proficiency in MS Excel and business reporting tools.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Practical experience in business analysis and requirements gathering.
  • Exposure to BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Knowledge of SQL and data querying.
  • Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, or strategic planning.
  • Familiarity with process improvement and workflow optimization.
  • Exposure to project management methodologies and tools.

title: Gadstrup Skole søger to dansklærere – heraf én med funktion som læsevejleder
description:
Brænder du for danskfaget og for at gøre en forskel for elevers faglige udvikling og trivsel? Gadstrup Skole søger to dygtige og engagerede lærere på fuld tid med undervisningskompetence i dansk.

Den ene stilling rummer desuden en funktion som læsevejleder for hele skolen, svarende til cirka halvdelen af stillingen.

Om Gadstrup Skole Gadstrup Skole er en tosporet skole med ca. 400 elever fra 0.-9. klasse. Vi er stolte af at være byens skole og af at skabe en hverdag, hvor faglighed, trivsel og fællesskab går hånd i hånd.

Vi lægger vægt på et trygt og ambitiøst læringsmiljø for både elever og medarbejdere. Hos os møder du engagerede kolleger, gode faglige sparringsmuligheder og en kultur, hvor samarbejde, nærvær og udvikling er bærende værdier.

Skolen ligger centralt i Gadstrup i Roskilde Kommune og er let at komme til med både bil og tog.

De to stillinger Begge stillinger er fuldtidsstillinger med dansk som centralt fag. Danskholdet vil være enten på 3. eller 6. klassetrin, og der indgår desuden en klasselæreropgave i ansættelsen.

Afhængigt af dine kompetencer og skolens behov kan der også indgå undervisning i historie, kristendomskundskab og engelsk. Andre fag kan sagtens også have interesse for os.

Du bliver en del af et stabilt og samarbejdende team med faste ugentlige teammøder, erfarne kolleger og gode muligheder for faglig sparring.

1. Dansklærer med læsevejlederfunktion

I denne stilling kombinerer du undervisning i dansk med en central funktion som læsevejleder på tværs af skolen. Læsevejlederfunktionen fylder cirka halvdelen af stillingen.

Du får en vigtig rolle i skolens arbejde med læsning, literacy og skriftsprogsudvikling fra 0.-9. klasse. Opgaverne kan blandt andet være at:

  • Vejlede og sparre med kolleger om elevers læse- og skriveudvikling
  • Bidrage til udvikling af undervisning og faglige indsatser
  • Gennemføre mindre, målrettede elevforløb
  • Understøtte skolens arbejde med faglig læsning, literacy og skriftsprogsudvikling
  • Medvirke til at kvalificere skolens samlede læseindsats
  • Spille en aktiv rolle i implementeringen af et nyt lærebogssystem.
Du er gerne uddannet læsevejleder. Hvis ikke, hører vi også meget gerne fra dig, hvis du har stærke danskfaglige kompetencer, erfaring eller tydelig motivation for læsevejlederopgaven. Vi er klar til at klæde dig godt på.

2. Dansklærer med klasselæreropgave

I denne stilling får du dansk på enten 3. eller 6. klassetrin og en klasselæreropgave. Du bliver en central voksen i elevernes hverdag og får mulighed for at skabe stærke faglige og sociale fællesskaber i klassen.

Vi søger en lærer, som har blik for både den enkelte elev og klassens fællesskab, og som har lyst til at indgå aktivt i tæt teamsamarbejde om undervisning, trivsel og forældresamarbejde.

Vi søger kolleger, der
  • Er læreruddannede og har undervisningskompetence i dansk eller stærke danskfaglige kvalifikationer
  • Er sikker i sin klasserumsledelse
  • Har erfaring med skole/hjemsamarbejdet
  • Brænder for god og varieret danskundervisning
  • Har blik for elevers læse-, skrive- og skriftsprogsudvikling
  • Arbejder struktureret, relationelt og med tydelige forventninger
  • Har lyst til at varetage en klasselæreropgave
  • Ser teamsamarbejde som en styrke og bidrager aktivt til fælles planlægning og udvikling
  • Har kompetencer i eller lyst til at undervise i historie, kristendomskundskab og/eller engelsk.
Til stillingen med læsevejlederfunktion lægger vi desuden vægt på, at du har interesse for eller erfaring med faglig vejledning, læsning og literacy – og at du har lyst til at inspirere og sparre med kolleger.

Hos os får du
  • To meningsfulde fuldtidsstillinger med danskfaget i centrum
  • Mulighed for at kombinere undervisning med faglig vejledning i læsevejlederstillingen
  • Et velfungerende og hjælpsomt team med faste ugentlige teammøder
  • Gode muligheder for sparring med ressourcepersoner og ledelse
  • En skole, hvor faglighed, trivsel og fællesskab prioriteres højt
  • Mulighed for at indgå i kommunale faglige netværk, herunder læsevejledernetværk med støtte fra læsekonsulenter
  • En grundig onboarding, så du får en god start på Gadstrup Skole.


Samarbejde og faglig kultur Samarbejde er en grundværdi på Gadstrup Skole. Vi prioriterer tæt samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper, årgange og teams, fordi vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab.

Vi vægter faglige og pædagogiske drøftelser højt og arbejder løbende med at udvikle undervisningen med udgangspunkt i elevernes behov. Der er plads til sparring, idéudveksling og fælles refleksion, og vi ønsker medarbejdere, der har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til skolens fortsatte udvikling.

En skole med stærke traditioner og gode rammer

Gadstrup Skole ligger i naturskønne omgivelser med gode udearealer og stærke traditioner. Vi værdsætter fællesskabende aktiviteter som blandt andet Store læser for små, morgensang, venskabsklasser, temauger og aktivitetsdage.

Vi har et tæt samarbejde med lokalsamfundet og bruger aktivt mulighederne i nærområdet, herunder spejderhytten, mosen, kirken og lokale foreninger.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af en engageret personalegruppe, der tager godt imod nye kolleger, hjælper hinanden i hverdagen og værner om en åben og positiv kultur.

Ansættelse og kontakt Stillingerne er på fuld tid med ansættelse gerne pr. 1. november eller hurtigst muligt derefter.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er efter gældende overenskomst, og der indhentes straffe- og børeattest samt referencer inden ansættelse.

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

  • Skoleleder Thomas Panzio på telefon 23 37 36 38
  • Afdelingsleder for 1.-5. klasse May-Britt Visti Lund Larsen på telefon 23 81 09 67
Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler den 28. september.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: Senior Backend Engineer ( Java)
description:

Salary range: Rs 2000000 - Rs 4500000 (ie INR 20 - 45 LPA)

title: Collections Agent
description:
Location: London (hybrid, open to discussion) Type: Full-time

Working pattern: Includes some weekend work, up to 2 weekends per month

Join the Revolution in Car Finance 🚗💥

At Carmoola, we're changing the way people get on the road, making it faster, fairer, and entirely built around the customer. We've started with car finance, reimagining it from the ground up with a seamless, digital experience that puts drivers in control.

Since launch, we've raised over £560m from top-tier investors, helped over 25,000 customers get behind the wheel, and we're scaling fast.

To keep looking after our customers as we grow, we're looking for an empathetic, resilient and customer-focused Collections Agent to help drivers get back on track when their payments fall behind.

Your Mission

You'll be on the front line of our Collections team, talking with customers who have fallen behind on their payments and helping them find a way forward. This is a high-contact role built around the phone, so you'll need to be confident and comfortable talking to people. From the first conversation through to putting an affordable payment plan in place, you'll play a real part in keeping people on the road while making sure they are treated fairly every step of the way.

This is a role for someone who is a great listener, stays calm under pressure, and genuinely wants to help people through a difficult moment. You don't need years of experience, just the right attitude and a real care for getting the customer outcome right.

What You'll Be Doing

Support customers who've fallen behind. Make outbound calls and handle inbound contact with customers in arrears, having honest, empathetic conversations to understand their circumstances.

Find fair solutions. Agree realistic, affordable repayment arrangements that work for the customer and for Carmoola, and follow them through to completion.

Spot and support vulnerability. Recognise when a customer needs extra care, follow our vulnerability process, and escalate where the situation calls for it.

Keep accurate records. Log every interaction clearly and completely so each account has a full, compliant history.

Do right by the customer, every time. Work within FCA guidance and Consumer Duty, treating customers fairly in every conversation.

Contribute to the team's goals. Meet call and collection targets while keeping quality and good customer outcomes front of mind.

Requirements

What You'll Bring

  • A customer-first mindset. You care about doing the right thing by people, especially those going through a hard time.
  • Great communication. You're confident and warm on the phone, a strong listener, and able to hold difficult conversations with empathy.
  • Calm and resilience. You stay composed and professional, even when a call is tough or emotional.
  • Organisation. You keep on top of your workload and record information accurately.
  • Drive and teamwork. You want to hit your targets and support the people around you.
  • No collections experience? No problem. You don't need a background in collections. We'll give you full training and teach you everything you need to know. What matters most is the right attitude and a genuine care for customers.
  • Call centre experience would be great. Time spent in a call centre, or any other phone-based role like customer service or retail, would be a real plus, but it isn't essential.
  • Genuine excitement for Carmoola's mission and the chance to help shape how people get on the road.
  • If you don't tick every box, please apply anyway. We care far more about attitude and potential than a perfect match on paper, and we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

Why Join Carmoola?

💰 Salary range of £30k to £35k, depending on experience

🔎 Yearly performance-based pay reviews

💼 Flexible working: we're open to remote and hybrid options, with a preference for spending some time together each week in our London office in the heart of beautiful Primrose Hill

🏝️ Holidays: 25 days + bank holidays, plus an extra day on your birthday 🥳

🩺 Private healthcare

📈 Pension: 5% employer matched contribution

🚲 Cycle to Work Scheme

🚀 Real exposure to how a fast-scaling lender works, a brilliant place to learn and grow your career

🎉 A fast-paced, fun team that works hard, supports each other, and celebrates the wins

🏋 Join a mega-talented and high performing team

title: Technical Product Manager, AI Storage
description:
Mirantis is looking for a Technical Product Manager to own storage for k0rdent AI, our control plane for GPU infrastructure and distributed AI workloads. In this role, you will define the storage strategy, roadmap, and feature priorities that determine how operators provision, tier, and scale storage across GPU clusters running large-scale training and inference.

GPU cloud storage sits at the intersection of high-performance computing and multi-tenant cloud, and the product must hold both worlds together. You will shape how k0rdent AI reasons about parallel file systems (Lustre, GPFS, BeeGFS, WEKA, VAST, DAOS), S3-compatible object stores for training data and checkpoints, automated tiering between hot NVMe and capacity tiers, and GPUDirect Storage paths that bypass the CPU to feed accelerators at line rate. These layers are typically operated as disconnected silos, with storage admins, platform teams, and ML engineers each owning a slice. Your job is to make them a coherent, declarative product.

You will work directly with engineering to shape requirements, with marketing to sharpen positioning, and with field teams to convert technical depth into wins in competitive GPU cloud and NeoCloud deals.

Impact:

  • Build the storage foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises
  • Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence
  • Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, roadmap, and priorities for k0rdent AI storage, defining how customers design, automate, and operate every aspect of their storage stack, including parallel file systems, object storage, tiering, snapshots, data protection, and more
  • Translate requirements from NeoClouds, GPU clouds, telcos, sovereign clouds, and enterprise platform teams into clear product direction
  • Partner with engineering and architecture to define requirements, evaluate trade-offs, and ship secure, scalable, reliable storage capabilities
  • Manage the storage backlog, using feedback from production deployments and design partners to refine roadmap priorities and positioning
  • Define positioning, packaging, and competitive differentiation for k0rdent AI storage
  • Create field-facing assets, including technical briefs, battlecards, and reference architectures; support strategic accounts as the storage product lead
  • Represent Mirantis at events, analyst briefings, and customer advisory boards; engage storage, silicon, and ecosystem partners on reference architecture alignment

Strong technical fluency in classical storage and the AI stack:

  • 5+ years in product management, technical product management, or a senior technical role owning a storage product, platform, or large-scale storage estate
  • Hands-on familiarity with parallel and distributed file systems (Lustre, GPFS/Spectrum Scale, BeeGFS, WEKA, VAST, DAOS), S3-compatible object storage, and block storage at scale
  • Fluency in Linux storage, Kubernetes storage (CSI, dynamic provisioning, storage classes), software-defined storage, hyperscale or service provider storage, or storage automation
  • Hands-on experience with modern GPU cluster storage, including GPUDirect Storage and RDMA data paths, NVMe-oF, hot/warm/cold tiering for training datasets and checkpoints, and high-throughput ingest pipelines

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry.
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies.
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.
  • Professional development and training.
  • Attend conferences and working groups.
  • Customized workstation (macOS, Windows).
  • A competitive compensation package with strong benefits plan and stock options.

It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com

title: DHL Freight söker: Terminalarbetare behovsanställning

Arbetsuppgifter och ansvar

Vad roligt att du är intresserad av arbete hos oss!

Dina arbetsuppgifter som terminalarbetare innebär att utföra terminalhantering av sändningar såsom lastning, lossning, truckning, scanning och kontroll av gods. Vi strävar alltid efter att förbättra service, produktivitet och processefterlevnad.

Profil & Bakgrund

För att lyckas i den här rollen ser vi att du har:

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
  • Har en truckutbildning enligt TLP10 och minst får köra truck typerna A2-4 & B1
  • Har god datorvana

Nedan kännetecknar dig som person:

  • Är strukturerad och resultatorienterad
  • Brinner för att kollegor och kunder är nöjda
  • Kommunicerar väl och är tydlig samt gillar att jobba i ett team

Återkoppling på ansökan

Vi söker löpande nya stjärnor till våra behovsanställningar. När vi har ett behov så kommer vi att titta på din ansökan och om din bakgrund matchar vad vi söker, så kontaktar vi dig. Vi ber om förståelse för att vi endast kan kontakta de sökande som går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen. Om du inte blir kontaktad för nästa steg i rekryteringsprocessen kommer din ansökan och tillhörande dokument, per automatik, att raderas efter 6 månader. Om du önskar att bli borttagen innan dess ber vi dig kontakta eneda.seferi@dhl.com

Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta Eneda Seferi vid frågor.

Tjänsten är placerad i Borås.

Vad erbjuder vi dig?

Vi på DHL trivs och många av oss har jobbat här länge. Vi är ett företag som ser våra medarbetares utveckling och potential – vi vågar satsa på våra medarbetare! I det stora globala, och internationella bolaget som vi är, har vi en härlig teamkänsla med familjär stämning där vi respekterar varandra. Här finns mycket medarbetarengagemang samt humor och vi tycker om att fira våra framgångar. Vi är certifierade i Top Employer och Great Place to Work vilket innebär att vi är en arbetsgivare som erbjuder den bästa arbetsmiljön för medarbetare att utvecklas både professionellt och personligt. Miljö och hållbarhet är viktigt för oss, vi arbetar ständigt med att utvecklas för att ligga i framkant, vilket uppmärksammas och ger resultat. Vi tar ansvar och blev bland annat utsedda till branschvinnare av Sustainable Brand Index B2B för tredje året i rad.

Vill du också vara med? Varmt välkommen med din spontanansökan!

Häng med oss bakom kulisserna, följ oss på Instagram

Eller kika närmare på DHL - vårt varumärke, DHL Freight - globalt eller DHL Freight Sverige

  • selv opsøge og ringe til kunder med proaktiv rådgivning.

Du har erfaring med rådgivning af kunder og kan hurtigt skabe god kontak
Vi har brug for dig, der:

  • har mindst fem års erfaring fra pension eller bank
  • er god til at forklare komplekse emner på en letforståelig måde
  • har med fordel et eller flere moduler fra Forsikringsakademiet. Alternativt er du motiveret for at starte på skolebænken igen
  • kan leve dig ind i andres situation, er nysgerrig, interesseret og nærværende i samtalen
  • er struktureret og forretningsorienteret, så du kan holde fokus på både kunden og PFA
  • er en man gerne vil samarbejde tæt med i et team, men som sagtens kan løse opgaver selv.

Dit nye team ser frem til at møde dig
I dit nye team er vi 10 formuerådgivere, 2 rådgiverassistenter og 2 studentermedhjælpere. Vi er en del af området Velkomst med 35 medarbejdere fordelt på to teams. Du vil møde et team, der har fokus på samarbejde og kunderne. Vi er resultatorienterede og målrettede, men samtidig har vi fokus på, at det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde. Vi har et åbent og fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle kan føle sig velkomne.

Hvad er det helt særlige, vi kan i PFA?

I PFA er hverdagen noget, vi glæder os til. Vi tror på, at arbejdsglæde og trivsel skaber markante resultater for vores 1,3 mio. kunder og dermed samfundet. Vi gør os umage for at skabe et sted, hvor det både er sjovt og meningsfuldt at gå på arbejde. Her kan du udvikle dig, fagligt og personligt, samtidig med, at du bidrager til noget større.

Vi er nemlig omkring 1.400 kolleger, der hver dag arbejder for, at vores kunder kan leve et godt liv, både nu og i fremtiden. Vi hjælper mennesker gennem hele livet, særligt når det handler om vores kunders økonomiske tryghed, deres sundhed og deres seniorliv. Derfor støtter vi selvfølgelig også dig, og vi tilbyder:

  • Muligheden for at gøre en forskel i Danmarks største pensionsselskab, hvor vi har et højt medarbejderengagement
  • Et inkluderende fællesskab og medarbejderklubber – fra yoga og løbeklub til fredagscaféer
  • Fleksible rammer med mulighed for hjemmearbejde og en arbejdsplads, der prioriterer trivsel og arbejdsglæde
  • Et moderne kontor i hjertet af Nordhavn, tæt på metro, vand og god energi
  • Attraktiv lønpakke med arbejdsgiverbetalt pension og en god sundhedsforsikring og tandforsikring

Du behøver ikke skrive en lang ansøgning – send os blot dit CV
Du behøver ikke sende en ansøgning. Vedhæft blot dit CV og tilføj et par linjer i dit resumé om, hvorfor du er interesseret i jobbet. Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du selvfølgelig velkommen til at kontakte Camilla Lerche Hansen, der er leder af Velkomst II i PFA, på tlf.: 51259522. Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig og senest den 30. August.

title: Clinical Assessor
description:
What we offer

  • Excellent training and ongoing support – be part of our valued team where wellbeing is prioritised.
  • Full or part time hours (minimum 3 days per week).
  • Monday to Friday between 8am to 5pm with no weekend or night shifts (occasional 8pm finishes may be required).
  • £39,500 starting salary, rising to £40,500 after DWP approval.
  • 10% of Salary Bonus scheme (based on quality and performance).
  • Hybrid working – home and clinic based (up to 3 days per week).
  • Watch this short video to find out more

Please note, due to business needs, part-time staff will be required to work on a Friday each week as part of their usual pattern. Also there will be an initial full time (paid) training period of 8 weeks so candidates must be able to commit to that.

Other benefits

  • HCPC/NMC fees paid and full revalidation support.
  • 15 weeks’ full maternity, adoption and shared parental pay.
  • Company pension, life assurance and Cycle2Work scheme.
  • Discounts across retail, travel, technology and wellbeing.
  • Free access to Headspace (for you and up to 5 others).
  • A paid volunteering day each year.
  • Ongoing training, development and clear career pathways.
  • 25 days’ holiday (rising to 27 with service) with the option to buy more up to 5 days.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Conduct functional assessments which include initial reviews, face-to-face, video or telephone assessments to evaluate how a claimant’s health condition or disability affects them for various types of benefit.
  • Analyse and interpret clinical information and supporting evidence.
  • Write detailed evidence-based reports to support the DWP/DfC in making informed and objective decisions - no treatment or diagnosis required.
  • Use IT systems to support clinical decision-making and report writing.
  • Develop your clinical knowledge and constantly learn about health conditions which are less familiar to you.

What are PIP and WCA?

  • Personal Independence Payment (PIP) is a benefit for people with a long-term health condition or impairment. It is paid to make a contribution to the extra costs that disabled people may face, to help them lead full, active and independent lives.
  • Work Capability Assessment (WCA) is a functional assessment that looks at a range of different activities relating to physical, mental, intellectual and cognitive functions, to help DWP determine a customer's capability for work or work-related activity.

About you

  • NMC registered Nurse (RGN, RMN or RNLD) or HCPC registered paramedic, occupational therapist or physiotherapist with a valid PIN and no current restrictions
  • Minimum of one year’s post-registration experience.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to produce clear, accurate and detailed reports.
  • Comfortable working quickly to meet structured targets.
  • Good IT skills including Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn new systems while working remotely.
  • excellent observational and communication skills, giving you the ability to listen, empathise and dig deeper.
  • A driving licence or access to transport for assessment centre working.

Please note: all candidates must hold the right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

About Capita HAAS

We were awarded two contracts to deliver the Health Assessment Advisory Service (HAAS) assessments in the Midlands and Wales for the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP), and in Northern Ireland for the Department for Communities (DfC).

We deliver assessments for a variety of different benefits, including delivering PIP, WCA and Specialist benefit assessments across the Midlands and Wales, and in Northern Ireland.

Security and compliance

Successful candidates will be required to successfully complete government baseline personnel security standard vetting. This is the recognised standard for the pre-employment screening of individuals with access to government asset.

This role is defined as regulated activity relating to children or vulnerable adults within the meaning of the Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups Act 2006 it is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. At vetting, you will undergo an enhanced criminality check which will show both spent and unspent convictions.

What happens next?

Please do complete our short application form and upload your CV. (Please ensure there are no unexplained gaps in your CV).

We’re an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

As a Disability Confident Leader, we are proud to guarantee interviews for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role.

If you have queries, or want to discuss any reasonable adjustments, please contact our friendly recruitment team:

Phone - 02035 970410

Email - haasrecruitment@capita.com

description:

komplekse tekniske løsninger.
