title: Digital Media Planner for Arla inhouse agency The Barn - Viby
description:
Are you the type that can’t help dissect brand campaigns when you meet them on your favorite digital platforms? Do you have the ability to stay ahead in the ever-evolving digital landscape? Are you eager to channel your expertise into crafting media campaigns for brands like Lurpak, Karolines Køkken, and Arla?

Come join us at Arla Foods’ digital in-house agency, The Barn.

So, what’s The Barn?

Our in-house agency – The Barn – was established in 2019 to help our global and local brands win in a world of increasing media complexity. Today, we have strong teams specializing in campaign development, and media strategy. We work interdisciplinary and we are curious, data driven, and result oriented. You’ll be working alongside specialists within strategy, planning, media buying as well as other nice colleagues in creative production, data analysis, tech and creative development.

Here’s the essence of your new job

As a Digital Media Planner you’ll be at the forefront of our digital media campaigns, playing a pivotal role in shaping the presence of our brands. You’ll be largely, but not solely, responsible for planning media campaigns from early briefing to execution, and evaluation. That’s the essence. Then there’s all the non-work-related fun, the fantastic vibes, and being part of a young and ambitious agency.

  • The ball’s in your hand You’ll be the mastermind behind developing data-driven media plans across a range of digital channels, that will drive engagement amongst the target audience
  • Collaborate and work smart Collaborate with brand managers, creatives, media buyers, and strategists to clarify brand objectives, target audiences and translating them into effective media campaigns
  • Present findings Together with our talented media buyers, you will be the one responsible for presenting campaign performance and you’re put on the spot to argue for your beliefs in how a campaign will be even better the next time
  • Inspire and develop Stay ahead of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in digital media planning, and share your knowledge with our team.
  • Partner up Build relationships with internal- and external stakeholders, where you will work closely with creative teams, and our media agency, to ensure consistent brand messaging throughout campaigns.
  • Be on brand Ensure brand guidelines and media best practices is key in the planning process.

Can you tick off the below?

You know how a media agency works from within, and know of the process from briefing, to planning, execution, and evaluation. You have experience with digital media planning from a similar position at an agency or inhouse, and you posses knowledge of digital ad ecosystems as well as META, YouTube, TikTok, and Snapchat.

You thrive in an environment with multiple stakeholders, and love to listen and learn.

You’re equally a motivator and a problem solver who knows the details of a given brands campaigns - while you are keeping stakeholders inspired on the media landscape, and the possibilities that arises. A go-doer, you could say.

As a person we expect you to be, well, first of all nice. Secondly, having excellent communication skills in English (Danish is a plus) and we need you to be comfortable with presentations and close collaboration with key stakeholders across the organization. You know… a people’s person.

What do we offer you?

This is your shot at joining an agency with an entrepreneurial mindset. An agency with full inhouse capabilities covering everything from digital media buying/planning, tech/development, creative, strategy and on-site production.

Our clients are our colleagues. This means we partner up and focus our energy on building the best communications and digital solution for our wonderful range of global and local brands such as Kærgården, Lurpak, Cheasy, Castello, Starbucks, Cocio and obviously Arla.

We are fiercely ambitious, international, and have hired from global hubs like London, New York and Singapore. But, unlike most agencies, we also offer a healthy and sustainable work/life balance and real flexible working. Some say The Barn is one of the best places they’ve ever worked (and even if they had 100 million dollars, they would still work here). Must be the informal atmosphere. Or the people. Or both.

Application and contact

If this sounds like the opportunity you’ve been waiting for, we’d love to hear from you! We process applications on a continuous basis and close the job opening once the right candidate is landed. Please apply with a short CV, and your motivation for joining our team. Don’t spend unnecessary time on crafting an extensive cover letter. We would rather hear from you in person.

For additional information, please reach out to Katrine Buhl (kataf@arlafoods.com). She’s nice too and very helpful.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

title: Centersygeplejerske i Hedensted Kommune
description:
Måske er det tid til næste skridt?

Vil du bruge din sygeplejefaglighed på en ny måde?

Måske er du allerede centersygeplejerske, måske arbejder du på et plejehjem eller i hjemmeplejen – eller måske er du nyuddannet og nysgerrig på, hvad sygeplejen kan bruges til i en anden rolle?

Uanset hvor du kommer fra, kan det være, at du er vores nye centersygeplejerske.

Vi søger en centersygeplejerske til Center Vest i Hedensted Kommune, hvor du får mulighed for at bruge din faglighed bredt og være tæt på både beboere, medarbejdere og den daglige praksis.

Om jobbet og opgaverne

Som centersygeplejerske bliver du en vigtig faglig sparringspartner og får blandt andet mulighed for at arbejde med udvikling, forløbsansvar, triagering og faglig prioritering, kompetenceudvikling, implementering af arbejdsgange og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Du kan enten få primær tilknytning til ét af vores plejehjem eller indgå i en springerfunktion på tværs af vores enheder.

Vores forventninger til dig

Vi ser mennesket – ikke kun opgaven

For os handler god sygepleje om mere end at gøre det fagligt rigtige. Det handler også om at se, lytte til og forstå det menneske, vi står overfor.

Beboerne skal opleve, at deres ønsker, behov og valg bliver taget alvorligt. Selvbestemmelse er derfor en naturlig del af vores måde at arbejde på.

Faglighed og samarbejde går hånd i hånd

Hos os er faglighed og samarbejde lige vigtige. Du er ansat, fordi du har stærke faglige kompetencer, men også fordi du kan indgå konstruktivt i et samarbejde med andre.

Vi tror på, at vores faglighed bliver endnu stærkere, når vi bringer den i spil sammen. Det er tanken bag vores tilgang “Ræk mig lige samarbejdet, tak”.

Vi skal turde række ud, når vi har brug for hjælp, og være nysgerrige på, hvad vores kolleger kan bidrage med. Samtidig har vi respekt for hinandens faglighed, arbejde og de beslutninger, der bliver truffet.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du er uddannet sygeplejerske, og vi håber, at du:

  • brænder for faglighed, udvikling og kvalitet
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar
  • står sikkert i din egen faglighed og samtidig er nysgerrig på andres
  • har respekt for mennesker, fagligheder, hinandens arbejde og den praksis, du bliver en del af
  • kan skabe overblik og bevare roen i en kompleks hverdag
  • ved, hvornår du selv skal handle, og hvornår du skal række ud
  • har lyst til at udvikle både dig selv og andre
  • har lyst til at være tæt på beboerne og lære dem at kende.

Erfaring fra ældreområdet er en fordel, men det vigtigste for os er din faglighed, din nysgerrighed og din lyst til at være en del af fællesskabet.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Det får du hos os

  • En selvstændig og udviklende sygeplejefaglig funktion
  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på den nære sygepleje
  • Fokus på faglig udvikling og kompetenceudvikling
  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på faglighed, samarbejde, ansvar, dialog og udvikling
  • Timetal efter aftale – mulighed for 37 timer i dagvagt
  • Weekendvagt cirka hver 4.-6. weekend
  • Løn og ansættelse efter gældende overenskomst med mulighed for kvalifikations- og funktionsløn.

Frisættelse – med ansvar og plads til at lære

Vi arbejder med frisættelse, fordi vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger opstår, når medarbejdere får mulighed for at bruge deres faglighed, tage ansvar og tænke nyt.

Det hænger tæt sammen med Finn Fajlfri. For vi ved, at hverdagen ikke altid går efter planen – og det skal der være plads til.

Vi ønsker en kultur, hvor vi tør stille spørgsmål, afprøve nye løsninger og sige:

“Det virkede ikke. Hvad kan vi lære af det?”

For os handler det ikke om at være fejlfri, men om at tage ansvar, lære og udvikle os sammen.

Du får mulighed for at skabe læring og faglig refleksion tæt på den daglige praksis – samtidig med at du selv udvikler dine kompetencer.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn og ansættelse efter gældende overenskomst, med mulighed for at forhandle kvalifikations- og funktionsløn.

Har du spørgsmål

Skal vi tage en snak?

Du behøver ikke beslutte dig for et nyt job, bare fordi du ringer til os.

Kom forbi, mød os og få en snak om jobbet. Fortæl os, hvad du brænder for, og hør mere om, hvad vi kan tilbyde.

Teamleder Ann Louise Olivarius på telefon 23 37 63 71/ ann.olivarius@hedensted.dk

Eller

Områdeleder Lotte Ahm Nielsen på telefon 21 77 27 08/ lotte.nielsen@hedensted.dk

Ansøgning

Din ansøgning med relevante bilag skal sendes senest 20. september 2026.

Vi holder 1. samtale den 25. september 2026.

Vi håber, at du kan starte senest den 1. november 2026.

Om os

I Social Omsorg bliver du en del af en Fajlfri kultur. Vi har stavet Fajlfri forkert med vilje, fordi vi ikke forventer, at du er perfekt. title: Lastvognsmekaniker søges til fast aftenhold nær Solrød strand
description:
Virkelig god løn og arbejdsvilkår på værkstedets faste aftenhold og samtidig have gode muligheder for at udvikle dig inden for diagnose, elektronik og ny teknologi

Du får en selvstændig hverdag med dygtige kolleger omkring dig. Der er styr på værktøj, reservedele og arbejdsgange, så du kan koncentrere dig om at levere et godt stykke arbejde.

Om dig

Du er lastvognsmekaniker, måske nyuddannet eller erfaren.

Det vigtigste er, at du:

  • Har styr på mekanisk arbejde og fejlfinding

  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig, også inden for el og ny teknologi

  • Tager ansvar for kvaliteten af dit arbejde

  • Forstår dig på sikkerhed og kan passe på dig selv og kollegerne.

Din hverdag

Du arbejder på et moderne værksted, hvor tingene fungerer.

  • Service, reparation og fejlfinding på lastvogne

  • Opgaverne spænder fra standard til mere specialiserede løsninger

  • Du arbejder både selvstændigt og sammen med kolleger

  • Fokus på kvalitet, tempo og sikkerhed i top.

Det får du

  • Førende lønvilkår

  • Førende muligheder for udvikling og karriere i en organisation, hvor du kan flytte rundt.

  • Moderne værksted med udstyr i topklasse

  • Gode arbejdsforhold i et team der hjælper hinanden, og hvor tingene fungerer i praksis


Praktisk information

Ansættelse: Fast fuldtidsstilling med direkte ansættelse hos virksomheden.

Vil du høre mere?

Du behøver ikke skrive en ansøgning eller have dit CV klar.

Send dit navn og telefonnummer til Glostrup-M@jobteam.dk og skriv “Lastvognaften”, så ringer vi dig op og fortæller mere om jobbet.

Du er også velkommen til at ringe direkte på 21541034

Du må selvfølgelig også gerne vedhæfte dit CV, hvis du ønsker det.

Vi tager samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette.

Stillingen er ikke et vikariat. Rekrutteringen håndteres af os, men du bliver ansat direkte hos virksomheden.


Sådan foregår rekrutteringen

Vi er rekrutteringspartner på stillingen og har til opgave at finde og præsentere relevante kandidater for virksomheden. Som en del af den opgave annoncerer vi jobbet uden virksomhedens navn og står for den indledende dialog med kandidaterne.

I den første del af processen er du som kandidat også anonym. Vi præsenterer dit CV for virksomheden uden navn og personlige oplysninger.

Hvis virksomheden gerne vil møde dig, fortæller vi dig, hvilken virksomhed det drejer sig om.

Herefter bestemmer du selv, om du ønsker at gå videre til en samtale. Først når du har sagt ja, deler vi dit navn og dine kontaktoplysninger med virksomheden.

Er du allerede i job, kan du derfor også undersøge en ny mulighed fortroligt, uden at din identitet bliver delt med virksomheden fra starten.

title: Quantitative Analyst, Structured Products Investment Team
description:
Quant/Developer Analyst for a Discretionary Macro Investment Team focused on Structured Products

A Career with Point72’s Macro Team

Point72’s Global Macro business is a scaled, global investment platform with more than two decades of experience trading across rates, FX, credit, volatility, and emerging markets. Operating across 10 offices worldwide, we have doubled our capital allocation and grown our number of teams fivefold since 2020. We combine deep asset-class expertise with a highly collaborative culture across macro, fundamental equities, and systematic strategies to drive differentiated investment performance and support long-term career growth for our talent.

What you’ll do

  • Help architect and maintain the infrastructure for Structured Products investing.
  • Leverage internal and external partners to help with data infrastructure builds.
  • Integrate alternative and traditional data sets to help streamline our analytic processes.
  • Use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance and optimize processes.
  • Work with risk parameters based on High Yield Equivalent and quantitative processes within market-standard analytics platforms such as Bloomberg.
  • Manage and assist in special projects within the CLO market.

What’s required

  • 3+ years at a sell-side firm in a trading or quantitative research role, or as a quant at a buy-side credit or mortgage-focused fund.
  • Undergraduate degree or higher in computer science, economics, engineering, mathematics, physics, or statistics.
  • Advanced knowledge of a programming language such as Python, C++, or SQL.
  • Advanced skills in Excel and cashflow modeling.
  • Extensive experience with third-party structured credit cashflow engines (e.g., INTEX) and API.
  • Commitment to the highest ethical standards.

We take care of our people

We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide:

  • Fully-paid health care benefits
  • Generous parental and family leave policies
  • Volunteer opportunities
  • Support for employee-led affinity groups representing women, people of color and the LGBT+ community
  • Mental and physical wellness programs
  • Tuition assistance

About point72

Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry’s brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people’s long-term growth. For more information, visit .

title: Senior BI & Reporting Analyst
description:

Manchester (Hybrid, 3 days p/w in the Office)
50,000 - 60,000 + Healthcare + Life Insurance

Are you experienced in building dashboards and reports using data held across different systems? This is an opportunity where you'll work directly with senior stakeholders and help develop reporting capability from the ground up on major utilities programmes.

This position is with a specialist consultancy that helps major infrastructure programmes improve how they manage and report their data. You'll work on a long-term utilities project alongside specialists in planning, risk and reporting, helping develop the dashboards used across the programme as the account grows.

The role is suitable for someone from a BI, reporting or project controls background who is comfortable with both the technical work and speaking with the people who use the reports. You'll have room to shape how the reporting is built, work directly with senior stakeholders and gain exposure working on complex infrastructure projects.

The Role:
*Build and develop dashboards and reports for a major utilities programme using Power BI, Tableau or similar tools
*Bring together cost, schedule, finance and risk data from different enterprise systems
*Design, build and maintain data models supporting complex multi-source reporting
*Improve data quality, governance and reporting consistency across programme reporting
*Automate recurring reports and reduce manual work
*Hybrid based role with 3 days per week in the Manchester office

The Person:
*Experience building dashboards using Power BI, Tableau or a similar BI tool
*Strong data modelling, data structuring and SQL skills
*Experience working with complex data from multiple enterprise systems
*Comfortable gathering requirements and working with senior stakeholders
*Experience in project controls, PMO, programme reporting, infrastructure or utilities would be beneficial

title: Senior Software Engineer – Integrations & API Connectivity
description:

title: Physiotherapist Assessor
description:
As a Physiotherapist Assessor / Functional Specialist at Capita HAAS (Health Assessment Advisory Service) you’ll use your clinical expertise and analytical skills in a different way - to meet with benefits claimants in person or via video link, write in-depth reports and make important clinical recommendations, all while enjoying a more structured and flexible way of working.

What we offer

  • Excellent training and ongoing support – be part of our valued team where wellbeing is prioritised.
  • Full or part time hours (minimum 3 days per week).
  • Monday to Friday between 8am to 5pm with no weekend or night shifts (occasional 8pm finishes may be required).
  • £39,500 starting salary, rising to £40,500 after DWP approval.
  • 10% of Salary Bonus scheme (based on quality and performance).
  • Hybrid working – home and clinic based (up to 3 days per week).
  • Watch this short video to find out more

Please note, due to business needs, part-time staff will be required to work on a Friday each week as part of their usual pattern. Also there will be an initial full time (paid) training period of 8 weeks so candidates must be able to commit to that.

Other benefits

  • HCPC fees paid and full revalidation support.
  • 15 weeks’ full maternity, adoption and shared parental pay.
  • Company pension, life assurance and Cycle2Work scheme.
  • Discounts across retail, travel, technology and wellbeing.
  • Free access to Headspace (for you and up to 5 others).
  • A paid volunteering day each year.
  • Ongoing training, development and clear career pathways.
  • 25 days’ holiday (rising to 27 with service) with the option to buy more up to 5 days.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Conduct functional assessments which include initial reviews, face-to-face, video or telephone assessments to evaluate how a claimant’s health condition or disability affects them for various types of benefit.
  • Analyse and interpret clinical information and supporting evidence.
  • Write detailed evidence-based reports to support the DWP/DfC in making informed and objective decisions - no treatment or diagnosis required.
  • Use IT systems to support clinical decision-making and report writing.
  • Develop your clinical knowledge and constantly learn about health conditions which are less familiar to you.

What are PIP and WCA?

  • Personal Independence Payment (PIP) is a benefit for people with a long-term health condition or impairment. It is paid to make a contribution to the extra costs that disabled people may face, to help them lead full, active and independent lives.
  • Work Capability Assessment (WCA) is a functional assessment that looks at a range of different activities relating to physical, mental, intellectual and cognitive functions, to help DWP determine a customer's capability for work or work-related activity.

About you

  • HCPC registered Physiotherapist with a valid PIN and no current restrictions.
  • Minimum of one year’s post-registration experience.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to produce clear, accurate and detailed reports.
  • Comfortable working quickly to meet structured targets.
  • Good IT skills including Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn new systems while working remotely.
  • excellent observational and communication skills, giving you the ability to listen, empathise and dig deeper.
  • A driving licence or access to transport for assessment centre working.

Please note: all candidates must hold the right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

About Capita HAAS

We were awarded two contracts to deliver the Health Assessment Advisory Service (HAAS) assessments in the Midlands and Wales for the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP), and in Northern Ireland for the Department for Communities (DfC).

We deliver assessments for a variety of different benefits, including delivering PIP, WCA and Specialist benefit assessments across the Midlands and Wales, and in Northern Ireland.

Security and compliance

Successful candidates will be required to successfully complete government baseline personnel security standard vetting. This is the recognised standard for the pre-employment screening of individuals with access to government asset.

This role is defined as regulated activity relating to children or vulnerable adults within the meaning of the Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups Act 2006 it is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. At vetting, you will undergo an enhanced criminality check which will show both spent and unspent convictions.

What happens next?

We’re an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

As a Disability Confident Leader, we are proud to guarantee interviews for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role.

description:
PCB Component Engineering Technical Leader

  • Contribute to the development of PCB commodity strategy.
  • Participate in the supplier selection process. Assess and qualify PCB suppliers. Take part in technical and process audits of suppliers as needed.
  • Lead PCB failure analysis and drive containment, corrective actions, and risk assessment.
  • Work closely with manufacturing and engineering teams to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across the organization. Effectively communicate complex technical concepts and solutions.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Possess Engineering/Chemistry/Material degree or equivalent, plus 15+ years PCB manufacturing experience
  • Solid understanding and direct experience in SLP (substrate like PCB), advanced-HDI PCB, mSAP process (modified semi-additive process) design specifications and requirements, qualification, manufacturing fabrication and test.
  • Competency in failure analysis techniques such as FMEA, 8D/Corrective Action, Fishbone IFD, Cause and Effect Analysis, Design of Experiments (DOE), and risk assessment.
  • Experienced in managing supplier relationships and implementing corrective actions and rigorous quality control measures to ensure product standards and reliability are consistently met.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong problem solving and conflict resolution skills along with customer focus, decision-making, influencing and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Familiarity of PCB materials (laminates and resins), Signal Integrity, reliability knowledge, and experience.
  • Lead multiple technical projects and manage day-to-day work while also focusing on long term goals

Why Cisco

We connect everything – people, process, data and things – and we use those connections to change our world for the better.

Colorful hair? Don’t care. Tattoos? Show off your ink. Like polka dots? That’s cool. Pop culture geek? Many of us are. Be you, with us! #WeAreCisco

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Butikschef i Netto - Terndrup
description:
Butikschef med styr på tingene

Hvad slår en dygtig butikschef, der bare har styr på tingene, når man har brug for det? Ikke ret meget, hvis du spørger os. Og hvis du er enig, så er denne stilling måske noget for dig.

Som butikschef sætter du ikke blot dit eget præg på din helt egen butik – du har også ansvaret for en masse dygtige medarbejdere. Og her taler vi altså sjove, dedikerede typer, som du selv rekrutterer, udvikler og motiverer. Det er nemlig sådan, du sikrer, at vores kunder altid får en god oplevelse i din butik.

Derudover har du et lederteam, som du løbende sparrer med og uddelegerer lederopgaver til, så det hele ikke ligger på dine skuldre. I Netto løfter vi nemlig alle i flok.

I din indarbejdning får du en grundig og struktureret introduktion til rollen som butikschef. Og du får først ansvaret for din egen butik, når du er klar. Du bliver blandt andet klædt på ved hjælp af videooplæring, ledertræning og en erfaren mentor.

Helt kort så skal du

  • udøve god ledelse, gå forrest ude i butikken og være et godt eksempel for dine kolleger
  • håndtere administrative opgaver fx vagtplaner og varebestilling
  • rekruttere og oplære nye medarbejdere og udvikle dine ansatte, så de er klar til næste skridt
  • opgive status og rapportere til distriktschefen
  • have styr på det med salgsresultaterne
  • være rollemodel for Nettos værdisæt og medarbejderoplevelse, vi kalder det NEX: Netto Employee Experience

**Alle de gode grunde
**Stillingen er en super mulighed for at være med i et dagligvareeventyr. Du bliver chef for mellem 20 og 40 medarbejdere og en del af en stærk kultur præget af god energi, engagement og Netto-ånd. Vi har fokus på din personlige udvikling som leder. Du kan også glæde dig til

  • en målrettet lederuddannelse
  • multimediapakke
  • konkurrencedygtig løn, pension og bonusordning
  • sundhedsforsikring
  • masser af gode personaleordninger fx rabatter i Bilka, føtex, Netto, Carl’s Jr. og Starbucks og leje af vores feriehuse og lejligheder i ind- og udland

**Leder- og livserfaring
**Som butikschef er det vigtigt, at du først og fremmest er et ordentligt menneske, der spreder trivsel og glæde omkring dig. Og så er det også essentielt, at du har erfaring med at lede mennesker. Mere præcist så forestiller vi os, at du

  • har erfaring som butiks- eller souschef eller en anden relevant lederbaggrund
  • kender til rutinerne i en moderne detailforretning
  • er åben over for Nettos ledermentalitet om at skabe resultater gennem høj medarbejdertrivsel

**Butikschef – blot en begyndelse?
**Hvis du på sigt ønsker at udvikle dig og have endnu mere ansvar, så er Netto det rette sted. Vi giver dig nemlig gode muligheder for at gøre karriere, og vi har mange års erfaring i at forme fremtidens ledere.

Netto er en del af Danmarks førende retail-koncern, så det kan være, du på sigt ønsker en stilling hos føtex, Bilka eller på hovedkontoret – eller du kan sigte imod en international karriere.

**Godt nyt med Netto 3.0
**Der blæser nye vinde i Nettos flag, og vi er i gang med at modernisere vores butikker i hele landet. I det nye 3.0-koncept har vi gjort alt fra interiør til uniformer mere lækkert. Det er en spændende udvikling, og vi er med til atdefinere fremtidens discountbutikker. Du er som butikschef afgørende for vores succes.

**Er du vores nye kollega?
**Send din ansøgning til os via knappen nedenfor. Vi inviterer løbende til samtale, så søg allerede i dag.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Netto – vi bærer vores logo med stolthed

Du kender måske allerede Netto som Danmarks største dagligvarekæde – men vidste du også, at vores medarbejdere er rigtig glade for at arbejde her?

Du bliver nemlig del af et helt specielt sammenhold med masser af opbakning, og hvor vi alle løfter i flok. For det vi laver er vigtigt, men dem, vi laver det med, er endnu vigtigere.

Vi håber, du er lige så begejstret for dyrevelfærd, reduktion af madspild og en bæredygtig fremtid, som vi er. Vi har bl.a. vores eget økologiske brand: ØGO. Og det er naturligvis til gode Netto-priser.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:

title: To hjertevarme og relations stærke pædagoger til vuggestue
description:
Om stillingen/arbejdspladsen

Fast stilling på 30 timer ugentligt i Sandgården og mulighed for 7 timer et andet sted i dagtilbuddet fra d. 1. november 2026.

Fast stilling på 32 timer ugentligt og med mulighed for 5 timer et andet sted i dagtilbuddet fra d. 1. oktober 2026.

Forestil dig en hverdag fyldt med små skridt, store øjeblikke og nysgerrige blikke. En hverdag, hvor du får lov til at være den trygge voksne, som hjælper børn med at tage deres første skridt ind i fællesskabet, sproget og verden omkring dem.

I Daginstitutionen Sandgården søger vi to uddannede pædagoger til vores vuggestue. Vi leder efter dig, der ser noget helt særligt i de yngste børns udvikling, og som brænder for at skabe nærværende, inspirerende og udviklende læringsmiljøer for børn i alderen 0-2 år.

Hos os bliver du en del af en stor integreret institution med engagerede kollegaer og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab. Vores pædagogiske fundament bygger på ICDP og et anerkendende børnesyn, hvor relationen til barnet er udgangspunktet for alt det, vi gør. Vi tror på, at børn udvikler sig bedst, når de mødes af voksne, der er nærværende, nysgerrige og oprigtigt interesserede i deres perspektiver. Derfor arbejder vi hver dag målrettet med at skabe stærke relationer, trygge fællesskaber og deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn.

I disse år har vi et særligt fokus på sprogudvikling. Sammen med Sprog & Integration og Sofiendalsskolen indgår vi i et spændende udviklingsprojekt om sproglige overgange, og i hverdagen arbejder vi systematisk med at styrke børnenes ordforråd og sprogforståelse. Vi bruger blandt andet tematiske forløb, litteratur og babytegn som en naturlig del af den pædagogiske praksis.

Vi er samtidig optaget af at skabe inspirerende læringsmiljøer, både inde og ude. Du vil få mulighed for at sætte dit præg på aktiviteter, lege og læringsrum, der understøtter børnenes trivsel, læring, udvikling og dannelse. Hos os er pædagogen ikke blot rammesætter, men en aktiv deltager i børnenes leg og fællesskaber. Vi tror på, at nærværende voksne skaber de bedste betingelser for børns udvikling.

I vuggestuen er vi optaget af at skabe genkendelighed for børnene via faste rutiner understøttet af piktogrammer. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du har et solidt overblik over dagens rutiner, og at du kan organisere dagen for børnene ved hjælp af piktogramtavlen. Hverdagen som pædagog i vuggestuen er præget af at arbejde i små læringsgrupper, hvor der er nærvær og tryghed for den enkelte. Det betyder, at du skal kunne tilrettelægge aktiviteter eller leg, som både er tryghedsskabende, og som du selv er deltagende i og igangsætter af, ligesom du skal kunne favne det større fællesskab på stuen. Vi holder samlinger med børnene og her vil en af dine pædagogiske opgaver være at tilrettelægge og afholde samlinger, som fanger børnenes opmærksomhed, og som er udviklende for børnefællesskabet på stuen.

Vi håber at møde en kollega, som møder børn, forældre og samarbejdspartnere med varme, energi og faglig nysgerrighed. En pædagog, der kan skabe struktur og overblik i hverdagen, men som samtidig tør tænke nyt, tage initiativ og bidrage til vores fælles udvikling. Du har erfaring med eller interesse for vuggestueområdet, ser værdien i inkluderende fællesskaber og motiveres af at omsætte refleksion til handling.

Til gengæld bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor trivsel, samarbejde og faglig udvikling prioriteres højt. Du møder engagerede kollegaer, som hjælper hinanden, deler erfaringer og ser både succeser og fejl som muligheder for læring. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab, og vi værdsætter medarbejdere, der har lyst til at bidrage med deres idéer, erfaringer og perspektiver.

Hvis du drømmer om en hverdag, hvor du gør en forskel for de yngste børn, hvor relationer er omdrejningspunktet, og hvor faglig udvikling går hånd i hånd med arbejdsglæde, så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Vi søger to uddannede pædagoger med tiltrædelse henholdsvis den 1. oktober 2026 og den 1. november 2026.

Kom og vær med til at skabe de første, vigtige kapitler i børnenes livshistorie. ✨


Arbejdsstedets adresse

Daginstitutionen Sandgården
Anna Anchers vej 7

9200 Aalborg SV


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem KL og BUPL.
Forud for endelig ansættelse indhentes der straffe- og børneattest samt reference.



Send ansøgning

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Søg jobbet" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.


Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på muligheder
Hos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.
Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

title: Mattel Retail Team Associate - Hartford, CT 06109
description:
The Opportunity: As a Seasonal Team Associate, you’ll partner with a Mattel Retail Services Representative to grow Mattel’s presence at major retailers, working a minimum of 15 hours per week during our busiest holiday season. We are looking for enthusiastic temporary team members who are passionate about merchandising, enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, and want to drive results and make magic happen this holiday season! This job can open the door to future merchandising career opportunities with Mattel.

What Your Impact Will Be:

  • Brand ambassador of Mattel/Fisher-Price brands and products
  • Collaborate with your lead Mattel Representative to secure prime product placements for Mattel’s iconic brands
  • Partner with lead Mattel Representative on monthly scheduling
  • Unpack cases of various Mattel toys
  • Merchandise and organize product on the sales floor
  • Construct & deconstruct store fixtures including shelving and racking
  • Implement point of purchase materials
  • Execute special projects as assigned including, but not limited to store events
  • Administrative tasks including but not limited to managing time entry, attending meetings, trainings, checking email etc.

What We’re Looking For:

Basic Job Qualifications:

  • Must be at least 18 years old
  • High school diploma or GED
  • Preferred work hours are during the weekday during daytime hours; occasional weekends
  • Must be available to work a minimum of 15 hours per week
  • Preferred device requirement – Up to date smartphone and/or computer with Chrome Browser to access for time worked entries, email and Workday. Other browsers (e.g. DuckDuckGo) are not supported. A mobile phone is required for multi-factor authentication to receive SMS(text) or voice call.
  • Must have access to reliable internet
  • Must have reliable transportation to travel to and between assigned store locations (gas mileage reimbursement per company policy)
  • Reside within approximately 20 miles of the assigned territory/store cluster or otherwise able to reliably service the assigned territory

Physical Requirements:

  • Stand, bend, twist, squat, kneel, reach
  • Walk for long periods of time
  • Climb ladders up to 12’ tall
  • Lift up to 25 pounds frequently, 50 pounds occasionally
  • Push/pull carts containing product - occasionally up to 100 lbs
  • Operate power tools (screwdriver & drill)

About You:

  • Merchandising, retail or customer service experience (preferred, but not required)
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ensure tasks are completed efficiently with a strong sense of urgency
  • Represent the brand with professionalism and a positive attitude
  • Bring a flexible, adaptable mindset and enjoy collaborating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Eagerness to learn new skills with a safety-first mentality
  • Tech-savvy (smartphone, apps)

Ready to make an impact this holiday season? Apply today!

The hourly rate for this position is $18.50.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

How We Work:
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

  • We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
  • We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
  • We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

title: Overlæge - neuroradiologi i Billeddiagnostisk Afdeling på Nordsjællands Hospital/Holbæk Sygehus
description:
Er du vores nye neuroradiolog i Billeddiagnostisk Afdeling på Nordsjællands Hospital / Holbæk Sygehus?

Vi søger en overlæge til vores neuroradiologiske team med tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

Hvis du drømmer om god trivsel, fantastiske kolleger, et omsorgsfuldt fællesskab, et stærkt fagligt miljø, masser af humor, højt til loftet og gode muligheder for medindflydelse og personlig udvikling – og er du med på selv at byde aktivt ind - så send os en ansøgning.



Hvem er vi?

Det neuroradiologiske team på Billeddiagnostisk Afdeling er kendetegnet ved høj faglighed, nysgerrighed, fleksibilitet og samarbejdsvilje. Teamet har et tæt samarbejde med adskillige afdelinger, hvoriblandt kan nævnes hospitalets store neurologiske afdeling, børneafdelingen og akutafdelingen. Som neuroradiolog på NOH, vil man naturligt også have en bred samarbejdsflade med kollegerne i Klinisk Fysiologi og Nuklearmedicin, da dette speciale er en del af Billeddiagnostisk afdeling. Endvidere kan du forvente at komme til at arbejde med primær udredning inden for hele det neuroradiologiske område, da hospitalet også har en stor ØNH-afdeling, onkologi og infektionsmedicin. Pr. 1. september 2026 varetager Nordsjællands Hospital radiologien for Holbæk og de tilhørende matrikler, så sammen med dine kolleger vil du blive en del af denne funktion med fysisk fremmøde på Holbæk et antal dage pr. måned efter nærmere aftale med dig.

Afdelingen har en stærk profil på det sociale område og arbejder med en høj grad af opgave-uddelegering. Vi har meget tydeligt fokus på det gode og respektfulde samarbejde og prioriterer det sociale fællesskab højt.

Nordsjællands Hospital er et stort akuthospital, har 70.000 indlæggelsesforløb og cirka 130.000 akutte forløb årligt og betjener et optageområde på 320.000 borgere. Stort set alle specialer er repræsenteret på hospitalet.



Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger en dygtig neuroradiologisk speciallæge-kollega. Relevant videreuddannelse indenfor f.x. ØNH-området eller børneneuroradiologien er en fordel men ikke et krav. Det, du ikke kan, når du kommer hos os, kan du helt sikkert lære. Samtidig ønsker vi at understøtte visionerne i Sundhedsreformen om, at fremtidens speciallæger både har brede generalistkompetencer og specialiserede kompetencer. Vi søger derfor dig, der brænder for neuroradiologi og vil bruge hovedparten af tiden i dette subspeciale, men som også har kompetencer i den brede thoracoabdominale radiologi og kan passe en vagt.

Neuroradiologisk team arbejder med en høj grad af selvledelse, så du må være komfortabel med den arbejdsform.

Afdelingen har en stor gruppe introduktionslæger og kursister på forskellige niveauer, som på skift har ophold i det neuroradiologiske team. Derfor er det vigtigt at du er interesseret i at supervisere og hjælpe dem til at blive dygtige nye speciallæger og gode samarbejdspartnere.



Hvad får du hos os?

  • Et fagligt inspirerende arbejdsliv i et godt socialt miljø på et visionært og udviklingsorienteret akuthospital med stærkt fokus på det gode patientforløb.
  • Fleksibilitet i arbejdstilrettelæggelsen. Vi prøver altid at strække os langt for at tilgodese individuelle hensyn.
  • Mulighed for at prøve kræfter med innovations- eller udviklingsaktiviteter – f.x. AI.
  • En afdeling med højt til loftet, flad ledelsesstruktur og rigtig god mulighed for medindflydelse – ikke mindst på planlægningen af det nye hospital, som vi forventer at flytte ud til i løbet af 2027.
Stillingen er vagtbærende, og man indgår desuden i eftermiddagsfunktionen, hvor man nogle gange om måneden arbejder til klokken 17.00. Vagten kan afholdes hjemmefra, hvis man ønsker det, ligesom der er gode muligheder for hjemmearbejde. Teleradiologien overtager vagten alle dage 22.00 – 07.30 bortset fra juleaften og nytårsaften, hvor de overtager klokken 20.00.



Send din ansøgning elektronisk senest 18. september 2026. Der afholdes samtaler ultimo september.



Ansøgningen skal ledsages af CV, der forholder sig til de 7 lægeroller, eventuel publikationsliste, dokumentation for selvstændigt virke og bevis for speciallægeanerkendelse.

Løn - og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og principperne om Ny Løn. Ansættelse som overlæge forudsætter, at der kan opnås en tilfredsstillende overlægevurdering iht. regionens regler.



Hvis du vil vide mere inden du føler dig helt klar til at sende din ansøgning så tag endelig fat i en af os:

Områdeansvarlig overlæge Camilla Schwartz på telefon 48 29 32 55/ camilla.schwartz@regionh.dk

Cheflæge Mette Marklund på telefon 61 71 15 22 / mette-charlotte.marklund@regionh.dk

Vi glæder os meget til at høre fra dig!

title: Sommerjobb 2027 - Design
description:
Vil du tilbringe neste sommer på en av Norges beste arbeidsplasser?

En sommer som gir deg et innblikk i konsulentverdenen, prosjektarbeid, nytt nettverk, samt mye sosialt og moro rundt sammen med en fantastisk gjeng. Høres det interessant ut?

Hver sommer ansetter vi studenter som får jobbe hos oss i en 6 ukers periode, i våre lokaler på toppen av Posthuset i Oslo eller hos noen av våre kunder. Du får en unik mulighet til å bli kjent med Sopra Steria EGGS som selskap og knytte langsiktige kontakter.

Innen design får du jobbe tverrfaglig med andre studenter innen meningsfylte prosjekter.

I løpet av sommeren hos oss vil du:

  • Få teste ut hvordan det er å jobbe som konsulent

  • Jobbe i team med andre sommerstudenter på reelle prosjekter

  • Bli kjent og lære sammen med erfarne Sopra Steria-konsulenter

  • Tilegne deg masse ny kunnskap gjennom prosjektarbeid og fagsamlinger

  • Få god oppfølging fra veileder og våre designere

  • Delta på sosiale aktiviteter og bygge et verdifullt nettverk

Hos oss kan du på sikt jobbe som konsulent innenfor en rekke forskjellige fagområder som du kan lese mer om her. Mulighetene er mange da vi dekker hele verdikjeden i prosjekter relatert til digitalisering, innovasjon og bærekraft.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er på ditt 4. studieår

  • Studerer noe knyttet til design, UX, tjenestedesign eller lignende

  • Tenker at det vi kan tilby, matcher dine ønsker for en sommerjobb

  • Er nysgjerrig på og motivert for å teste ut konsulentlivet

  • Har karakterer som gjør deg og de rundt deg stolte

  • Er opptatt av at design skaper en bedre hverdag for ekte mennesker der ute

Vi tror at du vil oppleve mestring og ha det gøy som konsulent hos oss gjennom sommeren dersom du anser deg selv som en god samarbeidspartner og relasjonsbygger. I tillegg tror vi det er en fordel å like struktur og orden, være målbevisst, profesjonell og kundeorientert.

Er du interessert, send oss en søknad hvor du begrunner hvorfor du kan tenke deg en sommerjobb hos oss i Sopra Steria og spesifiserer hvilke fagområde(r) du er interessert i. Husk å legge ved karakterutskrifter fra hele studieløpet, inkludert VGS-karakterer og portefølje når du sender inn søknad. Søknader uten karakterer eller portefølje vedlagt vil ikke bli vurdert.

Sommerjobbperioden i 2027 begynner 21.06.2027 og varer i seks uker.

I Sopra Steria benytter vi asynkrone videointervjuer som en del av vår rekrutteringsprosess av sommerstudenter. Mer informasjon om rekrutteringsprosessen finner du ved å trykke “søk her”.

Hørtes dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi at du vil sende oss din CV, portefølje og foreløpig karakterutskrift/vitnemål. Husk å legge ved karakterutskrifter fra hele studieløpet frem til nå, inkludert VGS-karakterer. Vi ber ikke om søknadsbrev, men ønsker at du svarer på noen spørsmål som en del av søknaden. Søknader vurderes fortløpende.

Sopra Steria har kunder og prosjekter som kan kreve sikkerhetsklarering på ulike nivåer.

Søknadsfrist: 1. oktober 2026

Vi er Norges ledende konsulentselskap innen digitalisering, innovasjon og bærekraft. I Sopra Steria bistår vi våre kunder innen privat og offentlig sektor med å bli fremtidens virksomheter. I en årrekke har vi vært rangert som en av Norges beste arbeidsplasser. Du finner oss i Oslo, Stavanger, Trondheim, Bergen, Drammen, Hamar, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand og Tromsø.

title: AI Automation Lead F/M/X
description:
Job Description:

ROYAL CANIN ’s MISSION IS TO TRANSFORM EACH CAT AND DOGS HEALTH AND WELL-BEING BY PUSHING THE LIMITS OF NUTRITION AND KNOWLEDGE IN PARTNERSHIP WITH PET PROFESSIONALS.

Driven by our strategic vision to serve 35 million pets and generate $10b NSV by 2030, Royal Canin (RC) stands as a frontrunner in the Pet Nutrition industry. Fueled by our dedication to provide unparalleled experiences for both our customers and associates, we initiated the EOS program in 2023. This initiative blends transformative strategies with extensive digitization efforts, across Supply Chain, Finance, and Sales domains, positioning us at the forefront of industry evolution.

Having proven AI's potential through several successful pilots, we are now structured to scale these initiatives and expand their impact.

The AI & Automation Lead provides the program with hands-on engineering capacity, driving a dual focus: on one hand, identifying and implementing internal AI and automation opportunities (test automation, process automation, and AI-enabled efficiencies) to increase productivity; on the other hand, supporting the building of customer-facing use cases to increase business value. This role exists to turn good ideas into adopted, measurable improvements rather than one-off experiments, so the team can deliver more, faster with greater reliability and we create value for our customers.

What will be your Key Responsibilities?

  • Support the development of business cases that enhance the customer experience and ensure value tracking
  • Opportunity identification: Continuously scan the team's ways of working (testing, release management, reporting, recurring manual tasks) to identify automation and AI opportunities, and build business cases (effort saved, risk reduced) for the most promising ones.
  • Test automation: Design, build and maintain automated test suites to increase regression coverage and reduce manual effort ahead of each Run and major release.
  • Process automation: Automate repetitive internal processes (status reporting, environment refreshes, backlog hygiene, documentation) through scripting, low-code automation platforms, freeing the team to focus on higher-value work.
  • AI-enabled efficiencies: Pilot and operationalize generative-AI and agentic tools to accelerate internal tasks such as documentation, code/config generation, meeting summarization and knowledge search — within the Responsible AI guardrails.
  • Reusable assets: Package successful automations and prompts as documented, reusable components in the asset library, so they can be replicated across streams and markets rather than rebuilt each time.
  • Value tracking: Define and track success metrics (time saved, error reduction, adoption, business value) for every automation delivered, and report progress.
  • Community & enablement: Act as an automation champion within the program's "AI movement," sharing practical learnings and quick wins through trainings, the newsletter and demos to grow internal AI and automation literacy.

Context and Scope :

  • The role works transversally across streams— its scope is the team's internal ways of working first, and customer- or associate-facing use cases in the future.
  • It operates in close collaboration with the Project Managers and PMO, the streams' Lead and Product Owners and Business Process Owners, the Test Ambassadors community, and the Factory where relevant, to ensure automations fit smoothly into existing delivery and release processes.
  • The role requires comfort working hands-on across Salesforce, scripting and AI tools, and the judgment to apply guardrails proportionate to the risk of each automation, even for internal-only use cases.
  • As the team moves from isolated pilots to a structured practice, the analyst will help shape the standards, templates and reusable assets that make future automation work faster for everyone.

What are we looking for?

  • Master’s degree in IT, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in test automation, process/RPA automation or a related quality/engineering role, ideally within a Salesforce or broader SaaS delivery environment.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation tooling, plus basic scripting skills (e.g. Python, JavaScript) for custom automations and integrations.
  • Working knowledge of generative AI and agentic tools (e.g. Copilot-type assistants, Claude, Agentforce, OpenAI-style APIs) and a genuine interest in applying them to everyday productivity problems
  • Familiarity with low-code automation/RPA platforms is a plus.
  • A process-mapping mindset: able to break down a manual task, spot the automatable steps, and judge the effort/value trade-off without over-engineering the solution.
  • Comfortable working in an Agile delivery environment, with the discipline to document, test and hand over automations so they remain maintainable by others.
  • Strong communication skills to explain technical automations simply, build trust with non-technical stakeholders, and turn quick wins into visible team-wide adoption.
  • A pragmatic, curious, improvement-driven mindset — energized by experimenting, measuring impact and scaling what works.

title: Produktionskoordinator til delikatessen - Fredericia
description:
Produktionskoordinator til delikatessen

Har du sans for god kvalitet og lyst til at tage ansvar? Som produktionskoordinator i føtex delikatesse bliver du en nøglespiller i at skabe indbydende, friske og velduftende specialiteter til vores kvalitetsbevidste kunder. Sammen med slagtermesteren sikrer du, at delikatessen leverer lækre retter – hver eneste dag!

føtex som arbejdsplads og karrierevej

Hos føtex får du mere end bare et job – du får en karrierevej. Uanset dit niveau har du mulighed for at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt. Vi tror på, at tilfredse og dygtige medarbejdere er nøglen til glade kunder. Derfor tilbyder vi dig en arbejdsplads, hvor du kan forfølge dine ambitioner – ikke kun i føtex, men på tværs af hele koncernen.

Velkommen til delikatessen – vi laver mad fra bunden

I delikatessen arbejder vi med et stort udvalg af kvalitetsprodukter, herunder kød, fisk, mejerivarer og friskbagt brød fra vores eget bageri. Vi tilbyder alt fra specialiteter direkte fra disken til store convenience-løsninger. Derudover leverer vi anretninger ud af huset, som fx buffeter, tapas, smørrebrød og festmiddage. Her får du mulighed for at arbejde med friske råvarer og skabe madoplevelser, der giver kunderne lyst til at komme igen.

Skab velsmagende oplevelser i et fantastisk fællesskab

Som produktionskoordinator er du bindeled mellem delikatessen og slagtermesteren. Du spiller en central rolle i at skabe gejst og engagement i afdelingen, hvor du støtter dine kolleger i at levere deres bedste gennem samarbejde og faglig udvikling.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Planlægge og deltage i tilberedningen af vores mange måltidsløsninger.
  • Betjene kunder og levere en serviceoplevelse, der får dem til at komme igen.
  • Sikre kvaliteten af vores produkter og overholde hygiejnestandarder.
  • Sikre den rette bemanding og bidrage til, at afdelingen når sine mål.

**Her er muligheder for dig, der kan og vil
**Vi tror på, at alle har en leder i maven. Uanset om du skal lede dig selv, dit team eller en hel afdeling, klæder vi dig på til opgaven. Du får daglig sparring fra din leder og mulighed for at deltage i interne kurser, der styrker dine kompetencer. Vi ved, at dygtige medarbejdere skaber en god arbejdsplads med glade kolleger og tilfredse kunder.

**Hvem er du?
**Vi er ikke så optagede af dine eksamensbeviser – vi er mere interesserede i dig som person og det drive, du bringer med dig. Vi forventer dog, at du har erfaring fra en lignende stilling, og vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Trives i et travlt miljø med korte deadlines og uforudsigelige opgaver.
  • Tør gå forrest og være en synlig og motiverende leder.
  • Er dygtig til at planlægge og strukturere din arbejdsdag, så du er klar til det uventede.

**Klar til at tage næste skridt?
**Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt via linket her på siden. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Specjalista / Specjalistka ds. Operacji Magazynowych 15757-15759
description:

title: Administration Officer - Technical Operations
description:

Performs and supervises a wide range of administrative activities or services function including but not limited to office administration, maintain departmental trackers, dashboards, manpower records, and operational reports to provide accurate performance visibility and management oversight. Consolidate information across shifts and teams, monitor delays, findings, and outstanding actions, and ensure timely follow-up, escalation, and reporting to management.

  • Prepares both routine and non-routine reports

  • Liaises with internal and external customers and stakeholders to ensure proper support and business engagement on different activities.
  • Leads a small team of admin level staff
  • Handles more varied and volume work activities usually involving
  • Usually has more frequent internal and external interactions

Education & Experience

  • High school plus 3 years work experience or a Bachelor degree with 1 year of relevant experience required.

3. Documentation, Process Improvement & Stakeholder Communication

  • Maintain and update manuals, SOPs, work instructions, and administrative procedures while supporting periodic reviews and documentation governance.
  • Identify and implement improvements to processes, systems, tracking, and reporting, while facilitating effective communication and collaboration across operational teams and support departments.

title: Studentermedarbejder med interesse for natur, politik og friluftsliv
description:
Friluftsrådet søger en dygtig og engageret studentermedhjælper med interesse for natur, politik og friluftsliv.

Som studentermedarbejder hos Friluftsrådet får du en central rolle i arbejdet med lokale natursager og politiske spørgsmål. Du kommer bl.a. til at udarbejde korte politiske baggrundspapirer og hjælpe vores 23 lokale friluftsråd med at navigere i sager om natur og adgang til naturen.

Friluftsrådet er en paraplyorganisation for friluftslivet, og vi varetager friluftspolitiske interesser på både nationalt og lokalt niveau. Hver dag får vores lokale friluftsråd henvendelser, som de skal forholde sig til, og de har brug for assistance til blandt andet at sortere i indkommende myndighedsafgørelser og få skabt et overblik over, hvilke typer af sager der sendes fra kommuner, styrelser og nævn til de lokale friluftsråd.

Du vil skulle bistå de politiske konsulenter med sagsbehandling og opgaveløsning knyttet til det lokalpolitiske arbejde, fx er der jævnligt behov for at udarbejde baggrundspapirer, der kort og præcist beskriver en speciel type sag, lovgivning eller projekt – det kunne være i relation til Grøn trepart, fredningssager, klager til nævn mv.

Derudover har vi brug for hjælp til drift af projekt ”Gå nye veje”, som handler om barrierer for adgang til naturen.

Vi søger dig som:

  • Studerer på en relevant uddannelse (fx naturforvaltning, naturressourcer, geografi, landskabsarkitektur, skov- og landskabsingeniør, statskundskab). Det er en fordel, hvis du har været i gang med studiet et stykke tid –eventuelt i slutningen af din bachelor eller starten af din kandidat.

  • Interesserer dig for friluftsliv og naturforvaltning samt i at arbejde med frivillige.

  • Har interesse for og gerne kendskab til lovgivningen inden for natur- og miljøområdet.

  • Har kendskab til og erfaring med GIS-værktøjer.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage initiativ.

  • Har mulighed for at møde ind på kontoret i Sydhavnen ca. 15 timer om ugen.

Det vi tilbyder dig

Du vil indgå i et team bestående af flere politiske konsulenter, der har det overordnede ansvar for kontakten til de lokale frivillige.

Vi tilbyder en meningsfuld og dynamisk arbejdsplads i København nær Sydhavn station. Arbejdsstedet er på Friluftsrådets kontor i Scandiagade 13, 2450 København. Vi er omkring 30 fuldtidsansatte og 5 studentermedhjælpere, der arbejder med naturdannelse, friluftsliv, øget adgang til naturen og formidling af natur og friluftsliv til børn og unge. Friluftsrådet arbejder for at skabe bedre naturoplevelser gennem friluftslivet for hele befolkningen og de tilsluttede organisationers medlemmer.

Arbejdstiden er gennemsnitligt 15 timer om ugen. Arbejdstiden skal lægges mandag til torsdag, vi er fleksible og tager selvfølgeligt hensyn til dit skema og ferieønsker. Lønnen er 160,25 kr. i timen plus feriepenge.

Din ansættelse i Friluftsrådet vil give dig værdifuld erfaring og indsigt i arbejdet i en interesseorganisation og bredt i politik og den offentlige forvaltning af myndighedsopgaver inden for natur- og miljøområdet.

Friluftsrådet betragter diversitet som et aktiv og menneskers forskellighed som en væsentlig ressource i vores udvikling. Derfor opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen. Rekrutteringen sker alene på baggrund af kvalifikationer og kompetencer.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 1. september 2026 kl. 12. Vi forventer at holde samtaler umiddelbart derefter og opstart er snarest muligt.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send en mail til job@friluftsraadet.dk og skriv ”Studentermedarbejder lokal interessevaretagelse” i emnefeltet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte politisk konsulent Annette Ritzau Eigaard på telefon 24 63 05 64 eller afdelingsleder Jes Lind Bejer på telefon 24 63 62 58.

Vi passer på dine personoplysninger
Hvis du søger et job hos os, så behandler vi dine personoplysninger med det formål at vurdere og behandle din ansøgning. I vores persondatapolitik (se afsnit 2.16) kan du læse mere om, hvordan vi behandler dine personoplysninger og dine rettigheder.

title: Customer Assistance Coordinator - Roadside
description:
📍 Croydon, CR9 6HD | 🏠 Hybrid Working | 💼 Full-Time

  • Location: Croydon (CR9 6HD) — hybrid working model, with IT equipment provided
  • Full-Time: £27,013.60 per year + up to £2,045 performance bonus | 35 hours/week

Are you a natural communicator who thrives on helping people in their moment of need? Join Allianz Partners as a Customer Service Coordinator in our Roadside Assistance team, based in Croydon (CR9 6HD) on a hybrid working model. In this role, you'll be the reassuring voice customers rely on when they need help most — managing roadside assistance cases with professionalism, empathy, and efficiency. As part of a globally recognised insurance and assistance organisation serving millions of customers worldwide, you'll have the support, tools, and development opportunities to build a genuinely rewarding career.

What You'll Do

  • Respond to customer calls with professionalism, empathy, and efficiency, ensuring every interaction meets Allianz Partners' quality standards
  • Proactively manage each roadside assistance case from first contact through to resolution, ensuring timely and appropriate service delivery
  • Communicate clear, consistent updates to customers throughout their case, keeping them informed and reassured at every stage
  • Work within established call guidelines and procedures to consistently meet quality and compliance standards
  • Log and update case information accurately across multiple systems simultaneously, maintaining data integrity throughout
  • Collaborate with your team and management to drive continuous service excellence and share best practice

What You'll Bring

  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills, with the ability to remain calm and solution-focused under pressure
  • A customer-first mindset with a compassionate, professional approach — especially when supporting customers in stressful situations
  • Confidence using multiple systems and managing several tasks at the same time
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, including weekends and bank holidays, across a shift pattern of 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM, Monday to Sunday
  • A reliable home working setup for hybrid working days
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted tools or digital customer service platforms is a plus — we're continuously evolving how we use technology to improve the customer experience

Desirable:

  • Experience in a customer service, contact centre, or emergency services environment
  • Knowledge of roadside assistance processes or motor claims

What We Offer

At Allianz Partners, we believe in taking care of the people who take care of our customers. Here's what you can look forward to:

  • Pension Scheme — Auto-enrolled from the 1st of the following month, with 4% employee and 4% employer contributions, plus a 2.5% matching increase after 1 year of service
  • Private Medical Cover
  • Life Assurance — 4x your annual basic salary
  • Flu Vaccinations & Eye Care Vouchers
  • Free Roadside Assistance — available after your 6-month probation period
  • Travel Insurance — at a discounted rate
  • Interest-Free Season Ticket Loan — available after probation
  • 3 Paid Volunteering Days per year — after 12 months of service
  • Discounts — on Allianz products and a wide range of retail and lifestyle brands
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — 24/7 confidential support for wellbeing, legal, and financial matters
  • Recognition & Rewards — for high performance and long service
  • All IT equipment provided — PC, dual monitors, keyboard, and mouse

Who We Are

Allianz Partners is a world leader in assistance and insurance solutions, operating in over 75 countries and serving millions of customers every year. In the UK, our Roadside team is at the heart of what we do — delivering fast, reliable support to customers when they need it most. We're part of the wider Allianz Group, one of the world's largest and most trusted financial services organisations, with over 125 million customers globally. We're proud to be an employer that genuinely invests in its people — offering real career development, a supportive team culture, and the stability of a global brand with a local feel.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer. We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions. Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future – for our customers and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture. We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

To Recruitment Agencies

We have an in-house recruitment team that focuses on sourcing great candidates directly. Therefore, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters. When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when such a contract is in place. Without a contract, we will not accept invoices related to unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate is ultimately hired. Please do not contact hiring managers directly.

title: Offshore Project Engineer
description:
Make your mark as Offshore Project Engineer for Boskalis Subsea Services located offshore and onshore when required. You will be focal point for the mobilisation and demobilisations, you will also work in conjunction with the onshore Remote Operations Centre (ROC) during offshore execution phase. You have a combined role;

  • Focal point for mobilisations and de-mobilisations.
  • Fulfil project engineer duties.
  • Provide onshore support to projects/initiatives if/as required

Your responsibilities as Offshore Project Engineer:

The main responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide leadership during mobilisations and demobilisations to ensure that the activities are delivered safely and efficiently in accordance with approved deck plans or as amended where necessary through the Management of Change process.
  • Ensure deck plans, lift plans, and mobilisation plans are received and reviewed prior to Mobilisation.
  • Verify that all project equipment is delivered with suitable documentation / certification and tested prior to sailing.
  • The Offshore Project Engineer will perform the role of Project Engineer during the offshore phase of the project.
  • Support the onshore Remote Operations Centre (ROC) and act as lead engineers offshore if ROC connectivity fails.
  • Monitor performance of offshore subcontractors against project deliverables, ensuring compliance with standards and schedules.
  • Oversee the delivery of engineering tasks, installation sequences, and operational procedures as instructed by the ROC, providing real-time progress, technical observations, and operational constraints as required.
  • Maintain onboard control of all project documentation, drawings, procedures, and ROC updates, ensuring latest revisions are used.

You can make your mark as Offshore Project Engineer if you have:

  • 3-4 years minimum Project/Field Engineering experience in Subsea Construction and/or IRM environments. DSV and CSV exposure desirable.
  • Engineering qualification (HNC or above – Mechanical/Civil) or relevant knowledge obtained through practical experience in all aspects of the Offshore Project Engineer role
  • Ability to deliver complex mobilisation and offshore operation activities.
  • OPITO BOSIET/FOET with CA-EBS, MIST and OEUK Medical.

What you can expect

  • A dynamic environment: A job that allows you to collaborate with a talented team of experts from different backgrounds and contribute to making a significant impact.
  • Rewarding conditions: Besides a competitive salary, you will receive access to a contributory pension scheme, private medical insurance and death in service benefit.
  • Career development: We offer you plenty of opportunities to bring out the best in yourself for example through (online) courses at our Boskalis academy.
  • Opportunities to connect with colleagues across the organization: Through networking and knowledge-sharing sessions, events, and employee communities.

Extra information

  • Your team: you will work closely with the Engineering, Project and Offshore teams and various departments throughout the business.
  • Where you will work: you will be primarily based offshore on our DSVs and/or CSV with some time spent in the Aberdeen office as required.
  • Full/part- time job: The position of Offshore Project Engineer is based on a Guaranteed Day Contract.
  • Next steps: Apply easily by completing the online application form. Interviews are held online or in the office. Once it’s clear we’re a good match, we’ll make you an offer – and look forward to welcoming you to the company.

We are more than happy to answer your questions about the position of Offshore Project Engineer. Please contact Matthew Hurrel, Recruiter.

Please apply by filling in your details and by uploading your cover letter and CV on our careers site.

Please note: Boskalis never requests a financial contribution to arrange visas or other documents related to a job vacancy. Be wary of individuals who pretend to be our recruiters and do ask for such contributions.

Disclaimer for Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies

We appreciate your interest in our vacancies and understand that your candidate might be enthusiastic about this exciting opportunity. However, our recruitment process is not structured this way, at Boskalis we handle recruitment ourselves. Therefore, we do not accept unsolicited applications or CVs

title: Principal Architect | Agentic AI
description:
Our NielsenIQ Technology teams are building and evolving Connect, a unified, global, open data ecosystem powered by cloud and on-premises technologies. Clients around the world rely on NielsenIQ data and insights to innovate and grow. As a Principal Architect within the Enterprise Architecture team, you will define architecture for key components and capabilities across NIQ platforms, ensuring alignment with business strategy, product objectives, technology standards, and the long-term platform vision. You will partner with architecture peers, Product and Operations leaders, engineering leaders, and development teams to take solutions from initial requirements through design, delivery, and production operation. A key focus of this role is shaping the responsible adoption of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and agentic AI across the enterprise. The successful candidate will combine broad enterprise architecture experience with practical knowledge of AI-enabled systems and will grow into an end-to-end platform architect as their knowledge of NIQ's platforms expands.

Responsibilities

• Lead the development of architecture designs for key products and capabilities across NIQ platforms, working closely with product stakeholders, engineering teams, and other architects.

• Define high-level solution approaches and blueprints that guide component-level design while maintaining an end-to-end view of platform integration, future products, and the technology roadmap.

• Create, maintain, and promote reference architectures, architecture principles, standards, patterns, and decision records for key areas of the platform.

• Shape enterprise architecture for AI, Generative AI, and agentic AI solutions, including model integration, retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration, tool and API use, memory, workflow automation, and human-in-the-loop controls.

• Define reusable patterns for secure and scalable AI agents, including identity and access control, data grounding, context management, guardrails, evaluation, observability, auditability, failure handling, and cost management.

• Partner with security, privacy, legal, data governance, and Responsible AI stakeholders to ensure AI solutions meet enterprise requirements for confidentiality, intellectual property, regulatory compliance, transparency, and risk management.

• Assess emerging technologies and viable alternatives for front-end applications, platform services, data pipelines, databases, AI platforms, foundation models, vector stores, and agentic frameworks, including build-versus-buy recommendations.

• Establish model and solution evaluation criteria covering quality, accuracy, groundedness, safety, latency, scalability, resilience, and total cost of ownership.

• Identify future-state solutions and drive innovation through proofs of concept, technology migrations, controlled pilots, and productionization.

• Provide architecture leadership, coaching, and design governance, promoting pragmatic, high-quality solutions and consistent engineering practices across teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in application development, solution design, or software architecture, supported by a strong engineering background and experience with enterprise-scale platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, secure, highly available, and observable distributed systems in production.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data modelling, and high-volume processing across relational and non-relational data stores; experience with multi-terabyte databases is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Azure AI services, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or comparable enterprise AI platforms.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and interoperability standards, such as semantic orchestration frameworks, multi-agent frameworks, and the Model Context Protocol.
  • Experience defining Responsible AI governance, AI risk controls, threat modelling, red-teaming, or security patterns for AI-enabled applications.
  • Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design for performance, scalability, availability, resilience, privacy, and security.
