fås ved henvendelse til uddannelseskonsulenterne
  • Maibritt Bjørnli på telefon 21 18 99 77 eller
  • Anne Kirsten Nielsen på telefon 24 82 74 46

Har du spørgsmål til oplysningsskemaet eller har du brug for hjælp
kan du kontakte Anne Marie Rokkjær på telefon 96 11 73 12 eller mail AR@Holstebro.dk

title: Business Controller to H&M Assortment
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

H&M Assortment is where we design and develop our fashion collections for a wide variety of customers all over the world. At Assortment you will be a part of a mixed team consisting of designers, pattern makers, product developers and planners, all working together to create the best customer offer while at the same time influencing H&M on a global scale. Sounds like fun? It is!

We aim to become industry leaders in creating irresistible products & assortment and are building a fast-moving & creative organization that is centered around the product. We want to build a trusted fashion brand and democratize sustainable fashion.

As a Business Controller, you will play a key role in generating sustainable sales growth and profitability for your area of responsibility both short- and long term. Through surrounding analyses and fashion forecast, this role will enable a current and commercial assortment. Together with your team, you will lead the development of our global assortment by generating growth, profitability, and customer value to optimize each region and ensure a locally relevant assortment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Optimize sustainable sales growth and profitability with the right quantity, the right timing, at the right place and at the best price.
  • Take business-minded decisions and implement actions based on commercial analyses on sales, customer behaviour, and market trends.
  • Take informal leadership responsibility, communicate insights in a clear, inspiring, and simple way. Mentor and lead your team towards our purpose and set goals.
  • Participate in defining vision, strategy, goals and timeline together with the team leader.
  • Support the team with buying follow-up securing the right assortment mix and volumes.
  • Perform ongoing sales analysis and identify future potential and risk
  • Take responsibility for the controlling and secure the balance between top-down vs. bottom-up perspective.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with:

  • A degree in business, economics, engineering or equivalent area
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, generate insights, and turn them into business actions
  • Leadership ability and a strategic mindset
  • Salesmanship and the ability to identify what our customers want
  • Experience within e-commerce is meritorious
  • Great communication skills
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

And people who are:

  • Naturally curious mindset and constantly looking for possibilities to develop new growth and more efficient ways of working
  • Working strategically and will enjoy developing our business as well as working hands-on analysing numbers
  • Communicative with ability to communicate with impact with a variety of stakeholders
  • Engaging team player and self-motivated to drive goals and thrive in an entrepreneurial setting

JOIN US

This is a fulltime position based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden reporting to Assortment Controllers. You don’t have to live in Sweden already, we welcome applications from all parts of the world and offer relocation support if needed. Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible but latest by 12th September. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.

We are constantly looking for talented people to join our team and our start date is flexible (throughout 2026 or 2027). We work proactively and review applications continuously. Therefore we encourage you to submit your application if you are completing your studies or other commitments in 2026 and 2027.

We welcome applications from both recent graduates and professionals with few years of experience, as you'll have opportunities to learn, grown and, have an impact from day one.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

  • All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound
  • In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

To ensure we provide an insightful experience to our candidates, and we support their understanding of the role scope and responsibilities for this role, we use an online assessment method for skills-based recruitment with our recruitment processes. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you will receive feedback with the score you obtained. If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

title: Handicaphjælper til respiratorisk nattevagtsstilling i Roskilde- få vagter á 12 timer i et 6-ugers rul.
description:
Vil du gøre en forskel for et andet menneske og samtidig blive en del af et stærkt og velfungerende team?

Hos Olivia Danmark søger vi lige nu en handicaphjælper til en respiratorisk ordning hos en mandlig borger i Roskilde. Du behøver ikke have erfaring med respiratorisk hjælp, da vi sørger for grundig oplæring. Det vigtigste er, at du er ansvarsfuld, stabil og har lyst til at hjælpe andre. Vi tilbyder 2 faste vagter ud af et 6 ugers rul.

Om stillingen

Vi kan tilbyde dig Du bliver en del af en velfungerende ordning med erfarne kollegaer, hvor flere har været ansat i mange år. Arbejdet foregår i borgerens eget hjem, og du arbejder som udgangspunkt alene på dine vagter, men med tæt sparring og støtte fra både teamet og områdelederen.

Udover respiratorisk overvågning og hjælp vil der også indgå plejeopgaver i samarbejde med kommunen. Disse opgaver vil blive gennemgået nærmere i forbindelse med en samtale.

Arbejdstid

title: Director, Product Development & Industrialization
description:
Position Summary

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, The Director, Product Development & Industrialization is responsible for leading new product platforms from concept through full-rate production. This role combines deep technical engineering expertise with hands-on industrialization leadership to ensure products are not only designed to meet performance, reliability, and customer requirements, but are also manufacturable, scalable, and supported by a capable supply chain.

The successful candidate will be expected to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels, owning critical design decisions while also developing suppliers, establishing manufacturing processes, managing launch readiness, and driving successful product introductions. This is a highly cross-functional position requiring direct engagement with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Purchasing, Operations, and external suppliers.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable creating CAD models, conducting FEA and tolerance stack analyses, troubleshooting production issues on the manufacturing floor, and leading cross-functional teams through industrialization and production launch activities.

Key Responsibilities

Product Development & Technical Leadership

  • Lead the design and development of new firearm products, accessories, and related platforms from concept through production.
  • Develop and maintain complete Technical Data Packages including CAD models, engineering drawings, specifications, bills of material, and supporting documentation.
  • Utilize PTC Creo or equivalent CAD software to create detailed component and assembly designs.
  • Conduct engineering analyses including:
    • Finite Element Analysis (FEA)
    • Tolerance stack-up analysis
    • Design for Manufacturing (DFM)
    • Design for Assembly (DFA)
    • Reliability and durability assessments
  • Perform root cause investigations and implement corrective actions for design, manufacturing, and supplier-related issues.
  • Evaluate materials, manufacturing methods, finishes, and component designs for performance, quality, and cost optimization.

Industrialization & Manufacturing Readiness

  • Develop and execute industrialization plans for new product introductions.
  • Define manufacturing strategies including make-versus-buy decisions and production process selection.
  • Lead manufacturing readiness activities through prototype, pilot, validation, and production builds.
  • Define requirements for:
    • Tooling and fixtures
    • Gauging and inspection methods
    • Process controls
    • Assembly procedures
    • Test equipment and validation methods
    • Work instructions and production documentation
  • Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Operations to establish efficient production processes and assembly lines.
  • Support facility and production floor setup for new product launches.
  • Establish launch readiness criteria and support transition into stable serial production.

Supplier Development & Supply Chain Leadership

  • Identify, evaluate, and qualify suppliers for components, assemblies, materials, and specialized manufacturing processes.
  • Lead technical supplier assessments and capability evaluations.
  • Partner with Purchasing to develop sourcing strategies for new product platforms.
  • Manage supplier readiness throughout development, launch, and ramp-up phases.
  • Identify and mitigate supply chain risks impacting launch timing or product quality.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Coordinate activities across Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Purchasing, Supply Chain, Quality, and Product Management.
  • Maintain project risk registers and drive resolution of critical technical and operational issues.
  • Mentor engineers and technical staff while promoting engineering best practices and structured problem solving.

title: Constructeur  Betonconstructies
description:
Als constructeur werk je in multidisciplinaire projectteams aan diverse typen civiele
constructies (bruggen, tunnels, sluizen, funderingen e.d.). Je ontwerpt of ondersteunt de
ontwerper en bent verantwoordelijk voor de constructieve analyses van civiele
kunstwerken en verantwoordelijk voor de berekeningen van tijdelijke en permanente
constructies conform de Eurocode en veiligheidseisen. Je draagt samen met
modelleurs/tekenaars zorg voor heldere Bouwwerk Informatie Modellen en sluitende
detailtekeningen. Je speelt een cruciale rol in de technische haalbaarheid en veiligheid
van projecten.

Je werkzaamheden omvatten:

  • Het ontwerpen en berekenen van bouw- en hulpconstructies.
  • Het uitvoeren van constructieve analyses en sterkteberekeningen
  • Het beoordelen van technische tekeningen en ontwerpen
  • Het adviseren van opdrachtgevers en projectteams
  • Het bewaken van constructieve veiligheid en uitvoerbaarheid
  • Samenwerken met engineers, projectleiders en uitvoerende partijen. Wij zoeken een analytische en nauwkeurige constructeur met een sterke technische basis.
  • HBO / WO werk- en denkniveau (bij voorkeur civiele techniek of bouwkunde).
  • Enige werkervaring met beton gerelateerde projecten.
  • Solide kennis van vingerende normen, richtlijnen en constructieve veiligheid (bijv. EC-2; beton, EC-3; Staal en EC-7; Geotechniek).
  • Ervaring met SCIA Engineer voor 2D/3D EEM-analyses en modelleringen van civiele constructies.
  • Ervaring met FEM-Design of vergelijkbare EEM-software voor 3D betonconstructies en bruganalyses.
  • Ervaring met IDEA StatiCa voor complexe detailberekeningen van betonelementen, D-gebieden, ankertoepassingen en complexe verbindingen.
  • Bekend met Technosoft Geotechniek (ondersteunt EC7 + CUR 166 werkflows) en BuildSoft Diamonds.
  • Affiniteit met recente modelleer en tekentechnieken.

Competenties

  • Analytisch sterk
  • Probleemoplossend denken
  • Enthousiasmerend
  • Goede schriftelijke vastlegging (ontwerpnota’s)
  • Kan variantenstudies uitvoeren en oplossingen onderbouwen
  • Een uitstekend brutosalaris tussen € 4300,- en € 6200,- per 4 weken afhankelijk van je ervaring.
  • Uitdagende en afwisselende projecten binnen civiele techniek en infra.
  • Toegang tot opleidingen en volop ruimte voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
  • Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.
  • Woon je niet om de hoek? Geen probleem. Wij vergoeden je reiskosten per kilometer, zodat je zorgeloos op pad kunt.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling met werkgeversbijdrage.
  • 30 vakantiedagen per jaar.
  • Een ruim keuzebudget boven op je salaris, inclusief vakantiegeld. Jij bepaalt zelf: meer vrije dagen (tot 13 extra), of extra geld op je rekening.

title: AI Transformation & Strategy Consultant
description:
We’re looking for an AI Transformation Consultant to help organizations rethink how work gets done using generative AI, automation, and agent-based workflows.

In this role, you’ll work closely with business and technology leaders to identify high-impact opportunities for AI, rapidly prototype solutions, and help scale AI-enabled ways of working across the enterprise. You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, operations, and applied AI — helping clients move from experimentation to measurable business impact.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who combines structured problem solving with curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and a builder’s mindset. You should be excited by fast-moving technologies, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and motivated by solving real business problems with AI.

You’ll have the opportunity to work directly with modern AI platforms and tools, including LLMs, copilots, workflow automation platforms, and agentic systems, while partnering with cross-functional teams to shape how organizations adopt AI responsibly and effectively.

What You’ll Do

Identify & Shape AI Opportunities

  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities for generative AI, automation, and AI-enabled transformation
  • Translate ambiguous business challenges into practical AI use cases, workflows, and solution concepts
  • Help prioritize AI initiatives based on business value, feasibility, scalability, and user impact
  • Define success metrics tied to efficiency, adoption, quality, and measurable business outcomes

Design & Deliver AI-Enabled Solutions

  • Help design, prototype, and implement AI-powered workflows and agent-driven solutions across functions such as operations, finance, sales, customer support, and enterprise services
  • Structure multi-step workflows, including decision logic, orchestration, inputs/outputs, and human-in-the-loop processes
  • Collaborate closely with technical, product, and data teams to move solutions from pilot to scaled deployment
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and platforms to identify practical enterprise applications

Drive AI Transformation Execution

  • Support end-to-end delivery across multiple AI and transformation initiatives
  • Drive execution across cross-functional teams while balancing speed, quality, and business priorities
  • Help establish scalable operating models, governance approaches, and implementation best practices for enterprise AI adoption
  • Navigate ambiguity and solve complex problems in fast-paced client environments

Measure Impact & Optimize

  • Track adoption, performance, and business impact of AI-enabled solutions
  • Analyze user feedback, workflow outputs, and operational metrics to continuously improve effectiveness and user experience
  • Refine prompts, workflows, and operating processes to improve reliability and business outcomes
  • Support the development of repeatable playbooks and scalable delivery approaches

Enable Adoption & Change

  • Help organizations adopt new AI-enabled ways of working through training, change management, and stakeholder engagement
  • Educate business teams on how to effectively and responsibly leverage AI tools and solutions
  • Develop documentation, playbooks, and best practices to support scalable adoption
  • Partner with legal, risk, and compliance stakeholders to support responsible AI implementation
  • 2–7 years of experience in management consulting
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Experience supporting digital, data, automation, or AI-related initiatives in a consulting or enterprise environment
  • Strong understanding of generative AI concepts, including LLMs, AI agents, copilots, automation workflows, and enterprise AI adoption challenges
  • Hands-on experience experimenting with AI tools such as OpenAI, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or workflow automation platforms is strongly preferred
  • Ability to translate business problems into structured solutions and practical implementation approaches
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with experience working across business and technical teams
  • Product and solution-oriented mindset with a focus on driving measurable business impact
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments with a high degree of ownership and ambiguity
  • Demonstrated curiosity for emerging AI capabilities and a willingness to continuously learn and experiment
  • Experience working with enterprise systems, data platforms, CRM tools, or operational workflows is a plus
  • Exposure to Agile delivery methodologies or transformation programs is preferred
  • Experience in consulting, technology, financial services, or fintech industries is a plus

Why Join Us

  • Work on real-world AI transformation initiatives across industries
  • Help organizations operationalize generative AI at scale
  • Collaborate with strategy, product, data, and engineering teams
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools, copilots, and agent-based workflows
  • Shape how enterprises adopt AI responsibly and effectively
  • Join a fast-growing team focused on the future of enterprise AI transformation
  • Build highly valuable experience at the intersection of business strategy and applied AI

This role does not require deep machine learning engineering expertise. However, candidates should be comfortable working closely with technical teams and actively experimenting with modern AI tools and workflows.

Compensation & Benefits

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.

Compensation

  • Annual Base Salary Ranges, commensurate with experience and qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.

    • Consultant level: $89,800 - $110,200

    • Senior Consultant level: $124,400 - $129,500

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP
  • 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options
  • College savings and student loan repayment programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Workplace
Sia values in-person collaboration. When serving clients, consultants may be required to work onsite at a client location based on engagement needs. Between client engagements, consultants are expected to work from a Sia office or approved coworking location at least three days per week. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a Sia office or approved coworking location. Sia maintains offices and coworking arrangements across multiple U.S. markets, including New York City, Charlotte, Greater Seattle, San Francisco Greater Bay Area, Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Baltimore, Chicago, Washington D.C.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Our Commitment

At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.

title: Uddannet pædagog i Børnehusene ved Skovens børnehave – har du guldmedalje i relationskompetence og er du god til at lege?
description:
Vi mangler en uddannet pædagog i Børnehusene ved Skovens børnehave, da en af vores dygtige pædagoger har valgt at videreuddanne sig. Hos os får du mulighed for at sætte din pædagogiske viden i spil i et fagligt miljø med erfarne kolleger.

Hos os er der to uddannede pædagoger på hver stue og en pædagogmedhjælper. Derudover har vi en pædagog i flyverfunktion og en pædagogstuderende ansat.

Børn og voksne skal glæde sig til at komme i Børnehusene ved Skoven. Børnene skal opleve engagerede og dygtige voksne – og de voksne skal udvikle sig og bidrage til, at institutionen er en dejlig arbejdsplads. Vil du være med? Lige nu mangler vi en uddannet pædagog til vores børnehaveafdeling. Du bliver en del af en stue med en uddannet pædagog og en erfaren pædagogmedhjælper.

Vi bor i et stort sort træhus og er nabo til Ryvangens Naturpark. Udelivet er en stor del af vores hverdag året rundt, og vi er så heldige at have både skoven, den nærliggende sø og en stor legeplads med egen bålplads. Vi har også tre ladcykler, så vi kan komme endnu mere ud i det blå.

Vi opfordrer ungerne og hinanden til bevægelse og aktivitet. Børnene giver den gas i rytmikkælderen, de suser af sted på cykelbanen, og vi kommer hjem fra skoven med røde kinder og sorte negle.

Personalegruppen er kendetegnet ved engagement, nærvær og ikke mindst arbejdsglæde og humor. Vi er gode til at hjælpe hinanden og arbejde på tværs af stuerne, og vi har høje ambitioner om, at ungerne skal gå glade, trygge og nysgerrige i børnehave hver dag.

I dagligdagen arbejder vi struktureret og veksler mellem planlagte aktiviteter i mindre grupper, den frie udforskende leg og voksenfaciliterede lege og aktiviteter. Som pædagog forventer vi, du kan understøtte, facilitere og deltage i børns leg. Vi arbejder også med pædagogik og udvikling i rutinesituationerne. Det er vigtigt, at rutinesituationerne giver mulighed for nærvær, udvikling og samvær med børnene.

Institutionens familier afspejler Københavns Kommunes mangfoldige demografiske sammensætning, hvilket også afspejles i vores indsats om at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn. Vi har derudover et tæt samarbejde med vores ressourceteam, der består af en logopæd, en psykolog, en socialrådgiver, en sundhedsplejerske og en støttepædagog.

Vi har stuemøde i arbejdstiden en gang ugentligt kl. 12-13.00. Dette prioriterer vi højt, da vi oplever, det er med til at kvalificere det pædagogiske arbejde med børnene.

Vi arbejder ud fra Nord Klynge G's fælles børnesyn, og hvert år prioriterer vi at tage på et fælles klyngeseminar med overnatning, hvor vi har fokus på pædagogisk udvikling og har inviteret spændende oplægsholdere.

Om dig
Vi forventer, at du

  • besidder en høj faglighed og er interesseret i børns udvikling og trivsel
  • ved, at arbejde med børn kræver tålmodighed, nærvær og lydhørhed
  • altid har børnenes perspektiver for øje i dit arbejde
  • tager ansvaret for kvaliteten i relationen til barnet
  • har en legende tilgang til læring
  • elsker at komme ud og inddrage naturen i pædagogikken
  • skriver og taler dansk
  • har humor og er god til at samarbejde
  • ved, at kolleger er afhængige af hinanden – også klokken syv om morgenen i snevejr!
Og måske trænger du til at være et sted, hvor du er vigtig?

Børnehaven er normeret til 88 børnehavebørn fordelt på fire stuer.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelsen sker under gældende overenskomst mellem FOA/LFS og Københavns Kommune. Vi ønsker, at du kan starte den 1. oktober 2026, men vi venter gerne på den helt rigtige kandidat. Du kan søge om timetal fra 35 til 37 timer ugentligt. Husk at skrive i din ansøgning, hvor mange timer du er interesseret i. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og indenfor rammerne af lokal løndannelse. I forbindelse med ansættelsen indhenter vi børne- og straffeattest og tager referencer.

Mere information
Du er velkommen til at komme på besøg. Kontakt pædagogisk leder Stina Knobelauch på 23 61 01 26/23 60 84 24.

Sammen med din ansøgning beder vi dig vedhæfte CV og uddannelsesbevis.
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. Du må også gerne sige det gerne videre, hvis du kender en dygtig kandidat.

title: Principal Engineer, Casting
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Principal Casting Engineer to serve as the lead technical authority for our internal casting needs. This is a hands-on, high-impact role dedicated entirely to ensuring Beehive’s innovative engine platforms have a fast, reliable, and vertically integrated path from design to flight-ready hardware.


You will be the technical lead responsible for the internal casting of Beehive’s proprietary engine components. You will work as a core member of the team to translate complex engine designs into successful, high-integrity cast components. This role is critical to scaling precision casting operations, introducing new technologies, and supporting cross-functional product innovation. The ideal candidate will have a strong command of metallurgical science, casting simulation, defect analysis, and automation opportunities, with a track record of delivering complex components at scale.


What You'll Do...

Technical Leadership

    • Act as the technical authority for the casting process, leading process definition, control, and continuous improvement across all programs
    • Mentor engineers in casting fundamentals, advanced metallurgy, and best practices
    • Review and approve gating/riser designs, shell configurations, and critical process documents for development and production programs

Process Innovation & Development

    • Lead development of next-generation casting processes including single crystal (SX), directionally solidified (DS), equiaxed (EQ), and additive-enabled casting workflows
    • Develop robust casting parameters for nickel-based superalloys, titanium, cobalt, and advanced steels in vacuum or inert environments

Simulation & Data-Driven Engineering

    • Oversee use of casting simulation tools (e.g., MAGMASOFT, ProCAST) to predict defects, optimize gating, and reduce trial iterations
    • Drive adoption of data analytics and digital twins to correlate process parameters with quality outcomes and productivity KPIs

Quality & Compliance

    • Define critical-to-quality (CTQ) metrics and ensure compliance with AS9100, NADCAP, and program-specific specifications
    • Lead complex RCCA investigations using 8D, FMEA, and Six Sigma methodologies
    • Interface directly with stakeholders as the SME on casting process capability and conformance

You have...

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Materials Science, Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. Citizenship is required, as only U.S. Citizens are eligible for a security clearance
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in precision investment casting, with at least 5 years in a principal or technical leadership capacity
  • Deep expertise in casting of superalloys, vacuum melting, ceramic shell chemistry, thermal control, and defect prevention
  • Demonstrated proficiency in casting simulation, statistical process control, and technical documentation
  • Experience with high-performance industries such as aerospace, defense, or IGT is strongly preferred
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. Citizenship is required, as only U.S. Citizens are eligible for a security clearance

Nice to have...

  • Knowledge of automated foundry systems, robotics, and in-situ inspection technologies
  • Experience integrating additive manufacturing into the casting workflow (e.g., printed wax/ceramic patterns, hybrid cores)
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to influence capital investment and product cost models
  • Thought leadership via industry publications, patents, or conference presentations

If this sounds like you, please submit an application with your resume. This could be the opportunity you are looking for to expand your skills, contribute to a winning team, and work with talented people who love what they do and take pride in our mission.


Beehive Industries offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes group Medical, Dental, Life, and Short and Long-Term disability coverage from day one. We also offer a generous 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a Company match. Every role at Beehive Industries is bonus eligible, and will also receive equity in the company.


Beehive Industries is committed to full compliance with applicable anti-discrimination laws. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We strive to create an inclusive work environment and will not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Achubwr Bywyd / Lifeguard - Wrexham

Ymunwch â’r Egni yn Freedom Leisure – Gwneud yn Dda, Teimlo’n Dda!

Yn Freedom Leisure, mae popeth yn ymwneud ag awyrgylch cadarnhaol, pobl wych, a chael effaith go iawn. Ydyn, rydyn ni’n rhedeg cyfleusterau hamdden a diwylliannol, campfeydd, a phyllau nofio—ond wrth wraidd y cyfan, ein pobl ni sy'n gwneud y gwahaniaeth.

Fel un o ymddiriedolaethau hamdden elusennol blaenllaw'r DU, rydyn ni’n falch o'n cenhadaeth o Wella Bywydau Trwy Hamdden. Rydyn ni yma i helpu cymunedau i fyw bywydau iachach a hapusach trwy wneud ein canolfannau'n groesawgar, yn gynhwysol, ac yn hygyrch i bawb - oherwydd mae pawb yn haeddu teimlo'n dda. Rydyn ni i gyd am ddarparu gwasanaeth cwsmeriaid anhygoel gyda gwên—bob dydd. Rydyn ni’n creu mannau lle mae pobl yn teimlo'n gartrefol, wedi'u cefnogi, ac wedi'u hysbrydoli.

Os ydych chi'n angerddol am helpu eraill ac yn caru creu profiadau gwych, byddwch chi'n teimlo'n gartrefol gyda ni. Nid oes angen i chi fod yn arbenigwr i ddechrau - byddwn yn rhoi'r holl hyfforddiant a chefnogaeth sydd eu hangen arnoch chi. Gyda dros 130 o ganolfannau ledled Cymru a Lloegr, mae yna lawer o le i dyfu. Mae llawer o'n tîm wedi adeiladu gyrfaoedd anhygoel gan wneud yr hyn maen nhw'n ei garu, gan helpu cwsmeriaid o ddydd i ddydd a gwneud i bobl deimlo'n dda.

Rydyn ni’n falch o fod yn weithle lle mae croeso i bawb, eu bod yn cael eu gwerthfawrogi, a'u cefnogi i ffynnu—oherwydd pan fydd ein tîm yn adlewyrchu'r cymunedau rydyn ni’n eu gwasanaethu, rydyn ni i gyd yn tyfu'n gryfach gyda'n gilydd.

Mae bod yn achubwr bywyd gyda ni’n grêt achos byddwch yn datblygu sgiliau gydol oes fel gwaith tîm a chyfathrebu. Dyma un o’n swyddi mwyaf boddhaol sy’n eich gadael yn teimlo’n wirioneddol grêt ar ddiwedd pob shifft. Rydych yn cwrdd â phobl o bob math a gwneud ffrindiau am oes gyda’ch cydweithwyr.

Mae ein hachubwyr bywyd yn rhan annatod o’n tîm ac maen nhw wedi mynd ymlaen i fod yn athrawon nofio, goruchwylwyr a mwy hyd yn oed. Byddwn yn eich cefnogi chi i ddatblygu a chyrraedd eich potensial!

title: Personlig hjælper søges – Silkeborg/Kragelund
description:
Personlig hjælper søges – Silkeborg/Kragelund

Lidt om mig:

Jeg hedder Kristoffer og er en glad, smilende og snakkesalige ung mand på 31 år.

Jeg søger en ny hjælper på 32-37 timer om ugen - 6-7 vagter i gennemsnit hver 4. uge.

- Derudover er jeg også åben for hvis der er nogen som søger en vikar stilling. Hvis vi har en god kemi og du passer godt ind kan der være mulighed for permanent fastsættelse.

I april 2017 var jeg ude for en skiulykke, der desværre resulterede i, at jeg i dag sidder kørestol og er lam fra brystet og ned. Jeg har derfor brug for hjælp til daglige praktiske gøremål.

Jeg blev i 2022 færdig med min bachelor i pædagogik. Derudover har jeg en studentereksamen og en sergentuddannelse. Jeg har haft flere ufaglærte jobs, inden jeg kom til skade. I dag arbejder jeg på et gartneri hvor jeg er to-tre gange om ugen.

Jeg er glad og positiv over for mine hjælpere. Jeg behandler dem med respekt og er taknemmelig over for den hjælp jeg får. Jeg kan godt lide at snakke, men er også en person som nyder at være meget alene, det er på den måde, jeg lader op og får energi på. Jeg er humoristisk (hvis jeg selv skal sige det) og har let til smil og grin.

Jeg har en stor passion/hobby for planter, have og hobby projekter. Jeg har mere end 50 planter i mit hjem. Så hvis du godt kan lide planter og f.eks. ved hvad en Monstera Albo er, er det en stor bonus :D

Jeg har mit eget lille salg af brugte planter og i hverdagen bruger jeg meget tid på mine egne planter og have.

Så hvis du ingen interesse har for planter eller have, så er vi måske et forkert match.

Lige nu arbejder jeg 4-8 timer om ugen for en virksomhed i Silkeborg. Her opbygger jeg hjemmeside og SO-ME mm.

Jeg bor sammen med min kæreste og har en hund (Cocio). Så for mig er det vigtigt, at du har en god forståelse for, hvordan det er at indgå som hjælper i et hjem hvor du skal være sammen med min kæreste og hund i hverdagen.

Dit job som hjælper hos mig:

Som hjælper hos mig vil du have indflydelse på din vagter. Jeg har et værelse, hvor mine hjælpere opholder sig, når jeg ikke har behov for hjælp og hvor de sover. Jeg holder løbende opfølgende samtaler med alle mine ansatte, så jeg er sikker på at alt går som det skal for begge parter. Jeg er åben, ærlig og modtagelig hvis du har ideer. Jeg forventer gensidig respekt :-).

Dine opgaver vil være:

* Ledsagelse ud af huset til forskellige arrangementer, da jeg er meget impulsiv og elsker at lave noget med min familie og venner.

* Hjælp til træning.

* Ledsagelse på arbejde.

* Indkøb, rengøring samt oprydning.

* Tøjvask.

* Bad, toiletbesøg og personlig pleje.

* Projekter vi laver sammen.

Kort sagt skal du være mine arme og ben, når jeg har brug for det.

Arbejdstimer:

Jeg søger en fastansat hjælper på 37 timer i ugens dage fra mandag til søndag. Arbejdstiden vil primært være 24 timers vagter. Mødetiden ligger fra 08:15 til 08:15 dagen efter.

Jeg søger også ansatte til færre timer. Eller vikarer som gerne vil dække sygemeldinger eller er interesseret i at arbejde i weekender og ferie.

Hvis du allerede kan starte i september, er det et stort plus.

Krav til dig:

* Badning og toiletbesøg kan måske være grænseoverskridende for nogen, derfor må du ikke være af en sart og skrøbelig støbning.

* Det er MEGET vigtigt at du er stabil og pålidelig. Jeg har et rigtig godt team hvor alle samarbejder og der er få sygemeldinger. Derfor søger jeg en medarbejder som kan indgå i teamet med samme arbejdsindstilling.

* Du skal være indstillet på at møde min familie, kæreste og venner, derfor skal du have en god situationsfornemmelse.

* Du skal have gejst og gå-på-mod.

* Du skal have overblik og tålmodighed.

* Du skal være rummelig overfor ændringer.

* Humor er godt :-)

* Åben og ærlig.

* Snakkesalig og positiv.

*Proaktiv og tager selv initiativ til opgaver.

Erfaring eller uddannelse er ikke nødvendig.

Som hjælper kommer du tæt på min familie, venner og kæreste. Derfor kræver det, at du forstår balancen mellem, at være der for mig, når det kræves, og trække dig når behovet ikke længere er der.

Kemien er altafgørende for at få et godt samarbejde, hvorfor det vil vægte højt til samtalen og arbejdet hos mig.

Ansættelse hurtigst muligt.

Sidste ansøgningsfrist fredag d. 10.09.2026 til: Krizthadude@live.dk

Samtaler vil blive afholdt løbende og muligvis online. Hvis du ikke har hørt noget fra mig inden den 10.09.2026 er stillingen sandsynligvis besat til anden side.

Jeg glæder mig til at modtage ansøgning fra dig, hvor du fortæller om dig selv og motivationen til at søge jobbet som personlig hjælper. Du må gerne vedhæfte et billede af dig selv. Jeg vil hellere modtage en ansøgning, som er sjov og læse. Hvor jeg kan danne mig et indtryk af hvem og hvordan du er som menneske. End en alt for stilren og seriøs ansøgning.

Arbejdet som hjælper kan indimellem føles som hushjælp - hvilket det til tider også vil være. Men der er også mange andre aspekter og udviklingsmuligheder i jobbet, som du vil kunne opdage/se hvis du har en oprigtig glæde i at hjælpe en person med handicap til et bedre liv.

Jeg søger hjælpere som kan følge mig i mange år og som trives i et arbejde uden nær kontakt med kollegaer, men nær kontakt til personen de hjælper. Jeg har lige nu et velfungerende team med 5 ansatte.

Din arbejdsgiver vil være LOBPA og du vil blive aflønnet efter BPA-handicaphjælper-overenskomsten, der er indgået mellem DE, FOA og 3F.

title: To lærere med blik for alle elevers potentiale søges til Margretheskolen
description:
Brænder du for sammen med dine kolleger og ledelse at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle skolens elever? Så er du måske den ene af de to lærere, vi søger til at indgå i vores i forvejen dygtige kollegaskab.

Vi søger dig, der er læreruddannet, og som har
  • Et af følgende linjefag; dansk, engelsk, N/T eller madkundskab
  • Mod på og erfaring med at skabe læringsmiljøer, hvor alle elever kan deltage
  • Gejst for at udvikle din praksis i et professionelt læringsfællesskab (PLF)
  • Lyst til at arbejde både i vores almenklasser (A + B) og i vores C-klasser
  • En naturlig tilgang til elevinddragelse og tydelig relations-pædagogisk tilgang
  • Energi til at samarbejde tæt med både teamkolleger, forældre, eksterne samarbejdspartnere og ledelse
Stillingerne er på fuld tid og til ansættelse senest pr. 1. november 2026.

Kort om os på Margretheskolen Margretheskolen er en tosporet folkeskole, som ligger tæt på naturen i Gundsømagle et kvarters kørsel fra Roskilde. Skolen har god opbakning fra forældre og lokalsamfund. Vi er ca. 470 dejlige børn og unge og 60 ansatte.

Vores gruppeordning, C-klasserne, er for normaltbegavede elever med forskellige opmærksomheds-, koncentrations- og udviklingsforstyrrelser. C-klasserne er en integreret del af vores skole, og det er helt centralt for os, at vores medarbejdere arbejder sammen på tværs af A-, B- og C-klasserne. Stillingerne vil derfor indeholde opgaver i både almen klasserne og i C-klasserne.

Vi er en skole med stærke og velfungerende traditioner. Vi vægter et tæt forældresamarbejde og gør meget ud af at markere og gøre overgangene i børnenes skoleliv trygge og meningsfulde – fra sfo-start til dimission.

Margretheskolen er en skole og en arbejdsplads, som tror på ligeværdighed. Vi er certificeret som UNICEF Rettighedsskole. Det betyder, at vi har et rettighedsråd og inddrager skolens børn og unge i de spørgsmål, som handler om dem, deres trivsel og tryghed. Vi arbejder naturligt sammen på tværs af professioner, og vi har selvfølgelig også ét samlet personalerum.

Vi er nu i år tre af vores fem års plan med fokus på PLF og psykologisk tryghed som fundament for at udvikle stærke fællesskaber blandt os alle; elever, medarbejdere, forældre og ledelse. Målet er en fortsat udvikling af motiverende læringsmiljøer af høj faglig kvalitet, deltagelsesmuligheder for alle elever og styrkelse af vores tre pejlemærker; Rettighedsskole, Grøn skole og Musikmagnet.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Dine løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er efter gældende overenskomst.
Roskilde Kommune indhenter børne- og straffeattest samt referencer for alle, der bliver ansat hos os.

Vil du vide mere?
Vi vil meget gerne høre fra dig og fortælle dig mere om vores skole og stillingerne. Så ring gerne til Heidi Rask Schlyter (afd.leder/souchef) på 3179 5004, Malene Dorff Rothmann (afd.leder) på 4046 2680 eller Lone Marker (skoleleder) 2089 8587.

Det praktiske
Der er ansøgningsfrist mandag den 14. september. kl. 8. Vi holder løbende samtaler.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og modtage din ansøgning.

title: Warehouse Part Time Days
description:
Your Impact at Lowe’s

As a Receiver/Stocker, you help keep the store clean, safe, and ready for customers by accurately receiving freight, stocking shelves, and organizing merchandise and top stock. You’ll unload deliveries, handle equipment and hazardous materials safely, and make sure your area is prepped for daily success.

This role is physical and fast-paced, requiring safe lifting practices and attention to detail. You’ll spend most of your shift on your feet, working mornings, afternoons, evenings, or overnight depending on store needs. And when a customer or teammate needs help, you’ll be there with a friendly, professional attitude.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe’s is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe’s associate, you’ll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit .

Your Day at Lowe’s

You’ll keep shelves stocked and backrooms organized by unloading freight, moving products to the sales floor, and maintaining a clean, safe workspace. You may also assist customers in locating or loading products. Most shifts are physically active, and scheduling may include morning, evening, or overnight hours based on store needs.

Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver SMART customer service by assisting customers, answering questions, and offering support during projects
  • Stock merchandise by unloading freight, down-stocking, organizing shelves, and setting up pallets
  • Support store operations by verifying deliveries, completing dock prep, and using equipment like pallet jacks and forklifts
  • Maintain a safe, clean environment by following proper procedures for hazardous materials, equipment use, and housekeeping
  • Operate store equipment including scanners, Zebra phones, balers, and other tools as needed
  • Pitch in as a team player to complete other assigned tasks

Additional responsibilities for Pro Fulfillment Stores include:
  • Use the Orders App to pick and stage Flatbed Delivery orders
  • Load delivery orders, ensuring quality, accuracy, and safe loading practices
  • Rotate orders by delivery date and resolve customer order issues
  • Proactively communicate with customers to ensure delivery satisfaction
  • Execute Delivery Readiness best practices

Minimum Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable

Preferred Qualifications
  • 3 months Experience operating forklift/power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment
  • 6 months Experience in a warehouse performing inventory handling and stocking

Lowe’s commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we actively seek and encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

Travel Requirements

This role does not require regular travel, but occasional travel may be needed for meetings, training sessions, or to support nearby stores.

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

Lowe’s employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,700 home improvement stores, 530 branches and 130 distribution centers. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. title: HSSE Business Partner - NSW & ACT
description:
As the HSSE Business Partner, reporting to the Head of HSSE, you will partner closely with operational leaders across the retail network to embed safe behaviours, strengthen safety culture and improve safety performance. This field-facing role will provide practical coaching, guidance and support to State Managers, Area Managers and Store Managers across our retail network.

You will provide:

  • Coach operational leaders to strengthen safety leadership capability and build safety ownership across the retail network.
  • Support Store Managers and Area Managers to embed safe work practices and promote a proactive safety culture focused on prevention, learning and accountability.
  • Conduct site risk assessments, safety observations, reviews and compliance checks across the retail network.
  • Support leaders to identify, manage and escalate operational safety risks and monitor corrective actions through to completion.
  • Provide practical recommendations to improve safety compliance, risk management and overall performance.
  • Support the investigation and follow-up of safety incidents, including coaching leaders to identify root causes and implement effective corrective actions.
  • Monitor incident trends and communicate key safety learnings across the network.
  • Support stores to maintain emergency response readiness and safe ways of working.
  • Partner with Operations, Store Enablement, Group Safety and Group Security to implement Group HSSE requirements.
  • Provide HSSE advice and support across operational initiatives, change programs and day-to-day decision-making.

What We offer:

title: Processor - Wares (43191)
description:
SUMMARY

Under the direction of the Team Leader, process all donations. Major duties include greeting and assisting donors/customers, receive incoming donations, issue donation receipts, grade donations, pricing, hanging and barbing donations and maintain processing area in a clean and neat and safe condition.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/DUTIES

1. Greet each customer/donor with a courteous, friendly and professional attitude; provide prompt, efficient, and accurate customer/donor service at all times, issue donation receipts for articles donated; assist customers with lifting items in and out of their vehicles.

2. Sort donations as they arrive into proper carts or bins and make proper determination as to the quality of donations.

3. Sort, box and label hangers by type.

4. Hang garments in a timely manner as to maintain prescribed production level; sort hang, and barb color of the week.

5. Place and present all merchandise on appropriate racks in accordance with merchandising policies and procedures.

6. Sort and price hard goods (wares).

7. Rotate stock on a timely basis and in accordance with established procedures; bring stock to sales floor in a timely manner.

8. Keep production area clean and safe.

9. Maintain well groomed appearance and appropriate dress code including name badge and vest.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS/DUTIES

1. Assist in textile color rotation per established procedure.

2. Direct customers to proper area and provide general information as requested.

3. Stay alert and watch for shoplifting; notify store management on suspicious activity.

4. Refer all customer complaints to management in a timely manner.

5. React calmly and respond to emergency situations.

6. Perform other duties as assigned by the Store/Team Leader.

title: Associate Director for Graduate Writing and Academics
description:
The Graduate Program’s Associate Director for Graduate Writing and Academics is a member of a team that supports graduate law students (candidates for the LLM (Master of Laws) and SJD (Doctor of Juridical Science) degrees) and visiting researchers in their academic, student life, and co-curricular pursuits.

The Associate Director for Graduate Writing and Academics provides high-level academic and writing support to LLM and SJD students, most of whom received their primary legal education outside the U.S. The position helps students to find their scholarly voice and develop their academic skills and interests.

As an Associate Director for Graduate Writing and Academics you will:

  • Advise and support LLM and SJD students in their legal/academic research and writing, including in formulating research projects, crafting effective paper proposals, and organizing and presenting arguments effectively, and develop and implement innovative programming related to these skills
  • Advise and assist LLM and SJD students and recent alumni in moving projects toward publication and serve as a liaison between current students and alumni with common academic interests
  • Assist students in complying with academic rules and requirements, including with respect to plagiarism and proper paraphrasing
  • Work with HLS faculty supervisors and research librarians to address specific LLM and SJD research and writing needs
  • Maintain primary responsibility for the structure and presentation of SJD theory and methodology seminar
  • Select, train, supervise, and mentor student writing advisors; run writing and response paper workshops and conduct informal events for students to present their work in progress
  • Review and advise LLM students on their applications to the Winter Term Writing Program and SJD program
  • Review initial SJD study plans and make bibliographical suggestions and recommendations for revisions and refinement of research fields
  • Read drafts of SJD dissertation chapters and offer suggestions on structure, sources, and methodology
  • Review, evaluate, and make recommendations on LLM applications, including assessing substantive legal essays for cogency
  • Support SJD students in developing teaching skills, including advising on teaching fellowship opportunities across Harvard schools
  • Perform other duties and tasks as needed

Basic Qualifications

Graduate degree in law, social sciences, humanities, or similar field with 3 or more years of relevant work experience.

Additional Qualifications and Skills

We are looking for people who:

  • Have independent scholarly interests and experience
  • Demonstrate excellent writing, communication, interpersonal, and time management skills
  • Have experience and enjoy working with a culturally and geographically diverse population
  • Demonstrate sensitivity and empathy in their work with students
  • Have the ability to respond with flexibility and imagination to unanticipated situations
  • Build and foster an internal culture of positive collegiality
  • Take initiative, anticipate needs, and consistently demonstrate resourcefulness, good judgment, and creative problem-solving
  • Consistently go above and beyond the call of duty to ensure smooth teamwork and an excellent student experience and provide responsive and detail-oriented support in a high-volume, service-driven environment
  • Can handle complex and confidential matters with discretion and maturity

In working with SJD candidates, the Associate Director for Graduate Writing and Academics operates at the same meta-level of practical and scholarly judgment as with LLMs but employs greater scholarly sophistication.

Standard Hours/Schedule: Full-time. Weekend and evening work required periodically and during designated times of the year. A strong candidate is an organized and resourceful self-starter who can work independently but is also an excellent team player.

Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position

Pre-Employment Screening: Identity, Education

Other Information:

This position is based primarily on campus with the opportunity for remote work based on business needs and manager approval.

All offers are made by HLS Human Resources.

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that all duties and responsibilities must be performed at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location. Certain visa types may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 058. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions
  • Wellbeing and mental health resources
  • Support for families and caregivers
  • Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
  • Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

title: Økonomi- og regnskabsassistent søges
description:
Har du styr på tallene – og lyst til at gøre en forskel for vores kunder?
Hos Djursland Landboforening har vi travlt, og derfor søger vi en engageret og serviceminded regnskabsassistent til vores afdeling for Økonomi og Regnskab.

Vi hjælper omkring 700 kunder og medlemmer med regnskab, økonomi og rådgivning – og vi er stolte af at være en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og gode relationer går hånd i hånd.

Nu mangler vi dig, som har lyst til at blive en del af holdet.

En hverdag med ansvar, variation og kundekontakt
Som regnskabsassistent bliver du en vigtig del af vores team. Du får en hverdag, hvor du både arbejder selvstændigt med dine opgaver og sparrer med dygtige kolleger.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Bogføring og momsafstemning

  • Udarbejdelse og opstilling af skatteregnskaber og årsrapporter

  • Kvalitetssikring af regnskaber og arbejdsgange

  • Digitalisering og udvikling af vores arbejdsprocesser

  • Kontakt og dialog med kunderne om deres regnskab og økonomi

Vi tilpasser gerne stillingen efter din erfaring, dine kompetencer og det, du brænder for. Måske er du stærk i bogføring, måske har du erfaring med årsrapporter – eller måske har du lyst til at udvikle dig inden for et nyt område.

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tage ansvar og være en del af fællesskabet.

Hos os bliver du ikke bare en medarbejder

Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når man trives.

Derfor får du hos os en arbejdsplads med:

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab. Vi hjælper hinanden, deler vores viden og lægger vægt på et godt samarbejde på tværs af fagområder.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling. Du får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer og få ansvar i takt med dine interesser og erfaringer.

  • En grundig introduktion. Vi sørger for, at du kommer godt fra start og bliver klædt ordentligt på til dine nye opgaver.

  • En arbejdsplads med plads til livet. Vi ved, at arbejdslivet skal fungere sammen med fritid og familie. I travle perioder løfter vi i flok – og når der er mulighed for det, prioriterer vi også fleksibilitet og balance.

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med regnskab og økonomi

  • Har flair for tal og sans for detaljen

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt

  • Er nysgerrig på digitale løsninger og nye arbejdsgange

  • Trives med kundekontakt og kan kommunikere på en imødekommende måde

  • Har lyst til at være en aktiv del af et fagligt og socialt fællesskab

Du behøver ikke at kunne det hele fra dag ét. Det vigtigste for os er din motivation, din tilgang til arbejdet og lysten til at udvikle dig.

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning til afdelingsleder Merete Palk på mpa@landboforening.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller lyst til at høre mere om hverdagen hos os, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Merete på tlf. 8791 2071.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

title: DARBUOTOJŲ SAUGOS, SVEIKATOS IR APLINKOSAUGOS SKYRIAUS VADOVĖ (-AS)
description:

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart!

Prisidėsi prie žalios ir saugios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:

  • Vadovaujant DSSA funkcijai, įskaitant darbuotojų saugos, sveikatos ir aplinkosaugos komandas, užtikrinant efektyvų veiklų koordinavimą, kompetencijų ugdymą ir atskaitomybę;

  • Užtikrinant darbuotojų DSSA kompetencijų ugdymą ir mokymų sistemos veiksmingumą;
  • Koordinuojant rangovų saugos ir aplinkosaugos valdymą bei užtikrinant teisės aktų reikalavimų laikymąsi;
  • Bendradarbiaujant su valstybinėmis institucijomis ir kitomis suinteresuotosiomis šalimis;
  • Prisidedant prie organizacijos pasirengimo krizėms, veiklos tęstinumo ir nuolatinio tobulinimo.
  • Aukštasis universitetinis išsilavinimas darbuotojų saugos, aplinkosaugos, sveikatos mokslų, inžinerijos ar kitoje susijusioje srityje;
  • Sertifikuoto saugos specialisto arba lygiavertė profesinė kvalifikacija;
  • Reikšminga profesinė patirtis DSSA srityje (ne mažiau kaip 10 metų);
  • Sėkminga lyderystės, komandų ugdymo ir veiklų koordinavimo patirtis;
  • DSSA valdysenos, auditų ir atitikties užtikrinimo patirtis;
  • Puikus DSSA reikalavimų išmanymas;
  • Gebėjimas daryti įtaką ir bendradarbiauti su įvairių lygių suinteresuotosioms šalims;
  • Puikios lietuvių ir anglų kalbų žinios žodžiu ir raštu.

Privalumas būtų:

  • Patirtis formuojant ir įgyvendinant DSSA sprendimus sudėtingose pramonės, energetikos ar kitose aukštos rizikos organizacijose;
  • ISO 45001 pagrindinio auditoriaus kvalifikacija ir ISO 14001 vidaus auditoriaus kvalifikacija;
  • NEBOSH diplomas arba lygiavertė tarptautinė kvalifikacija;
  • Pažangūs incidentų tyrimo ir prevencijos mokymai.
  • Už gerus rezultatus kartą į metus skiriamas papildomas priedas (iki 10% metinio atlyginimo);
  • Patogus atvykimas į darbą: darbuotojams, gyvenantiems toliau nei 30 km nuo biuro, yra galimybė pasirašyti panaudos sutartį ir padengti dalį eksploatacijos;
  • Maloni dienos dalis: pusė pietų kainos padengiama įmonės, o kava ir vaisiai visada po ranka;
  • Papildomų naudų paketą pasirenkant: pensijų kaupimą, sveikatos draudimą ar kitą naudą iš pasirenkamų naudų sąrašo „MELP“ programėlėje;
  • Papildomas apmokamas dienas: sveikatinimuisi, trumpalaikės ligos atveju, savanorystei, už sukauptą darbo stažą;
  • Modernią, aukščiausius saugumo reikalavimus atitinkančią darbo aplinką;
  • Plačias mokymosi, kvalifikacijos kėlimo programas;
  • Lyderystės ugdymo programas;
  • Unikalius energetikos transformacijos projektus;
  • Galimybę prisidėti prie nacionalinio energetikos saugumo.

Įvairovė – mūsų stiprybė

Energetika – viena perspektyviausių karjeros sričių, pritraukianti vis daugiau moterų. „Ignitis grupėje“ nuosekliai siekiame šio pokyčio, užtikrindami lygias karjeros galimybes visiems talentams. Mums svarbu:

  • Lyčių balansas lyderystėje – strateginių pareigybių talentų programoje moterų dalis išaugo nuo 27 % iki 39 %.
  • Ekspertų matomumas – žiniasklaidoje cituojamų moterų eksperčių dalis padidėjo nuo 4 % iki 26 %.
  • Karjeros tęstinumas – vaiko priežiūros atostogų metu suteikiame visas papildomas naudas, o sugrįžus peržiūrime atlyginimą.

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart!

Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

title: Solutions Engineer (AI Platforms)
description:
Solutions Engineer (AI Platforms)

At-a-Glance
- Mid-level engineering role deploying an AI platform into complex customer environments
- Integration, configuration and extension of a proprietary AI operating system
- Python, APIs, cloud infrastructure, LLM and agent tooling
- Strong mentoring from senior engineers and a clear route to senior
- Share options and a genuinely AI-first engineering culture

About the Company
My client is a UK technology company building an AI operating and orchestration layer that puts intelligent systems to work inside large, complex organisations where accuracy and accountability really matter. The platform is already live and in daily operational use with major customers. The engineering group is small, senior and unusually fast moving, with AI tooling built into how the team genuinely works rather than bolted on afterwards.

The Role
Getting a powerful AI platform to work inside a customer environment is a real engineering discipline, and this is a chance to learn it properly alongside people who already do it well. You will build integrations with customer data and systems, configure and extend the platform, and help make sure what goes live is robust and observable. You will have your own areas of ownership from early on, with senior engineers close by rather than looking over your shoulder. It suits someone a few solid years into their career who wants to get very good at AI engineering quickly.

Key Responsibilities
- Build integrations with customer data sources and systems
- Configure and extend platform capability to meet customer requirements
- Implement retrieval and agent configurations under senior guidance
- Contribute to monitoring, observability and evaluation of live solutions
- Diagnose and resolve issues in production and secure environments
- Document deployment steps and patterns so they can be repeated
- Take part actively in code and design review
- Feed platform gaps and practical lessons back to core engineering

What You'll Need

Essential:
- 2 to 4 years commercial software engineering experience
- Solid Python and experience working with APIs and integrations
- Some hands-on exposure to cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS
- Practical interest in large language models and agent-based systems, whether professional or self-directed
- Comfortable asking questions and working things out in unfamiliar territory
- Eligible for UK security clearance

Desirable / Nice to Have:
- Any experience deploying software into customer or restricted environments
- Familiarity with graph databases or vector retrieval infrastructure

Why Apply?
- Get properly good at AI engineering somewhere it is used in earnest
- Platform already live with significant enterprise customers
- Share options as part of the package
- Modern AI tooling is standard practice, not a pilot scheme
- Flexible working pattern
- Real mentoring from a small, very senior engineering team
- Clear and visible progression route to senior

Next Steps
Interested? Get in touch with Brendan McCrory at I can talk you through the team, the process and what the client is actually looking for before you decide.

Work From Home

title: Quotations Specialist
description:

Responsible for reviewing bid packages, formulating project quotations, and providing product knowledge.
