Hvis du tænker:

“Det lyder faktisk lige som noget for mig” …
…så vil jeg meget gerne høre fra dig.
Hvis du derimod stoppede med at læse ved “på MIN måde”, så har vi nok allerede sparet hinanden for en jobsamtale. 😂🦑

Jeg glæder mig til at høre fra dig – måske er du den næste blæksprutte på holdet. 🦑

Organisatorisk er Onkologisk Afdeling er en stor afdeling med flere behandlingsafsnit bestående af: os (sengeafsnittet), ambulatorier, strålebehandling, Palliativ Team og Palliativt Sengeafsnit.

Vi er inddelt i seks diagnoserelaterede teams, og du vil blive tilkoblet et af disse teams.

Som SSA i afdelingen vil du opleve mange spændende sygeplejefaglige problemstillinger, da vi både har kurative, palliative og terminale forløb samt akutte forløb. Vi har vores egen akut modtagefunktion alle døgnet timer hvor største delen af vores patienter indlægges gennem. Du får derfor mulighed for at udvikle dine menneskelige, kommunikative og faglige kompetencer, der er også plads til, at du kan dykke yderlig ned i specifikke onkologiske problemstillinger.

Som forberedelse til NYT OUH er det Palliativt sengeafsnit i foråret 2025, fysisk flyttet sammen med Onkologisksengeafsnit, det betyder vi har et tæt samarbejde med personalet i Palliativsengeafsnit og stor mulighed for udvikling af palliative kompetencer som sygeplejerske i Onkologisk Afdeling.

Vi er en god blandet flok af sygeplejersker og social- og sundhedsassistenter med niveauer fra novice til ekspert, og der er plads til alle uanset erfaring. Vi tager god hånd om dig, som er nyansat og hjælper dig trygt og godt på plads i stillingen.

Ud over masser af grin og gode kollegaer, kan også tilbyde dig

  • Et spændende og afvekslende speciale
  • Introduktion og oplæring med mentor
  • Onkologiskole med fagspecifikke emner
  • Kollegasparring
  • Kursusdage i SimC
  • Godt samarbejde med tværfaglige kollegaer, såsom læger, fysioterapeuter, diætister m.m.
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med sociale arrangementer f.eks. fyraftensøl, café besøg mm.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. Hvis du har lyst til en snak eller rundvisning forinden, er du velkommen til at tage kontakt til oversygeplejerske Janne Hammer på telefonnummer 6541 5222 eller TR Kennet Marten på telefonnummer 23604647

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
Role summary

The Staff Data Engineer designs, builds, and operates the data foundation and the evaluation infrastructure behind ServiceNow CRM Agentic AI. The role has two halves that reinforce each other. The first is conventional but demanding data engineering: architecture, pipelines, and transformation across structured and unstructured sources, held to production standards of reliability and quality. The second is newer and rarer: building the measurement layer that tells product and AI teams whether an AI agent actually did its job.

That second half changes the nature of the work. Agent behavior is probabilistic, so quality cannot be asserted, only measured—against metrics that have to be defined before they can be tracked, and against ground truth that someone has to establish and defend. This engineer defines those metrics with product and AI teams, sets the labeling and validation standards, builds the datasets that reflect how agents behave in the real world, and automates the pipelines and dashboards that turn agent execution logs into a signal the organization can act on.

the Staff Data Engineer owns these decisions across a domain rather than within a single project. They set design standards and quality gates others adopt, mentor junior engineers, and generalize evaluation patterns so each Agentic AI team is not rebuilding measurement from scratch.

What you do Design and architect data infrastructure

Design and oversee deployment of the data architecture and pipelines that capture, manage, and store structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources. Establish the processes and data flows across cloud services, local databases, and other applicable storage forms, and own the contracts between data producers and consumers.

Build and automate data transformation

Develop technical tools using machine learning and data-engineering techniques to cleanse, organize, and transform data. Implement automated processes that maintain the integrity of data structures and hold quality standards on an ongoing basis rather than at a point in time.

Define agentic evaluation metrics and ground truth

Partner with product and AI teams to define evaluation metrics for agentic workflows, including task and mission completeness, instruction adherence, tool use, and end-to-end workflow success. Establish ground truth labeling standards, annotation guidelines, and validation criteria, and design evaluation datasets that reflect real-world agent execution rather than idealized paths.

Build agentic evaluation pipelines

Design and implement automated evaluation infrastructure that measures AI agent performance using LLMs and agent execution logs. Create the dashboards, reporting, versioning, and reproducibility that make evaluation datasets and results trustworthy over time and comparable across releases.

Establish standards and continuous improvement

Create design standards and quality assurance processes for data systems. Define quality gates and validation frameworks, analyze workflow performance, and recommend optimizations that keep the platform aligned with evolving CRM AI requirements.

Lead cross-functional collaboration

Collaborate with product, engineering, and data science teams. Mentor junior engineers on data engineering and evaluation design, and generalize evaluation patterns and metrics so they can be reused across Agentic AI products rather than rebuilt per team.

Required qualifications

  • Data engineering depth. 8+ years in data engineering, with a record of owning production data platforms end-to-end. Depth and demonstrated judgment matter more than tenure.
  • Domain ownership. Demonstrated ownership of a data domain or platform, including architecture decisions, migrations, and the operational consequences of both.
  • Evaluation infrastructure experience. Hands-on experience building measurement or evaluation infrastructure for machine learning or AI systems: evaluation pipelines, benchmark harnesses, quality dashboards, or golden datasets. This is the gating requirement for the role.
  • Ground truth and labeling. Experience defining ground truth and running or directing labeling work, including guideline authoring and annotator agreement.
  • Core technical stack. Production Python, strong SQL, distributed processing, workflow orchestration, a cloud data platform, and infrastructure-as-code, with continuous integration and on-call experience.
  • Standard setting. Evidence of setting standards that others adopted, such as design standards, quality gates, or validation frameworks, rather than only meeting standards already in place.
  • CRM and Order domain familiarity. Sales CRM, lead-to-cash, or order data familiarity, at a depth sufficient to judge whether an evaluation dataset reflects how sellers and agents actually work.
  • Internal programs. Demonstrated experience in internal evaluation programs and patterns such as automated evaluation suites, data kits, or AI data factory approaches.
  • Mentorship and generalization. Mentorship of junior engineers, and a record of generalizing a solution so that it was reused across teams or products.
  • Education. Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

title: Vil du have fleksible dagvagter og gøre en forskel for mennesker med erhvervet hjerneskade? Bliv tilkaldevikar på Botilbuddet Viben i København NV
description:
Har du lyst til et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du gør en forskel for mennesker med erhvervet hjerneskade? Og har du brug for fleksibilitet i dit arbejdsliv? Så kan du blive en del af Viben som tilkaldevikar.

Vi søger engagerede tilkaldevikarer til dagvagter på både hverdage og i weekender.

Fleksible vagter, der kan tilpasses dig
Vagterne ligger som udgangspunkt kl. 07.00-15.00, men vi er fleksible i planlægningen. Har du fx først mulighed for at møde kl. 08.00 eller brug for at gå kl. 13.30, kan vi aftale vagten ud fra dine muligheder.

Velkommen til Viben
Viben er en del af Center for Længerevarende Boformer under Socialforvaltningen i Københavns Kommune. Vi er et botilbud for 35 voksne borgere med erhvervet hjerneskade fordelt på fire etager.

Vi ligger i København NV tæt på park, station og byliv og har blandt andet et hyggeligt gårdmiljø med sansegynge og bålplads, som vi bruger til sociale aktiviteter med beboerne.

På Viben arbejder vi målrettet på at skabe et hjem, hvor beboerne kan trives og have en høj livskvalitet. Vi har fokus på etik, medbestemmelse og inddragelse i eget liv.

Vi lægger vægt på faglig refleksion, kollegial og ledelsesmæssig sparring og en respektfuld og anerkendende omgangstone.

Læs mere om Viben og vores tilbud på Viben | Handicap.

Hvad skal du lave?
Som tilkaldevikar bliver du en del af hverdagen på Viben og løser forskellige opgaver sammen med dine kolleger. Opgaverne kan blandt andet være

  • plejeopgaver
  • pædagogiske opgaver
  • praktisk støtte som fx tøjvask, oprydning og lettere rengøring
  • dokumentation i vores dokumentationssystem
  • medicinadministration efter gældende instrukser og oplæring
Opgaverne varierer fra dag til dag, og du får mulighed for at bruge både dine faglige og personlige kompetencer.

Vi søger dig, som

  • har lyst til at tage dagvagter og kan træde til, når der er behov
  • trives i en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens
  • kan kommunikere tydeligt og målrettet og har forståelse for kommunikation som en del af den pædagogiske praksis
  • har gode IT-kundskaber og kan formulere dig godt både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • forstår betydningen af god dokumentation
  • har respekt for borgernes selv- og medbestemmelse
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og ansvarsbevidst
Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du møder borgerne med respekt, tager ansvar og har lyst til at lære. Du får en god oplæring og mulighed for at spørge dine kolleger til råds.

Hos os får du

  • et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du gør en forskel for andre
  • fleksibilitet i forhold til planlægning af dine vagter
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel, faglighed og udvikling
  • en hverdag med forskellige og udviklende opgaver
  • god oplæring og mulighed for sparring med kolleger og ledelse
  • en arbejdsplads med plads til forskellighed og mangfoldighed
Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst.

Du ansættes som tilkaldevikar og tilbydes vagter, når vores faste medarbejdere er fraværende. Der vil være mulighed for både dag- og weekendvagter.

Ved tilbud om ansættelse indhenter vi straffeattest og relevante referencer.

Vil du vide mere?
Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Stephan Veislinger på 21 58 96 12.

Din ansøgning skal sendes via stillingsopslaget, da vi ikke aftaler jobsamtaler over telefonen.

Husk at vedhæfte dit CV sammen med din ansøgning.

Søg via linket senest fredag den 25. september 2026

title: ASIC Verification Technical Leader
description:
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) delivers the silicon, optics, and hardware platforms for Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products. We craft the networking hardware for Enterprises and Service Providers, the Public Sector, and Non-Profit Organizations across the world. Cisco Silicon One (#CiscoSiliconOne) is the only unifying silicon architecture in the market that enables customers to deploy the best-of-breed silicon from Top of Rack (TOR) switches all the way through web scale data centers and across service provider, enterprise networks, and data centers with a fully unified routing and switching portfolio. Come join us and take part in shaping Cisco's ground-breaking solutions by crafting, developing and testing some of the most sophisticated ASICs being developed in the industry. You will engage in dynamic collaboration with verification engineers, designers, and multi-functional teams, working together to ensure the successful verification of the ASIC throughout its lifecycle.


Your Impact

You will contribute to developing Cisco’s progressive data center solutions by crafting industry-leading sophisticated chips, with full exposure to all aspects of our systems and applications, including silicon, hardware, software, telemetry, and security. Specific responsibilities include:


• Architect block, cluster and top-level DV environment infrastructure.

• Develop DV infrastructure from scratch.

• Maintain and improve existing DV environments.

• Develop test plans and tests for qualifying design at block, cluster and higher-level environments with mix of constraint random and advised stimulus.

• Ensure complete verification coverage through implementation and review of code and functional coverage.

• Ensure RTL quality with qualifying the design with Gate Level Simulations on netlist.

• Collaborate closely with designers, architects, and software teams to address and debug issues during post-silicon bring-up, ensuring seamless integration and efficient performance.

• Support testing of design in emulation.

• Lead all aspects of and manage the ASIC bring-up process.


Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or master’s Degree in equivalent experience in EE, CE, or other related field.

• 10+ years of related ASIC design verification experience.

• Proficient in ASIC verification using UVM/System Verilog.

• Proficient in verifying sophisticated blocks, clusters and top level for ASIC.

• Experience building test benches from scratch, hands on experience with System Verilog constraints, structures and classes.

• Scripting experience with Perl and/or Python.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Networking ASICs would be an advantage

• Experience with Forwarding logic/Parsers/Buffer management/Arbitration and scheduling

• Experience with Veloce/Palladium/Zebu/HAPS.

• Formal verification (iev/vc formal) knowledge.

• Demonstrated ability on one or more protocols (PCIe, Ethernet, RDMA, IPv4/6, TCP).


Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Product Manager - Accounting & Finance
description:
Product Manager – Accounting & Finance

Location: Fort Lauderdale, Florida – Hybrid
Florida is preferred, although we’re open to considering candidates based further afield depending on experience and suitability.

Description

Pinewood.AI is seeking a driven, collaborative, and commercially minded Product Manager to lead the development of our Accounting functionality within our Automotive Intelligence Platform. This is a key role within our Product Team, focused on building smart, integrated solutions that help automotive retailers improve financial control, operational efficiency, compliance, and profitability.

As part of the team shaping the future of our platform, you’ll work closely with Project Delivery Managers, Developers, Support, Account Management, and commercial teams to translate dealership needs, accounting requirements, and market opportunities into impactful software features. You’ll become the go-to subject matter expert for your product area, helping shape the roadmap, prioritise development, and communicate the value of what we build both internally and externally.

We’re open to people who have taken different routes into product. You might already be an experienced Product Manager or Product Owner with knowledge of automotive accounting, or you could be an experienced dealership accounting or finance professional with strong systems knowledge who is interested in moving into a product-focused role. What matters is a strong understanding of dealership accounting, an aptitude for technology, and the ability to turn real-world customer problems into practical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

    • Own and develop the product vision and roadmap for Accounting functionality, aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and the requirements of the North American automotive retail market.
    • Build deep expertise in dealership accounting workflows and act as a subject matter expert for your product area across the business.
    • Work with Project Delivery Managers and Developers to define, refine, and prioritise deliverables using clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
    • Collaborate with Account Management and Partner Support teams to gather feedback, understand dealership needs, identify opportunities, and resolve product issues.
    • Translate accounting requirements, customer feedback, market insight, and relevant regulatory change into clear and practical product requirements.
    • Own and maintain a prioritised feature backlog, balancing customer value, commercial impact, financial and regulatory requirements, risk, and technical considerations.
    • Sign off new functionality and ensure high-quality releases that deliver clear value for customers.
    • Engage with technical teams to provide context and direction on functionality, ensuring solutions meet requirements and are technically feasible.
    • Represent your product area in customer, partner, and manufacturer discussions, gathering market insight and communicating our product direction and value.
    • Act as an internal champion for your product, communicating progress, releases, and product value while using customer feedback and product performance to drive continuous improvement.

Requirements

    • Strong experience and knowledge of accounting within an automotive retail or dealership environment, with a good understanding of dealership accounting processes, systems, and financial workflows.
    • We’re open to candidates from different professional backgrounds. You may already be a Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar, or you may be an experienced automotive accounting professional looking to move into a product-focused role.
    • Strong understanding of accounting processes such as general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, reconciliation, financial reporting, transaction processing, and month-end activities.
    • Knowledge of US accounting requirements and financial controls, including familiarity with US GAAP and the accounting and tax considerations that affect automotive retailers.
    • A strong understanding of how dealership accounting requirements translate into systems, processes, and day-to-day user workflows.
    • Experience working with software development teams, technology projects, or within a SaaS environment would be advantageous, but is not essential for candidates bringing strong automotive accounting and systems expertise.
    • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to assess priorities based on customer needs, business value, risk, and operational impact.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting requirements clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Highly organised and detail-oriented, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    • Knowledge of dealership management systems, accounting software, sales tax, payment processing, financial integrations, or relevant regulatory and compliance requirements would be advantageous.

Benefits

  • A very competitive salary
  • Excellent bonus scheme
  • Flexible mix of home and office working
  • 4 weeks PTO
  • 401k
  • Excellent health insurance benefits
  • Regular 1-2-1s and career development opportunities

Why join Pinewood.AI?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a strategically important product area as Pinewood.AI continues to grow its presence in North America. Accounting sits at the heart of dealership operations, and you’ll have a genuine opportunity to influence how our platform supports the financial processes of automotive retailers across the US.

We also recognise that great product people don’t all come from the same background. If you’ve spent your career working in dealership accounting or finance, you already understand many of the problems our Product Team is trying to solve. You’ll be supported by experienced product, delivery, and development colleagues who can help you build your product management skills, while you bring the accounting, systems, and customer knowledge that helps us build the right solutions.

Equally, if you’re already an experienced Product Manager with automotive accounting knowledge, you’ll have the autonomy to take ownership of an important product area, shape its direction, and work directly with customers and technical teams to bring that vision to life.

With Pinewood.AI expanding in North America, you’ll be joining at an exciting stage of our growth, with the opportunity to directly influence both our product and how we support automotive retailers in the market.


About Us

Our story began more than 20 years ago with a clear purpose to create technology designed around the real needs of automotive retailers. As automotive professionals as well as technologists, we built practical solutions that help dealerships run more efficiently and deliver outstanding customer experiences.

Today, Pinewood.AI is a market leader in dealership management and automotive intelligence. Our cloud-based platform connects every part of a retailer’s business, including vehicle sales, service, parts, workshop, finance, insurance, stock management, customer relationship management, and business reporting. By bringing everything together in one intelligent system, we help retailers and manufacturers make better decisions, improve performance, and increase profitability.

We are now expanding into North America, bringing our proven platform to a new audience. This is an important stage in our growth where we are building our presence in the United States and Canada. Joining Pinewood.AI at this time means becoming part of a fast-growing, startup-style team that is supported by an established and successful global business. You will play a key role in introducing and embedding our platform across North American dealerships.

title: PhD scholarship in AI Regulation and Risk
description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for a vacant PhD scholarship within the fields of AI Regulation and Risk at the Department of Business Humanities and Law. Expected starting date is 1 February 2027.

About Department of Business Humanities and Law (BHL) at CBS
Department of Business Humanities and Law explores how people, organisations, institutions, and societies shape business. Its core research themes include entrepreneurship, business ethics, leadership, governance, culture, learning, business history, and business law from commercial and societal perspectives. The department comprises three academic units and nine reseach groups.

CBS LAW group at the Department of Business Humanities and Law at Copenhagen Business School, conducts research on business law from both a societal and a commercial perspective, with particular attention to the substance of, and the interplay between, international law, EU law and national law. Among its principal focus areas is digital regulation, including its influence on business practice and on digital policymaking. The department accordingly offers substantial research and supervision capacity in IT law, internet law, telecommunications regulation and platform regulation. Its key research areas in recent years have been the regulation of artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and risk-based regulation.

These competences are represented at three principal domains: EU digital policy, comprising the manner in which EU legislation is made, the factors that shape regulatory choice, and the comparative dimension of digital lawmaking; risk-based regulation in the digital sector, including the compliance challenges that organisations encounter in implementing instruments such as the AI Act, the GDPR and EU cybersecurity legislation; and strategic compliance management, an approach that treats compliance as a source of competitive advantage rather than a cost of doing business, by embedding legal obligations in strategy and operations.

Teaching responsibilities of the Department include undergraduate and graduate teaching in business law including digital regulation, IT law, AI regulation, cybersecurity, etc.

PhD project
The project should concentrate on risk-based nature of AI regulation and digital regulation in general. In that sense, it should be looking at either the policy side – when is risk-based appropriate and why is it chosen – or the strategy/operational side – how companies work with assessing and mitigating risk in an intensive compliance environment.

Examples of research areas a scholarship might cover:
  • Risk-based regulation as a regulatory technique
  • The regulatory stack: AI Act, GDPR and sectoral law in interaction
  • Translating the EU AI Act into corporate governance
  • AI, cybersecurity and value-chain accountability
  • The political economy of EU digital lawmaking


The three-year PhD programme at CBS gives you the opportunity to conduct research under the supervision of CBS’s associate professors and professors, supported by research related PhD courses. The programme is highly international, and you are expected to participate in international research conferences and to spend time at another research institution as a visiting PhD student. See the CBS homepage for more information about the PhD programme, .

CBS PhD graduates are held in high esteem not only in academia and research institutions but also in government and business where their research qualifications are in high demand.

CBS is committed to ensuring excellence, transformative and relevant teaching and research. Candidates who wish to join us must be interested in working in an organisation of this type and it is expected that the applicant shows an interest in joining the department's research environment. You can read more about the department's research here: www.cbs.dk/bhl.

Application and admission requirements

The department will give priority to applicants with high grades from their universities.
To be considered the applicant must
  • have a basic education at master's level (corresponding to the 3 + 2 Bologna process)
  • have received the grade of 10 (or equivalent) for the master's thesis according to the Danish 7-point grading scale()
  • have a weighted grade point average of at least 8.2 on the Danish 7-point grading scale for the bachelor's and master's degree combined or alternatively a weighted grade point average must be at least 9.5 for the master's degree alone. If the grade point average is not met, documentation for being in the top 40% of the class is also accepted.
  • have an educational background in law, regulation and/or related disciplines
  • have completed the master's programme before starting the PhD programme at CBS
  • master academic English at a high level in writing and speaking

The application (see link below) must include a five-page PhD project description. The project description must include:
  • a presentation of an original research question
  • a description of the initial theoretical framework and method
  • a presentation of the proposed empirical material
  • a work plan for the three years

More information can be found here:

In addition to the project description, copies of the following must be included:
  • motivation cover letter
  • diploma for bachelor's and master's degree or other certificates at an equivalent level as well as the grade transcripts
  • documentation for being in the top 40% of the class (if grade requirements are not met). In rare cases, the grade requirement can be waived.
  • a concise curriculum vitae (CV)
  • a list of articles and publications (if applicable)
  • one example of a selected written work (e.g. master's thesis)
  • documentation of English language skills is not required for the application but may be requested if the applicant is shortlisted for interviews.

The PhD student is enrolled in the CBS PhD School. Further information about PhD scholarships and the PhD programme can be found at .

For further information please contact Professor Andrej Savin, email asa.bhl@cbs.dk or Head of Department Pia Bramming, email pib.bhl@cbs.dk. Information about the department can be found at

Employment and salary
A PhD scholarship runs for a period of three years and includes teaching obligations corresponding to 416 work hours. The scholarships are fully salaried positions, according to the national Danish collective agreement. The monthly salary is currently approximately DKK 30,264 up to DKK 36,877 depending on seniority and a pension contribution totalling 18,07 %. The scholarship includes tuition fees, office space, course and travel costs (according to the current CBS agreement).

Salary level and employment take place in accordance with the Ministry of Finance's agreement with the Academics' Central Organization.

Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee comprised of tenured faculty shortlists at least two-five applicants to be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline.

Applicants shortlisted for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and will receive the result of their personal assessment later. When the assessment committee has finished their work selected applicants will be invited for an interview. Please note that a positive assessment does not automatically result in an interview. Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

The application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system.

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see above), by the application deadline.

Details about Copenhagen Business School are available at .

Application due 9/27/2026

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About Us

Our shared vision is to develop and operate the most successful, innovative, and comprehensive platform for the motor insurance market within the Allianz Group and beyond. We deliver high-quality solutions, embrace agile values, and foster a collaborative and motivating work environment.

As part of the NOVA / BiPRO Firmen Kraft Team, you will contribute to the development of innovative solutions for the commercial motor insurance market, supporting sales applications, service routes, and integration interfaces that drive business success.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable microservices and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build and enhance modern Angular-based frontends integrated with backend services.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Own end-to-end feature implementation, from design and development to deployment and support.
  • Ensure software quality through automated testing, code reviews, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Monitor and maintain application performance, stability, security, and production support activities.
  • Develop and maintain integrations and interfaces with internal Allianz systems and external services.

Your Requirements

  • Several years of experience with Java 17+, Spring Boot, and modern backend development, including microservices architecture.
  • Strong experience with Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS/SCSS, and frontend-backend integration.
  • Solid knowledge of RESTful APIs and SOAP-based services, with experience in system integrations and message routing technologies such as Apache Camel.
  • Proficiency with Git, code reviews, pull requests, Maven, IntelliJ, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and GitHub Actions.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing using JUnit, Mockito, and preferably frontend testing frameworks such as Jest, Jasmine, Cypress, or Playwright.
  • Experience with cloud-native and containerized environments, including Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Spring Cloud, and Spring Security.
  • Ability to work independently in agile, cross-functional teams, communicate technical decisions effectively, troubleshoot complex applications, and leverage modern AI-powered development tools and workflows.

What we offer

  • We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
  • We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
  • From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
  • Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.

About Allianz Technology

Allianz Technology is the global IT service provider for Allianz and delivers IT solutions that drive the digitalization of the Group. With more than 10,000 employees located in 55 countries around the globe, Allianz Technology works together with other Allianz entities in pioneering the digitalization of the financial services industry.

We oversee the full digitalization spectrum – from one of the industry’s largest IT infrastructure projects that includes data centers, networking and security, to application platforms that span from workplace services to digital interaction. In short, we deliver full-scale, end-to-end IT solutions for Allianz in the digital age.

D&I statement

Allianz Technology is proud to be an equal opportunity employer encouraging diversity in the working environment. We are interested in your strengths and experience. We welcome all applications from all people regardless of gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, age, nationality, religion, disability, or philosophy of life.

Join us. Let´s care for tomorrow.

You. IT

title: Expedition Logistics Employee
description:
We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Expedition Logistics Employee to join our operations team in Weert, Netherlands. In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and managing logistics operations to ensure timely and efficient expedition of goods. You will work with multiple stakeholders to optimize supply chain processes, maintain accurate documentation, and support the smooth execution of shipments from our Weert facility.

  • Coordinate expedition planning and logistics operations, including scheduling, routing, and resource allocation
  • Manage inventory tracking and maintain accurate records of shipments, ensuring all documentation is complete and compliant
  • Communicate with vendors, carriers, and internal teams to confirm delivery schedules and resolve logistics issues
  • Prepare and process shipping documentation, including customs forms and international shipping requirements
  • Monitor shipment status and provide timely updates to relevant stakeholders
  • Analyze logistics data to identify inefficiencies and recommend process improvements
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company logistics protocols
  • Support warehouse operations and coordinate with warehouse staff to facilitate efficient loading and unloading
  • Maintain organized records and databases using logistics management systems
  • Troubleshoot logistics challenges and implement solutions to minimize delays
  • Proven experience in logistics operations, expedition coordination, or supply chain management
  • Proficiency with logistics software and inventory management systems
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and data entry
  • Knowledge of international shipping regulations and customs procedures
  • Solid communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Problem-solving abilities and capability to work independently
  • Familiarity with warehouse management systems and supply chain processes
  • Experience with route planning and vendor management (preferred)
  • Knowledge of European logistics standards and regulations (preferred)

But first this. We have already asked quite a few things from you, so you can also expect an attractive package of employment conditions in return. In addition to offering you a challenging position as a Logistics Employee Order Planning and Follow-up within an international employer, you will also receive:

  • High degree of responsibility and independence.
  • Good primary and secondary employment conditions with a gross monthly salary between €3,000 and €3,750 gross depending on age and experience.
  • A pleasant and professional working environment.
  • The secondary employment conditions include 27 vacation days, 13 ADV days, flexible working hours, a discount on your fitness subscription, a bicycle plan and a profit-sharing arrangement.
  • A fun and challenging position!

title: Arbejdstidsplanlæggere til Granbo og Møllebækken
description:
Er du dedikeret arbejdstidsplanlægger med blik for både drift, samarbejde og fleksibilitet?
Har du erfaring med arbejdstidsplanlægning og lyst til at være en central nøgleperson i et højt specialiseret socialområde? Motiveres du af at få hverdagen til at hænge sammen for både medarbejdere og ledelse, så der skabes ro, overblik og sikker drift? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som arbejdstidsplanlægger til Granbo og Møllebækken i Specialområde Børn og Unge (SBU). Vi søger to medarbejdere, der kan etablere sig som et stærkt vagtplanlæggerteam på tværs af de to institutioner.

Om stillingen
Du bliver organisatorisk tilknyttet Granbo og Møllebækken, som er to af SBU’s døgntilbud til børn og unge med særlige behov. Granbo og Møllebækken deler ledelse og det forventes derfor, at man kan varetage planlægnings- og administrationsopgaver på tværs af de to tilbud.

Som arbejdstidsplanlægger bliver du en vigtig samarbejdspartner for ledelsen og medarbejderne, og du får en central rolle i at sikre, at arbejdstidsplanerne understøtter både kerneopgaven, medarbejdernes ønsker og gældende regler og aftaler.

Du bliver sammen med din nye kollega en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab gennem SBU's planlæggernetværk, hvor videndeling og sparring er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Derudover får du løbende støtte fra SBU Administrationen samt adgang til specialiseret rådgivning fra Socialstabens konsulenter inden for arbejdstid, løn og overenskomstforhold.

Dine opgaver
Du skal blandt andet arbejde med:
  • Udarbejdelse og vedligeholdelse af arbejds- og grundplaner
  • Daglig arbejdstidsplanlægning og bemandingsstyring
  • Ferieplanlægning, afspadsering og håndtering af vikarbehov
  • Løbende tilpasning af vagtplaner ved sygdom og øvrige ændringer
  • Lønrelaterede registreringer og fraværsregistrering
  • Koordinator- og tovholderfunktion i MyPlan/PDC Plan
  • Administrative opgaver som varemodtagelse og andet økonomi
  • Rådgivning og vejledning af ledere og medarbejdere om arbejdstidsregler og planlægningsmæssige forhold
  • Introduktion og oplæring af nye medarbejdere i planlægningssystemet
  • Bidrag til udvikling og kvalitetssikring af planlægningsområdet
  • Tværgående opgaver mellem Granbo og Møllebækken efter behov
Det bringer du med dig
Vi søger erfarne arbejdstidsplanlæggere – gerne fra social-, sundheds- eller specialområdet – og som trives med at skabe overblik i en hverdag med mange hensyn og komplekse sammenhænge. Du har erfaring med PDC Plan/MyPlan eller et tilsvarende planlægningssystem og motiveres af at finde løsninger, der både understøtter kerneopgaven, medarbejdernes ønsker og de gældende arbejdstidsregler og overenskomster. Derudover skal du være interesseret i og klar på at varetage andre forefaldende administrative opgaver.

Som person arbejder du struktureret, systematisk og med blik for detaljen. Du er samtidig god til at skabe relationer og samarbejde med både ledere og medarbejdere, fordi du ved, at de bedste løsninger findes i dialog med dem, der berøres af planlægningen. Du kommunikerer klart og respektfuldt, er serviceminded og møder andre med en løsningsorienteret tilgang.

Derudover har du flair for administrative systemer og digitale værktøjer, og du trives i en rolle, hvor dagene sjældent er ens. Du formår at bevare overblikket, når planer ændres, og du kan prioritere opgaverne, så både drift, kvalitet og trivsel understøttes bedst muligt. Vi forestiller os, at du ser god arbejdstidsplanlægning som en vigtig forudsætning for, at medarbejdere, ledelse og tilbud kan lykkes med den fælles kerneopgave.

Vi tilbyder
  • En spændende og selvstændig nøglefunktion tæt på driften
  • Mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel for medarbejdere, ledelse og den samlede opgaveløsning
  • En arbejdsplads præget af høj faglighed, samarbejde og udvikling
  • Et stærkt fagligt netværk af arbejdstidsplanlæggere på tværs af SBU
  • Sparring og støtte fra SBU Administrationen og Socialstaben
  • Grundig introduktion til opgaverne og specialområdet
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling
Om Specialområde Børn og Unge
SBU er en del af Socialområdet i Region Midtjylland og tilbyder højt specialiserede indsatser til børn og unge med komplekse udviklingsmæssige, sociale og funktionsmæssige udfordringer. Vores fælles mål er at skabe trygge rammer, der understøtter trivsel, læring, udvikling og livskvalitet for de børn og unge, vi er sat i verden for at hjælpe.

SBU omfatter døgntilbud, interne skoler og specialiserede indsatser på flere lokationer i regionen. Vores løsninger skabes i tæt samarbejde med kommuner, pårørende og andre vigtige aktører, så vi sammen kan sikre de bedst mulige rammer for børnene og de unges hverdag, udvikling og fremtid.

Du kan læse mere om Specialområde Børn og Unge på .

Ansættelsesvilkår
  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem Danske Regioner og HK Kommunal.
  • Ansættelsesform: Fast fuldtidsstilling.
  • Der indhentes børneattest og straffeattest i forbindelse med ansættelsen.
  • Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt og senest d. 01.11.2026
  • Ansøgningsfrist: 11.09.2026
  • Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes i uge 38
Vil du vide mere?
Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Sebastian Hvidt, afdelingsleder på Møllebækken på telefon 29133431 eller Malene Hegnet, konstitueret afdelingsleder på Granbo på telefon 23356022.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Sygeplejerske søges til Plejehjemmet Havkær i distrikt Nord, Aarhus Kommune - Genopslag
description:
Om jobbet:
Plejehjemmet Havkær søger en sygeplejerske med en bred faglig rygsæk og hjertet på rette sted, som har lyst til at indgå i et tværfagligt team og bidrage til at skabe trivsel og livskvalitet for vores beboere.

Da en af vores dygtige sygeplejersker skal ud at opleve verden, søger vi en ny sygeplejerske i et vikariat frem til september 2028.

Vi søger dig, der brænder for at skabe livskvalitet for beboerne på plejehjemmet Havkær sammen med tværfaglige kolleger, beboere og deres familier. Du bliver en del af et velfungerende team med høj faglighed og positiv energi og sammenhold.

En typisk hverdag på Havkær kan være, at du møder ind til vores morgenmøde, hvor beboerne gennemgås (triagering) og aktuelle problemstillinger som skal vurderes. Derefter koordinerer du dagens program med din sygeplejerskekollega, for at koordinere, hvem, der varetager hvilke opgaver. Derefter skal du med ud til beboerne, så du kan støtte SOSU assistenter og hjælpere i de komplekse forløb, eller fordi du er i gang med den sygeplejefaglige udredning. Måske er der en beboer, der er dårlig, hvilket kræver hurtig kontakt til plejehjemmets læge og pårørende, for at afklare videre behandling. Måske skal du arrangere et hjemmebesøg, fordi du er forløbsansvarlig for en ny beboer. Mulighederne er mange og du er selv med at sætte rammerne.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at stillingen ligger inden for det døgndækkede område. P.t. forventes tjenesten fortrinsvis at være i dagvagt med weekendvagt hver 14. uge.

Din profil:
Vi søger en sygeplejerske, som kan indgå i vores tværfaglige team med godt humør og en positiv energi.

Derudover så tænker vi, at:

  • Du drives af faglighed og med blik for at skabe livskvalitet for beboerne og deres netværk.
  • Du kan samarbejde, arbejde selvstændigt, justere og evaluere beboernes i tæt samarbejde dine kolleger og huset øvrige samarbejdspartner f.eks. plejehjemslægerne, der kommer fast til stuegang hver 14. dag.
  • Du er omstillingsparat i en hverdag, hvor det eneste sikre er, at det kan være uforudsigeligt.
  • Du tør at italesætte problemstillinger og tage svære samtaler med beboere og pårørende.
  • Du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret, men samtidig er du en del af et fællesskab.

Derfor skal du vælge os:
Vi er et mangfoldigt team, der består af mange forskellige fagligheder, og vi har respekt for hinandens faglighed. Vi er en god blanding af kollegaer med forskellig erfaring, hvilket giver en god dynamik og gode sparringspartnere. Vi tror på, at der skal være plads til alle, og det gør os stærke.

Som sygeplejerske på Havkær får du mulighed for:

  • At arbejde med det hele menneske.
  • Udvikle din sygeplejefaglige viden.
  • Mulighed for at opstarte, følge forløb og indsatser over tid.
  • En god sygeplejegruppe på tværs af plejehjemmene i distrikt nord.
  • At arbejde med kvalitetsarbejde som en del af forbedringsteamet.


Om afdelingen:
Plejehjemmet Havkær er beliggende i Tilst og rummer 38 lejligheder fordelt i 4 huse. Husene er år tilbage blevet forbundet af gange, så man frit kan bevæge sig mellem husene. Hvert hus har en lille gårdhave med blomster, gyngesofa og mulighed for, at beboerne kan nyde solen med en kop kaffe.

Selvom plejehjemmet er opdelt i 4 separate huse, så arbejder vi som ét plejehjem, hvor vi er afhængige af hinandens kompetencer.

Vi er et velfungerende plejehjem, hvor vi arbejder struktureret og vil bruge vores tid bedst muligt, så beboerne får den bedste omsorg. Vi vil også gerne arbejde endnu mere med kvalitet i vores hverdag og har masser af ambitioner.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Stillingen ønskes tiltrådt den 1. november 2026.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og efter konkret forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation.

Ugentligt timetal: 37 timer.


Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til forstander Maria Leegård Thomsen på tlf.nr.: 2332 3134 eller mail: maleth@aarhus.dk.


Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 20. september 2026.

Vi forventer at afvikle jobsamtaler løbende.

I Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg har vi en generel politik om, at der ved ansættelser indhentes referencer og evt. straffeattest. Du må derfor forvente at blive anmodet herom, hvis vi tilbyder dig stillingen.
Vi gør opmærksom på, at der i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen vil blive foretaget opslag i vores referenceregister. Referenceregisteret omfatter tidligere medarbejdere i Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg, der er blevet bortvist grundet væsentlig misligholdelse af ansættelsesforholdet.


Om Sundhed og Omsorg og Aarhus Kommune:

Sundhed og Omsorg (MSO) i Aarhus Kommune arbejder med omsorg for ældre og sundhed for alle borgere.


Aarhus Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle - uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold - til at ansøge stillingen.
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus til en god by for alle. Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Specialpædagog til Heltidstilbuddet på Mølleholmskolen
description:
Brænder du for at arbejde læringsorienteret med børn, der har kognitiv funktionsnedsættelse, der indimellem er kombineret med andre specifikke diagnoser, og har du lyst til at være en del af en dedikeret og professionel arbejdskultur med mulighed for egen udvikling?

Vær med til at:

  • arbejde ud fra en tydelig specialpædagogisk tilgang.
  • understøtte udviklingen af børnenes dannelse.
  • videreudvikle og sætte dit præg på Heltidstilbuddets mellemtrin.
  • skabe en struktureret hverdag ud fra børnenes færdigheder.

Vi er narrativt funderet i Heltidstilbuddet
I Heltidstilbuddet er vi en kollegagruppe på 60 pædagoger og lærere. Vi er normeret til 69 børn og unge i alderen 6-18 år, hvor flertallet af børnene er fysisk selvhjulpne og har et aktivt verbalt sprog – dog sjældent aldersvarende.

Hos os er undervisningen og de socialpædagogiske aktiviteter flettet sammen over hele dagen, hvor lærere og pædagoger arbejder tæt sammen omkring det enkelte barns udvikling af de skolefaglige, personlige og sociale kompetencer. Vi arbejder med det narrative i praksis – både i forhold til elever, forældre og hinanden.

Stillingen er i Mellemtrinnet/udskoling i Heltidstilbuddet
Du bliver en del af vores mellemtrin, hvor der er 14 børn og 12 medarbejdere. Børnene er delt i tre hold, hvor du bliver fast tilknyttet det ene hold, der består af to lærere og to pædagoger. Vi tilstræber en planlægning, hvor I altid er to voksne sammen med fem børn.

Vi sætter en dyd i høj faglighed
Du bliver en del af et dedikeret medarbejderteam med forskellige styrker og fagligheder, der ser det tætte samarbejde og den faglige sparring som essentielt for arbejdet. Vi er nysgerrige og åbne og reflekterer sammen over vores pædagogfaglige praksis - og du ved ligeledes, hvorfor du handler, som du gør og tør sætte din egen praksis til diskussion.

Vi vægter faglig udvikling af alle medarbejdere højt, og har temadage/fællesundervisning, hvor vi løbende tilfører ny viden. Senest har vi har en pædagogisk dag med Bo Hejlskov, og til foråret der pædagogisk weekend med temaet: udvidet diagnoseperspektiv. Vi har god forberedelsestid og fast tid sat af hver uge sat af til pædagogisk sparring på eget hold.

Vi har opmærksomhed på de forskellige kompetencer, vi har internt i personalegruppen. Hos os er der mulighed for både at undervise og få undervisning af sine kolleger, når vi videndeler, genbesøger og sliber de pædagogiske redskaber, som vi bruger.

Du skaber læring, der understøtter dannelse
Du formår at få øje på udviklingspotentialerne i børnene og understøtter dem i at lykkes med at lære nyt. Du er entusiastisk og har gå-på-mod ift. at varetage en undervisende funktion.

Vi lægger desuden vægt på, at du:

  • er uddannet pædagog – gerne med erfaring indenfor specialområdet.
  • har en special eller socialpædagogisk tilgang.
  • er robust og har en positiv grundindstilling til opgaveløsningen.
  • er struktureret og kan se hvordan en hverdag hænger godt sammen.
  • er bevidst om dine svage og stærke sider, og bruger det aktivt i teamsamarbejdet.
  • kan gribe bolden her og nu – men også drible det lange seje træk.

Du er en eftertragtet samarbejdspartner
Dine samarbejdsevner er i top. Du giver glædeligt en hjælpende hånd med, når behovet melder sig, og du formår samtidig at trække på dine kollegers styrker. Du ser det tætte forældresamarbejde som en fordel for børnenes trivsel. Det er samtidig vigtigt, at du har lyst til at blive en del af vores netværksskabende miljø, der er en del af vores fundament.

Du strukturerer dagligdagen og har flair for positiv kommunikation
Det falder dig naturligt at skabe og indgå i en struktureret hverdag og ved, at det er forudsætningen for en velfungerende dagligdag. Du lægger vægt på en positiv tilrettevisende og anerkendende kommunikation.

Bliv en del af en kultur, hvor vi tager hånd om hinanden
I opstartsfasen bliver du tilknyttet en mentor, der sørger for at klæde dig på, så du kommer godt ind i jobbet, opgaverne og kulturen. Vi har en tilgængelig afdelingsleder med en tillidsbaseret tilgang til ledelse.

Yderligere oplysninger
Stillingen er på 32 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse pr. 1. november 2026.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst. I forbindelse med ansættelse, indhentes der børne- og straffeattester samt referencer fra tidligere ansættelser.

Ansøgningsfristen er torsdag den 17. september 2026

Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler onsdag den 23. september 2026 kl. 8:30-12:00.

Ansøgning, CV, og anden relevant dokumentation skal sendes elektronisk.

Hvis du vil vide mere eller har lyst til at besøge os, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder, Dorte Ørbæk, på 20149034. Du kan også læse mere om Mølleholmskolen og Heltidstilbuddet på vores hjemmeside.

title: Functional Specialist Part-Time - Midlands
description:
What we offer

  • We offer contracts of 3 days (22.5hrs) or 4 days (30hrs) per week. Days will usually be set and must include a Friday.
  • Excellent training and ongoing support – be part of our valued team where wellbeing is prioritised.
  • Monday to Friday between 8am to 5pm with no weekend or night shifts (occasional 8pm finishes may be required).
  • £39,500 starting salary, rising to £40,500 after DWP approval pro rata.
  • 10% of Salary Bonus scheme (based on quality and performance).
  • Hybrid working – home and clinic based.
  • Watch this short video to find out more

Other benefits

  • HCPC/NMC fees paid and full revalidation support.
  • 15 weeks’ full maternity, adoption and shared parental pay.
  • Company pension, life assurance and Cycle2Work scheme.
  • Discounts across retail, travel, technology and wellbeing.
  • Free access to Headspace (for you and up to 5 others).
  • A paid volunteering day each year.
  • Ongoing training, development and clear career pathways.
  • 25 days’ holiday (rising to 27 with service) pro rata with the option to buy more up to 5 days.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Conduct functional assessments which include initial reviews, face-to-face, video or telephone assessments to evaluate how a claimant’s health condition or disability affects them for various types of benefit.
  • Analyse and interpret clinical information and supporting evidence.
  • Write detailed evidence-based reports to support the DWP/DfC in making informed and objective decisions - no treatment or diagnosis required.
  • Use IT systems to support clinical decision-making and report writing.
  • Develop your clinical knowledge and constantly learn about health conditions which are less familiar to you.

What are PIP and WCA?

  • Personal Independence Payment (PIP) is a benefit for people with a long-term health condition or impairment. It is paid to make a contribution to the extra costs that disabled people may face, to help them lead full, active and independent lives.
  • Work Capability Assessment (WCA) is a functional assessment that looks at a range of different activities relating to physical, mental, intellectual and cognitive functions, to help DWP determine a customer's capability for work or work-related activity.

About you

  • NMC registered Nurse (RGN, RMN or RNLD) or HCPC registered paramedic, occupational therapist or physiotherapist with a valid PIN and no current restrictions
  • Minimum of one year’s post-registration experience.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to produce clear, accurate and detailed reports.
  • Comfortable working quickly to meet structured targets.
  • Good IT skills including Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn new systems while working remotely.
  • excellent observational and communication skills, giving you the ability to listen, empathise and dig deeper.
  • A driving licence or access to transport for assessment centre working.

Please note: all candidates must hold the right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

About Capita HAAS

We were awarded two contracts to deliver the Health Assessment Advisory Service (HAAS) assessments in the Midlands and Wales for the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP), and in Northern Ireland for the Department for Communities (DfC).

We deliver assessments for a variety of different benefits, including delivering PIP, WCA and Specialist benefit assessments across the Midlands and Wales, and in Northern Ireland.

Security and compliance

Successful candidates will be required to successfully complete government baseline personnel security standard vetting. This is the recognised standard for the pre-employment screening of individuals with access to government asset.

This role is defined as regulated activity relating to children or vulnerable adults within the meaning of the Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups Act 2006 it is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. At vetting, you will undergo an enhanced criminality check which will show both spent and unspent convictions.

What happens next?

Please do complete our short application form and upload your CV. (Please ensure there are no unexplained gaps in your CV).

We’re an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

As a Disability Confident Leader, we are proud to guarantee interviews for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role.

Please note there will be an initial full time (paid) training period of 8 weeks so candidates must be able to commit to that.

If you have queries, or want to discuss any reasonable adjustments, please contact our friendly recruitment team:

Phone - 02035 970410

Email - haasrecruitment@capita.com

title: Gourmetslagter i føtex - Viby J
description:
Gourmetslagter i føtex - Viby J

Uddannet gourmetslagter i føtex

Er du uddannet gourmetslagter, og brænder du for at levere kvalitet og skabe gode kundeoplevelser? Som slagtersvend i føtex bliver du en del af et stærkt team, hvor arbejdsglæde, udvikling og faglig stolthed går hånd i hånd.

**Skab gode kundeoplevelser
**I føtex slagterafdeling arbejder vi med et bredt sortiment af kød, fisk og delikatesser. Fra MesterHakket og krogmodnet oksekød til friskfangede rødspætter og økologisk plantefars – vi tilbyder alt, hvad hjertet og maven begærer. Som slagtersvend er du med til at sikre, at vores kunder får den bedste kvalitet og service, uanset om det er til hverdag eller fest.

**En hverdag med fokus på kvalitet og teamwork
**Du kan se frem til en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger om at levere de bedste varer og den bedste service. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Fylde slagterboksen op og klargøre butikken, så den fremstår indbydende og præsentabel.
  • Ekspedere og rådgive kunder om kød, kvalitet og tilberedning.
  • Forberede og tilberede slagtervarer af høj kvalitet.

Her er muligheder for dig, der kan og vil

Vi tror på, at alle har potentiale til at udvikle sig. Derfor tilbyder vi:

  • Daglig sparring med din leder, så du kan vokse i rollen.
  • Interne kurser og uddannelse, der styrker dine faglige og personlige kompetencer.
  • Karrieremuligheder i hele koncernen, hvis du ønsker at tage næste skridt.

**Hvem er du?
**Vi søger en uddannet gourmetslagter, der er stolt af sit håndværk og brænder for at dele sin viden og passion med kunderne. Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Er udadvendt og imødekommende, så kunderne føler sig godt behandlet.
  • Har motivation, engagement og en struktureret tilgang til dit arbejde.
  • Trives i et team og bidrager til et godt samarbejde med dine kolleger.

Din alder er underordnet – det vigtigste er, at du har lysten og evnerne til at levere kvalitet og skabe gode oplevelser for vores kunder.

**Klar til at blive en del af føtex?
**Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning allerede i dag via linket her på siden. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Bilingual Concrete Operations Superintendent
description:
This role is for one of Weekday’s clients


Min Experience: 1+ years
Location: Nebraska, United States
JobType: full-time

We are seeking an experienced Bilingual (English/Spanish) Concrete Operations Superintendent to lead field operations for a well-established concrete construction business. This is a high-ownership leadership opportunity for an experienced Concrete Superintendent or an exceptional Concrete Foreman ready to take the next step.

The ideal candidate will oversee multiple projects, develop Foremen and field crews, improve scheduling and communication, strengthen operational systems, and ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, on schedule, and to a high standard.

This role offers the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and play a meaningful part in improving field operations and supporting the company's continued growth.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee multiple active concrete construction projects.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop Foremen, crew leaders, and field teams.
  • Prepare and communicate weekly work schedules and manpower requirements.
  • Coordinate labor, equipment, materials, subcontractors, and project logistics.
  • Monitor labor productivity, project progress, and job costs.
  • Maintain high standards for quality, safety, and workmanship.
  • Serve as a key field contact for customers and resolve project-related concerns.
  • Identify and address potential issues before they result in delays or cost overruns.
  • Improve communication and coordination between field and office teams.
  • Develop future Foremen and strengthen the leadership capabilities of field crews.
  • Implement and improve operational processes, scheduling systems, and field procedures.
  • Gradually take ownership of day-to-day field operations and reduce senior leadership's involvement in routine project management.

Requirements

  • Proven experience leading concrete construction crews and managing multiple projects.
  • Experience as a Concrete Superintendent, Senior Foreman, or equivalent field leadership position.
  • Strong understanding of concrete construction operations, scheduling, manpower planning, and jobsite coordination.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Hands-on leadership style with the ability to earn the trust and respect of field teams.
  • Experience coordinating labor, equipment, materials, and subcontractors.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop Foremen and crew leaders.
  • Stable work history with progressively increasing leadership responsibilities.
  • Fluent English and Spanish communication skills are required.
  • Willingness to travel for projects and stay overnight when required.

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is a practical, accountable leader who takes ownership of outcomes rather than simply managing individual jobs. You should be comfortable making decisions in the field, communicating clearly with both English- and Spanish-speaking employees, solving problems quickly, and developing people around you.

Exceptional Concrete Foremen who have consistently led crews, delivered quality work, and are ready to transition into a Superintendent-level role are encouraged to apply.

Travel

Projects may be located within approximately a 300–350 mile radius of the primary operating area. Overnight travel will be required for projects outside the local area. Company-paid lodging and a daily travel per diem are provided, with most employees returning home for weekends.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $95,000–$100,000
  • Performance Bonus: $10,000–$20,000
  • Potential Total Earnings: $120,000–$140,000+
  • Company truck
  • Fuel provided
  • Company phone
  • Paid vacation and holidays
  • Company-paid lodging for overnight travel
  • $75 daily travel per diem
  • Ongoing leadership coaching and professional development
  • Opportunity for expanded leadership responsibilities as the business grows

Why Join?

This is more than a traditional Superintendent position. You'll have the opportunity to shape field operations, build stronger teams, develop future leaders, improve systems, and contribute directly to the long-term growth of the business.

Must-have skills:

  • English and Spanish
  • Construction

Good-to-have skills:

  • Concrete Construction
  • Field Operations
  • Crew Management
  • Project Scheduling
  • Team Leadership

title: Pladesmed/svejser søges til automotive virksomhed i Dragør
description:
Svejsning · CNC-bukning · Laserskæring – Fuldtid, fysisk tilstedeværelse, Dragør, Danmark

Er du typen, der læser en tegning, starter maskinen og er stolt af det, der kommer ud i den anden ende? RENTEQ Automotive er en startup i vækst, og vi har brug for en dygtig smed til at hjælpe os med at bygge de rammer og kabinetter, der indgår i hvert eneste køretøj, vi konverterer. Hvis du er praktisk anlagt, nysgerrig og har lyst til at sætte dit præg på noget, der virkelig betyder noget – så læs videre.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner. Vi holder til i Dragør og tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til produktion.

Din rolle

Som vores smed vil du omsætte tegninger til de færdige dele, der går i vores produkter. Fra vores værksted i Dragør betjener du vores 8+1-akset CNC-kantbukningsmaskine, laserskærer og svejseudstyr til at fremstille de bærende rammer og kabinetter, der udgør rygraden i vores køretøjskonverteringer.

Det her er ikke et samlebånd – hvert projekt er anderledes, og du skal kunne tænke selvstændigt. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, kan finde ud af bidrage til problemløsninger tidligt, og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang.

Dine opgaver

• Betjene den 8+1-aksede CNC-kantbukningsmaskine til at producere præcisionsbøjede rammer og konstruktionsdele

• Opsætte og betjene laserskæreren til pladeemner, beslag og kabinetpaneler

• Svejse bærende rammer, kasser og kabinetter – MIG og TIG afhængigt af materiale og specifikation

• Læse og fortolke tekniske tegninger og omsætte dem til færdige dele

• Kvalitetskontrollere eget arbejde – målkontrol, svejsekvalitet og pasform – inden det går til produktion

• Samarbejde med ingeniørteamet om at identificere designproblemer og give praktisk feedback

• Holde værkstedet organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret

• Understøtte prototypeiterationer – forvent at der er hyppige designændringer og flere projekter kørende på én gang.


Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Har du praktisk erfaring inden for svejs/smedearbejde – det kan være fra en håndværksuddannelse, teknisk skole eller reel værkstedserfaring?

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan sætte kryds ved det meste af nedenstående:

• Erfaren svejser – MIG er et krav, TIG er et stort plus

• Fortrolig med CNC-bukningsmaskiner; erfaring med fleraksede bukkemaskiner er ideelt

• Erfaring med laserskæring – opsætning, nesting og sikker betjening

• I stand til at læse og arbejde ud fra tekniske tegninger og 3D-modeller

• Øje for detaljen: du måler to gange og er stolt af præcist, pænt arbejde

• Trives i et team, hvor ingen dage er ens

• Proaktiv – du identificerer problemer tidligt frem for at lade dem blive til andres problem

• Dansk på højt niveau og velfungerende engelsk, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

• En central rolle i en startup i vækst, hvor dit arbejde er synligt i hvert køretøj, der forlader vores værksted

• Et uformelt og rart team i en flad virksomhedsstruktur med variation i arbejdsdagene

• Et sundt og attraktivt arbejdsmiljø med moderne fabrikationsudstyr

• Ordentlige faciliteter i Dragør med god adgang i bil og med offentlig transport

• Reelle muligheder for at vokse med virksomheden, efterhånden som vi skalerer til fuld produktion.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv til Lasse Gersel på email lasse@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, inden du søger, er du meget velkommen til at skrive til os på samme adresse eller ringe på tlf. +45 20 90 98 96.

title: Digital Reporter, Panama City, FL
location: Panama City Beach - Panama City Beach, FL
description:
Are you detail-oriented, tech-savvy, and eager to play a key role in legal proceedings?

Join Esquire as a Digital Reporter—a vital position where you'll ensure accurate audio capture and maintain control of judicial proceedings.

Why Choose Esquire?

Esquire is a leader in legal support services, known for innovation, professionalism, and delivering exceptional quality. As part of our team, you'll receive comprehensive training, competitive benefits, and the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology. At Esquire, we are focused on Getting it Right for our clients, our partners, and our employees. We understand that the client experience begins with us, and we’re committed to empowering our employees to continually innovate our services to earn clients for life.

About the Role

As a Digital Reporter, you'll be responsible for capturing and preserving verbatim records of depositions and other judicial proceedings. Whether in-person or remote, you'll use specialized recording software and hardware to produce high-quality audio/video documentation. You’ll also administer oaths, create detailed annotations for transcription, and ensure smooth and professional proceedings.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately record legal proceedings using advanced audio/video equipment
  • Administer oaths and maintain control as an independent authority
  • Annotate essential testimony for transcription and playback as needed
  • Manage and secure exhibits, backup files, and complete job-specific worksheets
  • Maintain professionalism and build effective relationships with clients and legal professionals
  • Perform timely preparation for assignments and respond to communications efficiently

What You’ll Need

  • Skills: Strong attention to detail, ability to meet deadlines, and excellent problem-solving skills under pressure
  • Experience: Familiarity with court procedures, legal terminology, and digital recording technology is preferred
  • Certifications: Ability to obtain a Notary Public license and AAERT's Certified Electronic Reporter (CER) certification
  • Technical: Proficiency in Microsoft Office and touch typing (minimum 60 wpm with accuracy)
  • Education: Associate’s degree in legal studies, communications, or audio/visual technology is a plus
  • Personal Attributes: Self-motivated, professional demeanor, and adaptability to work in various environments
  • Other Requirements: Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the ability to pass a national criminal background check

What Success Looks Like

  • Producing accurate and high-quality audio recordings for transcription and review
  • Demonstrating exceptional professionalism with clients and colleagues

title: Softgoods Magnetics Product Design Engineer
description:
