title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer (Cloud Security / AI Platforms)
description:
About Gramian

Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs.

About the Role

Our client is a Big4 Consultancy group that works with leading financial institutions on AI-driven transformation, automation, advanced analytics, and financial crime prevention. Their work spans intelligent fraud detection, AML/KYC modernization, autonomous workflows, enterprise AI platforms, and the secure industrialization of AI in highly regulated environments.

We are looking for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to build and secure the cloud infrastructure supporting production AI solutions. The role focuses on CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, container orchestration, cloud security, monitoring, and compliance automation across AWS and Azure environments.

CONTRACT: Contractor assignment, expected October 2026 – July 2027, with potential extension

COMMITMENT: Full-time

LOCATIONS: Europe-based, preferably CEE; remote, with potential future hybrid work in Prague

PROCESS: Initial qualification followed by technical and client interviews

NOTES: Fluent English is required. Strong AWS experience is highly preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain secure, automated CI/CD pipelines for AI applications.
  • Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or comparable tools.
  • Embed automated security scanning, vulnerability checks, and compliance guardrails into delivery pipelines.
  • Manage containerized workloads and Kubernetes environments, including AKS and EKS.
  • Configure cloud permissions, identity controls, and secure network boundaries.
  • Establish application and infrastructure monitoring, alerting, and logging.
  • Improve platform availability, reliability, and operational resilience.
  • Collaborate with enterprise security teams on penetration testing and remediation.
  • Support secure deployment patterns across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Apply DevSecOps best practices across infrastructure, security, and release processes.

Requirements

  • Approximately 5–10 years of professional DevOps, DevSecOps, SRE, or cloud engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security controls, IAM, networking, and permissions.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or comparable IaC tooling.
  • Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes, ideally including AKS and EKS.
  • Experience designing and operating automated CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience implementing security scanning, vulnerability management, or compliance controls in delivery pipelines.
  • Fluent professional English.

title: Data Analytics Engineer
description: We’re looking for a Data Analytics Engineer to join our Data team and help us shape the data ecosystem in the company. You’ll likely thrive in this role if you have a strong analytical mindset and proven experience in transforming complex data into actionable insights. If a dynamic, cross-functional environment brings out your best, you’ll feel right at home. We are flexible with the location of this role. We are open to on-site (offices in Copenhagen or Wroclaw), hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CEST+1). About Us Cookie Information and Piwik PRO are leading SaaS companies specializing in privacy-first compliance and analytics. Together, we’re building intuitive, user-friendly products that help organizations navigate data privacy and marketing insights. You will join a small, newly formed Data team consisting of one other Data Analytics Engineer and one Data Analyst. The Role Day-to-day, you will work closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making across the organization. You will act as the owner of data integrity and play a key role in the growth and development of our data infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Develop and manage datasets in a modern data warehouse environment (we use BigQuery). Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines using dbt. Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries for various analytical needs. Take independent ownership of data quality and data integrity across the data warehouse, proactively identifying inconsistencies, monitoring data reliability, and driving improvements at the source. Collaborate with engineers and other internal stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and relevance. Analyze and interpret complex datasets to support strategic business initiatives. Build interactive and insightful data visualizations and dashboards using Looker Studio. Document analytical processes and methodologies to ensure reproducibility and clarity. About you A minimum of 2 years hands-on experience in a Data Analytics Engineer or related analytics role, ideally within SaaS or ecommerce environments. Solid background in using modern data warehouse platforms, such as BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, or similar technologies, including querying, performance tuning, and data modeling. Practical experience building and maintaining data transformation pipelines using dbt or similar tools (e.g. Dataform). Ability to develop and maintain Python-based pipelines (e.g. dlt) and data transformations for ingestion into the data warehouse. Proven ability to translate complex data insights into clear business actions, aligning analytical work with broader company objectives. Fluent command of English, both written and spoken (C1). It would also be great if you have: Experience in visual analytics with tools like Power BI and Looker Studio, capable of building impactful dashboards and reports. Experience with AI-assisted data analysis or business intelligence. What we offer: Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits. A positive, informal workplace. The opportunity to work with a modern, recently built data warehouse with plenty of scope for development. The opportunity to shape and develop your role. Application process: We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today. This is what our recruitment process looks like: A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins, in English) An assessment (take-home) An in-depth interview with the hiring manager and a member of the team (online, approx. 90 mins) Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we are actively working to build a more diverse team. We encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

title: Assistant Supervisor Inbound - Tech 2
description:
Venlo, Limburg | €2,607 – €3,349 | Fulltime | TFT | Shifts

Ready for the next step in your logistics career? Want more responsibility and real impact within a dynamic logistics operation?

As an Assistant Supervisor in Venlo, Limburg, you’ll play an important role in ensuring the daily warehouse operation runs smoothly. You’ll work in an international logistics environment where technology, structure, teamwork and continuous improvement are key.

You won’t just focus on today’s operation. You’ll also identify opportunities to improve processes, support your team and help the operation perform at its best. If you’re ready to grow, take ownership and make an impact on the warehouse floor, we’d love to have a conversation with you.

You will manage a team of 20 to 30 warehouse employees, including pickers, packers and line leads, and report directly to the Supervisor.

Your responsibilities include:

Our process is fast and straightforward:

Arvato is an equal opportunity employer. We assess candidates based on talent and motivation.

Ready to take the next step in your logistics career and make an impact within a dynamic international operation in Venlo? Apply now.

title: Nyuddannet eller på vej videre i karrieren? Bliv miljøsagsbehandler i Aalborg Kommune
description:
Vil du gøre en forskel på miljøområdet for borgerne og virksomhederne i Aalborg Kommune? Trives du med at samarbejde på tværs af fagområder? Og motiveres du af at indgå i et stærkt og engageret team med stor faglighed? Så kan du blive vores nye kollega.

Vi søger en kollega til afdelingen Miljø i Teknik og Miljø. Stillingen er i Team Erhvervsaffald.

Om jobbet
Dit daglige arbejde er en god blanding af administration og tilsyn i marken. Du skal derfor trives med at fordybe dig i sagsbehandling – men også kunne handle hurtigt og træffe klare, faglige beslutninger, når situationen kræver det. Enkelte gange årligt vil der være besigtigelse uden for normal arbejdstid.

Du lander i en afdeling med fokus på vidensdeling og faglighed. Vi går op i at opgaver løses i fællesskab, og sørger for en grundig oplæring.

Vi er et energisk team med godt kollegaskab, der løser en bred vifte af miljøopgaver.

Flere af opgaverne har stor kompleksitet i form af, at der er flere parter inddraget i sagerne - fx borger og virksomheder der henvender sig i forbindelse med anmeldelser og klager eller involvering af andre myndigheder.

Her er eksempler på opgaver, som kan blive dine:

  • Behandling af anmeldelser af byggeaffald inkl. tilsyn på byggepladserne
  • Affaldstilsyn, hvor vi ser på virksomheders sortering af affald og affaldsdata
  • Reguleringen af §42 virksomheder, herunder henvendelser om støj, røg og støv
  • Regulering af midlertidige aktiviteter som bygge- og anlægsarbejder
  • Sager om håndtering af asbest
  • Tilladelser til musikarrangementer på restaurationer og offentlige pladser
  • Ressourceperson på faglige IT-systemer


Om dig
Du har en relevant uddannelse inden for miljøområdet og 0-3 års anciennitet. Du kan være ingeniør, biolog, miljøteknolog eller have en anden naturvidenskabelig uddannelse.

Det vigtigste er, at du har interesse for miljøområdet og lyst til at arbejde med myndighedsopgaver.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er udadvendt og trives med at rykke ud til vurdering af miljøsager, hvor der er flere parter involveret
  • Arbejder struktureret og har blik for kvalitet i sagsbehandling
  • Synes om en hverdag, hvor teamånd og fokus på fælles sparring vægtes højt
  • Er typen der springer til, når kollegaerne mangler en hjælpende hånd
  • Flair og lyst til at sikre brugen af teamets fag-IT-systemer
  • Kommunikerer klart og professionelt - både mundtligt og skriftlig
  • Kan bevare overblik og prioritere i en varieret hverdag
  • Har lyst til at sætte dig ind i lovgivningen på miljøområdet

Beskriv gerne i din ansøgning, hvilke opgaver du har særlig interesse for.


Om os
Afdelingen Miljø består af cirka 40 medarbejdere fordelt på tre teams Virksomhedsmiljø, Landbrug og Erhvervsaffald. Du bliver en del af Team Erhvervsaffald, hvor du får 16 engagerede og specialiserede kolleger, som spænder bredt på begge sider af år 2000.


Om Teknik og Miljø

Aalborg Kommune er Danmarks tredjestørste kommune og er i fortsat udvikling. I Teknik og Miljø er vi omkring 700 medarbejdere. Vi arbejder med udviklingen af de fysiske rammer, der gør Aalborg til en attraktiv, dynamisk og bæredygtig kommune, hvor vi vægter miljøet højt.

Læs mere om Aalborg Kommune og vores opgaver i Teknik og Miljø her: Teknik og Miljø - Aalborg Kommune


Vi tilbyder
Hos os får du:

  • En spændende og meningsfuld stilling med stor samfundsmæssig betydning
  • Stor frihed til at planlægge dit arbejde
  • Dygtige og engagerede kolleger, der prioriterer samarbejde og sparring
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling
  • Deltagelse i interne faggrupper og tværkommunale netværk
  • Fleksible arbejdsforhold med flekstid og mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale
  • En attraktiv arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel, kvalitet og udvikling


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen er fast med en arbejdsuge på 37 timer og ønskes besat senest 1. november 2026. Arbejdsstedet er Teknik og Miljø, Stigsborg Brygge 105, 9400 Nørresundby.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er efter gældende overenskomst mellem KL og forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Du skal have kørekort til bil.


Yderligere informationer
Kontakt gerne:

Teamleder for Erhvervsaffald, Gitte Grønhøj, mobil 2330 4124

Miljøsagsbehandler Erhvervsaffald, Camilla Winde, mobil 2070 2620

Forud for ansættelse, indhenter vi reference.


Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på muligheder
Hos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.

title: Jobopslag: Salgskonsulent
description:
Salgskonsulent - Elektronisk sikring

Vil du være en del af et stærkt team med frihed, ansvar og markedets bedste produkter?

title: Vil du som er SSA være en tryg og stabil støtte i hverdagen for en ung borger 7870 Roslev?
description:
I dette team er tryghed, stabilitet og respekt for borgerens hjem helt centrale værdier. Vi i ActivCare søger faglærte SSA’er, der har lyst til at blive en del af et nært og ansvarligt samarbejde, hvor man møder ind med ro, overblik og en oprigtig interesse for at skabe en god hverdag for borgeren.

Her bliver du en del af et fast team, hvor god kommunikation, ordentlighed og mødestabilitet har stor betydning. Din indsats handler ikke kun om praktisk hjælp, men også om at bidrage til en tryg, forudsigelig og respektfuld ramme omkring borgerens hverdag.

Om opgaven

Du bliver en del af et team omkring en ung borger, som bor hjemme hos sin familie. Borgeren har indimellem aktiviteter uden for hjemmet, og derfor er kørekort en vigtig del af opgaven. Du skal kunne ledsage borgeren og være tryg ved at køre handicapbilen, når der er behov for transport til aktiviteter eller aftaler uden for hjemmet.

Borgeren har en fysisk funktionsnedsættelse og behov for støtte i hverdagen. Opgaverne omfatter blandt andet hjælp til respiratoriske hjælpemidler, forflytning, ernæring via sonde og let personlig pleje.

ActivCare søger

· 1 fuldtids dagvagt – ca. 10 vagter pr. måned

· 1 afløser dagvagt – ca. 5 vagter pr. måned

· 1 fuldtids nattevagt

Dagvagterne er på 12 timer, og nattevagterne er på 9 timer.

Vagterne placeres efter ønskeplan, hvor du har mulighed for at få indflydelse på, hvordan dine vagter fordeles. Der er ikke et fast vagt- eller weekendrul, men weekendvagter vil indgå som en naturlig del af planlægningen i teamet. Vi søger derfor dig, der trives med en fleksibel vagtplan og gerne vil bidrage stabilt – både på hverdage og i weekender.

Vi forestiller os, at du

· er uddannet SSA

· er ansvarsbevidst, rolig og mødestabil

· kan arbejde respektfuldt i et privat hjem, hvor familien også er en naturlig del af hverdagen

· har kørekort og er tryg ved at køre handicapbil som en naturlig del af opgaven

· har lyst til at lære opgaverne grundigt og indgå i et samarbejde med både familie og team

Du får

· en meningsfuld stilling, hvor du gør en tydelig forskel i hverdagen

· grundig oplæring i opgaverne omkring den unge mand

· mulighed for enten fuldtids- eller afløserstilling

· et tæt samarbejde med et fast team, familien og ActivCare

· opstart hurtigst muligt

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send os gerne din ansøgning og opdateret CV hurtigst muligt via vores hjemmeside .

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter ved rette match.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: ASIC DFT Engineer
description:

Meet the Team:


The Common Hardware Group (CHG) delivers the silicon, optics, and hardware platforms for Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products. * Work closely with the design/design-verification and PD teams to enable the integration and validation of the Test logic in all phases of the implementation and post silicon validation flows.

* Your team will participate in the creation of Innovative Hardware DFT & physical design aspects for new silicon device models, bare die & stacked die, driving re-usable test and debug strategies.

* The job requires the candidate to have the ability to craft solutions and debug with minimal mentorship.


Minimum Qualifications:


* Bachelor's or a Master’s Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering required with at least 4-8 years of experience.

* Knowledge of the latest innovative trends in DFT, test and silicon engineering.

* Experience with Jtag protocols, Scan and BIST architectures, including memory BIST and boundary scan.

* Experience with ATPG and EDA tools like TestMax, Tetramax, Tessent tool sets, PrimeTime

* Verification skills include, System Verilog Logic Equivalency checking and validating the Test-timing of the design

* Experience with Jtag protocols, Scan and BIST architectures, including memory BIST and boundary scan.

* Experience with ATPG and EDA tools like TestMax, Tetramax, Tessent tool sets, PrimeTime

* Experience working with Gate level simulation, debugging with VCS and other simulators.


Preferred Qualifications:

* Post-silicon validation and debug experience; Ability to work with ATE patterns, P1687

description:
Kunne du tænke dig et fritidsjob med mening?

Vi søger dig, der har hjertet på rette sted og lyst til at hjælpe den ældre generation.

Som Hjælper får du mulighed for at gøre en stor forskel for andre mennesker, der virkelig har brug for din hjælp – og samtidig får du lidt ekstra ind på bankkontoen.

Du bestemmer selv, hvor meget du ønsker at arbejde, og hvilke arbejdsopgaver du vil påtage dig.
Vi lægger vægt på, at du er tilknyttet de samme ældre over længere tid – gerne fra dit lokalområde – så der skabes en tryg og stabil relation for både dig og den ældre.

For at blive Hjælper skal du være fyldt 18 år.

Opgaver vi mangler hjælp til lige nu

Lige nu søger vi hjælpere til 1 opgave i 5250 Odense SV:

  • Fast opgave: havearbejde

Typiske arbejdsopgaver

  • Havearbejde (fx græsslåning og lugning)

Du får

  • 150 kr. i timen, udbetalt hver 7. dag
  • Et job, hvor du er med til at øge livskvaliteten for ældre
  • Nye relationer til inspirerende personer med livserfaring og spændende historier
  • Fleksible arbejdstider
  • Forsikring, når du er ude hos de ældre

Interesseret?

Vi afholder løbende online on-boarding kurser for nye hjælpere.
Her bliver du klædt på til opgaven og har mulighed for at stille spørgsmål.

Læs mere eller tilmeld dig her

title: Sr. Product Data & Pricing Analyst
description:
Company Overview

Driven Distribution Group is the holding company of Tri-State Enterprises, Inc. and Chicago Parts & Sound, LLC. As a leading automotive aftermarket distribution company, Driven Distribution Group is committed to delivering exceptional service, operational excellence, and strong partnerships with our customers, suppliers, and employees. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in our Core Values: Do the Right Thing, Reach for Greatness, Initiate Positivity, Value Teamwork, and Embrace Feedback—which guide everything we do.

Position Summary

The Sr. Product Data & Pricing Analyst is responsible for managing product data integrity, overseeing pricing strategies, and supporting the execution of data-driven decisions across the organization. This role plays a key part in ensuring accurate product content, optimizing pricing structures, and collaborating across departments to support inventory, sales, and marketing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and update product data, including SKUs, descriptions, pricing, attributes, and images in internal systems and databases.
  • Analyze market pricing trends and competitor data to support pricing recommendations and adjustments.
  • Collaborate with Category Management, Purchasing, and Sales to ensure accurate product positioning and margin optimization.
  • Assist in managing pricing updates and mass uploads in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Product Information Management (PIM) systems.
  • Develop and maintain reports related to pricing, product performance, and profitability.
  • Support vendor onboarding by ensuring completeness and consistency of product data.
  • Identify and correct discrepancies in product content and pricing across internal systems.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Management, Marketing, or related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in pricing, product data management, or similar roles in the automotive aftermarket or distribution environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with a focus on data accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of ERP/PIM systems.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Epicor, NetSuite, or similar ERP systems.
  • Familiarity with ACES & PIES data standards in the automotive aftermarket industry.
  • Demonstrated analytical ability with experience in pricing tools (e.g., Zilliant, Vendavo). Exposure to BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) or comparable tools is beneficial.

Core Competencies

  • Data Accuracy & Integrity
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Communication
  • Time Management
  • Problem Solving

Work Environment and Physical Demands

  • Office-based environment with occasional warehouse visits.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods and use a computer and telephone.
  • Occasional travel may be required for vendor or trade meetings.

Additional Requirements

  • Candidates must meet employment eligibility requirements as established by U.S. federal law.
  • Employment is contingent upon a conditional offer and the successful completion of a background check and, where permitted by law, a drug screening.

Compensation & Benefits

Driven Distribution Group offers competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Basic Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
  • Voluntary Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Short-Term Disability (STD)
  • Voluntary Benefits
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee Referral Program
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off (PTO), sick leave, and holidays
  • Safety shoe reimbursement program
  • Employee discount program for auto parts

Reasonable Accommodations
Driven Distribution Group is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Other Duties

This job description highlights the primary responsibilities of the role but is not intended to cover every task. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may be adjusted from time to time to support business needs, consistent with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law. We are committed to providing a workplace that is inclusive, respectful, and supportive for all employees.

Texting Privacy Policy and Information:

  • Message type: Informational; you will receive text messages regarding your application and potentially regarding interview scheduling.
  • No mobile information will be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes.
  • Message frequency will vary depending on the application process.
  • Msg & data rates may apply.
  • OPT out at any time by texting "Stop".

title: Stefanshjemmet, Strandvejen Stuen., søger 1 omsorgsmedhjælper (ufaglært) på 30-37 timer pr. uge, i blandede (overvejende aften) vagter i en fast stilling
description:
Stefanshjemmet, Strandvejen Stuen., søger 1 omsorgsmedhjælper (ufaglært) på 30-37 timer pr. uge, i blandede (overvejende aften) vagter i en fast stilling

Stefanshjemmet, er et socialpædagogisk botilbud (SEL §83 og 85) og aktivitetscenter (SEL §104).

Vi søger 1 omsorgsfuld kollega til vores botilbud på afdelingen Strandvejen Stuen, for borgere med erhvervet hjerneskade/ handicap.

Om os:

Hos os bliver du en del af en stabil personalegruppe, hvor samarbejde, faglighed og humor går hånd i hånd. Vi arbejder målrettet med at skabe struktur, tryghed og udvikling for den enkelte borger – med respekt for deres livshistorie og ressourcer.

Vores vikarer er ofte studerende eller pensionister, og de supplerer vores faste medarbejdere, som har forskellige social- og sundhedsfaglige baggrunde. Sammen sikrer vi en høj fælles faglighed.

På Strandvejen Stuen bor 12 beboere i alderen 50-80 år.

Vi arbejder tværfagligt pædagoger, SSA’er, terapeuter og omsorgsmedarbejdere sammen for at sikre beboernes individuelle hjælp til pleje og socialfaglige behov.

Du kan finde mere information om Stefanshjemmet via vores hjemmeside.

Dine opgaver:

-Støtte borgere i hverdagen med udgangspunkt i deres individuelle behov

-Skabe tryghed og gode relationer

-Indgå i pleje- og omsorgsopgaver i samarbejde med kolleger

-Deltage i sociale aktiviteter med borgerne

-Samarbejde med det øvrige personale

Vi forestiller os, at du:

-Har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker

-Er rolig, tålmodig og omsorgsfuld

-Er ansvarlig og mødestabil

-Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage initiativ

-Har fokus på at bidrage til en god kultur og et positivt samarbejde i hverdagen

-Gerne har erfaring fra lignende arbejde (men det er ikke et krav)

Vi tilbyder:

-Et meningsfuldt arbejde med tæt borgerkontakt

-God oplæring og støtte fra erfarne kolleger

-Et stærkt fællesskab og godt arbejdsmiljø

-Erfaring inden for både det social- og sundhedsfaglige samt det pædagogiske område

-Praktisk information

-Arbejdstid: Dagvagter, aftenvagter og weekender hver 3. weekend

-Arbejdssted: Stefanshjemmet, Strandvejen 1

Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale. Vi afholder samtaler løbende

Arbejdstid:

Arbejdstiden er skiftende mellem dag og aftenvagter og med arbejde i gennemsnit hver 3. weekend. Dine mødetider i dagvagt er enten kl. 7-13 eller 7-15, aftenvagterne er fra kl. 15-23. Din vagtplan vil bestå af overvejende aftenvagter

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til principperne om Ny løn efter overenskomst med gældende fagorganisation. Vi har driftsoverenskomst med Aarhus Kommune.

Kontakt:

Vil du vide mere om vores skønne afdeling, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingen på:

41 86 67 26 og spørge personalet som arbejder der. Ring gerne mellem kl. 13 og 17

Eller forstander Mille Hammershøj på telefon 6192 3547.

Du kan også få mere at vide om Stefanshjemmet på vores ().

Ansøgninger kan sendes pr. mail til stefanshjemmet@aarhus.dk mærket ”Omsorgsmedhjælper Str. Stuen”.

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende, så forvent at blive kontaktet hurtigt hvis du matcher vores krav og profil.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Guest Care & Property Executive (UK Based-Remote)
description:
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent. We admire the importance of innovative social media strategies and are committed to connecting talented individuals with great companies that need their unique skills. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

We are looking for a proactive and organized Guest Care & Property Executive to support our UK-based client's guest communications, property management, and enquiry handling during both regular and out-of-hours operations. This role combines customer service, operational support, and database management to ensure a smooth experience for guests, landlords, and internal teams.

Working Hours various:

Monday – Friday: 9:00 am – 10:00 pm GMT

Saturday & Sunday: 8:15 am – 10:00 pm

This role provides operational cover to ensure seamless, exceptional guest, supplier and landlord support. The

UK office is open from 9:00 – 5:30 pm. We then run an Out Of Hours (OOH) service until 10 pm from South

Africa. The core OOH timings are from 5:30 – 10:00 pm Mon – Friday and 8:15am – 10:00pm Saturday &

Sunday.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guest Care & Out-of-Hours Support

  • Monitor and respond to guest, landlord, email, phone, and Airbnb enquiries
  • Handle check-in support, access issues, maintenance concerns, and urgent guest situations
  • Coordinate with landlords and suppliers to resolve issues quickly
  • Escalate complex cases when needed
  • Maintain clear shift handovers and operational updates

2. Property Database Management

  • Update and validate landlord and property information
  • Maintain accurate property listings and availability records
  • Review temporary listings and database accuracy
  • Support property database growth and landlord data management

3. Enquiry & Booking Support

  • Manage and follow up on pending and last-minute enquiries
  • Update enquiry statuses and accommodation offers
  • Support urgent accommodation coordination and operational requests

4. Additional Projects

Assist with occasional projects such as:

  • Social media support
  • Review collection
  • Process improvements
  • Business initiatives and administrative tasks

Requirements

  • Previous experience in customer service, operations, hospitality, property, or administrative roles
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent multitasking and organizational abilities
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and customer-focused mindset
  • Good computer skills (Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365)

    Technical Setup Required
    • Quiet workspace
    • Reliable internet connection
    • Computer/laptop
    • Mobile phone
    • Microsoft Teams access

Benefits

  • Competitive salary.
  • Ability to work remotely.
  • Significant room for growth over time

description:

title: Lead Wind Turbine Technician (Scotland South)
description:
Are you ready to lead a team that keeps renewable energy flowing while helping power a cleaner future? As a Lead Wind Turbine Technician, you’ll play a key role in maintaining and improving wind farm performance, supporting safe operations, and developing colleagues across our onshore wind portfolio.

At EDF power solutions, we’re powering an Electric UK and Ireland.

This is an exciting opportunity to step into a leadership position where your technical expertise, commitment to safety and ability to inspire others will directly support renewable energy generation and our journey to a net zero future.

The Opportunity

As a Lead Wind Turbine Technician, you’ll provide day-to-day leadership to a team of technicians, helping deliver safe, efficient, and high-quality maintenance activities. You’ll oversee operational performance, support technical problem-solving, lead and mentor in Main Component Exchange readiness and completion work, and support the maximising of turbine availability across our Scotland South wind farm assets.

Alongside a competitive salary and potential for an annual bonus, this role is based at our asset operation service centre in Livingston. This is an on-site position with travel required to other wind farm locations as business needs dictate.

We’ll support your continued development as you expand your leadership capability and technical expertise. Working closely with site teams and contractors, you’ll contribute to continuous improvement, operational excellence, and the reliable generation of renewable energy.

Why EDF power solutions?

We’re united by a shared ambition: to tackle climate change, shaping an Electric UK and Ireland. Our diverse team is growing fast, driven by innovation and a commitment to clean, green energy for all.

With technologies spanning onshore and offshore wind, solar, battery storage and green hydrogen, we’re the UK & Ireland’s most diverse renewable generator. By 2035, we aim to deliver 10GW of low-carbon energy – and we’d love you to help us get there.

Who You Are

We’re looking for a Lead Wind Turbine Technician who combines strong technical capability with a safety-first mindset and the ability to lead others effectively. You’ll be comfortable working in challenging environments while maintaining high operational standards. To be shortlisted, you need to offer…

  • Previous accreditation as AT/AE under WTSR
  • Vestas experience in maintenance and complex fault finding ideally one or more of the following turbine variants: V90-2 Grid-Streamer, V105, V112 and V117
  • Qualification in electrical and/or mechanical disciplines to NVQ Level 3 or equivalent experience
  • High level of physical fitness and good health
  • Ability to work at height and in adverse weather conditions
  • Excellent understanding of health and safety requirements
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Leading and supervising wind turbine technicians to deliver safe and high-quality maintenance activities
  • Planning, coordinating, and reporting maintenance work across wind farm sites
  • Supporting complex fault finding, diagnostics and repairs
  • Maintaining mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems
  • Managing stocks of spare parts, tools, and consumables
  • Monitoring site performance and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
  • Supervising contractors and ensuring work are completed to agreed standards
  • Promoting compliance with and auditing of health, safety, and environmental procedures
  • Applying WTSR, CDM and company safety requirements in all activities
  • Supporting the development and mentoring of team members

Pay, Benefits and Culture

If you’re looking to join a company where you can work hard, have fun and help to create a net zero future – then you’re in the right place! If you’re passionate about tackling climate change to support a cleaner, greener future, we’d love you to come and join us.

Alongside a competitive salary and potential for an annual bonus, and a market-leading pension scheme, our employee benefits include flexible benefits tailored to your lifestyle – from electric vehicle leasing and private healthcare to extra holiday and more.

Everyone is welcome at EDF power solutions; we’re committed to building a workforce that reflects gender balance, social mobility and inclusion of minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ+ communities, and those with disabilities. As a Disability Confident employer, we will support applicants requiring adjustments.

title: Information Security Analyst Subject Matter Expert (SME) - Project-based
description:
At Umpisa Inc., our mission is to make the Philippines be known globally as a tech hub.

Umpisa Inc. is a progressive technology services company that partners with select industries, clients and people to work on pioneering and industry-changing solutions via digital transformation, modern software development and venture building.

We create a set of world-class and impactful products and solutions to help organizations and individuals live better lives. We offer demanding, challenging and rewarding careers in software development, product development, emerging technologies, and more for the right candidates.

As Information Security Analyst, you will:

  • The Information Security Analyst (SME) is responsible for protecting the organization’s information assets by designing, implementing, and maintaining security controls, policies, and best practices. As a Subject Matter Expert, this role provides hands-on technical expertise, risk assessment, and advisory support across the business, ensuring compliance with security standards while enabling secure business operations.
  • Compliance Monitoring: Support the implementation and monitoring of security policies to ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards (e.g. ISO 27001, NIST)
  • Participate in internal, external or regulatory audits as required.
  • Other work or projects as assigned.

Requirements

Essential Skills:

  • Aligns with our values: Excellence, Integrity, Professionalism, People Success, Customer Success, Fun, Innovation and Diversity
  • Strong communication skills
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills
  • Excellent problem-solving ability

Key Responsibilities

Security Operations & Risk Management

  • Act as the organization’s Subject Matter Expert on information security concepts, risks, and controls
  • Identify, assess, and manage information security risks across systems, applications, and processes
  • Monitor security events, incidents, and alerts; investigate and coordinate remediation actions
  • Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and support penetration testing activities

Policy, Governance & Compliance

  • Develop, review, and maintain information security policies, standards, and procedures
  • Ensure alignment with industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, or equivalent)
  • Support internal and external audits, client security assessments, and compliance requirements
  • Provide security guidance for data protection, access management, and secure handling of information

Advisory & Enablement

  • Serve as a trusted security advisor to IT, Engineering, HR, and Business teams
  • Review system designs, architecture, and changes to ensure security-by-design principles
  • Support third-party risk assessments and vendor security reviews
  • Translate complex security concepts into clear, actionable guidance for non-technical stakeholders

Awareness & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead or support information security awareness and training programs
  • Stay current with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and security best practices
  • Recommend and implement improvements to tools, processes, and controls

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • at least 5 years of experience in information security, cybersecurity, or IT risk roles
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Information security principles and frameworks
    • Risk assessment and vulnerability management
    • Identity and access management (IAM)
    • Data protection and privacy concepts
  • Experience working in a hands-on, SME or fast-growing organization
  • Experience communicating policies and compliance requirements with both technical and non-technical audiences at various levels in the organization.
  • Good experience in establishing and performing policy, standard and procedure assessment in a cloud-based environment, technologies, and services.
  • Good experience defining, revising, and implementing corporate information security policies, standards, processes, guideline, and related regulatory expectations.
  • Familiarity with various industry frameworks and requirements including NIST framework, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2, etc.
  • Passionate in ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our critical assets and contributing to our organization's information security initiatives by applying your knowledge and attention to details.
  • Able to work and communicate well with different stakeholders.
  • Remains composed when decisions have to be made quickly.

Preferred:

  • Relevant certifications (any of the following):
    • CISSP, CISM, CISA
    • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Auditor
    • Security+, CEH, or equivalent
  • Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Familiarity with security tools (SIEM, endpoint security, vulnerability scanners)
  • Good understanding of regulatory requirements in different markets the organization operates (e.g., MAS, HKMA, FSC, BNM, BSP, BOT).
  • Good understanding of security risk and compliance assessment, process, and procedures
  • Good to have Cybersecurity Fundamental certifications such as CompTIA Security+, ISC, etc
  • Able to develop and implement new and improved ways of doing work; encourage staff and guide organization and foster a positive security behavior and posture.

title: Social- & sundhedshjælper-elev
description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med mennesker? Så er det måske noget for dig at starte som social- og sundhedshjælperelev i Brøndby Kommune.

Du skal vælge Brøndby Kommune fordi du:

  • Garanteres en praktikplads.
  • Får løn efter gældende overenskomst.
  • Alle over 25 år får voksenelevløn.
  • Får en fast tilknyttet uddannet vejleder.
  • Får kursus i dokumentation og forflytning.
  • Har fast tid til fordybelse i praktikken.
  • Deltager i fælles refleksioner med andre elever og vejledere i praktikken.
  • Deltager i fælles frokost med andre elever i praktikken, hvor I kan sparre med hinanden.
  • Deltager i fælles Studieunits med uddannelseskoordinatorer.
  • Deltager i færdigheds- og simulationstræning.

Gennem uddannelsen lærer du om personlig pleje og praktisk hjælp til ældre borgere.

Din uddannelse foregår i borgerens eget hjem, enten på et ældrecenter eller i hjemmeplejen. I hjemmeplejen cykler du mellem besøgene, og det forventes at du kan cykle trafiksikkert og stiller egen cykel til rådighed.

Vi har et tæt samarbejde med SOSUH, hvor du går i skole.

Vi har et tæt samarbejde med 10. klasse skolen UCN i Brøndby, hvor vi løbende har elever i erhvervspraktik.

Hvornår og hvordan søger du?
Brøndby Kommune optager elever til uddannelsesstart i januar og august.

Du søger om optagelse til uddannelsen som social- og sundhedshjælper ved at søge, når vi har slået elevannoncerne op på kommunens hjemmeside, under "Job hos os" eller på www.lærepladsen.dk

Du kan søge om ansættelse på grundforløb 2 som fortsætter med et hovedforløb, eller du kan søge om ansættelse direkte på hovedforløbet, hvilket forudsætter at du har et grundforløb 2.

Du kan læse mere om grundforløbet på www.sosuh.dk

Krav til ansættelse på Grundforløb 2:
Du skal være optaget på SOSUH, og have modtaget din personlige uddannelsesplan.

Krav til ansættelse på hovedforløb mod social- og sundhedshjælper:
Bestået grundforløb 2 mod social- og sundhedsuddannelsen.

Varighed og opbygning.
Uddannelsen tager 14 måneder og veksler mellem skole- og praktik.

Mulighed for videreuddannelse.
Efter end uddannelse kan du søge job i hjemmeplejen, på ældrecenter eller i aktivitetscenter i hele landet og arbejde på alle tider af døgnet.

Du har mulighed for at videreuddanne dig til social- og sundhedsassistent.

Løn og ansættelse
Du vil blive ansat med en uddannelsesaftale og får løn efter gældende overenskomst.

Alle elever over 25 år vil få voksenelevløn.
Alle elever under 25 år ved ansættelsesdatoen, vil under HELE uddannelsen få elevløn.

Brøndby Kommune er din arbejdsgiver gennem hele uddannelsen.

Vil du vide mere?
Du kan læse mere om uddannelsen på www.sosuh.dk.

Du er også velkommen til at kontakte uddannelseskoordinatorerne:

Mail: beras@brondby.dk
Telefon: 21 35 03 37

Mail: majfr@brondby.dk
Telefon: 21 69 71 37

title: Studentermedhjælper - reception og salg hos N'AGE Vejle
description:
Vi søger en dygtig studentermedhjælper til Vejle, som er et naturtalent indenfor kundeservice og salg af hudplejeprodukter.

Du bliver en del af teamet i vores travle og hyggelige klinik i centrum af Vejle. Her vil du arbejde sammen med et stærkt og ambitiøst team af kosmetiske sygeplejersker og receptionister, som har en ekstremt høj faglighed indenfor deres felt. Som studentermedhjælp i receptionen spiller du en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at vores kunder får den bedst mulige oplevelse hos N’AGE. Du får et afvekslende job med faglige udfordringer, der spænder over alt lige fra femstjernet kundeservice, håndtering af bookinger og skriftlig besvarelse af kundehenvendelser til løbende oprydning og renholdning af klinikken og andre praktiske opgaver.

Det går stærkt til tider og du skal trives med et selvstændigt ansvar, og have gåpåmod til at lære en masse på kort tid. Du vil blive uddannet og løbende vurderet indenfor både kundeservice og salg af hudplejeprodukter.

Et studiejob omfatter typisk 10-15 timer om ugen, men kan variere efter behov. Vagter ligger som regel eftermiddag og tidlig aften i tidsrummet cirka kl. 15-20 i hverdagene, og om lørdagen. Fleksibilitet indenfor disse rammer er et stort plus. De primære opgaver er:

  • Tage imod kunder, servere kaffe og sikre, at de føler sig velkomne
  • Sikre optimering af kalendere, booke tider for kunder og besvare telefon og mails
  • Rådgive i og sælge kliniske hudplejeprodukter
  • Sikre at klinikken hele tiden fremstår pæn, ryddelig og indbydende
  • Fylde varer på produktdisplays og lager
  • Lettere rengøring og vask
  • Andet forefaldende arbejde
  • Du er kommet godt fra start med din bachelor indenfor en studieretning, hvor du har fleksibilitet ift. arbejdstider
  • Du er serviceminded og tager del i hele paletten af opgaver
  • Du fører opgaverne ordentligt til dørs og sikrer, at der er styr på alle ender
  • Din positive væremåde spreder godt humør blandt både kunder og kolleger
  • Du har en passion for hudpleje og har virkelig lyst til at rådgive og sælge hudplejeprodukter – dokumenteret salgserfaring er et plus
  • Du er initiativrig i forhold til egen læring og søger sparring på det, du ikke ved
  • Du er mødestabil og er fleksibel ift. at tage en ekstra vagt indimellem, når der er behov
  • Du har gode formuleringsevner i både skrift og tale, og god IT-forståelse

Kunne du tænke dig at blive en del af N'AGE teamet, så skynd dig at sende os dit CV på dansk, og gerne nogle supplerende ord om dig selv. Vi vurderer ansøgninger løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: cBrain søger knivskarpe udviklere
description:
Har du passion for software? Og er du blandt de 10% bedste, og brænder du for at udvikle software, der gør en forskel, og som får brugerne til at klappe?

Hos cBrain får du mulighed for at blive en del af et team af dygtige kolleger med stor erfaring inden for alle aspekter af softwareudvikling.

Du skal være blandt de bedste og ønske at arbejde i en ung dynamisk virksomhed på Østerbro. Dit fokus bliver udvikling, men du vil deltage i alle dele af et projektforløb. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du både har et solidt datalogisk fundament, og evner og ønsker at deltage i kommunikationen med kunder i forbindelse med design, implementering, test og overlevering.

Dine kolleger er dygtige softwareudviklere og arkitekter, og du vil via vores mentor-ordning få tilknyttet en seniorudvikler, der vil sikre, at du hurtigt og løbende vil udvikle dig fagligt.

cBrain udvikler software til en mængde platforme, og det er vigtigt, at du besidder evnen og lysten til at være på forkant med udviklingen af disse platforme. Det kunne f.eks dreje sig om nye brugergrænsefladeparadigmer (iPad, tablets og mobile applikationer), enterprise frameworks til at sikre åbne API’er og ekstrem skalering, søgemaskiner og cloud computing.

Arbejdsopgaver

Som softwareudvikler i cBrain vil dine opgaver bla. bestå i:

  • Udvikling af udvidelser og ny funktionalitet for eksisterende og nye kunder.
  • Deltagelse i designworkshops.
  • Udarbejdelse af teknisk design og kravspecifikation.
  • Detailafklaringer med kunden.
  • Test og teknisk dokumentation.
  • Teknisk support for eksisterende kunder.

Faglige kvalifikationer

  • Du har en relevant teknisk uddannelse som fx. datalog, ingeniør, cand. IT eller lignende.
  • Du brænder for at lave software og er med på de nyeste teknologier og forstår at omsætte disse til brugbare løsninger.
  • Du forstår at sætte dig ind i komplekse datalogiske problemstillinger.
  • Du har en solid forretningsmæssig tilgang til softwareudvikling og forstår at sætte dig ind i de arbejdsprocesser, som kunden sidder med.

cBrains software er baseret på Microsoft .NET, og det forventes, at du har en bred forståelse for .NET eller tilsvarende teknologier.

Da intern kommunikation, design og dokumentation samt kundekontakt foregår på dansk, er det et krav, at du taler og skriver flydende dansk.

Ud over de ovenstående faglige kompetencekrav lægger vi vægt på, at du er kreativ og forstår at omsætte gode ideer til lækre løsninger. Du er systematisk, struktureret, selvstændig, analytisk stærk og besidder en god helhedsfornemmelse. Du er videbegærlig, brænder for at dele din viden med andre og er dygtig til at videreformidle komplekse problemstillinger for dine kolleger og for kunderne. Du er nærværende, udviser et højt personligt engagement og nyder at samarbejde med dine kolleger.

Vi tilbyder

cBrain arbejder med forretningskritiske systemer både inden for det offentlige, hvor vi bl.a. leverer software til mere end 75 danske myndigheder, samt private kunder.

Der er alle steder tale om kernesystemer, som digitaliserer forretningsgange og kommunikation, og den software du er med til at lave, gør en væsentlig forskel.

cBrain sætter innovation meget højt og har et miljø, hvor der er plads til (og brug for), at du tænker i kreative løsninger. Dette kan være ud fra et forretningsmæssigt, et brugergrænseflademæssigt eller et teknologisk synspunkt.

cBrain har en organisation og kultur, hvor der bliver lyttet til alle, og du vil hurtigt komme i en situation, hvor du kan sætte dit personlige aftryk på vores produkter og løsninger.

cBrain står for alle dele af en software-implementering. Der er således mulighed for at udvikle sig både bredt (mod f.eks. projektledelse) og dybt (teknisk specialist eller arkitekt) eller en blanding som lead-udvikler. ****

Om cBrain

cBrain er en børstnoteret dansk softwarevirksomhed, der leverer cBrain F2® – en commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) digital platform, udviklet specifikt til offentlige myndigheder. I modsætning til traditionelle IT-projekter med skræddersyede løsninger tilbyder cBrain en standardiseret tilgang, der accelerer og effektiviserer digitalisering samt reducerer risici. cBrain F2 platformen anvendes i dag af over 100 myndigheder på tværs af fem kontinenter herunder blandt andet Tyskland, Storbritannien, USA, UAE og Kenya.

cBrain har ca. 230 medarbejdere med hovedkontor i Nordhavn, København, et tysk kontor i Berlin, samt medarbejdere i flere lande, herunder UAE, USA og Kenya.

title: Social Work Coordinator
description:
ABOUT:

Novocardia, a division of CVAUSA, is on a mission to revolutionize cardiovascular care and empower clinicians across the United States to consistently deliver high-quality, prevention-focused, value-based, patient-centered care. Chronic disease is the dominant cause of avoidable healthcare spending and death in the United States and worldwide. Fortunately, much of this disease burden and associated spending is potentially avoidable through delivery of more proactive, prevention-focused care. We are deeply passionate about improving care quality, and providing more Americans with access to great, evidence-based chronic disease care.

We are looking for high integrity, mission-oriented people who are passionate about improving the quality and value of chronic disease in America, excited to join a dynamic, rapidly growing, and diverse team.

Position Summary

The Social Work Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting Novocardia’s remote, multidisciplinary care team by addressing patients’ psychosocial needs and social determinants of health (SDOH) that require intervention. This role partners closely with Registered Nurses and Medical Assistants to ensure non-clinical barriers to care are identified, addressed, and integrated into the patient’s overall care plan.

The Social Work Coordinator is responsible for responsible for overseeing and coordinating social services for individuals in need. This role involves assessing client needs, developing service plans, and connecting clients with appropriate resources and support systems. This role ensures timely documentation, closed-loop referrals, and alignment with program workflows, quality standards, and accreditation requirements.

Job Responsibilities

SDOH Assessment & Patient Support

  • Assess the needs of patients through motivational interviewing and SDOH assessments to determine the appropriate resources to impact care outcomes.
  • Meet with patients to discuss identified social, emotional, environmental, financial, and behavioral health needs.
  • Develop and implement personalized care plans for clients, coordinating with other professional resources and agencies as needed.
  • Educate clients and their families about available resources and services
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of service plans and adjust as needed
  • Conduct follow-up visits and reassessments to ensure client needs are being met

Care Coordination & Resource Referral

  • Coordinate referrals to internal and external community resources, including behavioral health services, financial assistance, transportation, housing support, food access, and social services.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of local, regional, and national resources available to patients.
  • Ensure closed-loop referral processes, confirming patients are connected to appropriate services.
  • Collaborate with clinical team members to integrate social interventions into the patient’s care plan.

Advance Care Planning & Patient Education

  • Facilitate conversations related to advance care planning, including advanced directives, healthcare proxies, and goals of care.
  • Ensure documentation of advance care planning discussions aligns with clinical workflows and organizational standards.

Documentation, Quality & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate, timely documentation of assessments, interventions, referrals, and patient interactions in the EHR and care management platforms.
  • Ensure documentation and workflows align with organizational policies, quality standards, and accreditation requirements.
  • Support audits, reporting, and continuous quality improvement initiatives related to care coordination and SDOH interventions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Work (BSW) required
  • Active social work license
  • Minimum of 2–5 years of experience in healthcare, care management, care coordination, or community-based social work.
  • Experience addressing SDOH in chronic care, value-based care, or population health settings preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong assessment, counseling, and communication skills.
  • Comfort conducting advance directive and goals-of-care discussions with patients and families.
  • Knowledge of community resources, benefits, and social service systems.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a remote, multidisciplinary care team.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple patient needs and follow-up activities.
  • Proficiency with EHRs, care management platforms, and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and empathy in sensitive situations.
This is Full-time Remote Position
Based in Orlando, Florida

title: Principal Business Analyst
description:
Job Description

Taylor & Francis (T&F) is continuing its digital investment with a focus on the needs of academic researchers and institutes. Realising the long-term value of these investments depends on rigorous, coherent business analysis - understanding how the business works, framing the right problems, and ensuring that what we build reflects a shared, well-modelled view of our capabilities, processes and data.

The Principal Business Analyst is one of two senior BA practitioners aligned to the Taylor & Francis Business Architecture function, reporting to the Enterprise Business Architect. The role leads the largest and most complex cross-domain analysis in its domain group, actively builds up the T&F business architecture, and jointly with the other Principal BA owns the standards, methodology, community and capability of business analysis across T&F. They enable the broader BA community by providing quality oversight, operated through standards, peer review and coaching, not management authority.

You are the kind of Principal Business Analyst we are looking for if the following describes you:

  • You hold authority through expertise, not position - you are comfortable influencing and raising standards without line-management authority.

  • You are comfortable leading a large, ambiguous initiative while coordinating Business Analysts you do not formally manage.

  • You are confident raising the standards of a mixed BA team with varying skills and backgrounds, and you coach generously.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person, especially with senior business and engineering audiences.

  • You have the patience to build business architecture and BA capability incrementally, and you inspire others to persevere through resistance or setbacks.

  • You nurture an open environment where stakeholders and collaborators feel involved and heard, and you work across silos to articulate and achieve shared goals.

  • You are willing to challenge constructively, including pushing back on delivery pressure when it conflicts with BA practice standards or undermines analysis already done.

  • You have an exceptional ability to analyse complex problems, frame them well, and drive towards decisions with the customer in mind.

Key Responsibilities

Leading complex and cross-domain analysis

  • Personally scope the largest, most complex and most strategically significant analysis initiatives in the domain group - defining the problem, the scope of analysis required, the approach, the dependencies, and the BA capacity needed across domains.

  • Coordinate Domain BAs through design and implementation once an initiative is scoped - keeping the analysis coherent across teams, respecting capability boundaries, and surfacing and resolving cross-domain conflicts before they reach delivery.

  • Own requirements coherence across domain boundaries, preventing contradictory or overlapping requirements.

  • Lead requirements elicitation and facilitation for high-ambiguity or senior-stakeholder initiatives, and lead feasibility and options analysis for significant initiatives - presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders and governance forums.

  • Manage stakeholder relationships across domain teams and senior product, delivery and engineering stakeholders within the domain group.

  • Contribute to UAT planning across domains for cross-domain initiatives, ensuring end-to-end test coverage is coherent.

  • Maintain analytical quality as work moves through design and implementation, flagging where emerging delivery decisions undermine the original analysis, and act as the senior escalation point for the most ambiguous or contentious analysis problems in the domain group.

Building up the business architecture

  • Act as the primary BA point of contact for the Business Architect within the domain group, ensuring domain-model vocabulary is applied consistently across BA artefacts.

  • Ensure BA work on initiatives actively feeds the business architecture - processes, organisational structures, systems and data flows are progressively documented and kept current as delivery programmes progress.

  • Lead the documentation of capability-level processes, organisational structures, systems and data flows across the domain group, drawing on Domain BA contributions to build a complete and consistent picture.

  • Support the creation and analysis of Business Decision Records (BDRs), highlight opportunities to unify or simplify process, and surface capability-boundary questions to the Business Architect.

  • Validate that initiative analysis aligns with the target architecture and the domain model, and flag and escalate where it does not.

Managing the BA practice (shared across the Principal BAs)

  • Jointly define and maintain T&F BA methodology, standards, templates, artefacts and a shared vocabulary tied to the T&F domain model.

  • Jointly define the BA competency framework and progression model, and advise on recruitment, development and retention of BA talent.

  • Jointly run the T&F BA community of practice, identifying and addressing practice-wide skill gaps.

  • Jointly define requirements governance standards across the organisation (traceability, change control, sign-off) and UAT standards across the BA community.

  • Provide quality oversight of BA outputs within the aligned domain group — reviewing artefacts and ensuring process models, requirements documentation and domain analysis are correctly captured.

  • Coach Domain BAs in the aligned group on technique, standards and approach, building capability without direct line-management authority.

Deliverables

Key analysis and architecture artefacts produced and overseen by the Principal Business Analyst include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Initiative scoping and analysis plans for the largest cross-domain initiatives in the domain group

  • Requirements documentation and traceability for complex initiatives, kept coherent across domain boundaries

  • Feasibility and options analyses with recommendations for senior stakeholders and governance forums

  • Capability, process, organisation and data-flow models that feed the T&F business architecture

  • Contributions to Business Decision Records (BDRs) for the domain group

  • Cross-domain UAT plans and end-to-end test coverage maps

  • Key practice-level artefacts produced jointly with the other Principal BAs include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • T&F BA methodology, standards, templates and shared vocabulary tied to the domain model

  • BA competency framework and progression model

  • Requirements governance and UAT standards for the BA community

  • Quality-review and coaching outputs that raise the standard of BA work across the group

Qualifications

Education/ Skills Required

  • Degree-level education, or professional experience where you have gained equivalent knowledge.

  • Business analysis certification (e.g. BCS/ISEB, IIBA CBAP) is desirable but not essential.

  • Substantial track record of business analysis in complex, multi-domain organisations - publishing, content or platform business experience is an advantage.

  • Demonstrated experience scoping and leading large, complex or cross-domain analysis initiatives end-to-end, including coordinating multiple BAs through design and implementation.

  • Demonstrated experience setting BA standards and methodology in a federated or distributed delivery environment.

  • Direct experience working alongside enterprise or business architects on capability-driven analysis and design. Comfortable contributing to architecture-level artefacts and recording architectural decisions.

  • Strong track record of engaging at senior stakeholder level - technology leadership and business sponsors.

  • Coaching and developmental experience with junior or mid-career BAs, even where formal line management is not involved.

  • Demonstrated experience of working with colleagues in multiple locations and time zones.

Additional Information

You must have the right to work and live in UK.

You must have the right to work and live in UK.

Location: The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. We ask that candidates live within a commutable distance of our London office to ensure that as a balanced worker they can make it to our office location to collaborate as required. There is an expectation for a minimum of 3 days per week in-person time.

We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at conference – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

What we offer in return:

  • A competitive salary + bonus
  • 24 days annual leave
  • 4 volunteering days annually
  • Day off for your birthday
  • Pension contributions
  • Medical insurance for self and dependants; life cover and personal accident cover for self
  • Seasonal social and charitable events
  • Training and development
  • Tools and equipment for remote working

We want all our candidates to shine in our recruitment process. Please let us know if there is anything we can do to ensure you are able to show us your best self. This could include having the application form in a different format, more time for questions, or anything else – please ask us, we are happy to be flexible! Please contact recruitment@tandf.co.uk

Being Yourself at Taylor & Francis:

If you’re excited about working with Taylor & Francis to foster human progress through knowledge, we invite you to apply even if your existing skills and experience don’t fit every item listed above. At Taylor & Francis, we are at our best and most successful when colleagues can be themselves and make a contribution regardless of their identity or background. As a colleague, you will have the opportunity to further innovate and develop in areas that you are passionate about. Our goal is to empower you with the resources, incentives, and flexibility you need to enjoy success at work and to live a healthy, balanced life.

Taylor & Francis is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in and value diversity of people and thought, fostering a supportive and inclusive environment where all colleagues can learn and succeed as their true selves. Taylor & Francis recruits, develops, and retains colleagues without regard to any protected personal characteristics or other non-merit based factor.

If you have a disability, or face another barrier, and would like to request an adjustment to assist your participation in the hiring process and/or in the advertised position, please contact recruitment@tandf.co.uk. Your request will be reviewed and considered in the strictest confidence.

We genuinely care about our colleagues, promoting work-life balance, wellbeing, and flexible working. We believe that the skills and experience you bring to Taylor & Francis are invaluable. We want you to have the opportunity to develop your abilities, and to innovate and develop in areas which you are passionate about. To find out more about our business and the great career opportunities please go to our Careers Site:

Or better yet check out our LinkedIn ‘Life’ Page, highlighting our accomplishments, employees, and company culture. It’s also a good way of meeting our recruitment team, who will be happy to advise you on your journey here at T&F.

title: Bioanalytiker søges til fast stilling hos Afdeling for Klinisk Biokemi, Laboratorie for Medfødte Stofskiftesygdomme, Rigshospitalet
description:
Har du mod på at arbejde i et højt specialiseret laboratorium, med stort fokus på den enkelte patient, så modtager vi gerne din ansøgning.

Laboratorium for medfødte Stofskiftesygdomme søger en bioanalytiker til en fast stilling med besættelse den 01.10.2026 eller snarest muligt derefter. Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt.

Laboratoriet har landsfunktion for diagnostik af medfødte stofskiftesygdomme og her udføres en række biokemiske analyser til bestemmelse af metabolitter og enzymaktiviteter i primært blod og urin. Resultaterne anvendes i diagnostisk øjemed og som opfølgning på behandling af allerede diagnosticerede patienter.

Vi tilbyder

Vi kan tilbyde et job i en velfungerende afdeling, hvor du bliver en del af en medarbejdergruppe på 6 bioanalytikere og 3 kliniske akademikere. Det er et job med et tværprofessionelt samarbejde mellem bioanalytikere, akademikere, diætister og læger. Hos os er der gode muligheder for at tage ansvar og arbejde selvstændigt inden for et højtspecialiseret laboratorieområde.

Arbejdsopgaver

Du vil indgå i laboratoriets rutineanalyser, som består af følgende:

  • Modtagelse af prøver, registrering og præanalyse.
  • Metabolitanalyser i fysiologiske væsker vha. bl.a. HPLC, GC-MS, UPLC-MSMS og spektrofotometri
  • Enzymanalyser
  • En blanding mellem manuelt og automatiseret arbejde
  • Databehandling
Vi forventer, at du

  • Er uddannet bioanalytiker
  • Er fleksibel, omstillingsparat, arbejder selvstændigt, omhyggeligt og ansvarsbevidst
  • Har kendskab til IT på brugerniveau
  • Bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
Om afdelingen

I Afdeling for Klinisk Biokemi arbejder vi fokuseret med en arbejdspladskultur, der understøtter medbestemmelse og din deltagelse i samarbejdet vil være med til at forme og forbedre vores arbejdsmiljø, til gode for både dig og dine kollegaer.

Din ansøgning skal sendes senest d. 11. september 2026. Ansøgning vedlagt eksamenspapirer, autorisation & CV sendes til linket på denne side.

title: Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager is responsible for the timely and effective delivery of technology led projects, in support of AJ Bell’s strategic objectives. The role is for a Project Manager to deliver projects through the entire delivery life cycle; from project entry through to go-live and post implementation. Projects are undertaken primarily to deliver technology driven change in support of the evolving technology landscape however given the wider financial backdrop experience of delivering IT change in a financially regulated environment would be an advantage.

What does the job involve?

  • Managing the delivery of multiple technology led projects and initiatives
  • Delivering complex IT projects often working with third party suppliers to implement a hybrid of internal and external solutions
  • Establishing and maintaining effective and trusted relationships with internal stakeholders and external third-party suppliers
  • Co-ordinating and driving the collaboration of project resources to get the best from project teams
  • Defining scope and production of project plans with responsibility for leading and managing the project team to these plans
  • Producing resource forecasts and budgets and monitoring progress against these.
  • Where change is required, following appropriate change control procedures
  • Regularly reporting on the status and health of projects to sponsors and wider stakeholders at all levels of the organisation
  • Effectively managing project risks, issues and dependencies, and assessing for any potential risk to consumer outcomes posed by the project
  • Ensure that all duties are carried out with the aim of protecting customers and improving customer experience
  • Supporting and enabling the business to achieve its regulatory requirements, including consumer duty

Competence, knowledge and skills

  • Strong technical knowledge and experience gained from a technology background
  • An ability to quickly understand technical topics
  • Ideally PRINCE2 Practitioner certification
  • Ideally experience of IT development methodologies e.g. Agile, SDLC
  • Experience of delivering in a financially regulated environment desirable
  • Financial services industry knowledge, e.g. pensions, investments and stockbroking, would be beneficial
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to build and manage effective relationships
  • Good business/commercial knowledge
  • Analytical skills/problem solving
  • Strong planning and organisational skills
  • High attention to detail

About AJ Bell

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We're proud to be recognised as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work® in 2025 and 2026, a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

What we offer

  • 26 days holiday, increasing with service, plus buy/sell scheme and bank holidays
  • 7% pension with matched contributions
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Share schemes, including free shares and BAYE
  • Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
  • Free onsite gym
  • Enhanced family leave, subject to qualifying criteria
  • Travel and bike loan schemes
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Life at AJ Bell

  • Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
  • Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
  • Casual dress code
  • Friendly, supportive team environment

Our ways of working

At AJ Bell, our people are the heart of our culture. We believe in building strong connections by working together. That's why we offer a hybrid working model, where you'll spend a minimum of 50% of working time per month in the office. For new team members, an initial period will be spent full-time in the office to help you immerse yourself in our business and build valuable relationships with your colleagues.

Inclusion & diversity

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

Agency information

This vacancy is being managed exclusively by our in-house Recruitment team. We are not partnering with recruitment agencies on this opportunity and will only accept applications submitted directly by candidates.

title: Driftskoordinator til Forsyning & Service, Depot, Aarhus Universitetshospital
description:
Danmarks største og bedste hospital søger en ansvarsbevidst driftskoordinator til forsyningssektionen, som brænder for at give vores patienter og kliniske kolleger en optimal service.

Forsyningssektionen på AUH er opdelt i fire afsnit, som samlet sikrer et optimalt forsyningsflow. Depotet er ét af de afsnit, og det er til dette afsnit der søges en driftskoordinator.

Afsnittets primære ansvar er bestilling og levering af forbrugsvarer på hospitalets kliniske afdelinger og derudover tage del i vedligeholdet af de IT-systemer, der bruges til førnævnte formål. Sekundært deltager afsnittet også i andre forsyningsopgaver, bl.a. madtransporter og transport af sterile utensilier.

Det er ikke et krav, at man kender til arbejdsgangene på hospitalet, da en grundig introduktion sikrer, at man som driftskoordinator bliver klædt på til opgaven.

Det forventes, at man ved, hvad det vil sige at forbedre og drive medarbejdere i en forsyning- og serviceorganisation. Der stilles store krav til driftsforståelse, vedligeholdelse af medarbejdernes kompetencer, samt samarbejdet mellem funktionsleder, driftskoordinator og medarbejderne. Afsnittets drift starter kl. 5.00, og derfor forventes det, at man som driftskoordinator har regelmæssig arbejdstid i disse tidlige morgentimer. Dog vil de konkrete arbejdstider blive aftalt funktionsleder og driftskoordinator imellem, så der både tages personlige hensyn og bliver sikret tilstedeværelse for medarbejderne.

En afgørende opgave for den nye driftskoordinator på området er løbende at understøtte den daglige drift og optimere arbejdsgange på tværs af hele Forsyningen. Dette sker i samarbejde med andre driftskoordinatorer, medarbejdere og funktionsledere. Derfor er det på sigt forventet, at en driftskoordinator får en delvis forståelse for de tre andre afsnit i forsyningssektionen.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver i Depotet vil være at

• understøtte den daglige drift
• planlægge vagter, ferie, afspadsering m.m. i PDC vagtplan
• have kontakt og dialog med de kliniske afdelinger
• deltage i udførsel og sparring ift. udformning af procedurer, optimering m.m.
• være en del af afsnittets ledelse og derfor bl.a. deltage i ansættelse af medarbejdere

Vi tilbyder

• en afvekslende og udfordrende dagligdag med mange forskellige opgaver
• et åbent og samarbejdsorienteret miljø, hvor du har mulighed for selv at præge arbejdsopgaverne og rækkefølgen af dem
• et stærkt team hvor trivsel og kompetencer er i højsædet
• en samling venlige og hjælpsomme kolleger
• et job hvor du gør en forskel i sundhedsvæsenet.

Vi forventer, at du

• har erfaring med ledelse og delt ledelse uden personaleansvar
• er god til at skabe relationer og er kommunikativ stærkt
• kan tilegne dig organisatorisk indsigt og overblik
• har erfaring med at bruge IT-løsninger i dagligdagen
• er løsningsorienteret og har øje for videreudvikling samt forankring
• kan håndtere perioder med spidsbelastning og er i stand til at tage beslutninger på egen hånd
• kan tale, læse og forstå dansk og engelsk.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst for ledende servicepersonale indgået mellem Danske Regioner og Ledernes Hovedorganisation & FOA.

Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børneattest.

Ansættelsen vil først ske efter opslagets udløb med forventet tiltrædelse d. 1. november 2026 eller efter individuel aftale.

Ved yderligere oplysninger vedr. stillingen kan funktionsleder Mads Jessen Pedersen kontaktes på mail majpde@rm.dk eller på telefon 2940 9394.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.
