title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger.

That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something.

Within Worldwide Sales & Operations Support, the Pacific Operations team is responsible for flawlessly executing Apple's supply chain in the Pacific region to fulfill millions of customer orders from Greater China, North East Asia, South Asia and Australia-New Zealand while making sure that the right Apple products reach our customers at the right place and at the right time.

We are seeking an experienced and pragmatic Senior Data Engineer to join our Business Analytics team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain the end-to-end data pipelines and operational software applications that our Operations team depends on. The ideal candidate excels at bridging complex data ecosystems and functional software, and is tool-agnostic: you choose the most resilient solution for the problem — whether that is a deterministic SQL model, an asynchronous worker queue, a graph traversal algorithm, or a modern machine learning/LLM component.

In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to solve complex problems, operationalize data into decision-making tools, and contribute to the strategic direction of our business analytics initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of practical experience building production data pipelines, distributed systems, and backend services.
  • Deep proficiency in Python, modern SQL, and data modeling frameworks (e.g., dbt).
  • Hands-on experience with orchestration tooling (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) and modern data warehouses (e.g., PostgreSQL, Snowflake, DuckDB).
  • Experience applying vector databases/extensions (e.g., Milvus, pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone) to build features — embedding, semantic search, hybrid search, and RAG retrieval.
  • Experience applying graph databases (e.g., TigerGraph, Neo4j, Memgraph, AWS Neptune) to build features — data modeling, writing queries (Cypher/Gremlin), and multi-hop traversals.
  • Strong API development experience using modern frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Go, Node.js) and async task queues/streams (e.g., Celery, Redis, Kafka).
  • Working knowledge of how AI agents operate — tool/function calling, retrieval, context management, and multi-step reasoning — and experience serving data to users through agentic solutions (e.g., MCP servers, agentic frameworks, LLM tool use).
  • Practical exposure to applied AI/ML workflows (embeddings, semantic caching, model serving endpoints, or RAG pipelines) with the discipline to use them judiciously.
  • Strong systems-thinking abilities, with the capacity to identify second-order consequences and systemic constraints before writing code.
  • Ability to operate autonomously across the entire stack to diagnose ambiguous operational problems and deliver working solutions.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering end-to-end applications to user-facing interfaces (e.g., React, Streamlit).
  • Working knowledge of Docker for packaging and deploying their own applications (containerize a service, write a Dockerfile, run it).
  • Experience implementing data observability and tracing tools (OpenTelemetry, Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, Prometheus).
  • Background in operations research, graph algorithms, or mathematical optimization.
  • Strong knowledge of supply chain processes, including demand forecasting, inventory management, and replenishment.
  • Demonstrated skill in data visualization and communication tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.

title: Strategic Data Architect for Social Impact
description:
This Volunteer Placement is Located in: Bogotá, Bogota, Colombia

Start Date: November 2026

Placement Length: 5 months

Language Requirements: Spanish Level 4-Advanced and English Level 5-Fluent

Please submit a Spanish Resume and Statement of Interest

Eligibility: Open to Canadian Citizens and Permanent Residents of Canada only

The Volunteer’s Role

Help local foundations turn data into insight, action, and stronger community impact. In this volunteer role, you will support partners to organize information, develop practical tools, and create a strategic framework that strengthens learning, collaboration, and evidence-based decision-making.

Your work will help improve data governance, social impact measurement, operational efficiency, and digital readiness. By helping build a reliable “single source of truth,” you will contribute to more informed decisions and stronger community philanthropy across regional foundations.

As a volunteer, your duties will include:

  • Assess, organize, and consolidate data from Regional Foundations by reviewing existing sources and designing a standardized model with useful segmentation categories, such as entity type, region, topic, and target population.
  • Develop practical templates, dashboards, and analysis models that help partners report consistently, visualize results, and use data more effectively.
  • Compile regional methodologies and propose knowledge management approaches, including a repository of local initiatives and metrics to compare results across organizations.
  • Recommend digital security protocols to protect sensitive personal and organizational data, especially in territories affected by active armed conflict.
  • Propose simple, concrete, and context-specific actions to strengthen digital security practices for TerritoriA and the Territorial Foundations.

Essential Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in areas related to Economics, Statistics, Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Science, Business Administration, or other related fields.
  • Experience in research and with social organizations, NGOs, or social impact projects is highly valued, especially in contexts involving vulnerable populations and confidential data. The ideal volunteer can translate technical data guidance into clear, practical processes that non-technical teams can confidently use.

Essential Background:

  • Three to five years of experience implementing information systems, managing data, controlling data quality, or supporting analytical processes in medium or large organizations.
  • Experience designing and managing data capture and storage systems that support analysis, visualization, automation, and reports with key findings and recommendations.
  • Experience in data analysis, beneficiary information systems, and data collection or visualization tools that support reliable monitoring, stronger decision-making, and effective exchange networks. Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools is desirable.

What’s in it for YOU? A life-changing experience!

About Us

Cuso International (Cuso) is an international cooperation and development organization based in Canada that works to create social and economic opportunities for equity-deserving groups. Building on over sixty years of impactful work, we address global challenges by tackling the root causes of inequality. Working alongside our partners, we are focused on efforts to improve economic resilience, advance equity and inclusion for all, and deliver progress on climate action. We believe that by sharing skills, we can build better futures. Guided by our values of courage, inclusion, sustainability and accountability, Cuso combines innovative strategies and enduring partnerships to create lasting, meaningful change in communities across Africa, Latin America, the Caribbean, and Canada.
Project: Sharing Canadian Expertise for Inclusive Development and Gender Equality (SHARE)

Partner: TerritoriA

Benefits

Volunteer Support and Requirements

Support Package

Cuso International provides a comprehensive support package to ensure volunteers maintain a modest and healthy lifestyle aligned with local standards. This includes:

  • Monthly living allowance
  • Accommodation
  • Health insurance (including required vaccinations and antimalarial medication)
  • Round-trip airfare and visa/work permit costs
  • Pre-placement, in-country and reintegration training (along with access to self-directed materials and online resources)
  • Ongoing local support
  • Access to the Employee Assistance Program during and after placement

Selection and Screening

If you are shortlisted, you will need to:

  • Confirm passport or permanent resident details for travel
  • Provide two professional references and one personal reference
  • Complete a language assessment during the initial phone interview
  • Pass a police check and medical clearance before departure
  • Comply with anti-terrorism checks
  • Agree to uphold the Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) policy and Code of Conduct

Residency and Citizenship: Candidates are responsible for confirming how volunteering internationally may affect their citizenship or residency status. Canadian Permanent Residents should verify requirements with Immigration Canada before travel.

Inclusion and Accessibility: Cuso International welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds and equity-deserving groups. We provide reasonable accommodations throughout recruitment and placement. If you have accessibility needs, please contact us for support.

Ready to Make a Difference? Apply to volunteer today!

title: Information Security Analyst
description:
THIS ROLE

this role plays a key role in protecting IQEQ's networks, systems, and critical information assets. In this role, you will monitor and respond to security threats, investigate cyber incidents, and operate security technologies such as firewalls, antivirus, SIEM, and SOC tools. You will work closely with Red and Blue Teams to identify vulnerabilities, implement security controls, and strengthen the organization's security posture. This position is ideal for a security professional who is passionate about threat detection, incident response, continuous improvement, and staying ahead of the latest cybersecurity trends and best practices.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • You'll monitor networks, systems, and applications to detect, investigate, and respond to security threats, breaches, and cyber incidents.
  • You'll operate and maintain security technologies such as firewalls, antivirus solutions, SIEM, SOC, and other security tools to safeguard the organization's infrastructure.
  • You'll document security incidents, assess their impact, respond to MyIT security requests, and support timely remediation efforts.
  • You'll collaborate with Red and Blue Teams to perform security testing, identify vulnerabilities, implement security controls, and maintain high security standards.
  • You'll stay current on cybersecurity trends, emerging threats, and industry standards while researching and recommending security improvements to strengthen the organization's security posture.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation and benefits – including allowances, government-mandated benefits, 13th month pay, and performance-based bonuses
  • Health and wellness support – HMO coverage from Day 1 (with dependents), life and accident insurance, mental health support, and medical allowances
  • Leave benefits – generous paid time off, special leave types, and observance of all Philippine holidays
  • Hybrid work setup and tools – company-issued laptop, work-from-home kit, and flexibility after initial onboarding
  • Learning and growth opportunities – access to training, annual salary reviews, internal mobility, and performance rewards

ABOUT YOU

  • You hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with experience in information security and security solution administration.
  • You have hands-on knowledge of penetration testing methodologies and techniques for assessing system and network security.
  • You possess a strong understanding of cybersecurity technologies, including firewalls, proxies, SIEM, antivirus, and IPS/IDS solutions.
  • You are experienced with security and infrastructure tools such as Darktrace, Nessus, Acunetix, Nmap, Kaspersky AV, SCCM, Windows Security, Cisco ASA, and Cisco ISE.
  • You can identify network and system vulnerabilities, develop mitigation plans, and manage patch deployments while balancing business impact and operational requirements.

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

title: Samstyrende teams Billund Ude søger SSA, SSH eller ufaglært.
description:
Samstyrende teams Billund Ude søger SSA, SSH eller ufaglært, da vi er så heldige at 2 af vores fantastiske medarbejdere har valgt videreuddannelse inden for sundhedsområdet.


Derfor søger vi 1-2 medarbejdere som har lyst til at arbejde i en udegruppe. Når vi kigger til alle 3 faggrupper, er det fordi vi er godt dækket ind og kan være fleksible.

Vi er en meget velfungerende hjemme- og sygepleje som har til huse imellem Billund Plejehjem og Lykkebo (Værestedet) på Skolevej i Billund. Vi er +45 medarbejder som hver dag gør vores yderste for alle vores fantastiske borger i Billund by. Om aftenen dækker vi også Vorbasse, Hejnsvig og Krogager.

Og da Billund jo er en stor turistby, har vi også ofte gæsteborgere, som vi hjælper med at få en god ferie oplevelse.



Vi arbejder om dagen i 2 teams – Team City og Team Ring.

Vi startede arbejdet som samstyrende team i november 2024 – vi er godt på vej og arbejder med den nye ældrereform som trådte i kraft 1. juli 2025, hvor netop den samstyrende tanke er omdrejningspunktet. Vi har arbejdet meget med teams dynamik og borgermøder Vi arbejder ud fra en rehabiliterende tankegang og med udgangspunkt i principperne om trænende hjemmehjælp på tværs af faggrupperne med fokus på udviklingsmuligheder og selvbestemmelse for den enkelte borger. Kerneopgaven er meget vigtig for os – vi arbejder ud fra borgernes ressourcer, ønsker og værdighed.

For os er det vigtigt at vi har en åben og ærlig dialog/kommunikation, både mellem kollegaer og til ledelsen. At vi taler til hinanden på en respektfuld måde. Vi ønsker, at alle henvender sig til dem eller den som kan gøre noget - hvis der opleves vanskeligheder eller udfordringer. Omsorg, tillid og hjælp til hinanden i den tværfaglige indsats og som gode kollegaer er meget vigtigt for os.

Vi har stort fokus på uddannelse både internet og som evt. videreuddannelse i sundhedssystemet.



Vi tilbyder:

  • Et introduktionsprogram efter dine ønsker og behov (vi arbejder på en fælles onboarding i hele kommunen).
  • En hverdag hvor ikke 2 dage er ens.
  • Et kollegateam bestående af sosu-elever, sygeplejestuderende, SSHèr, SSAèr, sygeplejersker, terapeuter og ledelsesunderstøttelse.
  • At der lægges vægt på din indflydelse og dit medansvar.
  • At der er rig mulighed for at gøre brug af dine kompetencer, samt mulighed for at udvikle disse.
  • Mulighed for sparring med kollegaer med forskellige fagligheder og mange års anciennitet.
  • At blive en del af et hold hvor der er plads til forskelligheder, og hvor vi passer på hinanden og på alles trivsel.
  • Stor respekt for balancen mellem arbejde og fritid – vi arbejder med at indfører en form for ønskeplaner/pusleplaner.
  • Sociale arrangementer.
  • En synlig, nærværende og medarbejdende ledelse.


Vi forventer:

  • Lyst til at arbejde med ældre og på andre måder udfordrede borger og disses pårørende.
  • At du er mødestabil og fleksibel.
  • At du kan bevare roen i en til tider travl hverdag.
  • At du har en positiv indstilling til dine opgaver og alle omkring opgaven.
  • At du har kørekort, men også er indstillet på at cykle. Manglende kørekort kan løses.
  • At du er indstillet på at arbejde overvejende i dagvagt med evt. få aftenvagter. (skulle du have et ønske om kun aftenvagt vil vi se positivt på dette).
  • At du er indstillet på at arbejde hver 2. weekend – med 3 ferieweekender pr. år. derudover forsøger vi altid at hjælpe med ekstra frihed hvis der skulle være behov for dette.


Hvem er du:

  • Du er uddannet indenfor sundhedsområdet.
  • Du er ufaglært og har lyst til at prøve at arbejde indenfor sundhedsområdet med henblik på uddannelse inden for området.
  • Du er ung, moden eller midt i mellem.


Vi glæder os til at hilse på dig, og du er meget velkommen til at kigge forbi os til en snak og en kop kaffe.

Ring til distriktsleder Birgit Wammen Andersen på 2080 3614 eller faglig koordinator Stine Lykkegaard på 2555 7988 og få en snak eller en aftale.



Stillingerne ønskes besat snarest eller 1. november 2026.



Ansøgningsfrist d. 14. september 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes i ugerne 38 og 39.

title: Udekørende servicemontør
description:
Udekørende servicemontør til A.E. Maskiner

A.E. Maskiner ApS er i fuld fart frem, og derfor søger vi en dygtig servicemontør til vores landsdækkende serviceteam. Du får base med udgangspunkt i Randers og bliver en vigtig del af vores arbejde med service, fejlfinding og reparation af entreprenørmaskiner hos kunder i hele Danmark.

Som udekørende servicemontør får du din egen veludstyrede firmabil og en hverdag med stor variation. Du kører ud til kunderne, finder løsningerne på stedet og sikrer, at maskinerne hurtigt kommer tilbage i drift. Det kræver både teknisk overblik, selvstændighed og lysten til at levere god service.

En hverdag med frihed, ansvar og stærke kollegaer

Hos A.E. Maskiner bliver du en del af et team på mere end 60 medarbejdere, hvor vi vægter faglighed, samarbejde og ordentlighed højt. Vi arbejder i et uformelt miljø med korte beslutningsveje, og vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når man tager ansvar og hjælper hinanden.

Du får et job, hvor dagene sjældent ligner hinanden, og hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med moderne entreprenørmaskiner, avanceret udstyr og spændende tekniske udfordringer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

* Er uddannet mekaniker

* Har kørekort minimum kategori B

* Kan arbejde selvstændigt og holde struktur i en travl hverdag

* Har erfaring med service, fejlfinding og reparation

* Er serviceminded og god til at finde løsninger

* Har kendskab til IT og diagnoseværktøj

* Er fleksibel og trives med en afvekslende arbejdsdag

Hos os får du:

* Egen veludstyret firmabil

* Et selvstændigt job med stor frihed under ansvar

* Attraktive løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

* Gode kollegaer og et stærkt fællesskab

* Arbejde med moderne entreprenørmaskiner og teknisk udstyr

* Mulighed for faglig udvikling og efteruddannelse

Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, og vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Klar til at tage næste skridt?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Rasmus Byriel på TLF. 40 23 10 29.

Send din ansøgning og CV til Job@aemaskiner.dk.

title: Mattel Retail Team Associate - Harrisburg, PA 17055
description:
The Opportunity: As a Seasonal Team Associate, you’ll partner with a Mattel Retail Services Representative to grow Mattel’s presence at major retailers, working a minimum of 15 hours per week during our busiest holiday season. We are looking for enthusiastic temporary team members who are passionate about merchandising, enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, and want to drive results and make magic happen this holiday season! This job can open the door to future merchandising career opportunities with Mattel.

What Your Impact Will Be:

  • Brand ambassador of Mattel/Fisher-Price brands and products
  • Collaborate with your lead Mattel Representative to secure prime product placements for Mattel’s iconic brands
  • Partner with lead Mattel Representative on monthly scheduling
  • Unpack cases of various Mattel toys
  • Merchandise and organize product on the sales floor
  • Construct & deconstruct store fixtures including shelving and racking
  • Implement point of purchase materials
  • Execute special projects as assigned including, but not limited to store events
  • Administrative tasks including but not limited to managing time entry, attending meetings, trainings, checking email etc.

What We’re Looking For:

Basic Job Qualifications:

  • Must be at least 18 years old
  • High school diploma or GED
  • Preferred work hours are during the weekday during daytime hours; occasional weekends
  • Must be available to work a minimum of 15 hours per week
  • Preferred device requirement – Up to date smartphone and/or computer with Chrome Browser to access for time worked entries, email and Workday. Other browsers (e.g. DuckDuckGo) are not supported. A mobile phone is required for multi-factor authentication to receive SMS(text) or voice call.
  • Must have access to reliable internet
  • Must have reliable transportation to travel to and between assigned store locations (gas mileage reimbursement per company policy)
  • Reside within approximately 20 miles of the assigned territory/store cluster or otherwise able to reliably service the assigned territory

Physical Requirements:

  • Stand, bend, twist, squat, kneel, reach
  • Walk for long periods of time
  • Climb ladders up to 12’ tall
  • Lift up to 25 pounds frequently, 50 pounds occasionally
  • Push/pull carts containing product - occasionally up to 100 lbs
  • Operate power tools (screwdriver & drill)

About You:

  • Merchandising, retail or customer service experience (preferred, but not required)
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ensure tasks are completed efficiently with a strong sense of urgency
  • Represent the brand with professionalism and a positive attitude
  • Bring a flexible, adaptable mindset and enjoy collaborating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Eagerness to learn new skills with a safety-first mentality
  • Tech-savvy (smartphone, apps)

Ready to make an impact this holiday season? Apply today!

The hourly rate for this position is $18.50.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

How We Work:
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

  • We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
  • We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
  • We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

Who We Are:
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

Visit us at and .

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran and protected veteran status, disability status, and or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Pursuant to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act, qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

title: Biografmedarbejder til Bibliografen
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe gode oplevelser i et spændende, travlt og multifacetteret kulturhus?

Bibliografen søger teknisk servicemedarbejder, der har fokus på at skabe gode kultur, film- og gæsteoplevelser.

Bibliografen er et af Gladsaxe Kommunes fem bibliotekstilbud og et unikt kulturhus, hvor folkebibliotek og biograf er smeltet sammen til et samlet hus og 18 medarbejdere, der hver især løfter mangeartede opgaver. Vi har et dejligt biblioteksrum, en cafe, et film- og medieværksted, og to moderne biografsale, hvor vi både viser de nyeste premierefilm og har plads til spændende kultur- og litteraturarrangementer.

Vi har brug for en kollega, der:

  • Er over 18 år.
  • Er frisk på at afvikle kulturelle arrangementer, og vil være med til at sikre biografens drift, som en del af vores operatørteam.
  • Har teknisk snilde, og hurtigt kan sætte sig ind i nye softwaresystemer.
  • Er god med en PC, og er vant til at betjene forskellige tekniske apparater, samt elsker at fejlfinde, og opsøge de rette løsninger.
  • Har stort overblik, godt drive, og får ting til at ske herunder: uddelegerer opgaver og følge op på vores ungarbejdere på vagten.
  • Brænder for film, og har det i sin natur at være rummelig, tale med folk, og yde god service.
  • Har lyst til at betjene både biblioteks- og biografgæster, starte en film i biografen, finde en bog fra bibliotekets hylder og sælge biografbilletter, popcorn og kaffe i samme åndedrag,

Opgaverne indebærer bl.a:

  • Betjening af digitale filmfremviser, redigering af filmplaylister, samt afvikling og opstilling til særarrangementer og events.
  • Servicering af biografens gæster i cafe og billetsalg, soignering af publikumsarealer.
  • Supervision af biografens ungarbejdere herunder: instruktion, koordinering og opfølgning af opgaver, der skal løses på vagten.
  • At være åbne og lukkeansvarlig på vagterne.
  • Rapportering til Bibliografens ledelse.

Vi søger en handlekraftig kollega, der finder det naturligt at tage ansvar og altid har den gode service i centrum. Du er omgængelig, diplomatisk og initiativrig og ønsker at bidrage til et godt samarbejde samt en hjemlig og hyggelig stemning for vores gæster. Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra detail, biograf, IT og teknik, hotel/konference, eller anden relevant branche.

Det praktiske

Stillingen består af faste weekendvagter hver 2. weekend suppleret løbende med løsvagter på alle ugens dage, særligt i spidsbelastnings – og ferieperioder. Derudover må der påregnes ekstravagter i spidsbelastnings – og ferieperioder. Der afholdes løbende samtaler og tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger den gældende overenskomst.

Send din ansøgning til bibliografenbio@gladsaxe.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte leder af Bibliografen Kristina Bolmgreen på 24610316

title: Senior AI Engineer (Agentic AI / AWS)
description:
About Gramian

Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs.

About the Role

Our client is a Big4 Consultancy group that works with leading financial institutions on AI-driven transformation, automation, advanced analytics, and financial crime prevention. Their work spans intelligent fraud detection, AML/KYC modernization, autonomous workflows, enterprise AI platforms, and the secure industrialization of AI in highly regulated environments.

We are looking for Senior AI Engineers to design, build, and deploy production-grade autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, and LLM-powered enterprise applications. The role will work across multiple delivery squads and focus on reusable architecture, agent orchestration, tool integration, cloud deployment, and evaluation of long-running AI workflows.

CONTRACT: Contractor assignment, expected October 2026 – July 2027, with potential extension

COMMITMENT: Full-time

LOCATIONS: Europe-based, preferably CEE; remote, with potential future hybrid work in Prague

PROCESS: Initial qualification followed by technical and client interviews

NOTES: Fluent English is required. Strong AWS experience is highly preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and build production-grade autonomous AI agents and multi-agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Develop reusable agent patterns and technical standards across multiple engineering squads.
  • Integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, proprietary tools, and enterprise systems.
  • Implement reliable tool-calling and structured-output workflows.
  • Design and optimize prompt strategies, context management, memory, and agent state.
  • Build stable, long-running agent workflows with appropriate error handling and recovery mechanisms.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and evaluation frameworks for agent behavior and model outputs.
  • Support the deployment of AI systems on public cloud infrastructure, primarily AWS.
  • Apply MLOps/AIOps practices across versioning, testing, monitoring, and evaluation.
  • Collaborate with engineering, data, cloud, and business teams to deliver secure and scalable AI solutions.

Requirements

  • 5–10 years of professional software, data, or AI engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on development experience with Python.
  • Proven experience designing and integrating LLM-powered or agentic AI applications.
  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong experience with enterprise AI integration patterns including MCP, A2A, structured outputs, tool calling, or skills-based architectures.
  • Professional experience designing and deploying AI solutions on public cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
  • Experience with MLOps/AIOps practices, including versioning, testing, monitoring, and evaluations.
  • Fluent professional English.

title: Specialty ASM
description:
What You Will Do
All Lowe’s associates deliver quality customer service while maintaining a store that is clean, safe, and stocked with the products our customers need. As an Specialty Assistant Store Manager, this means:
• Anticipating customer flow and work demand and redirecting efforts and schedules to ensure proper coverage when and where needed.
• Planning for spikes in sales and ensuring the store has the in-stock position to support the demand.
• Conducting safety walks, monitoring use of store power equipment, and coaching associates around safe work practices.
The Specialty Assistant Store Manager leads a team of associates who work together to ensure our customers receive exceptional service while shopping in a clean, safe, well-stocked store. The Specialty Assistant Store Manager is accountable for achieving sales and margin goals while driving operational efficiencies and maximizing overall customer satisfaction with the Lowe’s in-store experience. At times, the Specialty Assistant Store Manager is expected to provide full leadership over the store.

The Specialty Assistant Store Manager collaborates with peers on the store leadership team as well as the District Manager and Area support staff to assess the needs of our customers and develop the best methods for achieving service, sales, and operational objectives. Role-specific assignments and priorities will be tailored to specialty areas such as cabinets, appliances, etc. Furthermore, this individual may be asked to rotate through Merchandising and Operations assignments for the purpose of cross-training and development.
Travel Requirements: This role does not require regular travel; however, this role may need to travel on occasion to meetings, trainings, or to support neighboring stores.

What We're Looking For
• Salaried: Generally scheduled for 48 hours; more hours may be required based on the needs of the business.
• Requires morning, afternoon and evening availability any day of the week.
• Physical ability to perform tasks that may require prolonged standing, sitting, and other activities necessary to perform job duties.
• Minimally must be able to lift 25 pounds without assistance; may lift over 25 pounds with or without assistance.

What You Need To Succeed
Minimum Qualifications
• 2 years of experience leading associates in a retail environment.
• 3 years of experience working in a fast-paced, cross-functional work environment.
• 1 year of experience performing manager-on-duty responsibilities, including management of daily store operations and processes within and beyond assigned areas of responsibility.
• 1 year of experience directly managing sales associates (commissioned or non-commissioned) in retail, business-to-business, outside sales, or consumer service industry.
• Experience using Microsoft Office Suite.
• Ability to obtain sales related licensure or registration as may be required by law.

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in related field.
• 5 years of experience directly managing a team of sales associates (commissioned or non-commissioned) in retail, business-to-business, outside sales, or consumer service industry.
• 3 years of experience performing manager-on-duty responsibilities, including management of daily store operations and processes within and beyond assigned areas of responsibility.
• Experience working in the home improvement retail sector.
• Broad knowledge of interior/exterior product categories (e.g., flooring, cabinets, millwork, building materials, appliances, home décor, lighting, plumbing).
• Experience working with store computer systems (including but not limited to: Project Tool, Genesis, M2O, Thin Client, etc.).

If the state or local municipality requires a salesperson license for this position, you must either be licensed or pass the requisite licensing exam within sixty (60) days of starting employment in this position.

About Lowe’s

Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week, with total fiscal year 2025 sales of more than $86 billion. Lowe's employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,700 home improvement stores, 530 branches and 130 distribution centers. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

Lowe’s is an equal opportunity employer and administers all personnel practices without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, gender, age, ancestry, national origin, mental or physical disability or medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other category protected under federal, state, or local law.

title: Specialbørnehjemmene søger pædagogiske medarbejdere eller omsorgs- og pædagogmedhjælpere til Krabben
description:
"Der er tid til fordybelse omkring det enkelte barn. Når arbejdet foregår en-til-en, er der kun dig og barnet – og det fælles rum, vi skaber." – Pædagog på Krabben

Har du interesse for at arbejde i et specialiseret pædagogisk felt med en kompleks målgruppe, hvor fordybelse og nærvær er i fokus? Vil du være en del af en faglig engageret gruppe, hvor faglighed, nysgerrighed og vedholdenhed er en naturlig del af hverdagen, og hvor refleksion og samarbejde er afgørende?

Så er du måske en af de medarbejdere, vi søger til afdeling Krabben.


Hvad skal du lave?

På Krabben arbejder vi med en 1:1-normering, hvilket betyder, at du har fokus på ét barn ad gangen, da børnene er udfordret af udadreagerende adfærd og arousalregulering. Det giver mulighed for at skabe en stærk relation og tilpasse pædagogikken til barnets individuelle behov.

En typisk arbejdsdag kan fx indeholde:

  • Struktur og forudsigelighed: Du hjælper barnet med at navigere i dagligdagen gennem visuelle skemaer og faste rutiner.
  • Sansestimulerende aktiviteter: Fx leg på trampolin, gynge eller en tur i nærområdet, der understøtter barnets trivsel.
  • Pædagogisk støtte: Du guider barnet i sociale situationer, træner selvstændighed og hjælper med arousal-regulering.
  • Fagligt samarbejde: Du indgår i teammøder, supervision og refleksion for at sikre den bedste indsats for barnet.
Nogle børn har brug for hjælp til personlig pleje og måltider, og du vil altid være en del af en gruppe, hvor vi støtter og hjælper hinanden.


Krabben som arbejdsplads

"Jeg bliver dagligt fagligt udfordret i vores tværprofessionelle læringsfællesskab, som er kendetegnet ved omsorg og vilje til målgruppen." – Pædagog på Krabben

Vi har meningsfuldt arbejde med faglig sparring, supervision og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, der sikrer støtte i en krævende, men givende hverdag.

Hos os er relationen i centrum. Med udgangspunkt i en forståelse af, at alle gør det bedste de kan, arbejder vi mentaliserende og møder barnet dér, hvor det er. Vi skaber struktur, tryghed og forudsigelighed – og vi står sammen, når det bliver svært og udfordrende.

Krabben er et hjem, hvor vi griner, leger, pjatter og danser til musik samtidig med, at vi arbejder med sansestimulerende aktiviteter og skaber udviklende relationer for børnene/de unge.

Vi arbejder med en 1:1 normering for at sikre nærvær og målrettet pædagogisk arbejde til en målgruppe med udfordringer i forhold til mental retardering, arousal-regulering og problemskabende adfærd. Vi anvender systematiske risikovurderinger, supervision og relations skifte for at skabe et trygt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø.


Vi tilbyder

"Jeg behøver ikke tage en fridag for at komme til lægen. Jeg kan aflevere mit barn sent eller hente tidligt. Jeg har tid til mig selv – og til at lade op." – Pædagog på Krabben

  • Skiftende arbejdstider med arbejde hver anden weekend.
  • Høj faglighed blandt dine kollegaer og mulighed for videreuddannelse.
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.
  • Et udfordrende, og meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du aldrig står alene.
  • Fleksibilitet i hverdagen, så du kan skabe balance mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv.
Vi søger en pædagogisk medarbejder eller omsorgs- og pædagogmedhjælper, der…

"Og så har vi bare et rigtigt godt kollegaskab. Det er både sjovt, spændende og krævende at arbejde her." – Pædagog på Krabben

  • Er hjertevarme og med en positiv indstilling.
  • Har kendskab til eller interesse for at lære neuropædagogik og low arousal pædagogik.
  • Kan kommunikere reflekteret og målrettet, både skriftligt og mundtligt.
  • Har kørekort.

Det praktiske

Vi har to ledige stillinger på 30-37 timer ugentligt med ansættelse pr. 1. september 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Ansættelsesaftaler afholdes løbende.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst for omsorgs- og pædagogmedhjælpere samt pædagogiske assistenter indgået med 3F, Socialpædagogerne og FOA samt i henhold til gældende overenskomst for Socialpædagogisk personale ved døgninstitutioner mv. indgået med Socialpædagogerne (SL).

I forbindelse med ansættelsen indhentes straffe- og børneattest.

Vil du vide mere? Kontakt afdelingsleder Stine Aarup Langballe Sørensen på tlf. 2118 9075 hverdage mellem kl. 10-12.

Du kan læse mere om Specialbørnehjemmene på vores hjemmeside og Gør karriere (rn.dk)

Kom med indenfor i hverdagen på Specialbørnehjemmene på Facebook: Specialbørnehjemmene, Specialsektoren, Region Nordjylland og på Instagram: Specialbørnehjemmene, Specialsektoren, Region Nordjylland (@specialboernehjemmene)


Om Krabben

Fjordhuset er et af Region Nordjyllands 4 specialbørnehjem og er beliggende i Nørresundby. Fjordhuset rummer blandt andet Krabben, hvor der er ledige stillinger.

På Krabben bor der 6 fastboende børn og unge samt 3 i aflastning, i aldersgruppen 4-17 år. Det fysiske og kognitive funktionsniveau varierer, og ingen fungerer alderssvarende. Funktionsniveauet er varierende, men alle er mobile og fysisk aktive. Nogle har brug for hjælp til alt fra personlig hygiejne til ernæring, mens andre med støtte og guidning varetager det mere selvstændigt.

Gennemgående har de problemer med at regulere arousal, og har brug for fuldstændig støtte til at regulere sig. Derfor har alle en 1:1 normering. Denne normering er med til at skabe mulighed for et unikt udviklende relations arbejde.

Af diagnoser kan nævnes autismespektrumforstyrrelser, ADHD og tilknytnings- forstyrrelser m.m. Flere har intet eller begrænset verbalt sprog, hvorfor der arbejdes med alternativ og supplerende kommunikation.

Alle har brug for en individuel tilrettelagt, genkendelig, forudsigelig og struktureret hverdag, hvor der tages udgangspunkt i den professionelle relation, neuropædagogik og low arousal. Der er behov for fuldstændig specialpædagogisk støtte i forhold til adfærd, kontakt og samspil med omverdenen.

Børnene/de unge på Krabben har brug for et sansestimulerende miljø. Vi benytter nærmiljøet til små ture, da børnene/de unge har behov for skærmning og begrænsning af stimuli.

Vi har børn og unge, der har udfordringer med at kontrollere impulser, krav, følelse, uforudsete ting, tab af kontrol m.v., som kan resultere i massiv udadreagerende eller selvskadende adfærd.

title: Systems Administrator Specialist
description:
This role is for one of Weekday’s clients


Min Experience: 1+ years
Location: Nebraska, United States
JobType: full-time

Base Salary: Approximately $60,000–$80,000 + Annual Bonus
Work Mode: On-site

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Systems Administrator to join a growing Information Systems team within an established global manufacturing environment. This is an opportunity to help build and strengthen a dedicated IT function while taking ownership across infrastructure, systems, virtualization, connectivity, security, hardware, and end-user support.

The ideal candidate will be technically versatile, approachable, and comfortable supporting a broad user base while maintaining strong IT standards and best practices. As the team develops, this role can provide a path toward greater ownership and potential leadership responsibilities.

You will support an environment of approximately 800 users and work across a wide range of systems administration responsibilities.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and support Windows-based servers, workstations, and IT infrastructure.
  • Manage and maintain Microsoft Windows and Active Directory environments.
  • Support VMware and server virtualization platforms.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity, and end-user issues.
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, access, and system configurations.
  • Support networking infrastructure, including switches, connectivity, and related systems.
  • Assist with backup, recovery, security, and infrastructure continuity initiatives.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, and overall infrastructure health.
  • Provide responsive technical support to users across the organization.
  • Help establish and enforce sound IT policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Participate in infrastructure transitions and improvements as the new IT function develops.
  • Document systems, processes, configurations, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Collaborate with technology leaders and other IT team members on infrastructure initiatives.
  • Help train and mentor future team members as the department expands.
  • Remain hands-on while gradually taking on broader technical and leadership responsibilities.

Requirements

  • Approximately 8–10 years of progressive IT experience.
  • Several years of hands-on systems administration experience.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Windows and Active Directory.
  • Experience with VMware and server virtualization.
  • Hands-on knowledge of servers, workstations, hardware, and end-user support.
  • Exposure to networking, switches, backups, connectivity, and IT security.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with both technical teams and non-technical users.
  • Comfortable maintaining IT standards and explaining technical requirements to users.
  • Desire to remain technically hands-on while developing toward future leadership responsibilities.
  • Manufacturing or industrial IT experience is helpful but not required.
  • Associate or bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

  • Help build and shape a developing infrastructure and support function.
  • Work across the full systems administration environment rather than a narrow technical specialty.
  • Gain exposure to experienced technology leaders and established enterprise systems.
  • Take increasing ownership as the IT function grows.
  • Help train and develop future members of the technology team.
  • Potential pathway toward a supervisory or leadership position.
  • Join a stable organization with strong benefits and long-tenured employees.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: Approximately $60,000–$80,000.
  • Higher compensation may be considered for exceptional candidates.
  • Annual performance bonus opportunity, historically around one month's salary, based on company performance and not guaranteed.
  • Health insurance.
  • 401(k).
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • On-site amenities.
  • Limited on-call responsibilities, typically handled remotely.
  • Relocation assistance may be available.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a dependable systems professional who enjoys solving problems, working directly with users, and understanding how different parts of an IT environment work together. You should be comfortable taking ownership, learning established systems, improving infrastructure, and enforcing good IT practices while remaining collaborative and approachable.

Good-to-have skills:

  • Microsoft Windows
  • Active Directory
  • VMware
  • Server Administration
  • IT Infrastructure
  • Networking
  • Technical Support

title: GENOPSLAG - LÆRER MED MATEMATIK, NATURFAG (MELLEMTRIN OG UDSKOLING) SØGES TIL RUNDHØJSKOLEN I HØJBJERG.
description:
Vi søger en lærer til Rundhøjskolens mellemtrin og udskoling

På Rundhøjskolen leder vi efter en lærer, der har lyst til at sætte sit præg på hverdagen, byde ind med idéer og være en aktiv medspiller i et stærkt professionelt fællesskab. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes sammen, og vi værdsætter lærere, der er nysgerrige på deres egen praksis og tør udvikle den i samarbejde med kolleger.

Du arbejder bevidst med dine pædagogiske og didaktiske valg, følger elevernes læring tæt og justerer undervisningen, så den rammer dér, hvor eleverne er. Samtidig møder du eleverne med høje forventninger, engagement og blik for den enkelte.

En særlig del af stillingen er klasselærerfunktionen i vores 9. klasses elitesportsklasse. Her får du en central rolle i at skabe et stærkt og trygt klassefællesskab for unge mennesker, der hver dag balancerer ambitioner i både skolen og sporten. Klassen består af nogle af Aarhus' mest dedikerede unge elitesportsudøvere, og du bliver en vigtig voksen i deres hverdag, når du sammen med kolleger, elever og forældre understøtter både faglig udvikling, trivsel og sportslige ambitioner.

Vi søger en lærer, der skaber tydelige rammer og varieret undervisning, som motiverer eleverne til aktiv deltagelse. Du interesserer dig for elevernes trivsel, er i løbende dialog med dem og formår at skabe læringsmiljøer, hvor alle oplever sig som en værdifuld del af fællesskabet.

Din primære tilknytning bliver til udskolingen, men du vil også undervise på mellemtrinnet, blandt andet i matematik. Derfor søger vi en lærer, der trives med at arbejde på tværs af årgange og ser styrken i at følge elevernes udvikling gennem flere skoleår.

Du deltager i fælles aktiviteter og samarbejder konstruktivt og professionelt med engagerede og fagligt stærke kolleger.

Skolens profil:

Rundhøjskolen har en tydelig og levende idræts- og bevægelsesprofil, og vores motto er “Hvor man trives, lærer man”. Vi arbejder ud fra, at trivsel, bevægelse og fællesskab er en naturlig del af skoledagen, og du inddrager bevægelse i undervisningen, når det understøtter læring og deltagelse.

Din profil:

Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet lærer med undervisningskompetence i matematik og naturfagene. Derfor kan du se dig selv undervise i både matematik samt fysik/kemi, geografi og biologi i udskolingen.

Vi ønsker os, at du:

  • møder eleverne med tydelighed, interesse og høje forventninger og er nysgerrig på deres faglige og personlige udvikling
  • skaber stærke relationer gennem anerkendende kommunikation og et vedvarende fokus på trivsel
  • trives i et professionelt samarbejde med kolleger og forældre og ser fælles løsninger som en styrke
  • kan skabe struktur og ro i hverdagen gennem klare rammer og tydelige forventninger
  • har blik for elevernes ressourcer og motiveres af at flytte dem fagligt og personligt
  • arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for planlægning, gennemførelse og evaluering af undervisningen
  • ser værdi i at omsætte mål og planer til meningsfuld undervisning, der engagerer eleverne

På Rundhøjskolen bliver du en del af en skole med høje ambitioner på elevernes vegne og et stærkt fokus på fællesskab og trivsel. Vi er stolte af, at både elever, forældre og medarbejdere oplever høj trivsel, og at vores faglige løfteevne på 0,4 er blandt de højeste i Aarhus Kommune.

Hos os bliver du en del af et professionelt læringsfællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden og udvikler vores praksis sammen. Vi tror på, at stærke relationer, faglig nysgerrighed og fælles ansvar er vejen til de bedste resultater for eleverne.

Derfor skal du vælge os:

På Rundhøjskolen bliver du en del af en skole med tydelige rammer, høje ambitioner og et stærkt fællesskab. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når faglighed, trivsel og samarbejde går hånd i hånd, og derfor investerer vi både i vores elever og medarbejdere.

Hos os får du:

  • et trygt og velfungerende arbejdsmiljø, hvor sparring, humor og professionel dialog er en naturlig del af hverdagen
  • dygtige, nysgerrige og engagerede elever, som møder undervisningen med lyst til at lære og udvikle sig
  • engagerede forældre, der ser skolen som en vigtig samarbejdspartner
  • et tæt samarbejde med PPR og Familiecentret, så du aldrig står alene med komplekse problemstillinger
  • en skole, hvor faglig udvikling og trivsel prioriteres højt, både for elever og medarbejdere
  • gode betingelser for undervisning, herunder en målrettet prioritering af undervisning med to uddannede voksne
  • en stærk idræts- og bevægelsesprofil, som præger skolens kultur og hverdag

Som matematik- og naturfagslærer bliver du en del af stærke faglige fællesskaber. Vores matematikfaggruppe er velfungerende og understøttes af to engagerede matematikvejledere, som bidrager med sparring og udvikling. På tværs af årgange og klasser arbejder vi tæt sammen om planlægning, undervisning og elevudvikling, fordi vi ved, at vi lykkes bedst i fællesskab.

Du bliver også en del af et engageret naturfagsteam, hvor faglig nysgerrighed, samarbejde og lysten til at udvikle undervisningen er drivkræfter. Vi prioriterer sparring, videndeling og fælles udvikling af naturfagsundervisningen, så vi sammen kan skabe meningsfulde læringsoplevelser for eleverne.

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen, så send os din ansøgning. Vi kan ikke garantere, at fysiklokalet altid har præcis det udstyr, du drømmer om, eller at alle 9. klasseselever elsker matematik kl. 8.00, men vi kan garantere engagerede kolleger, stærke fællesskaber og en skole, der vil noget.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst.

Ugentligt timetal: 37

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger kan fås på skolens hjemmeside: og ved henvendelse til udskolingsleder Michael Yde 20 25 68 45 eller viceskoleleder Louise Barner 41 85 59 00.

Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.
Husk at uddannelsesbevis/eksamensbevis skal vedhæftes ansøgningen.

Ansøgningsfrist er 10/9-2026. Samtaler afholdes 16/9-2026

Om os

Rundhøjskolen er en lokal forankret folkeskole med distriktsklasser fra 0.-9. og syv specialklasser og en stærk idrætsprofil, herunder fem idrætstalentklasser (ESAA) fordelt på 8.-10. klassetrin.

Alle elever i 0.-9. klasse har i gennemsnit en hel lektion idræt og bevægelse på skoleskemaet om dagen.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen på årgangene – i indskolingen også med klassepædagogerne.

Årsplaner bliver til i fællesskab og ugeplaner laves i alle klasser i alle fag.

Rundhøjskolen tæller omkring 630 motiverede elever og 80 engagerede medarbejdere. Vores værdier er faglighed, trivsel og fællesskab, og vores motto er ‘hvor man trives, lærer man’.




Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Full Time - Loader/Cart Associate - Opening
description:
Key Responsibilities
  • Customer Service
  • Provides SMART customer service through the execution of Lowe’s customer service policies, procedures, and programs
  • Assists customers with locating, selecting, carrying, and loading merchandise while responding promptly to customers and associate questions
  • Supports checkout, fulfillment, and customer assistance needs throughout the store
  • Pulls, stages, and prepares customer and contractor orders accurately and efficiently
  • Use power equipment and store technology safely and effectively to move, stage, and load merchandise
  • Maintains in-stock conditions by down stocking and replenishing merchandise as needed
  • Supports large order fulfillment while maintaining product quality and accuracy
  • Collect carts and help maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas inside the store and parking lot
  • Identifies and reports safety hazards, theft, and security concerns to management and/or Asset Protection
  • Operates store equipment as needed depending on one specific role and department (e.g., Zebra phone, telephone, paging system, copiers, computers, CCTV surveillance system, key cutter, panel saw, paint mixer, flooring cutters, compacter baler)
  • Communicates all stock, special order merchandise, product features, application, warranty, and Lowe’s program information to customers, while responding knowledgeably to customer and employee questions and providing project guidance when needed.
  • Follows all Lowe’s safety policies and procedures, including proper use of power equipment, spotters and safety devices
  • Performs additional duties as assigned
  • The following are additional responsibilities for the Loader role specific to Pro.
    • Serves as a visible extension of the Pro Desk by supporting Pro customer relationships from arrival through order completion
    • Proactively engage Pro customers while assisting with loading, staging, and order fulfillment
    • Remains visible and available to support customers in the Pro loading area, including under the Pro canopy
    • Responds quickly to customer loading requests and helps ensure efficient service for large or complex orders
    • Builds relationships with repeat Pro customers and supports enrollment in MyLowe’s Pro Rewards and Pro Credit offerings
    • Ensures Pro Standards are maintained in parking lot and under Pro canopy.
    • Completes required power equipment and spotter training to support safe and efficient loading practices
    • Loads customer vehicles using proper techniques based on order size, weight, and fulfillment needs
    • Ensure orders are loaded accurately while maintaining product quality and safety standards
  • The following are additional responsibilities for the Loader role specific to the Garden Center.
    • Assists customers and associates with loading products and completing orders in the Garden Center
    • Remains visible and available to support customer needs throughout the Garden Center loading area
    • Completes required power equipment and spotter training to support safe and efficient loading practices
    • Loads customer vehicles using proper techniques based on order size, weight, and fulfillment needs
    • Supports the completion of large, high-quality orders while maintaining product accuracy and safety
    • Partners with the Garden Center Department Supervisor to ensure customer orders are staged and ready for pickup

Required Qualifications
  • 6 Months Experience using a computer, including inputting, accessing, modifying, or outputting information
  • 6 Months Experience using common retail technology, such as smart phones and tablets
  • Ability to obtain sales related licensure or registration as may be required by law

Preferred Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED
  • 6 Months Retail experience
  • 6 Months Experience as a Loader at any home improvement or hardware retailer
  • 6 Months Retail merchandising experience, including performing Zone Recovery, stocking, down stocking, facing/fronting product, pricing, maintaining signage, and housekeeping
  • 6 Months Experience in any industry inspecting, carrying, loading, and unloading product or material in or out of vehicles.
Pay Range: $16.94 - $16.94 per hour

Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. For information regarding our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit .

Associate Benefits ()

We offer exceptional benefits and wellness programs for eligible full-time and part-time associates, tailored for many different lifestyles. Our benefits range from health, vision and dental insurance to paid vacation, tuition assistance and parental and family-building benefits. Plus, we offer learning and development opportunities to help our associates grow their skills and achieve their goals.

title: Spécialiste Standard
description:
Business Introduction We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance.
Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply.
We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients. Position Summary Vous garantirez l’application cohérente des normes, spécifications et processus pour les matières entrantes. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes qualité, fabrication, réglementation et approvisionnement. Nous cherchons une personne qui agit avec rigueur, communication claire et sens pratique. Ce poste offre des opportunités d’évolution, un impact concret sur les opérations et l’occasion de contribuer à notre mission : unir la science, la technologie et les talents pour prendre de l’avance sur la maladie, ensemble. This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Maintenir et mettre à jour les normes techniques et les spécifications des matières entrantes. - Soutenir la mise en œuvre des normes dans les opérations de fabrication et qualité. - Examiner et approuver la documentation technique, les demandes de changement et les écarts liés aux normes. - Travailler avec les équipes transversales pour identifier et conduire des actions d’amélioration. - Former et coacher les équipes locales sur les normes et bonnes pratiques. - Suivre les indicateurs, préparer des rapports et fournir des éléments pour la prise de décision. Why You? Type de travail : hybride, minimum trois jours par semaine sur site. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals - Diplôme Bac+5 en chimie des matériaux, ingénierie, sciences pharmaceutiques ou domaine similaire. - Minimum 2 ans d’expérience en normes, qualité, opérations techniques ou rôle équivalent en environnement réglementé. - Expérience en documentation technique, gestion de modifications et gestion d’écarts. - Connaissance des exigences réglementaires françaises et européennes pertinentes. - Aptitude à travailler en équipe interfonctionnelle et à communiquer clairement. - Maîtrise du français et bonne maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’écrit et à l’oral. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus - Expérience de projets d’harmonisation des normes au niveau international. - Connaissance des systèmes de management de la qualité et des méthodes d’amélioration continue. - Expérience en environnement de fabrication pharmaceutique en France. - Compétences analytiques solides et sens du détail. - Expérience en conception et animation de formations techniques. - Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités et à respecter les délais. Localisation et contexte Le poste est rattaché à un site de production en France. Une présence sur site au minimum trois jours par semaine est requise pour ce rôle hybride. Join us and help make a measurable difference in health through practical, collaborative work.

Skills

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Summary

Lead the Strategy Deployment, PMO, and Governance agenda for the PSAI business, serving as the custodian of enterprise-wide execution excellence across the global API and API+ B2B portfolio. The role is responsible for translating strategic priorities into measurable outcomes, driving governance-led transformation, institutionalizing performance management rhythms, and ensuring rigorous execution of priorities and critical business initiatives. As a trusted advisor to the PSAI Business Head, the incumbent will orchestrate cross-functional alignment, accelerate decision-making, proactively mitigate risks, and enhance organizational effectiveness to deliver sustainable business growth, customer success, and long-term value creation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive the end-to-end PSAI Strategy Deployment Process (SDP), translating business strategy into actionable objectives, KPIs, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead the PMO for PSAI priorities, strategic transformation initiatives, and enterprise programs, ensuring disciplined execution, milestone achievement, risk mitigation, and realization of intended business benefits.
  • Establish and institutionalize a robust performance governance framework, including business reviews, operating reviews, scorecards, dashboards, and action-tracking mechanisms to improve execution transparency and accountability.
  • Drive governance-led transformation across API and API+ businesses by implementing structured operating mechanisms, decision forums, escalation protocols, and performance management disciplines.
  • Partner with commercial, operations, supply chain, quality, R&D, finance, and enabling functions to ensure seamless cross-functional alignment and timely delivery of strategic, customer, and operational priorities.
  • Provide strategic counsel to support decision-making on critical business, organizational, operational, and stakeholder matters.
  • Identify enterprise risks, execution bottlenecks, and interdependencies, driving proactive interventions and corrective actions to sustain strategic momentum.
  • Lead executive-level review forums and governance meetings, ensuring high-quality insights, fact-based discussions, timely decisions, and closure of agreed actions.
  • Build enterprise-wide visibility through management dashboards, KPI scorecards, and business analytics that enable performance monitoring and informed decision-making.
  • Foster a culture of execution excellence, continuous improvement, ownership, and outcome orientation across PSAI's global B2B business.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification from a premier institution preferred.
  • 2+ years in strategy execution, transformation, PMO, business excellence, consulting, or governance-led roles.
  • Proven experience in driving enterprise-wide strategic initiatives, strategy deployment, operating reviews, and transformation programs in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Certification in Project Management, Strategy Execution, Business Transformation, Lean/Six Sigma, or Program Management will be an added advantage.
  • Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, preferably APIs, API+, CDMO/CMO, formulations, and global B2B business models.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Executive Stakeholder Management
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Strategy Deployment & Execution
  • Business Analytics & Insight Generation
  • Financial and Commercial Understanding
  • Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
  • Strategic Problem Solving & Decision Support
  • Business Acumen in API, API+, CDMO/CMO, and Global B2B Markets

Our Work Culture
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/

title: (Senior) Transformatie Consultant
description:
Organisaties staan voor ingrijpende (digitale) veranderingen: nieuwe technologie, andere manieren van samenwerken, aangepaste processen en veranderend gedrag. In de practice Transformation Management begeleiden wij deze transformaties end‑to‑end, waarbij change & adoptie geen bijzaak is, maar een integraal onderdeel van het programma.

Als (Senior) Transformatie Consultant help jij organisaties om veranderingen niet alleen te ontwerpen, maar ook te laten landen, werken en beklijven. Je werkt op het snijvlak van strategie, uitvoering en menselijk gedrag en zorgt ervoor dat technologische en organisatorische veranderingen leiden tot duurzame business‑impact.

Deze rol draait om inhoud, delivery en samenwerking. Je staat zelf in het veld, werkt nauw samen met klanten en bent een trusted advisor voor management en directie.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt aan complexe transformaties bij organisaties in verschillende sectoren, vaak in een digitale of IT‑gedreven context. Afhankelijk van de opdracht vervul je rollen zoals change lead, transformation consultant of adoptie‑lead binnen grotere programma’s.

Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwerpen, uitvoeren en begeleiden van change‑ en adoptiestrategieën binnen (digitale) transformaties
  • Zorgen dat veranderingen worden geïmplementeerd, omarmd en verankerd in de organisatie
  • Leiden van change‑trajecten als onderdeel van bredere transformatieprogramma’s
  • Adviseren van leiders en sleutelstakeholders over hun rol in verandering en gedragsverandering
  • Actief stakeholdermanagement op meerdere niveaus (van medewerkers tot directie)
  • Integreren van change‑aanpak in programma‑ en projectsturing
  • Weerstand signaleren en ombuigen naar betrokkenheid en eigenaarschap
  • Faciliteren van workshops en sessies om draagvlak, inzicht en actie te creëren

Naast je werk bij klanten:

  • Draag je bij aan de ontwikkeling van de Transformation Management‑propositie
  • Werk je mee aan voorstellen, pitches en offertes
  • Deel je kennis en coach je junior consultants binnen de practice

Je bent een inhoudelijk sterke change professional die zich comfortabel voelt in complexe omgevingen en energie krijgt van het werken met mensen én systemen.

  • HBO‑ of WO‑opleiding
  • Minimaal 3 jaar consultancy-ervaring in change management, organisatieadvies of (digitale) transformaties
